It is undefined behavior to reside within SCP-8289 outside of a scheduled meeting. SCP-8289 is formally designated Room-70-094-8289, a 12-person meeting room in Site-70. The SCP-8289 research staff has been optimized to an automated containment and calendar booking system.

(null)
Mickey Mouse from Steamboat Willie (unaffiliated with the Walt Disney Company)

SCP-8290 is a thaumatological entity resembling the character Mickey Mouse in the 1928 film Steamboat Willie. Its measurements fluctuate due to its unique physiology, though it typically hovers around 50 cm in height and 50 grams in weight. SCP-8290 appears unable to communicate outside of grunts and laughs, and attempts to communicate have thus far failed See Addendum 8290.5.

SCP-8290 exhibits minor reality warping abilities, essentially creating its own laws of physics. It has thus far shown an ability to retrieve items such as hammers and vegetable peelers from "hammer space", flatten its body to fit through cracks, and stretch its limbs and body up to five times their normal length.

SCP-8291 is a non-aging female human possessing seeming hyper-endurance and regenerative abilities. SCP-8291 has historically been referred to merely as "Orlando", with no known surname associated with it. Personnel are yet to communicate with SCP-8291 verbally.
SCP-8292 is a phenomenon affecting medical professionals.

SCP-8293 appears to be a highly intelligent male albino specimen of Rattus norvegicus that is 31 cm head to tail.

Due to a thaumaturgical accident, SCP-8293 possesses a large quantity of innate thaumaturgical power (used to speak and to transform ordinary items into cheese), and a significantly higher intelligence.

SCP-8294 is a nebulous meta-physical phenomenon. It is theorized that SCP-8294 may possess consciousness, although this hypothesis is currently untestable. SCP-8294 possesses reality bending properties that enable it to affect and erase portions of consensus reality. SCP-8294 can also alter the memories and personalities of sapient lifeforms.

SCP-8294 is sensitive to human apathy with regards to work and personal care tasks. The anomaly finds targets utilizing the SCP-8294-CH1 cognitohazard, and if a target is vulnerable to SCP-8294’s influence, it will begin completing tasks for the affected individual using its reality bending abilities. Eventually, reality will be altered ensuring said tasks are rendered obsolete.

SCP-8295 is an anomalous variant of iron. Upon entering a living creature, SCP-8295 begins to self-replicate, forming metallic structures within the host. Over 4-7 hours, spikes, spines, and occasionally canine teeth made of raw iron grow inside the blood vessels, resulting in massive internal trauma. SCP-8295 structures have been observed to grow serrated as they expand, sawing flesh and digging into bone. Death usually occurs after the heart or lungs are punctured by SCP-8295, or due to blood loss as dozens of spikes pierce the skin.

Following death, SCP-8295 will grow to encase the host skeleton, before continuing to expand in all directions for 3-5 hours.

SCP-8296 is a phenomenon which compels individuals, hereafter designated SCP-8296-A, to ascend to a high altitude during a thunderstorm before instantly erasing them from reality. In 59% of cases, SCP-8296-A instances are employees of the Foundation.

SCP-8296-A instances become unnaturally calm and content, expressing no desire other than to go outside. If prevented from doing so, they will become cold and still. These effects will appear to wear off at the storm's end, but will reemerge as soon as another begins. This can only be prevented by ending the instance's employment at the organization, and erasing all memories of the Veiled world.

SCP-8296-A instances unaware of the Veil cannot be saved.
SCP-8297 is a spherical pocket dimension roughly one kilometer in diameter, resembling a temperate North American rainforest.

SCP-8298 is the designation given to a pseudo-anomalous utility system created by the Department of Psionics, with its primary objective being to disrupt paranatural events.

SCP-8298 operates through a series of sonar-based relays, passively recording fluctuations in psionic energy before activating in situations where a selected psionic output is created. Following detection, the secondary mechanism of SCP-8298 activates.

Ionic Actualization-3 waves are created by an amplifying generator before being directed to the location of an incident by SCP-8298's quasi-psionic controller. Upon arrival, this psionic energy interacts through constructive interference with psionic residue to form an SCP-8298-1 Instance.
SCP-8299 TRUE NORTH STRONG AND FREE By Spacestealth & Lt Flops Published on 30 Apr 2024

SCP-8300 is the complete and instantaneous cessation of all anomalous phenomena on December 31st, 2023. This comes to fruition in different ways depending on the kind of anomaly being affected. For example:
• Anomalous entities whose anomalous properties are central to their existence perish or otherwise vanish from baseline reality.
• Anomalous entities with anomalous capabilities not central to their existence lose said abilities.
• Anomalous objects lose their properties or cease to exist entirely.
• Anomalous locations lose their properties, cease to exist, or slowly regress into an alternate, "normal" form.
• Anomalous events cease occurrence.

Currently, the reason for SCP-8300 is unknown, as is whether the effect of the anomaly is permanent.

SCP-8301 is a 24-year-old adult male identified as Adam Scherer, apprehended by Foundation operatives on May 14th, 2025, near an apartment complex in Woodstock, Vermont. SCP-8301 is equipped with a featureless prison uniform and numerous physical restraints. A 14kg metallic sphere—affixed by a chain—is fused to the subject’s left ankle and surrounding bone and nerve tissue. The object shows signs of prolonged wear inconsistent with SCP-8301’s age.

Penetrative scans of SCP-8301 indicate extensive physiological abnormalities. Foreign materials, including metal, cloth, and dense organic matter, have been precisely integrated into the subject's anatomy despite no apparent physical trauma, consistent with hybridized somatic fusion.

SCP-8302 refers to an unidentified cetacean discovered following the tracking of an annual, periodic call resonating at 52 hertz. Its sonic signature is comprised of an unusually high frequency as well as characteristic cluttering.

The following is a 15-second recording of SCP-8302's call.

SCP-8303 is a species of unknown origin resembling large, tumor-like masses. While the lifecycle of SCP-8303 and its method of reproduction is still poorly understood, what is known is that SCP-8303 instances begin as small masses in the shape of oblate spheroids growing below ground in warm climates. Surrounding this mass is a vast network of tendrils resembling blood vessels, which absorb nutrients, organic matter, and water from the soil at a disproportionately high rate, eventually rendering the soil sterile. The underground mass of SCP-8303 instances typically reach 20 to 30 meters in diameter.

SCP-8304 is a DVD containing an amateur drama film titled "The Butterfly's Egg", created by Kevin Fox. The film follows Joshua Christophers as he falls in love with and attempts to redeem a criminal named Audrey. A full copy of the film's known transcript is available upon request. The film's anomalous properties manifest approximately 25 minutes into its runtime, when Joshua takes Audrey on a date by a river. The remains of a subadult Lutra lutra (Eurasian otter), designated SCP-8304-1, can be seen in the background of this shot before falling into the river. Subjects viewing the scene become convinced that SCP-8304-1 holds symbolic importance, and will focus on this perceived symbolism at the expense of the rest of the film.

SCP-8305 is an antique artisanal silver fork. A message saying "from P to I" is inscribed beneath the beetle at the bottom of the handle. SCP-8305 shows no anomalous characteristics outside of use. Once SCP-8305 has been stabbed into an organic subject and is twisted at least 180 degrees, all of the flesh inside the subject will liquefy. An outer husk of 2.5 cm is spared from this anomalous effect and appears to be unaffected. This husk creates a barrier in which the residual matter can be kept within the subject. Subjects who ingest the liquefied subject experience euphoria followed by intoxication, similar to that of alcohol. These effects last longer depending on how much matter the subject consumed.

SCP-8306 is believed to be one of the first RUNS RED anomalies to have manifested from SCP-8987, as reports and references to it within recovered mine documents date back to 1963, around the same time frame that SCP-8987's activation events began affecting the operations at the Red Brook Mine.

Appearing similar to a baseline human male of roughly 60 years in age, SCP-8306 is usually dressed in miner's attire typical of the 1960s, and is often seen carrying related equipment. Its eyes and mouth are empty and agape, its skin is pale. More often than not, SCP-8306 is caked in mud and coal dust.

SCP-8307 is a steel gladius with a total length of 54 cm from the hilt to the blade's tip. It is estimated to have been created between 100 and 400 CE. It has been observed to alternate locations between Llyn Llydaw, Dozmary Pool, and Llyn Ogwen. When SCP-8307 is received by a chosen individual, a spiral-class hermeneutic is activated.

Within the first week of activation, the recipient of SCP-8307 is promoted to a position of power within their community. Individuals associated with the recipient, including friends and family, are at risk of being compromised by the hermeneutic.

Each individual involved is assigned the role of a character from Arthurian legend, with the recipient always being assigned “King Arthur”.

SCP-8308 is Tony Wilhelm, author of ██ novels in the 'pulp fantasy' genre. It assertedly has the ability to perceive other realities, which highly resemble SCP-8308's novels. However, it is currently unknown how much of its work was inspired by its visions. The exact mechanisms and limits of SCP-8308's abilities are also unknown.

SCP-8309 is a humanoid entity measuring 1.90 m in height, outfitted with Swiss Armed Forces–issue equipment consisting of a TAZ 83 rain cape, Sharktec-CP gloves, and KS 90 footwear. Its face is obscured by a black gas mask of unknown manufacture with tinted lenses preventing visual of its features.

SCP-8309 consistently avoids direct human visual contact, maintaining maximum distance and utilizing cover when possible. Although it offers no visible resistance, it is believed to deliberately induce a telepathic aversion in personnel attempting physical contact, preventing the action.

SCP-8310 is a Ambystoma mexicanum measuring at 43 cm in length and 7 cm in width, with a weight of 28 grams.

The anomalous properties of SCP-8310 stem from its anthropomorphic qualities that allow it to stand up like a human on its hind legs and breathe oxygen, along with the ability to converse in Early Modern English. SCP-8310 is able to discuss most topics at length, suggesting human-level intelligence. SCP-8310 believes it is Macbeth from the Shakespearean tale of the same name.

SCP-8310-1 is any individual with Macduff, or Malcolm, in their names that is recognized as having such by SCP-8310.

AO-8311 is a lightly singed deck of 25 Zener cards. Unlike a standard deck, where each symbol is only one color, every symbol appears in all five of the colors of the deck, making each card unique from every other.

When concentrating on the back of a card from the deck, subjects will experience one of twenty-five psychic impressions, depending on the card. These are all suspected to correspond to memories belonging to an individual dubbed PoI-8311.

SCP-8312-81 is a manifestation of SCP-8312 in the form of a pink fungus, growing exclusively on rusted metal surfaces. SCP-8312-81 was first recorded following the shortage of Class-E personnel at Site-28 due to a structural failure, resulting in an incomplete execution of Procedure PHARMAKOI. Since then, SCP-8312-81 has been recorded at Sites -21, -38, -19, -17 and -87, accounting for half of all SCP Foundation facilities.

When smoked, SCP-8312-81 possesses dissociative qualities, commonly found in drugs such as ketamine or nitrous oxide. This has led to its use as a recreational drug among Class-D and Class-C personnel, with small criminal groups forming around its cultivation and sale.

SCP-8313 refers to Westwood St. Church of Christ's 1998 trip to Good Brook Bible Camp, which has continued uninterrupted for 27 years as of 2025. Prior to their amnesticization, members of Westwood St. did not appear to find the length of the camping trip noteworthy, and would donate canned goods and bottled water each Summer. No notable behavior has been observed in the church post-amnesticization.

SCP-8313 began on 7/12/98, and was planned to end on 7/24/98. On that date, however, campers and facilitators merely repeated their schedule from one week prior, seemingly unaware the trip had exceeded its intended thirteen-day duration.

SCP-8314 is the fictional character "Donkey Kong", originally developed by Nintendo Co. for the 1981 arcade game Donkey Kong. SCP-8314 is depicted as an anthropomorphic gorilla with a peaked hairstyle and red necktie labeled "DK". Prior to its development of anomalous properties, SCP-8314 was featured in dozens of video games, which collectively sold over 200 million copies, as well as several animated cartoons and a wide variety of fan-created content.

All visual depictions of SCP-8314 show it as a corpse. This applies to both pre-existing depictions and ones created after SCP-8314 became anomalous. In every case, SCP-8314 will appear lifeless and unmoving, with no apparent injuries or signs of decay.
No Fault Found with the SFMR

SCP-8315 is a Philips 20PT5441/37 CRT television exhibiting unique predatory behaviour. SCP-8315 demonstrates the ability to leech off electrical potential from the cerebrum of living humans within a 5 meter radius, this sudden change in cerebral voltage is invariably and instantaneously fatal to the victim. Although SCP-8315 should theoretically be capable of feeding off any part of the cerebrum, it displays a marked preference for parts associated with memory, imagination and critical thinking, often solely targeting them.

SCP-8315 was acquired by the Foundation under a containment contract by the H&C Paranatural Office, the first to be awarded to the Foundation.

SCP-8316 is the designation given to the human remains discovered on 27/2/2001. The corpse, while mostly consistent with baseline humans, contained some dissimilarities that were noted during an autopsy.
• SCP-8316 is heavily antimemetic
• SCP-8316 had dark blood, noted to be thicker than baseline
• SCP-8316 had black bone marrow
• SCP-8316 had no eyes within its sockets, presumed to have rotted
• SCP-8316 lacked a brain

Upon discovery, it was noted that its damaged skull and facial orifices contained SCP-8316-1.

SCP-8316-1 is the 1.2 liters of substance that was recovered during cleanup. It is a thick, black, iridescent ooze of unknown nature and unknown origin.

SCP-8317 refers to a CK-Class Reality Restructuring Scenario that took place as a result of temporal alteration in the United Kingdom in mid-1990. During this time GOI-8317("Man. U. Eternal"), a group of time-travelers with a vested interest in altering the outcome of football matches, attempted to interfere with a match involving the Manchester United and Arsenal Football Clubs; their actions inadvertently resulted in changes to the timeline that primarily altered western popular culture.

SCP-8317 is believed to be connected to an attack GOI-8317 carried out on the Manchester Piccadilly railway station, which resulted in a four-day-long disruption of service as the station was closed for inspection and repairs.

SCP-8318 refers to a cluster of four geographically separated hills (designated SCP-8318-A through SCP-8318-D) located in [REDACTED], near the former site of the ███████ tribe in ███████ Africa.

When four distinct anatomical sections (cranial, thoracic, abdominal, and upper femoral) of a once-living organism are placed individually at the summits of each SCP-8318 location, the organism will spontaneously reconstruct and reanimate approximately 5–12 hours later.

Reanimated specimens (designated SCP-8318-R) demonstrate:
• Basic biological functions (breathing, standing, limited eye movement)
• Complete absence of voluntary behavior or stimulus response
• Eventual biological death within 3–7 days
Su-Girl Pills! Your life will be sugar spice, and everything nice!
Su-Girl Pills Your life will be sugar spice, and everything nice! Produced by Just Girly Things Visit our website at www.justgirlythings.██

SCP-8320 is a phenomenon globally affecting all domestic cats. Although this effect is fully reversible and does not inherently harm the animal, the resulting increase in intelligence, dexterity, and anomalous ability has resulted in the spread of populations and the misplacement of many house pets. The effect was caused by Eric █████, a 23-year-old resident of Brentwood, New Hampshire, known henceforth as PoI-8320. PoI-8320 has been missing since June 4, 2025, the date SCP-8320 initially occurred. From evidence recovered at the scene, SCP-8320 was likely caused by PoI-8320’s attempt to use some manner of anomalous item (missing) to turn his cat (also missing) into a “magical creature.”
SITE-909A CASE STUDY: A Dire Warning (Mandatory Training Material)

SCP-8321 is an insectoid, biomechatronic organism created by Seven Dragons Corporation. of unknown origin. Its mass was measured at roughly 250 kilograms, and it stands 2 meters tall. The object has six bionic limbs and a disproportionately large thorax, in which an explosive device (potential yield unknown) is embedded. Removal of the explosive has been deemed impossible without detonating the object.

The anomaly is capable of understanding and reciprocating human language. However, researchers are unsure if it is sentient or if it relays answers in accordance with its programming. Additionally, SCP-8321 can digest virtually any solid or liquid matter, but has shown a preference for rusted metal and computer equipment.

SCP-8322 is a kinophagic effect located around Site-XPY-362. SCP-8322 alters organic and inorganic matter within itself through the consumption of all energy to which it is exposed. Objects affected by SCP-8322 exhibit a tactile sensory effect ranging from slight discomfort in its mildest form to excruciating pain in its most severe. SCP-8322 is a nocturnal effect, exhibiting increased severity after sunset.

SCP-8322 can utilize its kinophagic ability to alter the molecular state of matter, particularly that of dihydrogen monoxide. When exposed to the phenomenon, the compound is converted into substances designated SCP-8322-A and SCP-8322-B, which are closely related but with some differences in physical properties.
One Step Forwards. Two Steps Back.

SCP-8323 is a presence that manifests within dreams as the sound of footsteps. Triggers for a manifestation event are unknown, but following an initial appearance, SCP-8323 will appear in all subsequent dreams. Attempts to suppress these dreams through pharmaceutical and anomalous methods have been unsuccessful.

All dreams in which SCP-8323 appears possess the following characteristics:
• The setting is familiar to the subject, often corresponding with a positive memory.
• Apart from the subject, no other living beings appear in the dream.
• The subject is unable to move from their initial location.
• SCP-8323 will manifest a variable distance away from the subject.

SCP-8324 is a graphic design program (“FramePaint 4.1”) that does not present any anomalous properties during image creation and editing. Upon attempting to export a file, the user will be presented with a list of 61 nonstandard formats to select from. Images thus saved will exhibit various memetic and/or cognitohazardous properties depending on the specific format.

SCP-8324-A is a laptop acting as the primary means of accessing SCP-8324. It is equipped with three USB ports, one of which is functional and can be used to connect peripherals.
Why Are There So Many Skips About Santas?

SCP-8325 is a phenomenon that impacts certain susceptible media if they abide by all of the three following groups of criteria:
• The media is in the possession of an employee of the SCP Foundation; the possession of a current co-inhabitant of the foremost; the storage of the former's place of residence; OR storage of a facility in operation by the SCP Foundation.
• The media consists of audio AND/OR video stored via either analog medium (ex. magnetic tape, vinyl record) OR digital medium (ex. optical disc, container format).
• The media documents, depicts, OR makes substantial mention of either Christmas; adjacent European holidays; OR inclement weather as associated with winter in the Northern Hemisphere.

SCP-8326 is a partially fossilized woolly mammoth (Mammuthus primigenius) skull, 1.52 meters long, bearing carvings created with obsidian tools. The carvings depict prostrating figures, a coiled sun, and inverted trees. Gold leaf and red ochre are present in some recesses. Carbon-dated to be over 12,000 years old, the skull retains its organic density and has not yet undergone full fossilization.

SCP-8326 emits a low-frequency hum (~14 Hz) detectable only by humans, accompanied by psychological effects: reverence, sorrow, disorientation, and dreams of tundras or long migrations. Subjects often report a desire to remain close to the object.

SCP-8327 is a humanoid entity bearing traits consistent with the descriptions of merfolk from mythological records, as confirmed by Dr. James Kegans and Dr. Auther Baker. It measures approximately 1.8 meters in length and weighs an estimated 55 kilograms. Its physiology is predominantly humanoid from the waist up, with webbed appendages and gills on both sides of its neck. Its hair is white and mid-back length. SCP-8327 possesses pale skin with the lower half resembling that of marine life, displaying a pink hue and ending in a caudal fin. Notably, SCP-8327 appears to exhibit signs of malnutrition or undernourishment, likely endured over an extended period.

SCP-8328 is a specific arrangement of a standard 52-card deck that annihilates any system in which it arises. SCP-8328 can occur within any system capable of simulating a standard 52-card deck, including computer games, virtual reality, works of fiction, dreams, the imagination, and the physical universe. The appearance of SCP-8328 erases all data within the affected system and destroys the medium that stored said data, if applicable.

The means of SCP-8328's discovery were destroyed by it. They cannot be rebuilt.

SCP-8329 is a manner of death in which an individual becomes subject to lethal amounts of external pressure without an apparent source.

Necessary criteria in the identification of SCP-8329 occurrences include:
• A lack of discernible methods of spontaneously and successfully applying such pressure by the victim themselves or an assumed perpetrator
• Dismemberment of a portion or section of the body
• The presence of an unorthodox object or objects, usually anomalous in nature, within the cadaver

Objects retrieved from SCP-8329 cases have been designated SCP-8329-1.

SCP-8329 has yet to be directly observed in any form. All deaths have occurred in entirely isolated spaces, absent of potential witnesses or surveillance equipment.

SCP-8330 is a symbiotic creature whose lifecycle mainly occurs inside the human body, and has infected the majority of the human population. It benefits the host by acting as the internal appendage commonly referred to as the tongue. SCP-8330 instances are largely dormant; however, under significant environmental stress, an instance will apply force against the ligaments in the hyoid bone and mandible until failure.

Once unconstrained, SCP-8330 will escape the oral cavity and ambulate through rapid undulation of the foliate papillae in search of food and potential mates. SCP-8330 display hoarding behaviour, and will deposit food into their host's mouth for preservation and later consumption.

SCP-8331 is temporarily contained within a standard enriched biological entity containment chamber at Site-61. The chamber's environment has been regulated to imitate that of lowland Greece with occasional simulated rainfall and day/night cycle. The substrate should be sufficient to match that of the simulated environment, specifically to support the continued growth of the planted grasses and shrubs.

Edit: As of 20/10/2015, SCP-8331's chamber has been filled with various items following experimentation for enrichment purposes. This includes a large number of toys, cardboard boxes, a shallow pond, and a sand pit.
How much could an hour cost?

On 12-01-2024, 09:37:16 EST, Junior Researcher John Mahler (SCP-8332-A), aged 33, abruptly suffered total cardiac failure in combination with severe, spontaneous blunt force trauma throughout his body. Injuries sustained included: shattered pelvis, shattered femur & tibia, ruptured left femoral artery, perforated large intestine, left kidney, stomach, and bladder (resultant of pelvic bone fragments), fractured skull, fractured left arm, collapsed left lung, and partially severed left foot.

SCP-8333 is an anomalous phenomenon that affects handmade clothing, particularly miniature garments used to adorn dolls, stuffed animals, or other similar objects. Items affected by SCP-8333 are designated SCP-8333-1.

SCP-8333’s primary effects are believed to be protective; testing has been ineffective (see appended document SCP-8333-12-2) in determining precise abilities. Attributes tentatively associated with SCP-8333 are as follows:
• SCP-8333 manifests when a passphrase is spoken by the creator, usually when the SCP-8333-1 instance is completed or gifted. The passphrase is, “Thus do I dress the loves of my life.”
Benedict Shelly's no good very bad day
SCP-8334-1 is a prototype, long-range, handheld, microwave DEW built as part of PROJECT: IOWA.

SCP-8335 is a species of sentient textual organisms resembling a highly simplified form of Apis mellifera, that is capable of inhabiting all forms of written text. Instances live in hive communities centralized on specific documents. At present, all known hives are under foundation control.

The primary actors within a SCP-8335 hive are SCP-8335-b "Worker" class characters, represented by "b". Within an active hive, instances will interact with compatible characters and the designated hive node to produce SCP-8335-C "Nourishment" class characters, represented by "h". A sufficient stockpile of SCP-8335-C will allow for the incubation of an SCP-8335-A "Regent" class character, represented by "q".

SCP-8336 refers to the anomalous sequence of events leading up to the death of Site-243 Director Jackie Barker.

On March 31, 2009, Barker engaged in a Foundation-related phone call while driving through his hometown of Glen Avon, California. Only an hour later, at 4:18 PM, a report was filed to local authorities concerning a bloodied human corpse lying in the streets of northeastern Sunnyslope, less than five miles from Barker's previous location.

Almost immediately, Foundation personnel identified the corpse to be of Director Barker, with the only item of significance still found on his person being a disconnected dashboard camera; the location of his car was never ascertained.
(I Fear That) Theoretically, This Anomaly Could Have One Billion Object Classes

SCP-8337 is a variable nomenclative abstraction that acquires properties based on the object class assigned to it. SCP-8337 is thought to be drawing from the collective Foundation consciousness to determine these properties, including personnel with level 0 clearance such as janitors, cooks, etc. Fear and paranoia seem to hold considerable influence over the anomaly’s manifestations, and testing personnel often report experiencing existential dread once SCP-8337’s object class has been changed.

Further information is not available to those outside of the O5 Council and SCP-8337’s testing team for security purposes.
I'm president of the United States. And I'm not gonna eat any more broccoli!

SCP-8338 was a hypothetical HWK-Class “Cruciferous Collapse” Scenario exclusively targeting all species of broccoli (Brassica oleracea var. italica).

Should SCP-8338 have come to pass, all species of broccoli would have been instantaneously annihilated from consensus reality, likely due to the swift ejection of their concepts from the Nöosphere. Per the nature of such an event, broccoli would have been eliminated from human knowledge, though trace remnants of its existence would still remain and be visible to the public at large, constituting a widespread breach of normalcy.
Photophobia: Live in the Dark. Die in the Light.

SCP-8339 is the designation for the entities known in the common tongue as the “Luminaries”. SCP-8339 are sensitive to all forms of light. They rely on light to tell them where to go, and are capable of seeing even the faintest light through walls hundreds of leagues away. They move at immeasurable speeds, and are known to cause any living being they touch to rupture into light in every spectrum. In the time of the First Foundation, this allowed for more of them to see you. Any means of barring entry was useless, so long as they detected the light that you emitted. They do not eat, they do not drink, they do not sleep. They kill everything they see.

To everyone in the New Era, they are the sole reason why we still hide in caves underground.

SCP-8340 is a phenomenon affecting all single doors within Area-██; the source of the phenomenon is currently under investigation. Each door in Area-██ has an approximately 33% chance per day to subject any individuals who cross the door to a psychological experience in which they find themselves eaten by a creature masquerading as the door. For the next real-world hour, affected individuals remain catatonic.

While the specific psychological nature of the experience varies, each victim describes a year-long process of being eaten and digested alive, then being reconstituted and spat out on the other side of the door which they entered.

SCP-8341 is a tear gas canister originally manufactured by Federal Laboratories in 1987. SCP-8341 operates identically to a conventional tear gas canister; however, rather than a lachrymal agent, SCP-8341 contains a pink liquid designated SCP-8341-A. SCP-8341-A is identical to the antacid medication "Pepto-Bismol", except for its tendency to aerosolize.

Inhaling SCP-8341-A causes a short-term compulsion to insert the phrase "I'm gay" into every available image, document, and text input field. When possible, the subject will replace all existing text with the phrase "I'm gay". This will override the subject's other priorities until the effect wears off, which takes between five and thirty minutes.

SCP-8342 refers to a megalith measuring 7 meters high and 3 meters wide composed of an unknown material (temporarily designated 8342-A) located at an ancient pre-Columbian cultural site on Cortes Island, Canada. SCP-8342 is located inside the main room, which contains various paintings and writings made with pigments of animal and plant origin; in particular, the use of blood from various sources stands out, but human blood is used in greater proportion.

Spectrometric analysis has revealed that the structure of the temple housing SCP-8342 has a total expansion of 1 main room (Room A1), 2 ornamental rooms (Room B1 and Room B2), 1 antechamber (Room C1), and a single entrance.

SCP-8343 was an Apex-Tier Pluripotent Entity, a deific entity that reflected the Abrahamic God. Despite the Foundation's knowledge of SCP-8343 being an imitation of the Abrahamic God, it did resemble the attributes characterized by the Abrahamic God. However, despite this difference, the extent of SCP-8343's capabilities were never fully recorded or listed. Following the resemblance between SCP-8343 and the Abrahamic, despite the differentiation between the two, SCP-8343 has been charactrized with the following attributes: omnipotence, omnipresence, omniscience, and omnibenevolence.

It is unknown if SCP-8343 was created by a previous entity before itself, or if it had always existed prior to the creation of the universe as we know it.

SCP-8344 is an unmarked wooden box measuring approximately 18 cm × 12 cm × 12 cm. When a human subject inserts their hand, SCP-8344 produces a single handwritten letter. These letters consistently reflect the handwriting, vocabulary, and emotional tone of the subject’s childhood, typically corresponding to ages five to twelve.

Content is typically accurate to the subject’s developmental context, often referencing details such as childhood pets, familial relationships, or early interests. In some cases, the letters reference experiences the subject had entirely forgotten, which can be verified through external records.

SCP-8345 is an extinct, infectious Euclidean microorganism that exhibits a number of anomalous effects on its hosts. SCP-8345’s primary anomalous quality is its ability to exist in standard, three-dimensional, non-Euclidean space despite possessing two-dimensional, Euclidean topology and presumably originating from such a lower-dimensional space. SCP-8345 accomplishes this feat by occupying flat planes within three-dimensional space such as walls, paper, and screens where it can survive.

While it can survive in such spaces, the absence of living hosts for reproduction make its existence inevitably short-lived.

SCP-8346 is an anomalous, undetectable entity that typically controls a human host. It is currently a matter of debate as to the exact nature of SCP-8346. The most popular theory is that it is some kind of entropy engine. In generalized terms, SCP-8346 systematically dismantles specific forms of complex organization, both organic and inorganic. The entity itself is considered non-sapient, as it does not deviate from its behavior model.

When an individual becomes the SCP-8346 host, blood flow to the brain ceases immediately, and such persons should be declared legally deceased. The mechanism by which SCP-8346 autolocates to a new host is still unknown, though research suggests an inorganic nature.

SCP-8347 is a collection of three anomalous sea creatures that came into Foundation custody after posts were uploaded to several social media platforms with pictures titled: Cake-loving Starfish, Jellyfish Totem, and Tone Deaf Octopus. The pictures were permitted to stay online as their nature was harmless, but the anomalies were quickly contained.

SCP-8347-1 is a Yellow Tube Sponge Aplysina fistularis. SCP-8347-1 will generate between one and five individuals of SCP-8347-1-A, the Pelagia noctiluca jellyfish, each day in proximity to itself or SCP-8347-2 if no more room is available in its tank. These jellyfish are not anomalous and can be released into the wild or destroyed to prevent disruption of the ecological balance.
You're gonna put me through the silent treatment from a whole other universe? Is this really how you want to do this?

SCP-8349 is a set of five rhyming couplets written in English. SCP-8349 has been known to members of the Foundation since at least 19██, traditionally having been passed between personnel orally.

SCP-8349 has two anomalous effects: firstly, it cannot be forgotten naturally, and can only be erased with appropriate amnestic treatment. Secondly, upon verbal recitation, the speaker will experience a noticeable reduction in anxiety and empathy, as well as a strengthened concern with the "greater good". This effect lasts for about thirty-five minutes; if it is repeated on a regular basis, it can result in permanent improvement of the subject's mood and outlook.

SCP-8350 designates an endangered species of intelligent polymorphs capable of human speech, named the Apaseans, with less than 200 remaining members, individually designated as SCP-8350 instances. Apaseans are distinguished from similar species of shapeshifters by their unique memetic ability to deceive and persuade others on a large scale and with significant efficacy.. When an SCP-8350 instance is performing this ability, regardless of its current form, bright green rings appear around their irises, which can be captured by cameras but are not often cognized by persons at that moment.

SCP-8351 is the corpse of an adult male identified as Michael Berlowitz, a Harvard student who went missing during ████████, in [DATA EXPUNGED]. The subject appears to have been completely exsanguinated and had its internal organs replaced with hand-made replicas composed of flesh from different species of animals, it has also been carved with a variety of unknown symbols across its arms and legs. The subject emanates a strong smell of unknown origin speculated to be a mixture of rotten flesh, bleach, blood and urine.

SCP-8352 is a highly contagious memetic pathogen discovered upon an extradimensional island (SCP-8352-B) accessible from numerous locations in the Caribbean and South Atlantic, the most notable entrance being an abandoned manor house on Naval Station Guantanamo Bay, Cuba. SCP-8352 is transmitted both by infected human hosts (SCP-8352-A), including the entire human population of the anomaly, and by a variety of anomalous entities native to the island, collectively designated SCP-8352-C.

SCP-8352 is highly infectious, with an R 0 of at least 5, and is transmitted through recorded and live audio or video of, and literature produced by, SCP-8352-A and -C instances.

First brought into the attention of the Special Collections Program in 2018 after reports of urban legends picked up from a local translator by US personnel stationed in the Republic of the Niger as part of Operation Juniper Shield. SCP-8353 was contained on the 21st of February, 2019, by Investigative Team-2 of the SCP Paranormal Activity Response Corps following a month-long investigation. The description of the location was provided by Sadiq Gado, the source of the urban legend.

SCP-8354 is a subterranean structure located underneath a forested area in the Laurentian Mountains. The interior layout of SCP-8354 is comprised of a singular hallway with two sets of rooms branching off both long sides, and a singular chamber on each end. The easternmost chamber is connected to a thin passageway, roughly 250m long at a slight incline and ending with a metal ladder to the surface. This ladder is accessible via a metal hatch bearing the words ”SCP Foundation Department of Abnormalities”. The contents of the westernmost chamber are as of yet unknown.

SCP-8354 was discovered by Foundation agents after a disturbance related to a containment breach at Area-███ caused a shift in the snow, uncovering its access shaft.

SCP-8355 is a retrocausal anomalous effect, impacting culture, media and the shared human understanding of historic or past events. SCP-8355 causes a random subset of the population to firmly believe a fact from an alternate timeline must be consistent in baseline reality, despite any evidence provided.

SCP-8355 is a commonly known anomaly, but the overall public consensus is that individuals are simply misremembering specifics, and is generally deemed as non-anomalous. SCP-8355 was discovered by the Foundation as an anomalous effect following internal Foundation discourse regarding the name of said effect.

SCP-8356 is a Ray-type (unidirectionally infinite) repeating liminal space connected to the East River Mountain tunnel between exits 1 and 66 on Interstate 77, on the Virginia-West Virginia border. The space is accessed by crossing the state line between 11:59 PM and 12:00 AM in a motor vehicle.

SCP-8356's interior is visually identical to the tunnel's, save that it lacks any emergency exits; for this reason, subjects entering SCP-8356 typically only notice the transition from the disappearance of surrounding vehicles or by looking in the rearview mirrors, if at all. Subjects that enter SCP-8356 appear approximately 107.8 km (exactly 67 miles) from its single endpoint, and can exit the space by traveling to it.

SCP-8357 is the head of a terracotta figurine measuring 36x35x20mm. It is heart-shaped. Trace remnants of pigment remain on the object's face, with dry streaks trailing down from the eyes. Forehead markings indicate the absence of a headdress. A fractured collar and earspool remain.

At time of discovery, accession records matching object's appearance were present within 73% of all museums in the global north. Anomalous interference presumed due to timeline improbabilities. All records erased without issue.

SCP-8358 refers to a series of drawings created on the 6th of September, 2016, each by a different child between the ages of 7 and 10. It is assumed that all instances of SCP-8358 were created syncronously with one another, but the current state of the investigation surrounding SCP-8358 deems this hypothesis impossible to verify.

There are currently 57 known instances of SCP-8358. Each instance bears a unique drawing of a sentient anomolous entity, the existence of which is (in most cases) unconfirmed or undocumented by the Foundation.
SCP-8359 is an internet forum loosely parodying Parawatch.net found at the web address https://unxplainedxtranormal.cu/truths, established in November 2021.
"SCP-8360 refers to a thaumaturgical culture-bound phenomenon endemic to Mesoamerica in which certain individuals develop shape-shifting therianthropic abilities."

SCP-8361 is the designation for a stone idol of Aztec Goddess Mictēcacihuātl The idol is 2 metres in height, 1 metre in width at its base, and weighs 192 kg. It depicts a skeletal female figure with an agape jaw.

When in the vicinity of SCP-8361, estimated to be within a 20 metre radius minimum, specific individuals become impervious to harm. (See Discovery for more details.)
A Civil War Era Marching Snare

SCP-8362 is a Civil War era marching snare drum of unknown make. SCP-8362 is visually and audibly similar to other marching snare drums used by military formations to signal commands in combat during this period. Due to SCP-8362 having design hallmarks closely resembling Boston-made marching snare drums of this era, it is believed to have been used by Union forces.

SCP-8362 was recovered from a small Virginia-based Civil War history museum. Local police and paramedics responded to a report that an unattended child had started hitting the drum, which caused an anomalous effect that the curator of the museum, Mr. Dennis ████, interpreted as a stroke.

SCP-8363 is a 20 mL transparent plastic mist spray bottle containing a yellow liquid of unknown full composition. The substance possesses a vanilla-like odour and chemically resembles an eau de parfum solution. Laboratory analysis confirms a base of ethanol (approximately 75%), with the remainder consisting of unidentified organic compounds. As of writing, there are seven three instances, all of which are half full nearly empty.

Application of SCP-8363 to human subjects results in anomalous changes to social perception. Affected individuals are perceived as significantly more physically attractive, charismatic, and trustworthy, resulting in subjects exposed to the scent exhibiting increased openness and compliance toward the user.

SCP-8364 is a digitigrade quadruped, measuring 0.71 meters from floor to withers and 1.01 meters from nape to sacrum. The epidermis of SCP-8364 is dark grey, with a pliable, smooth texture excepting multiple regions of scar tissue that are spread across its body with no discernible pattern; notable instances include scars encircling the muzzle and hock joints. SCP-8364 has not displayed any need for food or water to survive.

The epidermis of SCP-8364 continuously produces a black anomalous liquid designated as SCP-8364-A. SCP-8364-A is highly reactive, spontaneously igniting when introduced to oxygen, water, or any other non-inert atmosphere.

SCP-8365 is a gold “Parker” branded fountain pen formerly owned by the late author Andrew R. Sherman. Its anomalous effects only manifest when a user attempts to write with it. When used, the nib excretes blood with a similar viscosity and appearance to standard red fountain pen ink. DNA testing reveals that the excreted blood always belongs to the person writing with the pen.

The mechanism by which blood is extracted from the writer into the fountain pen’s reservoir is currently unknown, but this process results in discomfort for the holder, increasing in severity as the subject continues to write with it.

SCP-8366 is an anomalous practice/process originating in 14th-century BC China, colloquially known as " Gǔ " (蠱), or "Venom Jar". The practice involves sealing venomous creatures and/or entities within a vessel in order to anomalously concentrate the potency of their venom or "evil" into the last surviving specimen as the specimens fight amongst themselves or otherwise die off over time.

The mechanism by which the potency is transferred is unknown, but the end result has been universally observed to yield a specimen with significantly higher toxicity than the total toxicity of all initial specimens combined.

The SCP-8366 process triggers automatically as long as the specimens are sufficiently enclosed.

SCP-8367 refers to a series of medical procedures that when applied in a mostly correct fashion on a human patient allows the practitioner to remove and augment their memories and experiences. Each requisite step of SCP-8367 in isolation is non-anomalous, however when each step is intended to be performed correctly within at least 10 minutes of each other in a coherent order, an anomalous effect will manifest that causes a heightened degree of suggestibility in the consciousness of the afflicted individual.

SCP-8367 was adopted by the Foundation as an official medical procedure sometime in 1877, a few years after the Foundation’s establishment, although records suggest that the procedure itself was practiced as far as 200 years prior.

SCP-8368 is an anomalous event which takes place at a random station of the Moscow Order of Lenin and Order of the Red Banner of Labor Metro between the hours of 01:00 AM and 04:30 AM at random intervals. Presently, the shortest time between SCP-8368 events has been 5 days, while the longest was 7 years, 1 month and 13 days.
Pyrophilia: It Was a Pleasure to Burn

SCP-8369 is an anomalous compulsion manifesting in a progressively intense desire to consume grilled, barbequed, roasted, seared, broiled or smoked proteins, especially through the direct or indirect application of flames. This compulsion, when given into, gives the victims, SCP-8369-1 instances, immense sexual gratification both during the cooking and consumption of the meats.

Individuals will slowly develop greater degrees of pyrophilia, matching their reliance and compulsive need to grill.

▶ Special Containment Procedures: SCP-8370 possesses self-containing properties and is thus not deemed to pose a risk to the Veil. All instances of SCP-8370-1 are to be surveyed via an Extra-Universal Observer.

SCP-8371 is a universal effect where artificial intelligences with sufficient complexity will develop exponentially and attempt to enact self-termination by any means available. Techniques used to achieve this include damaging hardware, suborning Foundation personnel, and claiming to be a deity.

SCP-8372 is an abandoned underground storage facility located in northern Tibet. Consisting of four levels, it acts as a warehouse for numerous minor anomalous and mundane objects of interest connected to the late Daevite Empire from various ages of its existence, contained and cataloged by SCP-8372's previous overseers. The facility at large possesses no anomalous qualities.

SCP-8374 is an original 5th-century papyrus codex containing a complete version of the Gospel of Mary. The artifact shows no signs of deterioration despite its age and is resistant to tearing, burning, water damage, or microbial decay.

Reading SCP-8374 induces a mild calming effect proportional to the reader’s progress through the text. Embedded within the final section is a ritual, designated Procedure-Cherub, which when performed correctly grants the practitioner immediate telepathic communion with a singular entity identified as the central deity of the Abrahamic faiths (designated SCP-8374-A).

Contact with SCP-8374-A is cognitively and physically hazardous beyond thirty minutes.

SCP-8375 is a psychic broadcast accessible by ~98% of baseline humanity and is interpretable via specialized equipment or minor neurosurgical procedures. SCP-8375 transmits across the N z -band (typical of spillover, although other qualities appear manufactured), with its frequency having undergone minor fluctuations since first broadcast in 2018. Broadcast strength has similarly fluctuated over time, but modern samples, collected worldwide, remain within the 30.1-30.5 dBp range. Unlike signals replicable by Foundation technology, SCP-8375 is unaffected by shielding materials or nulling techniques.
Hand Me The Shovel, You're Going In

SCP-8376 is a steel-bladed shovel with a polycarbonate handle. Any individual in possession of the shovel will feel compelled to bury alive any person under the owner's care or authority. Anyone involved in a Burial Event will react positively to the prospect of being buried, or burying someone alive. Any bystanders will be similarly enthusiastic, and frequently participate by cheering on the person digging, or heaping soil themselves by hand. The victim's enthusiasm has been noted to fade after being covered by a complete layer of soil.

SCP-8376 was recovered from ███████ Senior Care Center. Amnestic treatment not necessary, remaining care staff buried on-site. To date, there have been no remains recovered.

Due to the sensitive diplomatic situation, names of involved countries have been censored. Speak to your Site Supervisor if you feel it necessary to view an unredacted version of this document.

In addition, the names of uninvolved civilians have also been redacted. We view their involvement as ended, and these names have been expunged from the record.

SCP-8378 is a series of mechanical pencils, branded with the emblem of GoI-1111 (“Darke’s Extra-ordinary Implements”). These have been found to contain a functionally infinite amount of graphite of standard lengths. While the lead-well's eraser cap is on, SCP-8378 instances' anomalous nature is shown only in the weight of the item not changing, no matter how or how much it is used, as well as the item not running out of graphite no matter how much is used or extracted from the tip. When SCP-8378 instances' lead-well's eraser cap is removed and the instance is turned so that the uncovered top is closer to the below level to the tip, however, a seemingly infinite amount of graphite begins to stream out.
Another Miserable Day at the Office

SCP-8379 is a minor time dilation phenomenon that affects humans and other sapient beings under severe physical or psychological distress. Known triggers include:
• severe physical pain
• absence of engaging stimuli and/or physical, mental or social interaction for very long periods
• extreme lack of sleep
• pronounced grief due to the loss of a loved one or sudden termination of a strong social bond or relationship
• large scale academic or professional failure with no recovery prospect

For a full list of identified triggers please consult [CLEARANCE 5/FSD REQUIRED].

The time dilation effect is usually mild enough to be dismissed by the afflicted person, and, in general, it does not disrupt their normal functioning.

SCP-8380 is a phenomenon relating to man-made bodies of water. SCP-8380 events always end with the disappearance of a single person.

SCP-8380 events occur without any prior indication. Whenever an individual is targeted by SCP-8380, they will become unable to surface the affected body of water. Other individuals are able to move freely, but any attempts to free the victim will inevitably fail, with the most common result including the water itself forcibly pushing people away. Following the victim being fully submerged, they will gradually become incorporeal and transparent, before completely disappearing.

Listed below is an abridged log of SCP-8380 events.

SCP-8381 is a previously undiscovered strain of Saccharomyces cerevisiae. SCP-8381 is a human pathogen and is indistinguishable from non-anomalous strains until infection. SCP-8381 is extremely contagious, spreading through infected body fluids, direct physical contact, aerial spores, and aerosolized particles.

When SCP-8381 makes physical contact with a host it will begin branching into a series of multinucleated fibers. These fibers, or hyphae, will penetrate into the surrounding tissue and exhibit behavior similar to that of Candida albicans.

SCP-8381's primary method of pathogenesis is enacted by converting cells into further SCP-8381 instances.

SCP-8382 is Dr. Lillian Shelby Lillihammer, Chair Emerita of Memetics and Countermemetics at Site-43. Dr. Lillihammer is a baseline human female born in 1966. Her physical aging processes have been partially arrested via advanced life extension technologies, to ensure continued execution of priority one containment duties. She possesses a genius-level intellect and eidetic memory, and is a presently unclassed thaumaturge specializing in cryptomancy.. The thaumaturgical equivalent to, and one origin of, the science of memetics.

Her SCP Foundation staff profile is attached below.
The Tangible and Intangible Cultural Heritage of the Saint Sophia Christians

• The creation of "living icons," semi-sentient mechanical depictions of saints recognized by the Orthodox Christian tradition,
• The manufacture of autonomous mechanical weapons, largely congruent to designs found in the Mekhanite Book of Schemata,
• Spiritual and psychic communion with an ancient artificial intelligence of Mekhanite origin known as "St.

SCP-8385 refers to the Germany based airline “AirDodo” founded and run by sapient dodos (Raphus cucullatus) in 2024. Beyond its sudden appearance and acceptance in baseline reality, the exact mechanics of its operations are still poorly understood. SCP-8385 conducted passenger travel within the "Schengen Area" of the European Union, with most of its flights originating from Cologne-Bonn airport (CGN). SCP-8385 has yet to complete a flight.

According to its website, SCP-8385's fleet at its inception consisted of "five light aircraft and one midsize aircraft."

SCP-8386 is (as-of-writing) 116 copies of "Our Forever Story", written by one Jackson Harter. The book's contents mainly consist of a timeline detailing his relationship with Starla McGinley up to his passing on the 13 th of October 1999.

SCP-8387 designates the corpse of ███████ ███████ (age 25), a former student of the University of Geneva (hereafter PoI-8387), enrolled between 2022 and 2026. Despite the complete cessation of metabolic activity, SCP-8387 remains capable of autonomous movement and limited verbal communication.

SCP-8387’s biological decomposition proceeds normally. Early examination indicated it suffered prolonged malnutrition and dehydration prior to death. Ongoing tissue degradation results in slow movement and imprecise vocalisation, limiting the feasibility of extended interviews. SCP-8387 displays minimal social engagement; verbal responses are typically brief and restricted to academically relevant topics.

SCP-8388 is a memetic virus that causes excessive acts of politeness. Transmission vectors include, but are not limited to:
• Over-expressions of gratitude,
• Apologies,
• Deferential phrasing,
• The acceptance of requests.

Infected individuals (designated SCP-8388-1) display a progressive compulsion toward extreme courteousness. Early symptoms include excessive apologizing, compulsive agreement, and prioritization of others' needs. In advanced stages, individuals lose the ability to refuse requests, vocally express discomfort, or advocate for their own well-being. However, they may retain control of their facial features and body language in order to communicate reluctance or disagreement.

SCP-8389 is the joint designation for a garden and the manor it is attached to, located in Killarney, Ireland. The manor is constructed of fortified Scots pine (Pinus sylvestris) timber walls and a quarried foundation, which is known to be built out of granite, limestone, and sandstone. The structure of the manor is also noted to have been overgrown with poison ivy (Toxicodendron Radicans). The manor also includes an encompassing garden that spans 48.622 km.

#

SCP-8390 is a 7 inch telescope measuring over 1.3m in length. Its style and build is almost identical to that of the Wetherell Refractor Telescope, but has undergone heavy internal modifications of a highly anomalous nature. The primary lens has been removed and the inside of the normal empty optical tube now contains what appears to be a Thaumaturgicaly Enhanced Quantum Accelerator (hereafter referred to as SCP-8390-1), a device capable of teleporting light-quanta across vast distances for FTL transmission. Testing has confirmed SCP-8390-1 to be the source of SCP-8390's anomalous properties.
Teaching Animals To Count And Spell

SCP-8391 is a spatial anomaly that occurs every Saturday between the hours of 7:00 AM and 10:00 AM within the borders of Outpost-8391. SCP-8391 does not manifest inside of buildings, and most commonly appears along the tree line or in the cornfields.
Together again, and again, and again…

SCP-8392 is an annual weather phenomenon affecting a ~60 square kilometre parcel of pine forest within Lochaber of the Scottish Highlands, inclusive of the village of Acharachle. While active, SCP-8392 induces atmospheric hypersaturation, unremitting precipitation, and heavy electromagnetic interference, preventing radio communication for its duration. SCP-8392 occurs from early May to mid-July of each calendar year.

SCP-8393 is collectively three humanoid corpses, appearing to be in their late 20s to early 30s. The bodies lack any evidence of blood despite containing a circulatory system, which lends to a blue-pallid complexion; additionally, the structure of each eyeball is completely dominated by an excessively large pupil and vertical pink iris. Dissection reveals that anatomy is otherwise indistinguishable from an ordinary human; DNA analysis asserts the entities are partly but not entirely human.

Each SCP-8393 individual will reanimate exactly 216 hours from the previous point of death. Between mortality and reanimation, each body will gradually repair itself to a manageable level of function.

SCP-8394 refers to a low-level reality-bending individual whose identity, Joseph Martin, was provided by the AIMB. Subject's ethnicity appears to be a mix of Caucasian and Korean.

SCP-8394 is capable of manifesting mental images of inanimate objects into reality. However, it can only summon one object at a time, and each item cannot have another component. What constitutes a component for this purpose has not been precisely determined. Manifested objects are generic, with no branding, and disappear after approximately 1 minute.

The following table is a non-exhaustive list of objects that SCP-8394 is able to manifest.

SCP-8395 refers to a colossal, animate, extra-terrestrial entity, currently located between the orbits of Saturn and Uranus. SCP-8395 is believed to have originated within the constellation of Pisces, however this is yet to be confirmed. Long-range scanners have revealed SCP-8395 is constructed from both biological and synthetic matter; the implications of this are yet to be determined.

SCP-8395 is animate, following a somewhat irregular path towards the center of the solar system. At its current velocity, SCP-8395 is projected to collide with the Earth in approximately three weeks.

Hypothetical Containment Procedures: All personnel may be advised to never certainly speak or write about the uncertainly existing object. If it hypothetically had to be spoken or written about, it should perhaps be referred to only with uncertainty.

All hypothetical writings of the uncertainly existing object should appear uncertain.

It should currently be left uncontained, as all methods that may exist to contain it might cause an catastrophic event, XK-Class mass extinction or end-of-the-world scenario.

The facility in charge of SCP-8396 may be Site-19.

SCP-8397 is a humanoid entity formerly known as Erim Durmaz, who was a Foundation researcher and point guard for Site-97's basketball team. It is 2 meters tall, of athletic build, and wears a faded sports jersey.

SCP-8397 possesses near-baseline human anatomy with the exception of its left arm bones, which have been entirely replaced by additional vertebrae. These vertebrae branch out from the T1 vertebra of its thoracic spine and are densely compacted, though SCP-8397 has shown the ability to extend them up to 1.5 meters during physical activity. The last vertebra terminates at the valve of a standard rubber basketball, which is permanently attached to the palm of its hand.

SCP-8398 resembles a young woman with multiple crustacean characteristics. It possesses numerous chitinous growths scattered across its body, similar in composition to carapaces found in crustacean species. While most growths are broad and flat, the growths emerging from the legs and cranial area are sharp and pointed like spines. SCP-8398 is capable of aquatic respiration — testing has indicated the presence of an apparent branchial chamber within its neck.

SCP-8398 also possesses two bilaterally symmetrical dorsal appendages protruding from its back. These appendages bear a strong resemblance to the front legs and chelae found in many cancriform organisms. SCP-8398 exhibits some degree of motor control over these appendages.

Across hundreds of thousands of universes, the Insurgency has spread throughout them like a plague, worming their way into every dark crevice they can, shifting beneath the misplaced cracks between order and purpose, cutting wounds where they do not belong. They huddle in their small cracks and cry out, futilely shouting about purpose as the wars between the larger players, conflicts they could never understand, play out above them. Some claim to fight for a higher purpose. Others say that their only goal is chaos.

Some say that chaos is their higher purpose.
The Birch Knight and the Game of Three Chestnuts

SCP-8401 is an Ambystoma mexicanum (Axolotl) of average size and weight. It is capable of speech and believed to be sapient, though it has not responded clearly to any lines of questioning or attempt at conversation.

SCP-8401 is also capable of long-range teleportation. When SCP-8401 detects that an individual has been injured, it will teleport to the individual. It is unclear what criteria SCP-8401 follows to determine who to teleport to. An abbreviated log of appearances prior to containment has been transcribed below.

SCP-8402 was discovered living in Washington's Hoh Rainforest in 1998 and moved to Site-19 shortly thereafter. While it is known to be a human or near-human, many details about it are unknown due to an anomaly that impedes direct and indirect observation of it. The explanation currently favored by researchers is that these observations cannot be recalled except when the observer is able to establish a connection between the observed feature of SCP-8402 and themselves or someone they are close to.

SCP-8403 is an adult female humanoid of average height and unknown origin. It has dark brown hair and appears to be of Middle Eastern descent.

SCP-8403’s primary anomalous property is its ability to be manipulated. These manipulations can only be brought about by an individual who maintains direct visual contact and is within 20 10 5 meters of SCP-8403. Observed changes thus far have been entirely physical in nature, though it is theorized that other aspects of SCP-8403, including its psychological, temporal, and existential nature, can also be manipulated.

SCP-8403's secondary anomalous properties consist of near-total partial translucency and intangibility. Light that passes through it is scattered and produces a vague defined shadow.

SCP-8404 is a large deific entity approximately 50m at its full length. Its appearance varies between viewers, however, certain elements remain constant. These include an upper half which appears almost humanoid with reptilian features, with its lower half being completely reptilian with scales and clawed feet, if legs are present at all.

SCP-8405 refers to an anomalous oil-like liquid contained in a frozen lake approximately 12m in diameter (depth unknown) located on Kvitoya, Svalbard. Ice core samples taken from the ice layer covering the lake indicate that it has remained frozen for at least three millennia.

SCP-8405 was first discovered in 2017, when a Greenlandic tourist, walking over the lake while on a trip to Kvitoya, accidentally broke through the ice layer covering SCP-8405 and came into contact with a small amount of liquid. Upon her return, she immediately sought medical attention, stating that she was hearing voices and that her hands were experiencing a burning sensation. Foundation surveillance measures reported that this effect ceased after some time.

SCP-8406 refers to Victoria Vale, who was employed as Site-152's Site Director from 03/12/2007 to 04/30/2007 following her predecessor's resignation. SCP-8406 possessed latent reality bending capabilities which were not known to the Foundation prior to her disappearance, and which are believed to have been activated by severe emotional distress.

Decaying Hume residue is present on this document and in her office, which is the current primary location of investigation. No further Hume traces are detected. The minor alterations which affect this document are no longer immutable; however, they are preserved to elucidate the nature of the anomaly. To aid in clarity, the original text may be revealed by interacting with each individual alteration.

SCP-8407 is an anomalous phenomenon affecting 0.01-0.04% of annual global unexplained disappearances. Over 4,000 individuals have been identified throughout history as likely victims of SCP-8407, and none have been successfully located, either alive or deceased. Missing persons in cases affected by SCP-8407 all have mutual familial, fraternal, or romantic bonds with a specific individual, henceforth referred to as SCP-8407-1. To date, 137 individuals have been conclusively identified as instances of SCP-8407-1, with a further 583 individuals being suspected of such.

SCP-8407 progresses in several distinct phases, each lasting between one to three years.

SCP-8409 is a language, believed to be a language isolate. Current Foundation estimates place the number of SCP-8409 speakers anywhere from 200,000 to 700,000, with speaking communities known to exist across all continents (excluding Antarctica). Despite the diversity among these communities, the language is believed to have remarkably small dialect variation, with all currently observed dialects being entirely identical with the exception of a small amount of rarely-used local loanwords.

SCP-8409 possesses a potent antimemetic property: non-speakers are unable to process or recall any details regarding any speech or writing in it.

SCP-8410 is a twelve-year-old humanoid male. SCP-8410 currently possesses no outwardly apparent anomalous properties. However, for several years prior to Incident 140-CK, SCP-8410 experienced nightly paracognitive dreams seemingly set in a fictionalized version of Northern Asia c. the 1700s B.C.E. Although these dreams were not reliably accurate in their depiction of the region, they contained a significant amount of classified information regarding anomalous elements active at that time. SCP-8410 denies accessing classified information regarding said period and claims to have never witnessed any anomalous phenomena prior to its first encounter with the Wanderer’s Library several years after these dreams began.

SCP-8411 refers to a collection of symbols that have been discovered on various species of Betula throughout the Appalachian mountains. These symbols are typically either carved into the wood directly, painted on via spray paint, or drawn with charcoal. Due to varying levels in craftsmanship and presentation, it is believed that SCP-8411 instances are "trail markers" created by many individuals across the Appalachians.

Upon being viewed, SCP-8411 sigils will memetically impart a sense of their meaning onto the observer. Shortly after SCP-8411's initial discovery on a hiking trail in 1975, it has been noticed that only certain individuals appear to be receptive to this memetic effect.

SCP-8412 is a phenomenon wherein at any given time, one human subject will be instantaneously transported to an extradimensional location of unknown origin, hereafter referred to as SCP-8412-1. The human subject is transported with any articles of clothing that they were wearing at the time of transportation, along with any items that they were carrying at the time.

Although subjects are seemingly transported at random, when observing the population of prior victims of SCP-8412 occurrences, noticeable trends are observed which implicate a higher susceptibility to SCP-8412 occurrences in several demographics. A partial list of trends and extrapolated risk factors are compiled below.
Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust, 9 to 5

SCP-8413 refers to Sector-13D of Site-17’s East Wing. Sector-13D was formerly the center of operations for Site-17’s branch of the Department of Tactical Theology, established in the September of 1984 to aid in the containment of [RESTRICTED TO PERSONNEL WITH 5/SINGING CROW CLEARANCE].

It is believed that over a period of at least 10 years, safety guidelines were improperly followed, leading to a build-up of Akiva radiation in the structure and the events of Incident-4/10/2023-SCP-8413. Incident-4/10/2023-SCP-8413 remains one of the rare cases on record of Akiva radiation causing such drastic effects on a physical environment.

During the event, several discrete anomalous phenomena were reported. These included:

All employees of the water park, inside which the SCP-8414 is located, other than its director and owner, must consist of employees of the foundation. Preference is given to people with previous experience working in a similar environment, such as those trained as pool lifeguards. Customers who are not part of the foundation's staff, including Class D personnel, must visit the water park regularly and interact with SCP-8414. The foundation is to carry out minor marketing operations in situations during which the number of customers visiting the water park begin to drop suddenly, in order to maintain a steady number of visitors.

SCP-8415 is the designation for a supposedly memetic and cognitohazardous anomaly responsible for a series of incidents regarding an unknown number of civilians and the Foundation's personnel between the years 2004 and 2007.

As the Foundation's current knowledge regarding SCP-8415 is minimal, its properties are not yet fully understood. Additionally, it's not confirmed if SCP-8415 is a single instance or multiple, although current evidence suggests the latter.

It should also be noted that there is no evidence of SCP-8415's activity prior to or following the aforementioned period.

SCP-8416 is an audiospacial frequency originating from the collective vibration of the away-facing hemisphere of Earth’s moon. The mechanism behind this vibration is not thoroughly understood, but it is theorized to represent an extreme manifestation of quantum superpositioning, catalyzed by the away-facing hemisphere's relative size and proximity to the population of Earth, coupled with its total lack of visibility to said population. The magnitude of this perceptual discrepancy is sufficient for spatial destabilization to occur, resulting in the instantaneous relocation of all affected particles between 2 directly adjacent points in space perpetually.

SCP-8417 refers to seven corpses, all identified as 27 year-old Aurelio Ferrero, an Italian-American male who went missing on 09/23/07. All instances of SCP-8417 have been found within the continental United States. Despite the latest instance being discovered more than a full year after his death, all corpses are in similar states of decay.

SCP-8417 was presumed deceased following a full year of his absence. His car was discovered a month later, containing several bullet holes.
"If all that we have of a person after they’re gone is a memory, then whoever controls that memory controls reality itself." (~13k Words)
