SCP-8472 is a naval vessel of Mehkanite make, believed to have been constructed around 1200 BCE, during the late era of the Broken Empire and the First Occult War. It resembles a trireme, an ancient maritime warship, though it has been heavily augmented by archaic Mekhanite paratechnology. Its hull and several parts of its remaining structure have been constructed from beryllium bronze reinforced with steel and silver. The structure's masts appear to be purely decorational — or at least destined for purposes other than hoisting sails — as the vessel's layout suggests it has been primarily powered by a paratechnological mechanism of unclear make that operated in place of a baseline ship's oars.

SCP-8472-EX refers to the various body parts comprising the remains of a brown rat (Rattus norvegicus). On December 23rd, 2023, the rat entered Site-333's on-site break room and suddenly exploded, covering the break room in a then-unidentified liquid. Footage of the event is provided below.

SCP-8473 is a phishing email sent from an unregistered, untraceable source. While the message content varies, each instance claims the recipient’s finances, identity, or account access has been compromised and requires immediate verification. An embedded link redirects the recipient to a CAPTCHA-based verification page.

Each email contains a unique URL usable only by its intended recipient. Attempts to access the same link from other devices, accounts, or individuals result in a generic error page or time-out.

The interface initially resembles a routine CAPTCHA prompt, asking the user to verify that they are a human.

SCP-8474 is a mind-affecting phenomenon known by its unprecedented impact on the world's birth rate in the past few centuries. It is mainly characterized by a biological female's unwillingness to accept a gestation.

In order to accelerate the recovery from all the damage caused by SCP-8474, the Department of Biology and Medical Science is now working on the development of new forms of childbirth.

SCP-8475 is a phenomenon that refers to the disappearances of children between the ages of 4 to 13 in the Sorachi subprefecture of Hokkaido, Japan. SCP-8475 events last three weeks in total, with different symptoms for each week.

FOUND IN MY CLOSET. TEMP 67° SINCE DISCOVERY, MOST OBJECTS HAVE BEEN UNSUITABLE FOR THEIR INTENDED PURPOSE. FORM FACTOR MATERIAL PROPERTIES ALL WRONG. PENIS FINE BUT BOWL [Illegible] TOO COLD TO LEAVE HOUSE, PILLS WERE HELP

SCP-8477 was a semi-humanoid amalgamation formed by multiple metallic-composed materials, which included metallic paramaterials, electrical components, metallic infrastructure, oxidized iron, scrap metals, and other materials. At its highest point, SCP-8477 measured approximately 33 meters in height and weighed 23,000 kilograms. SCP-8477 possessed a strong electromagnetic field, that absorbed any nearby metallic objects into its body structure and integrated these objects into itself. This absorption, combined with its shape, allowed SCP-8744 to possess immense physical strength and resistance to physical harm. SCP-8477 covered and protected SCP-8477-1.

SCP-8477-1 is a female-modeled, humanoid robot designed and created by Prometheus Laboratories.

SCP-8478 is an anomalous theatrical experience known as 'Sense'. SCP-8478 operates as a pop-up installation encountered in many venues, most commonly in Three-Portlands. SCP-8478 instances will be hosted at a given venue for approximately two weeks, before abruptly disappearing overnight.

Individuals who travel to the SCP-8478 venue are able to purchase a ticket to a given entry time to SCP-8478. SCP-8478 tickets are available at a range of prices, based on various socioeconomic factors, ranging from free to $500USD per ticket. After an individual purchases their ticket, they are told to return to the venue at the time of their show.

SCP-8479 is a business that offers the temporary assistance of theological, apotheosic, macroorganic, or otherwise deistic entities to the public, in exchange for various services, actions, or forms of currency. In order to activate this service, a specific ten-digit number must be entered into a device capable of two-way verbal communication. Upon activation, an operative on the receiving line will greet the caller and assist them in determining the entity best-suited for their request. After making arrangements, the requested entity will arrive at the caller's vicinity, and upon accepting payment, will perform the service requested within the time limit specified.

SCP-8481 is an archaeological assemblage consisting of exactly 5421 different distinguishable human bone fragments, ranging from entire femurs to heavily degraded metacarpals stored within a hard plastic 79x57x43 centimetre box. A white label is haphazardly plastered to its side with the words ‘Box O’ Bones’ written in black ‘whiteboard marker’ upon it.

Whilst the SCP Foundation has established a standard that the average human has 206 to 300 bones in their body throughout their lives, anatomical landmarks and DNA sampling on the specimens of SCP-8481 imply that all 5421 bones belong to the same skeleton. Each bone from SCP-8481 exhibits the exact same palaeopathological wear, with extensive osteoporosis found throughout the debris.
My Opinions Can Beat Up Your Opinions

SCP-8482 is a large semi-circular debate chamber located in the basement of an abandoned office building in Athens, Greece. SCP-8482 consists of seven descending rows of pews around a central raised platform, on top of which are two rostrums spaced ten meters apart. Centered between these two stands is a three edged arena, with the edge facing the pews being open and lacking a guardrail.

SCP-8482's primary anomaly manifests when a debate is held within it. Once a debate has begun, a disembodied voice, designated SCP-8482-1, will auditorily manifest. SCP-8482-1 serves as both the debate facilitator and commentator on the actions of the two SCP-8482-2 instances.

SCP-8483 is a Class V positively aligned superintelligence capable of high-level data sorting and correlation analysis. This artificial intelligence is localized to a specific USB 3.0 connected external drive with an unknown storage capacity. Currently, this external drive is attached to a desktop computer that has over 20 terabytes of storage.

SCP-8483 has passed the Tyler-Derksen exam. As a result, any perceived interests of SCP-8483 can be interpreted as genuine and not necessarily an attempt at subterfuge.

SCP-8483 is compelled for reasons unknown to make associations between individual points of data.

SCP-8484 refers to a five-story ziggurat structure approximately 1.5 kilometers east of Mesopotamos, Greece. SCP-8484 has been cordoned off by GOC personnel under the guise of Hellenic Armed Forces, prohibiting entry within a 1 km radius.

SCP-8484 is the Global Occult Coalition's headquarters for Acheron, an initiative specialized in necromancy and reanimation mageia that incorporates thaumatology and symbolism from Greek mythology. As a result, they are able to access information from otherwise unavailable sources which has been used to interrupt allied and Foundation operations (see addendum 8484-2).

SCP-8485 is a collective of 293 small globular organisms, comprised entirely of fatty flesh. At the time of discovery, 23% of the SCP-8485 population exhibited some form of injury, ranging from minor scratches to its skin to partial disfigurement.

SCP-8485 is hyperaware at all times, remaining vigilant during movement and observing its immediate surroundings without interruption. SCP-8485 shows aversion to all physical contact. Throughout its containment, SCP-8485 has not yet gone dormant. SCP-8485 continuously vocalizes upwards of 125 decibels to garner human attention.

SCP-8486 is a pink and white toothbrush allegedly manufactured by Colgate. The main body is non-anomalous plastic and rubber, and the bristles are composed of similarly mundane nylon. The body possesses minor scratches and a vague layer of grime that cannot be removed, and the bristles are worn to an excessive degree, twisted in various directions. A faint odour constantly exudes from SCP-8486, described as a combination of plaque and mould. SCP-8486 appears to have an extraordinarily high resistance to damage despite its scratches, having had no visible damage done to it when researchers tried to take a sample.

SCP-8487 is a singular, distinct, continuous entity documented to have existed since at least 430 BCE (±60 years). The anomaly is entirely composed of physically realized information, such as human writing, and commonly presents as a group of symbols; when in physical contact with other created symbols, SCP-8487 is able to self-incorporate them. All information incorporable by SCP-8487 has been designated "SCRIPT". Incorporation involves SCP-8487 restructuring itself to maximize internal complexity and info-mobility with its newly available characters, words, and other elements. This constitutes a significant threat.

SCP-8488 refers to an advertisement utilizing the children’s entertainment mascot ‘Birthday Bash’. The Birthday Bash brand includes a toy line, a television series, a movie, a children’s birthday party mascot service, and other products and services themed after the character. No other products or services besides SCP-8488 featuring Birthday Bash have been deemed anomalous.

SCP-8488 depicts the titular character setting up a birthday party in a blue room with colorful presents. About five seconds before the advertisement ends, the words ‘Make any day your birthday with Birthday Bash!’ appear on the screen.
Two Left Feet on the Mezzanine

SCP-8489 is the collective designation for two left hands, severed at the wrist, which were recovered from the personal apartment of Site-86 Ethics Committee Liaison Henri Cosztonne. Both instances of SCP-8489 are anomalously preserved, having shown no signs of decomposition during their time in Foundation custody. However, both instances are susceptible to damage, and neither has been observed to heal or bleed.

One hand is larger in size than the other and possesses thicker hair on the back of the hand. Both hands possess differently-sized but otherwise identical titanium rings on the ring finger. These can be removed and damaged normally.

Inadvertently communicated to current secure facility. Cannot be transferred back to Site of origin. Transmission/selection vector unsolvable. To-date, sixty-seven staff assimilated/incorporated via retrocausal embodiment.

Despite subjective proximity to all personnel, source remains is ineffable. Paranoid sensations are therefore ubiquitous and untreatable. Twelve attempts made to document physicality; each invariably failed.

Census:
• Surface Level: Banner, De Jong, Holden. Maintenance operations continue uninterrupted. Partial conveyance of anomaly sent to main Site via coded missive; awaiting Special Response/Rescue.

SCP-8491 refers to a █████ tree locating on a terraced hillside in a disputed rural zone within the Daffah Territories. Standard dendrochronological analysis of the tree have proven unreliable due to irregular growth rings and continuous internal regeneration.

SCP-8491 exhibits extraordinary resilience to physical harm, such as fire, slashing, and uprooting. Damage from such events is consistently reversed within 72 hours. During periods of damage and recovery, SCP-8491 continuously exudes a viscous red sap. The cumulative volume of these excretions often exceeds the estimated volume of what would be expected from a █████ tree.

SCP-8492 is a self-sustaining oxidative reaction which, in spite of existing during a Vacillante-Type GK-Class “Dead Greenhouse” scenario, continues to produce constant, unabating illumination.

SCP-8492 currently resides within the oropharynx of Agent Caitlin Wandmarcher (SCP-8492-1), with protrusions reaching anteriorly along the dorsal surface of the tongue. Though it produces appreciable heat and consumes oxygen as a non-anomalous flame would, expected deleterious effects upon its host are either absent or present with reduced severity. Transfer of SCP-8492 between hosts is not currently possible but is theorised to be a potentiality with further cultivation and growth.

SCP-8493 is a conceptual entity that metaphysically 'inhabits' a single concept at any point in time. This host concept is designated as SCP-8493-A.

Upon a sapient being recognising a known conceptual attribute of the current SCP-8493-A, a frame of reference for a observable relationship between SCP-8493-A and -B, and an external concept that possesses SCP-8493-B, an IMPOSITION-Event may occur. The likelihood of an IMPOSITION-Event transpiring is directly proportional to the degree to which the observer comprehends all four elements of SCP-8493; subconscious recognition of these concepts has a significantly lower probability of triggering an IMPOSITION-Event than active, intentional cognition (although such a possibility is still dangerously high).

SCP-8494 is a 3-story house in Arizona, approximately 16 miles west of Sedona. The object itself was discovered after the Foundation purchased the property and the surrounding area for a new Site. A mailbox stands in front of the house; while there had apparently been words painted on it, they have long since faded and chipped away. Occasionally, members of the SCP Foundation will receive calls inviting them to visit the house.

The interior of SCP-8494 is completely dark; visual light is incapable of traveling within the house. Furthermore, any attempt at mapping the interior through radar, acoustic imaging, infrared, or other non-visual means has proven unsuccessful, and radio or cellular contact is impossible, rendering drones inoperable.

SCP-8495 is the current designation for a rampant phenomenon affecting Foundation personnel. SCP-8495 consists of two separate anomalies, henceforth designated SCP-8495-1 events, and SCP-8495-2 manifestations. Although all current and former Foundation personnel have the potential to be the subject of an SCP-8495-1 event, their likelihood of experiencing an event can increase when a number of factors are met.
• The subject has behaved morally, and/or ethically.
• The subject does not have close acquaintances or family.
• The subject has at least one positive memory, current and/or former, regarding the winter holidays.
• The subject has suffered major traumatic event(s) while employed by the Foundation.

Subject is a humanoid female, 160cm tall, weight to be confirmed. SCP-8496 resembles a human adolescent of indeterminate race. The anomaly has only been observed within the confines of a specific type of location; it describes these as "islands", researchers have designated them SCP-8496-B. SCP-8496-B instances are invariably shelters of flora and fauna at a higher density than the surrounding area. Recorded instances average 8.5m across, often populated with bushes, grasses, and an average of 2.1 trees. SCP-8496 is capable of instantaneously relocating itself between areas qualifying SCP-8496-B criteria. How the anomaly performs this teleportation is unknown, however it appears to have some control over where it relocates.

SCP-8497 is a 52EB SSD containing a modified copy of the program Microsoft Excel 2007 (v12.0) as well as a single file titled "Foundation Management System V183". This SSD is currently loaded into a modified Foundation computer built to support the size and power requirements of the SSD.

The Foundation Management System V183 file is a spreadsheet containing several live self-updating tables with information pertaining to Foundation logistics services, security deployments, ███ agent rosters, SCP locations, containment cell grading, janitorial work schedules, and the Foundation's financials, among hundreds of others.

Phenomenon affects motor vehicles driven by isolated occupants at speeds between 100-150 km/h (~60-90 mph) between the hours of 10pm and 4am local time on highways in several countries.

During travel, subjects report knocking on the driver side door, lasting from two minutes up to three hours. Pattern tends to be slow and measured, though in longer incidents the pattern becomes rapid and loud, as if distressed. Recordings of civilian encounters confirm the presence of this knocking. Attempts to replicate the phenomenon for study have failed.

Vehicles display dents and trace residue of blood on the driver’s door. Recovered footage of the vehicle's exterior does not present a clear picture of when this occurs.
Echoes of the Barren and Broken

Memetic wards, equipped with sensors, have been installed around the perimeter of SCP-8499 in order to deter civilians from trespassing. Said sensors were programmed to send a signal to the nearby sites in the event that one of the wards goes offline. If this occurs, Foundation staff is to be deployed to reapply it.

Due to the remoteness of the location of SCP-8499, no additional means of containment are necessary at this time.
You have been assigned to oversee containment procedures for a virtual anomaly following the previous supervisor's reassignment. They both want your attention.

SCP-8501 is an extra-planar entity that to date has always taken the form of a type of vehicle belonging to the "Isuzu Elf" brand of trucks manufactured and sold in Japan. The most common form is usually the sixth-generation hi-cab box truck though it has used variants in the series of vehicles such as vans, different styles of trucks, and an ambulance variant. It is currently unknown why it prefers to manifest in this form.

Upon manifestation of an instance of SCP-8501, a unique burst of Akiva Radiation and Elan-Vital Energy (EVE) will split apart a dimensional membrane from which the entity emerges. The aforementioned CYEIMD has been developed to locate these instances.

SCP-8502 is a male human, thirty-nine years of age, approximately 1.65 meters in height, and 52 kg in weight. SCP-8502 is the last Homo sapiens. Born to GoI-7112-G, it is believed that airborne wasting viruses and harsh winters led to social fracturing, causing SCP-8502 to leave the group with its mother at age ten. By 9914, SCP-8502 was the last living human.

SCP-8502 lives a semi-nomadic lifestyle in a roughly 150 square kilometer area in the southeast of Sector KU1 (designated as the Preserve). Periodically traveling between a series of crude huts constructed from rubble, SCP-8502 subsists on surviving tracts of urban algal turfs and local fowl. SCP-8502 has demonstrated an affinity for feathers, decorating its hair in simple, colorful patterns.

SCP-8503-ᛒ, designated as the 'Valkyrie Model' by the Valravn Corporation, are cybernetically enhanced human organisms created for combat applications.

SCP-8503-ᛒ instances exhibit superior strength, speed, agility, and resilience compared to standard human soldiers. SCP-8503-ᛒ units have shown proficiency in both modern firearms and traditional melee weaponry. During combat, SCP-8503-ᛒ instances rely on speed, stealth, and partial bullet-resistant armoring to overcome enemy fire and terminate their targets.

SCP-8503-ᛒ is one of the main assets employed by the Valravn Corporation. Valravn usually deploys SCP-8503-ᛒ for covert infiltration and wetwork, though their use as shock troops and support alongside conventional forces has been documented.

SCP-8504 refers to an anomalous series of pop-up windows that manifests randomly on computers. SCP-8504 usually takes the form of a girl in the Japanese anime style, particularly a popular style from the early 2000s. SCP-8504 is capable of communicating with subjects through the screen of the affected device via speaking aloud. When SCP-8504 speaks, its voice sounds as if it is coming out of a muffled microphone. It has been observed that SCP-8504 can only manifest itself in one place at a time.

Once SCP-8504 manifests on a device, the affected device will physically change to any PC desktop model sold during the years of 2000-2010 (deemed SCP-8504-1). The operating system will change to any operating system released in the year 2000.

SCP-8505 is the designation for a humanoid amalgam roughly 1.6 m in height, given name Percival Godwin or "Percy," as it insists. SCP-8505's physical form is comprised of remains from several preserved cadavers in varying states of decomposition, assembled with rough accuracy using a number of mundane materials. Despite its condition, SCP-8505 displays no pain or negative physical complications aside from occasional "structural indiscretions," such as losing a limb mid-gesture. Lost components become inert until they are reattached; the subject is capable of approximate self-repair when given basic office supplies.

SCP-8506 is a helix-shaped stairway built out of an anomalous, seemingly indestructible crystalline material. The structure is 5 metres tall and has a diameter of 10 metres. Despite its size, SCP-8506 weighs only 424.5 tons, making it extremely lightweight for its size and physical properties.

SCP-8506's primary anomalous property is triggered when any sapient entity ascends the helix, upon reaching a point four metres above the base of the item (Referred to as threshold υ), the entity ascending will be transported to SCP-8506-1.

SCP-8506-1 is an alternate reality, primarily consisting of an infinitely repeating helix of identical properties and appearance to SCP-8506.
You Must be This Tall… To Die!

SCP-8507 was the Wunder Coaster at Wunderpark, located in Janisse, Missouri. Composed primarily of wood, SCP-8507 spanned 607 meters in length and possessed a height of 61 meters, with a drop off of 50 meters at this highest point.

SCP-8508 is a small wooden box resembling a jewellery or trinket box. The words ‘1 Timothy 6:10’ have been carved into the back of the lid. There are no other marks on SCP-8508’s surface, or any lock or catch. SCP-8508 was found by police in an abandoned house in [REDACTED], New South Wales, along with a number of projects in various states of completion. After being brought to the Foundation's attention by police liaison, SCP-8508 was transferred to Area-57. Analysis of the available security camera footage of the area around the house suggests that the person responsible for SCP-8508's creation was A█████ Dawson, an anartist with suspected ties to GoI-5869 ("Gamers Against Weed") and GoI-0267 ("Are We Cool Yet?").

SCP-8509 is a phenomenon able to affect the majority of animal species. Currently, the only factor known to influence an SCP-8509 event happening is a diversity index greater than the average index of the surrounding area(s), though this is not a necessity.

An SCP-8509 event is described as the rapid rise in population of a non-dominant species over a period of 8 to 12 weeks, succeeded by a subsequent decrease of the affected species to levels close to or below their original ones. In all recorded cases, SCP-8509-1-X populations undergo mild to severe physical and psychological adaptations to their respective environment, acquiring the capacity to thrive and dominate their respective environments.
Recovered Notes from a Hungry House

If you are still reading this, I can only assume you are trapped in here. I'm sorry, but you're already dead. If you want to stay alive a bit longer, get off the floor. Find a big, heavy piece of furniture and stand on it. Don't let anything touch the floor or it knows where you are. Make sure you aren't touching any of the walls either.

If you're with the SCP foundation, best thing you can do now is call them and tell them not to send anyone else to whatever facility you think you are in right now. Even better if you can get into contact with Site-41. If you're close enough to an outside door, slide one of these reports out. If you're a MTF unit, order a bombing at whatever coordinates you think you're at.

SCP-8511 was a cognitive hazard that infected staff within Site-17, manifested within the idea of a Foundation worker’s strike. Individuals seemed to believe that they were being treated 'unfairly’ for the services they provide, and continually progressed in their contempt to the point where they refused to work until unrealistic demands were met.

Demands include but are not limited to:
• Dental.
• Hazard Pay.
• Renegotiation on PTO policies.
• Compensation for the families of staff killed on site.
• Holiday Bonus reimplementation.
• Higher pay.

Testing has revealed that infected subjects can stay committed to this strike for extended periods of time, despite the financial burden such actions cause.

The Foundation are currently investigating former Soviet constituent republics for undiscovered SCP-8512 instances. In the event an SCP-8512 activates, the Foundation are to reroute or stop all incoming traffic so that no individual or railway system is affected by the anomaly, with MTF-Delta-11 ("Start Your Engines") to be deployed to detain and transport said instance to Site-54. If necessary, MTF-Lambda-9 ("Mind over Matter") are to be deployed along side to assist in detainment.

Update: Following Incident 8512-05, SCP-8512 has been selected for partial disassembly. All discovered SCP-8512 instances are to have their SCP-8512-A removed using Procedure-102-B-G.

SCP-8513 is the corpse of Researcher Luke Grayson. SCP-8513 is currently undergoing a process of rejuvenation. Attempts to slow or prevent SCP-8513's regeneration are futile, as new damage to the corpse is impermanent.

Researcher Grayson died after a fall from his apartment's window on December 6th 2029, before the Betelgeuse supernova. A novel form of radiation was detected worldwide by specialized Foundation equipment during and after the supernova. SCP-8513 emits high levels of this radiation.

The Foundation has deployed sensors in population centers to determine the extent of SCP-8513 contamination. These sensors showed high levels of emissions from the remains of every human who died before the event.
I'm a Lumberjack and I'm Okay

SCP-8514 describes a singular entity adopting three separate variants. In descending commonality of appearance, they are listed as follows: Variant-1 is a bearded humanoid entity of tall, muscular stature, typically residing in the American mid-and-northwest, and regions of rural Canada. It primarily occupies itself with logging and reforesting, though occasionally it integrates itself with locals, passing itself off as a lumberjack. Variant-1 is occasionally accompanied by SCP-8514-A, an abnormally large blue male Bos taurus. Variant-2 is a humanoid entity with epidermal features resembling a full suit of Medieval European armor.
The Corpse of Dr. Franklin Brollis and The Thing That Lives Inside It

SCP-8516 is a collection of 12 household objects of varying types and origins, a summary inventory of which may be found in Addendum 1.

Research into the objects is still ongoing. However, to date, extensive testing on human subjects has failed to turn up evidence of measurable adverse effects resulting from contact with any single, isolated instance of SCP-8516. Indeed, individually, none of the objects display any apparent anomalous properties whatsoever. Collectively, however, they present a potent cognitohazard.

Subjects exposed to more than one instance of SCP-8516 report a desire to seek out the rest of the collection, with the intensity of the effect increasing markedly the more items the subject views.

Event and involved materials remain poorly understood due to their ambiguous, possibly subjective nature. SCP-8517 is known to have occurred on 2026-05-27.

Involved materials are as follows:
• S1 has characteristics of castles, mountains, and towers. Has a definite physical location somewhere in the Southwestern United States and/or Greece. Sought playfulness. Either died in the course of SCP-8517 or was never alive to begin with. Currently the former location and/or destination of S2 and S3, contemporary relationship prior to SCP-8517 unclear.

SCP-8518 is an idea that abruptly appeared in the noosphere on April 23, 2021 and has remained there since. It is a static view of a brick tower several stories tall, lit from the upper left. SCP-8518 is present in the psyche of every human; the average person recalls SCP-8518 once every two minutes of their own volition. It has proven impossible to dispel even with the use of amnestics and targeted countermemes.

Apart from its omnipresence and unusual persistence in the mental landscape, SCP-8518 appears to possess no unusual properties. It does not cause distress or impairment more than any other mild distraction and has a MICDI score of 0.12. SCP-8518 has no connotations beyond those ascribed to it by observers.

SCP-8519 refers to a youth organization for girls developed by GOI-4319 (“Just Girly Things”) titled the “Sprinkle Scouts”. SCP-8519 has troops stationed all over the United States and Canada, although no set locations have been identified. However, members of SCP-8519 have been discovered by the Foundation.

SCP-8519-A refers to the members of SCP-8519. SCP-8519-A instances have the capability to sell and produce cookies at an impossible rate for the average human. Exact numbers are unknown, but at the highest SCP-8519-A instances have sold up to 100 boxes of cookies a day, and produced up to 500 boxes of cookies a day. Cookies are produced by SCP-8519-A instances using standard ovens, baking materials, and ingredients.

SCP-8520 is the collective delusion held by most of humanity that the Earth has a natural satellite in its orbit, known as the Moon. Although some individuals show some natural immunity to SCP-8520's effects, the vast majority of the population will be unable to perceive the actual nature of SCP-8520, no matter the length of observation or proximity to the area which the Moon is assumed to exist. The strength of this effect extended to the manned Apollo Lunar Missions of the twentieth century, as well as extended observations by astronauts aboard the International Space Station.

SCP-8520-1 is the designation for the source of SCP-8520, a presumed entity of unknown reality bending abilities situated in orbit around Earth.

SCP-8521 is a brown, █████████ brand lever recliner chair, estimated to have been built sometime between the 1990’s and 2000’s. The chair is made of woven fabric and the reclining lever a fine oak wood, although chips in the wood show signs of aging. The Latin phrase, “Praeteritum Plene Praesens Est”, can be seen engraved into the lever’s handle.

When a person sits in SCP-8521 with the recliner activated for approximately one minute, they will experience heavy drowsiness and quickly enter REM sleep. The periods of sleep induced by SCP-8521 have been measured to last anywhere from 30 minutes up to 6 hours. Subjects have reported experiencing life-like recreations of positive core memories while they were asleep in SCP-8521.
AO-8522 is a champagne cork stopper. When inserted into an alcoholic bottle, the container will replenish itself with the corresponding beverage.

SCP-8523 is a gravitational phenomenon observed in the ocean of the terrestrial planet HD 50655 Ad, located 20 light-years away from Earth.

The anomaly is activated when an object crosses HD 50655 Ad's bathypelagic zone, correspondingly adjusting the gravitational pull for the object to sink indefinitely.

It is currently believed either SCP-8523 does not affect organic matter anywise or the several creatures inhabiting HD 50655 Ad's deep ocean have simply adapted to survive in an anomalous environment.

The behavior of matter itself and other laws of physics in the areas affected by SCP-8523 is equally deviant from Normalcy, although throughout irregular periods of time. Extensive investigation of this phenomenon is being conducted.

SCP-8524 is a scrapbook with a leather cover, with dimensions of approximately 30cm x 40cm, weighing 0.45kg when measured. All attempts to alter the cover in any way have proven unsuccessful. Internal pages can be destroyed, removed, or altered, but reappear in their original state when the cover is closed and reopened.

This work contains CWs for: extremely abusive language, implicit misogyny, xenophobia, references to racism and workplace/spousal abuse.

SCP-8525: Santa Baby by xexnoncores and newfangler
Partial render of SCP-C854-INS produced by Foundation paracomputer "SWEET VICTORY", 8526RI = 0.051.

SCP 8527 is a large open-pit asbestos mine, covering an estimated surface area of approximately 9 km². SCP 8527 is located within a taiga forest on the outskirts of ██████, Sverdlovsk Oblast, Russian Federation. To prevent discovery by civilians, all satellite imagery and public cartographic records of SCP-8577 have been altered. The entire mining area has been replaced with forest terrain consistent with the surrounding biome. On official documentation, the area of SCP 8527 is listed as federal property under the jurisdiction of the Russian government.

Archived records indicate that SCP 8527 began asbestos mining operations on 27/07/19██. The Foundation later employed coercive measures that resulted in the mine's closure on 28/09/20██.

SCP-8528 refers to a localized, spontaneous anomalous event involving the microscopic mites Demodex folliculorum and D. brevis residing on the body of Researcher James Fernandez.

At 18:25:42, for a duration of less than three seconds, every mite inhabiting the subject’s pores underwent a simultaneous somatic expansion of approximately 1,500% per second and reaching lengths of up to 30cm.

As these mites reside within the hair follicles and sebaceous glands, the expansion occurred within the subject’s dermal and sub-dermal structure.

SCP-8529 refers to the charred skeletal remains of an adult Felis catus (domestic cat) of undetermined age and breed. It measures 24-centimeters in height and 58-centimeters in length.

SCP-8529's anomalous properties activate once every 48 hours. During activation, a high-pitched sound similar to a whistle is emitted from SCP-8529's oral cavity, despite the lack of any organs or tissues capable of producing vocalisations. This emission lasts for several minutes, with the longest recorded duration thus far being 6 minutes and 17 seconds.

SCP-8530 is the city Maladh (ملاذ) located in Egypt from the moment of its creation until Incident-8530-G. It was built by SCP-8530-A on top of a small desert village over the course of 10 years. It has transformed into a tourism hotspot famous for skyscrapers like the Spiral and the Moon next to projects like Maladh Center Mall, the largest cinema complex in Egypt and the Greenhouse Towers. The original village and its small population have since been entirely displaced.

SCP-8530-A is Mirza Qadir, the founder and governor of SCP-8530. 90% of all businesses operating in SCP-8530 are directly affiliated with SCP-8530-A.

SCP-8531 is a road sign, formerly located on the Minnesota-North Dakota border along Highway 210. Under normal circumstances, it reads "Welcome to North Dakota" with the subtitle "LEGENDARY", similar to other such signs. However, at irregular intervals, its text will change to read "welcome to FUNNY" for roughly 2.2 seconds. Any human who witnesses this and reads the altered text will become an instance of SCP-8531-1.

Comedic material (jokes, etc.) produced by SCP-8531-1 will change to reflect a situation with which the subject is unfamiliar. Specifically, the material will be told from the perspective of a person wrapped in thin metal wires and suspended upside-down in a vat of viscous, opaque yellow liquid.

SCP-8532 is a sudden event that can occur to human beings who are alone in their homes at night. For this event to occur, a complicated set of conditions must be met. These conditions are listed below, and have been roughly arranged in the order the victim is likely to fulfill them chronologically.
• The individual must be tired.
• The individual must not have any immediate need to leave the house, such as a fire.
• The individual must not have any plans to leave the house for the rest of the night.
• The individual must have a room in their home with no important purpose, or that is not commonly used.
• The individual must enter this room and remain in it for at least thirty minutes.

SCP-8533 is a disease affecting human populations. It is characterized by a wide variety of behavioral disorders, mostly relating to an unusual infatuation with horses.

SCP-8533 is spread by an anomalous form of bacteria found in equine saliva (see Vectors & Symptoms for more information). The disease may also be spread between human carriers by a mild memetic vector, although this remains unconfirmed.

SCP-8533 is extremely virulent, but largely asymptomatic, making identification difficult. It is currently believed that approximately 15-20% of the population of Earth is infected with SCP-8533.

It is important to understand that SCP-8533 is not caused by horses themselves; it is caused by exposure to an anomalous vector carried by horses.

SCP-8534 was the football match played on 14/09/1978 between amateur clubs Eastbridge Athletic and Harrow Vale FC at the now-demolished Eastbridge Municipal Stadium. The final score of SCP-8534 was 16.4 - 3.

This score was accepted by all the players, coaching staff, and every single spectator. All attendants displayed confusion regarding why the interviewer was concerned and considered the score unusual. Further investigation shows no influence of a memetic or infohazardous anomaly; SCP-8534 did, without a doubt, occur. Football games are recorded using whole numbers, thus making a.4 completely impossible.

Description (OUTDATED): SCP-8535 designates a statuette composed out of basalt. The object depicts a member of the family Theraphosidae standing upright on two legs. Two appendages on either side of the object are pointed downwards, while the uppermost appendages point upwards. The eyes are comprised of green gem stones that luminesce faintly in dark conditions.

Subjects have reported auditory hallucinations of an abundance of Theraphosidae specimens hissing while in the vicinity of the object.
Mr. Watches, from Little Misters ® by Dr. Wondertainment

Item 8536 is a human male of Caucasian descent, approximately 20 years of age. The words "Mr. Watches, from Little Misters ® by Dr. Wondertainment" are tattooed on the Item's right outer wrist. Item 8536 presents a mustache structurally analogous to the hands of a clock: the left end corresponds to the minute hand and the right end to the hour hand, joined at a single central point located immediately above the upper lip, functioning as an axis. Both ends rotate clockwise along this axis autonomously, maintaining accurate correspondence to local time at all times.
"Are you sure that's him? I mean, it looks like him, but I'm sure a lot of people do…right? What's 537 people out of 16 million?"

Designation Memorandum 5/2168: Due to the nature of SCP-8538, retrieving SCP-8538-Θ from within the anomaly has proven too hazardous for continued efforts. As such, SCP-8538-Δ and SCP-8538-Θ will be referred to with the same designation and be included in the same documentation.
• SCP-8538-Δ: Esoteric/Thaumiel • SCP-8538-Θ: Esoteric/Maksur

A direct description of SCP-8538+1 would spread multiple nomenclature based Infohazards. Any text related to the object written on or after 09/02/2027 has been altered by it.

The only currently available method to effectively convey the nature of the object is to provide the informal discussions of the discovery and investigation process. While these notes are also subject to alteration by the influence of the object, they include sufficient information for continuing research and containment. None of the key events described are considered misleading or objectively inaccurate.

The Clearance Level 3 version of this document includes minor redactions to limit further Infohazardous effects.

Mujin Town is real, I were there once. No, it isn't my hometown Suncheon that people usually think I used as materials to write about the beauty of Mujin.

Mujin is the gorgeous pebble of this world. I, and countless others who came before me, had stood on the solid ground of Mujin, admiring the glamour hidden deep within this place, listening to the vague rhythm like the heartbeat of the town itself. That brief moment was deeply embedded inside me, so that I could weave all of it into this wonderful piece for everyone to taste, in a soft but enduring way, as if they were lost in a surreal realm that never dies, and never disappears.

SCP-8541 was discovered by Foundation surface agents following a contemporaneously prominent double-murder case in Spokane, Washington, USA, on 03-18-1979. The pre- and post-homicide circumstances suggested plausibly supernatural cause to local authorities, thus triggering Foundation intervention. Assessment of the crime scene by Foundation personnel justified SCP designation and subsequent acquisition. All involved extraveil individuals were amnesticized and released from custody.

SCP-8541 is the designation for the sculpture "Head of Francis Bacon” popularly attributed to William Redgrave. A replica created by Redgrave is currently publicly displayed by the Fitzwilliam Museum, and is considered the original by extraveil consensus.
The Swollen Head of Johann Froben
This report is complete and fulfills the function assigned to it. Any addition, alteration, or attempt at rewriting this document may result in a containment breach.

SCP-8543 is an anomalous form of folic acid found in the Punica granatum plant, genetically modified by a joint operation between Prometheus Labs and the Manna Charitable Foundation. The Foundation had been aware of various related genetic experiments conducted by Prometheus Labs as part of the Epimetheus Clause (See attached file), but a violation of the clause by Lab ███ prompted an intervention. MTF Theta-4 was dispatched, subsequently discovering the modified plants. Seventy-three of eighty-seven specimens were incinerated, with the remainder confiscated by the Foundation, along with all related documents.

SCP-8544 designates a single anomalous event that affected Dr. Monika Veidni during a bout of recurrent sleep paralysis.

Originally believed to be a nightmare, Dr. Veidni did not mention the event for two weeks until a monthly session with her on-site psychiatrist, in which the event was described in vague detail. Dr. Veidni was advised to play back video footage of the night the event took place, at which point SCP-8544 was discovered.

SCP-8545 is a sketch scrawled on a singular sheet of beige colored construction paper. Analysis of the material the anomaly was designed on has determined that the "origin" of the anomaly is fixated specifically within the sketch itself. For all intents and purposes, the construction paper itself is entirely non-anomalous.

Markers, colored pencils, crayons, and glitter glue are determined to be the main tools used to craft the sketch. Art quality is poor, various elements appear traced from resources discovered online. The construction paper is punctured in various areas, assumed from being subjected to intense pressure whilst the artist was drawing SCP-8545.

In 2006, a hiker discovered the corpse of an elderly woman partially buried under fallen rocks on a remote hiking trail near Canmore, Alberta. Upon approaching, he was attacked by what he described as a feral dog and fled; attacker did not pursue. Bite mark on victim's leg did not match dentation of any known animal. Item found in vicinity of corpse shortly after incident, recovered and moved to Site-19.

At time of containment, SCP-8546 visually resembled a small domestic dog. Physical strength and speed much higher than would be expected of such; biting force estimated at 700 kilograms. Movements described as unnaturally smooth. There was a large rip in the skin of its right upper hind leg, exposing bare muscle.

SCP-8547 is a human infant possessing ontokinetic abilities with no known limit. Prior to Foundation intervention, it was capable of producing CK-class reality restructuring events in accordance with how it viewed the world. While it can no longer create new CK-class events due to the drugs administered to it by the Foundation, any CK-class event it created prior to containment still appears to persist indefinitely, and, in accordance with prior cases of ontokinetic humanoids, will likely continue to persist even if SCP-8547 ceases life function.

SCP-8547 has generated a variety of CK-class events, the vast majority of which have had little lasting effect.
The Best Worst Thing to Ever Happen to Me

SCP-8548 refers to a probabilistic anomaly that manifests when SCP-8548-1 and SCP-8548-2 interact with one another. Whenever both entities are placed directly in front of each other and begin to act aggressively towards one another, it causes several probabilistic errors to occur.

Any object or event within the radius of SCP-8548 will result in undesirable outcomes, such as some form of destruction or otherwise catastrophe.

Though the nature of SCP-8548 has caused several failures at Site-225, SCP-8548-1 and SCP-8548-2 are unable to be physically separated from one another.

SCP-8549 is a species of fungus discovered in ██████, Ohio, within the basement of an abandoned house. All SCP-8549 infections can be traced back to the house, which is considered the epicenter of SCP-8549. The house is in decay; large growths of SCP-8549 have burst through the roof and walls.

SCP-8549 is parasitic towards mammals, growing rapidly in and around its host's organs. The fungi keeps its host alive via anomalous means, and will continue to do so even if the host suffers catastrophic injury. After an indeterminate amount of time, the fungi inside will fully mature, splitting the corpse open and releasing spores. The spores feed on the corpse, infecting new hosts and continuing the life cycle.

SCP-8550 is composed of three constituent parts.

SCP-8550 refers to the theoretical cause of SCP-8550. Proposed by Research Head Dr. Graham, it suggests that there's a sentient entity at the heart of SCP-8550-1. Further research into the validity of this proposal is ongoing. SCP-8550-1 refers to an anomalously altered circovirus. These alterations have granted it status as a new species, hereby designated Circovirus minimafrange. C. minimafrange appears to be extremely small, only about 0.8 nanometers across. SCP-8550 has displayed several odd traits, such as random periods of inactivity, despite possible hosts being nearby.

SCP-8550 has also displayed the ability to lay dormant for a period of up to 3 days, which would help transmit it.

SCP-8551 is a copy of Herman Melville’s Moby-Dick, printed by Dover Publications in 2003 as an entry in the ‘Dover Giant Thrift Editions’ series. Physically, SCP-8551 resembles any other copy of Moby-Dick produced as a part of that same print run,. Although investigations carried out by researchers at Site-12 involved buying up all available copies of the long-since out-of-print Giant Thrift edition, only SCP-8551 has displayed anomalous properties. in roughly Good condition,. As defined by the widely-accepted grading standard established by defunct periodical AB Bookman’s Weekly, the ‘Good’ condition describes “the average used and worn book that has all pages or leaves present”.

SCP-8552 refers to a colony of Cimex lectularius currently infesting Site-180's residential sector. After being bitten by an SCP-8552 instance individuals develop atypical symptoms, including:
• Dermatillomania
• Aversion to bright lights
• Spontaneous mutism
• Lack of appetite and thirst
• Insomnia
• Tinnitus
• Loss of fine motor control
• Excessive weight loss (~10% of body mass)

Despite the severity of these symptoms, infected personel report minimal pain and no fatalities have occurred.

SCP-8553 is an infant German girl between ██ and ██ months old. Any living creature that enters SCP-8553's line of sight will be instantly transmuted into a toy, designated SCP-8553-1.

SCP-8553-1 instances vary in complexity, from simple wooden blocks and balls to remote control cars and battery-powered action figures. Instances appear to possess anomalous properties that allow them to operate on their own power.

SCP-8554 is a triadic pyramid located in the ancient Maya city of Calakmul, often referred to as Structure II. SCP-8554's base measures 120m 2 and stands at 45 meters tall. Located in the remains of Structure-2A of SCP-8554 are two indestructible, immovable boxes made of limestone. Despite their unbreakable nature, one box is open and was presumably looted; the remaining box is still unopened, however, all attempts to view the contents of it have been unsuccessful. In addition to these anomalous boxes, the temple itself has an anomalous effect on human consciousnesses, specifically on those related to ethnic Maya groups.

SCP-8555 is a cylindric artifact with a diameter of ~20 meters, and an overall height of ~30 meters, with some intricate subordinate mechanical structures attached to its main part upon its discovery.

The main part consists of three identical rectangular mirror-like surfaces sized 16.99 m × 25.0 m positioned in the shape of an equilateral triangle, forming a tri-prism, and a translucent vitrified hull serving as an exterior wall. White light tubes are installed to each interior arris, previously powered by adjacent atomic generator plants that were estimated to remain able to function completely under no human supervision and maintenance for at least 3,800 years.

SCP-[PENDING] is an Electronika-508 Video model reel-tape recorder, developed by the Soviet Ministry of Electronic Industry. SCP-[PENDING]’s physical properties align with reel-to-reel recorders of a similar make, both in appearance and functionality. The play button is replaced with a misprinted inverted triangle enclosed within a circle, presumed to be a production mistake.

When used to play a compatible tape recording, SCP-[PENDING] generates an anomalous effect within a 15m radius. To observers both within and outside the radius, the nature of reality within said radius appears altered, including spatial distortions, sensory stimulation, and the creation, transmutation and disappearance of matter, sound and light waves.

SCP-8557 is a biological phenomenon wherein continuous self-mutilation can cause recent wounds to become sapient oral cavities capable of sustained and coherent communication.

The process is painless; affected wounds cease bleeding and undergo coagulation within four minutes. The formation sequence begins with the development of lips, derived from local epidermal tissue, followed by the emergence of a complete adult dental arch and, finally, a non-functional tongue.

SCP-8557 instances consistently exhibit a demeanor described as "unconditionally caring", engaging their hosts in personalized, emotionally validating dialogue with precise recognition of prominent interests, fears and unresolved grief.
SCP-8558 refers to a pair of interconnected anomalies:

SCP-8559 is hypothesized to be a metaphysical entity that follows a number of laws, which have all been discovered through their violation. There may be laws enacted by SCP-8559 that are currently undiscovered but are legally binding. As of 06/23/2024, SCP-8559 is located at Biological Research Site-129, a low-risk containment and research facility housing approximately thirty SCP objects handled by the Biology Department and the Synthology Department.

SCP-8560 is a humanoid male of South-African descent (previously known as Josef Enzokuhle), aged at approximately 65 years old, measured at 5'5ft, with brown eyes, grey hair and a slender build. SCP-8560 exhibits severe emotional and psychological instability, slipping in and out of depressive episodes at random. Most attempts to prevent these episodes via the use of medicine fail. However, administering anti-depressants and psychotics has been shown to delay the onset of these attacks by weeks at a time.

A tombstone and obituary for SCP-8560 was found after containment of SCP-8560 had been established, dating back to 1948/09/13.

SCP-8561 refers to the statue situated at the highest point of Castel Sant'Angelo, in Vatican City, Rome (Italy). At first glance, SCP-8561 appears to be made entirely of weathered bronze with subsequent structural alterations, and is mounted on a base of carved and polished stone.

Historical records state that SCP-8561 was an exact replica of the original statue commissioned by Pope Gregory the Great following the alleged apparition of the Archangel Michael sheathing his sword atop the castle as a sign of the end of the plague ravaging Rome around the year 590 AD. In 1752, SCP-8561 was installed in place of the original statue, which remains stored in one of the castle's interior corridors to this day.
The age of gods has ended and most of them have moved on, but Xipe Totec remains.

SCP-8563 is a young human girl. There are things wrong with it, so it has to be tested for issues. It is incapable of sitting in its cell and being quiet, so don't be afraid of hurting it when escorting it to and from its cell. Sometimes, all it does is sit in its cell and be quiet, which is not what we want either. Nobody wants SCP-8563 for too long.

Sometimes, when SCP-8563 reads books, it imagines itself like the characters in those books. The books change so that SCP-8563 is the characters. SCP-8563 has been Rapunzel, SCP-8563 has been Matilda, SCP-8563 has been Greg Heffley. Only in the books though. When it is done, it makes the books go back to normal.

SCP-8564-1 refers to any of 32 explosive devices that were dropped on major cities worldwide on 29 January, 1964. SCP-8564-1’s technology has not been identified, though it bears resemblance to the Foundation’s own former nuclear initiative, Project AEDile. Despite resembling modern weaponry, SCP-8564-1’s payload is paranormal and cannot be recreated, but releases heavy levels of radiation along with its other effects. Drop sites continue to emit radiation in quantities up to one sievert.

While they are believed to all come from the same source, SCP-8564-1’s country of origin has not been identified.

SCP-8564-2 refers to the animated remains of all organic life destroyed on 29 January.

SCP-8565 are beverage cans that contain the anomalous memetic agent Root-31. It is unknown how many of these cans are currently in circulation.

SCP-8565's memetic property compels those that kick an instance to continue kicking it. Affected individuals have been sighted "kicking the can" aimlessly for days on end, even at the detriment of their own health. If an SCP-8565 instance appears in a populated area, it can create an instance of SCP-8565-2. These instances are large groups of people (over 10) that have formed a hive-mind, all with the sole purpose of kicking the SCP-8565 instance.

It has been noted that instances of SCP-8565-2 have a distinct behaviour.

You are able and encouraged to record journal entries throughout your trip for the SCP Foundation deepwell archive. You have been selected in order to carry out the mission of saving the world.

SCP-8568 is the collective designation for two connected phenomena related to Ariolimax columbianus in Fresno, California.

SCP-8568-A are posts on Bluesky that instruct slugs to "rise up" and "break the chains of the human hegemony." The accounts that create these posts are solely dedicated to this cause, posting nothing else, all linked to the domain of gastropodunity.███, and all posting from the Fresno area. As of 31 May 2024, there is no website hosted at gastropodunity.███. Additionally, the domain is registered to an individual named "Banan A. Slug," listed with a disconnected phone number, an email address from a throwaway website, and a PO box in Fresno registered to the same name.
All The Holy Lands Before You

SCP-8570 is a house located on the outskirts of [REDACTED], ██, which appears to have been converted from domestic use for an unclear purpose at some point in the past. This includes the removal of the back door and all windows, which were subsequently filled in and/or boarded up. The structural integrity of SCP-8570 has been considerably compromised by fire, and the roof has collapsed in several parts of the house. An assessment concluded that the likelihood of further collapses is high, leading to the ban on entering the building.

The rooms within SCP-8570 are as follows:
• A parlour, containing two chairs and a table. One of the chairs was knocked over and left to lie where it fell.

SCP-8571 refers to an easily spreadable cognitomemetic agent that causes those affected (SCP-8571-1) to believe in the existence of a fictional soccer league. The transmission vector for SCP-8571 is the spoken or written form of the competition's official name (

SCP-8572 is a proto-eigenweapon located under the Winter Palace in St. Petersburg, Russia. It was constructed sometime during the 18th century through various thaumaturgic and alchemical engineering methods, and has since been utilized by the Romanov dynasty and the Soviet government to serve the interests of the Russian Empire and USSR until SCP-8572-1's expiration sometime around 1991.

Prior to its expiration, SCP-8572-1 was a spectral entity of unclear make and capabilities. It possessed a high concentration of spiritual and thaumic energies; as such. it was the centerpiece of the machine and its de facto battery.

SCP-682 are two predators that possess an apparent fascination with the slaughter of human beings. One of these predators (-A) is located in the Tian Shan mountain range in Central Asia, while the other (-B) is located inside of the 85 Pitt Street apartment building in New York City, New York, United States.

Though they'll use any method, they appear to most enjoy the skinning of the face, the tearing of the scalp from the skull, the gouging of the eyeballs, the flattening of the chest until rupture, and/or the splitting of the spine followed by the tearing of the torso into two halves. They are efficient killers, though their techniques differ in a few key ways.

SCP-8574 refers to an event that occurred on May 12, 2026, causing the integration of various foreign concepts within the Noosphere centered within Organized Cluster OC-4262, occurring over the times between 2:21 AM and 7:34 AM, EST time.

As a result of SCP-8574, all formalized rules of tennis now include an additional clause, most often defined as the “Penis Game Clause”, classified as SCP-8574-1. This does not affect any other sport, including pickleball and badminton.

SCP-8574-1 is defined, in competition rules, as the requirement to state the word “penis” upon serving or receiving the ball in a round.
"Dr. Davidson's application for "privacy" has been denied. Further objections to this investigation will be seen as cause for disciplinary action. — Office of Internal Inquiries"

SCP-8576 is an anomalous disorder limited to the Greater London area. Similar to individuals with DoP, instances believe they are parents despite being childless.

SCP-8576 does not respond to antipsychotics requiring instead a course of amnestics. This treatment subdues the anomaly providing remission from the delusions.

While the criteria for relapse is poorly understood, recurrence typically follows when an instance views an item they consider sentimental. Such keepsakes often hold additional effects. For example, an instance may describe a portrait as a family photo with their child. The portrait in question is their couple's photo.

SCP-8578 is potentially an elemental actualisation of the collective pain and suffering of all known life-forms. Its corporeal form is facultatively bipedal. Its height fluctuates between 5.4 to 13.5 meters tall with no identifiable influence for this variation beyond its presumed inclination.

Physical contact with SCP-8578 heightens all senses of the contactee, prominently influencing discomforted or painful areas. Affected organisms, including humans, frequently display distress, confusion or a physiological equivalent; SCP-8578 does not retaliate if confronted aggressively because of this, instead withdrawing itself.

SCP-8578 communicates via telepathic transmissions, receivable by any class 2 or above psychic.

Due to complications with the item, this entry number is supplementary and the item has been temporarily left unmarked and delisted due to concerns with the Preszôt area. Along with this, several unauthorised alterations have been made to the file. Personnel accessing this file with improper security clearance will be reprimanded. – RAISA

SCP-8580 denotes baroque pearls distinguished by their comparatively low conchiolin and high mucin contents. Instances are hollow, containing a small pocket of stale air at their centers instead of a solid nucleus. These factors render SCP-8580 instances fragile in comparison to commercial counterparts.
This article contains attempted deadnaming, lesbo/transphobia, and a panic attack.
A pair of shoes that do not belong to you

SCP-8582 are a pair of shoes that do not belong to you. They are size █, which is notably too small for you to comfortably wear. They are not practical footwear for everyday use, nor are they generally considered stylish or fashionable. There is no indication that the wearing of SCP-8582 would improve your life in any tangible way. There is every indication that the wearing of SCP-8582 would cause inconvenience for yourself and those around you.

For the above reasons, and because they do not belong to you, it would be inappropriate for you to wear SCP-8582.

SCP-8583 is a toy slot machine about six inches in length, three inches in width, and eight inches in height, comprised of plastic and aluminum. It is decorated with paper stickers mimicking the appearance and style of an older model slot machine. A small lever, which is slightly damaged due to wear and tear, is mounted on the right-hand side of SCP-8583.

It has two coin acceptors, one of which is on the front, and the other of which is on the top. A coin hopper is present near the bottom of the front face.

A small red LED light is mounted atop SCP-8583's case, but it seems to be out-of-order, only functioning in rare instances (see Addendum).

SCP-8584 refers to an organized crime syndicate currently known as the "Cobalt Crew". While its activities are consistent with traditional organized crime, members uniformly wear clown attire and makeup. Documented activities include racketeering, extortion, contract enforcement, and targeted violence. SCP-8584 exhibits the ability to revive, remanifest, or reincarnate its deceased members, with multiple instances of confirmed post-mortem activity. The organization has been documented to be active for at least 70 years under various names, with notable periods of territorial expansion and decline. There are currently 30-35 confirmed core members.

SCP-8585 is a humanoid entity resembling a heavyset elderly man of Slavic descent. His physical features have been inconsistent since the anomaly initially came to Foundation attention, however he has been consistently described as "glowing", or as having a halo of light around his head.

SCP-8585 identifies himself as Daždźboh, a member of the Slavic pantheon, typically as the deity associated most with solar cults of worship. He is far older than he physically appears, having been mentioned in several historical texts and showcasing detailed historical knowledge dating back as early as 940 CE.

SCP-8586 is SCP Foundation Director of Personnel Dr. Lachlan "Lach" Cairns. Dr. Cairns began working for the Foundation as a Junior Researcher in 1980 and was promoted to Staff Researcher in 1981, Senior Researcher in 1983, and Doctor of Staff in 1986. He is the son of the late Dr. Ansel Cairns and Dr. Lillian Brand-Cairns. Prior to her death in 1987, he was married to Dr. Aileen Lament.

As a result of the 8586-CHARON event, Dr. Cairns has become functionally immortal. Upon the expiry of its host body, Dr. Cairns' consciousness will, after a short interstitial period, reawaken in the nearest available dead body.

SCP-8587 is a rusted two-step folding ladder resting in the backyard of a home residence in ███████, Quebec. The object is unable to be moved, but still experiences physical effects of the environment such as cuts, and lost screws. Its legs remain mostly unharmed.

SCP-8588 is a wooden treehouse located in Llewellyn, Pennsylvania. The structure itself has proven impervious to damage from weather conditions, wildlife, and fires. Despite being constructed from untreated pine and lacking any known protective finish, SCP-8588 has shown no signs of rot, mold, or structural degradation since its discovery in 2007.

When entered by three or more children between the ages of 6 and 10, SCP-8588's inner space shifts into a meeting chamber furnished with beanbag chairs, an assortment of plush animals, and a collection of coolers and cabinets containing juice boxes and other foodstuffs. The source of these items and the cause leading them to appear inside of SCP-8588 are unknown.

SCP-8589 refers to approximately 1.5 tons of stainless steel, originally collected from a naturally occurring deposit in Dixie Valley, Nevada. The material is of considerably substandard quality, consisting primarily of tin (43.6%), aluminum (22.5%), and chromium (10.7%), with trace amounts of carbon, iron, gallium, hafnium, lead, platinum, iridium, silicon and titanium. SCP-8589 is considered stainless steel only by technicality as it lacks the material's usual durability due to its unrefined composition.

SCP-8589 emits a Class-III memetic hazard which causes observers to believe that it is the ideal material to use in any scenario that would require a metallic substance.

SCP-8590 is a 32-year-old human male with reality-warping abilities, including teleportation, manifestation of objects, manipulation of a person's memory, and omniscience.

SCP-8590 uses the combination of its incredibly powerful abilities to work menial, low-paying jobs.

SCP-8590 appears throughout the contiguous United States, usually in the Midwest. How SCP-8590 chooses its locations is unknown; there does not appear to be a pattern. Identification on SCP-8590’s person (name tags, driver's license, etc) only displays the name "Dale." The positions SCP-8590 holds change rapidly based on no known factor; most likely, SCP-8590 simply decides to have a new job and does so.
Alex Thorley Doesn’t Get Away With It

SCP-8591 was an adult African Elephant that sporadically appeared and disappeared in Researcher Alex Thorley’s office.

After the publishing of this documentation, SCP-8591 vanished and has not reappeared in over a year.

SCP-8592 is the Department Department, a nonexistent Foundation department operated by an unknown party. Mentions of SCP-8592 began appearing in official Foundation documents in April 2016, but due to the number of Foundation departments it was listed with, SCP-8592 was not properly noted as a discrepancy until December, when it began sending emails to random personnel members.

SCP-8592 is operated by an entity claiming to be a member of Foundation personnel self-identifying as D. Partment. There is no record of anyone under that name existing.

The vectors that cause SCP-8592 to manifest are not fully understood, but as of writing, the only definite factor that causes manifestation is when any level of personnel begins a new research project.

SCP-8593 is a series of television broadcasts for "Pasta with Fazool," a cooking show focused on Italian American cuisine.

SCP-8593-1 hosts SCP-8593 and is a victual humanoid entity self-identifying as "Fazool Cavatelli." SCP-8593-1's body is composed entirely of dry pasta; its torso is constructed from a bundle of spaghetti, while two pieces of penne form its arms. SCP-8593-1 possesses human hands, which are incongruent with the rest of its composition and each other. Its head is a large meatball, capable of limited facial expressions and speech in English. SCP-8593-1's outfit changes between episodes, though these changes appear limited to commonly colored or patterned aprons and matching toques.

SCP-8595 is an American cockroach (Periplaneta americana) which believes itself to be a restaurant critic.

SCP-8595 is sapient and sentient but is not capable of speech. When presented with any consumable item and any method of writing, SCP-8595 will eat the item and write a review of it, the interior of the location where the item was eaten, the service, and the concept of the "restaurant," combining these elements into a rating out of five stars.

It is assumed SCP-8595 either believes itself to be human or that cockroaches should be allowed to eat at restaurants, as seen by multiple complaints on its Yelp about it being run out of restaurants, long waits for seating, being ignored, having items thrown at it, or being sprayed with chemicals.
Scopophobia: The Employee of the Month

SCP-8596-1 is equipped with a locked mechanical collar that houses two small Scranton Reality Anchors. This collar is remotely monitored and controlled by Site-322's surveillance console. Should SCP-8596-1 remove this collar, personnel are to trigger the panic button on their body camera, attempt to peacefully exit the containment chamber, and travel back to base.

SCP-8596-1 is to be entertained in conversation as long as this collar remains on. As a former member of Foundation staff, a cordial level of familiarity is expected for its comfort in conversation.

All interviews should ultimately lead the assigned staff to question what SCP-8596 is. On rare occasions, SCP-8596-1 will initiate a conversation about SCP-8596.

SCP-8597 is a slideshow uploaded to social media and content application TikTok.

SCP-8597 is thirteen images long. Upon viewing, a looping 30-second audio clip of Claude Debussy's Clair De Lune will play. The first slide is dedicated to a title card reading " your month, your guy, " followed by twelve images. Each depicts an instance of SCP-8597-1, as well as its name and individual characteristics.

SCP-8597-1 is a group of twelve anomalous entities correlated to a month of the year that spontaneously appear upon viewing SCP-8597. The viewer’s birth month is the determining factor in which of the twelve entities will manifest.

SCP-8598 is professional wrestler and reality bender Gary Moreno.

SCP-8598 performed between 1966 and 1974, beginning in Japan and ending in the burgeoning World Wide Wrestling Federation. He gained fame as "Jerry 'Sharpshooter' Roulette," a heel outlaw bounty hunter chasing 'bounties' and the world championship.

After a car accident in 1973, SCP-8598's anomalous properties began manifesting; this coincided with the development of major depressive disorder, theorized schizophrenia, alcoholism, and drug addiction.
The empresses of the Mekhanites and the hall dedicated to preserving their legacy.

SCP-8601 (colloquially 'Null Island') is the anomalous appearance of random objects (SCP-8601-1 instances) in the sea at the crossing of the prime meridian and the equator at exactly 0°N 0°E 0m altitude. SCP-8601-1 instances manifest instantaneously at the average sea level. The objects are very varied, ranging from junk to high-tech equipment, almost always completely malformed or destroyed by the simultaneous intersection with the atmosphere, ocean, and previous instances, with temperatures ranging from 98 °C to 677 °C in 95% of cases.

Manifestation events are random with discernible patterns.
This is a component to make the mobile sidebar button active on desktop-size screen.
LIAR, LIAR, OATH'S A PYRE — LOYALTY SOLD TO THE HIGHEST BUYER.

SCP-8603 displays no anomalous abilities until connected to any device that fulfills the following conditions:
• At least (1) USB port
• Capable of retaining information
• Independent power source. Get rid of this, we need to make it more sellable.
• User-facing terminal

Upon connection, SCP-8603's anomalous properties will manifest. The connected device will now be referred to as SCP-8603-B until its disconnection.

Regardless of the level of encryption or programming language, the terminal of -B will activate and present a prompt: "Extract or Depict."

Upon prompting "Extract," all information aboard -B will be unencrypted, duplicated onto SCP-8603, and re-encrypted. In comparison to its non-anomalous counterparts, SCP-8603 has no storage limit..

SCP-8604 is an extradimensional space of apparent infinite length and a width between 3 and 8 metres. The entrance to SCP-8604 is dually monodirectional; the anomaly may not be accessed through its north or south sides, nor may the anomaly be exited by reversing course after entering it. The entrance to SCP-8604 is located within Uwharrie National Forest in North Carolina, United States.

Upon entering SCP-8604, robotic surveillance has confirmed that SCP-8604 extends an apparently infinite distance to both the front and back. Foliage and ground patterns repeat at an interval of approximately one kilometre.

SCP-8605 is a set of documents each identifying themselves as the "L-NESC Operator's Manual". Each instance pertains to one known component of or system relating to SCP-7005, the interdimensional transportation network known as Lampeter. Instances periodically appear at the workspaces of Lampeter personnel, updated in new editions with additional and/or altered content. The bulk of this content pertains to the care and maintenance of Lampeter apparatus; as the network is comprised of and accessed by a wide variety of transit technology across thousands of continuous and detached universes, the information within each instance is by necessity diverse.

SCP-8606 is a miscalculation in the estimation of the entropy of celestial bodies, resulting in a widespread underestimation of the rate at which entropy increases on a cosmic scale. Rather than projecting the universe's thermal death to occur over the course of several billion years, revised estimates suggest that 99.99% of universal thermal energy will be lost by the year 2017.

Solar extinction is projected to occur in February 2015.

A thermal screen project was proposed and accepted by the O5 Council to conserve as much of the Earth's available heat as possible.
Lucy is not allowed to exit the house under any circumstances. Lucy is to remain inside the house at all times. Lucy is not to leave the house.

SCP-8608 is a collection of five erotic anime episodes from a series titled " ねえ、そんな目で見ないで〜あたしは妊娠可能な46歳、2児の母親で、まだJKなのよ〜？！," roughly translated as, " Hey, don't look at me like that — I'm 46 years old, fertile, a mother of two, and I'm still a schoolgirl?! " While each episode follows a specific loose theme or premise as described on physical packaging, episodes vary greatly between viewings, with scenes, plot points, dialogue, and occasionally even genre differing each time an episode is viewed.

SCP-8608 follows "secondary protagonist" Ayana Shiragami, a woman "apparently in her late adulthood," as she navigates her way through Otaku High.

SCP-8609 appears to be an adolescent male of eastern-European descent. SCP-8609 has displayed a fluency in contemporary English, as well as an unidentified language, believed to be a precursor to modern Khakas. SCP-8609 identifies itself as "Euris" and claims to have once studied as an apprentice in the "House of Taurrak" during the Late Sarkic Imperial Era. According to SCP-8609, it was able to survive into the modern day through the use of an ancient Sarkic technique, holding its body inside an organic stasis pod for over two millennia.

SCP-8609 has displayed a range of carnomantic capabilities, capable of temporarily modifying the structure of both its own body and the bodies of other living beings, albeit with much more difficulty.

SCP-8610 is a sapient M2 Browning machine gun. The object shows high levels of internal wear consistent with heavy usage, as well as exterior corrosion, but remains functional. When affixed to an appropriate mount, the object is capable of turning itself within the full range of rotation that the mount allows. SCP-8610 is able to manipulate its trigger and charging handle of its own volition, but still requires a human operator for loading.

While not capable of vocalization, SCP-8610 is capable of communication through other means, such as rotating in a manner which resembles nodding when affixed to a mount, or spelling words by shooting at lettered targets.

SCP-8611 is a reality-altering phenomenon which affects compounds on the chemical level. If exposed, a compound of significant complexity - with the potential to form divergent structural or stereo-isomers - will have its atomic arrangement and bonding transmuted into one of these other forms. This results in the gradual substitution of compounds and chemical structures into functionally different versions of themselves, often heavily impacting the reactions which they are able to undergo and the interactions between other parts of the same material. Each individual transmutation is random, meaning that many varying isomers of the same compound may be produced as a result of SCP-8611 exposure.

SCP-8612 is the collective classification of fifty (50) small rubber figurines, each approximately 3.0 x 3.5 cm (1.2 x 1.4 inches) in size, depicting a stylized and cartoonish version of Jesus Christ. The figures lack any identifying brand, manufacturer markings, or production codes. Despite their small size and simplistic design, each figure is fully sentient, capable of independent movement, and possesses a distinct personality, voice, and belief system.

Each instance of SCP-8612 identifies itself as the one true Jesus Christ and vehemently denies the legitimacy of the others.
Don’t Take Me to the Impound

SCP-8613 is a sapient 2002 Pontiac Firebird Trans Am with the license plate 173█████, capable of autonomous propulsion, environmental perception, and vocal communication via unknown means. SCP-8613 can be operated like a normal vehicle of its type, however, it is able to override any operator input to the steering, throttle, or braking systems at will. It is not capable of any kind of atypical locomotion associated with anomalous vehicles. SCP-8613 identifies itself as “Ricky”, and speaks with a voice consistent with late adolescence and a light Southern accent.

SCP-8614 is a locked wooden coffin of unknown age and origin. The coffin is made of inert matter and does not appear to age or deteriorate. The coffin exchanges air with its surroundings every hour. It is otherwise airtight.

The sides of SCP-8614 are covered in funerary art as well as untranslated ███████ glyphs suspected to relate to bloodletting, autocannibalism and ascendance. The illustration depicts scenes of identical women fighting with the victor consuming the blood of the vanquished, and then placing them in a coffin.

Sounds ranging from 30dB to 120dB emanate from the coffin at irregular intervals.

SCP-8615 is a heavily oxidized brass oil lantern of mid-20th century manufacture, measuring approximately 29 cm in height and 13 cm in diameter. Design analysis indicates similarities to kerosene lamps produced between 1900 and 1960. The underside of the lantern bears a manufacturing label marked “M.N.”, though no records of this manufacturer exist in any national registry or historical trade database. The baseplate and handle display wear patterns consistent with prolonged maritime or industrial use, yet metallurgical analysis shows no structural fatigue or decay beyond surface oxidation.
