SCP-8616 is a predatory mutation that affects approximately 3.3% of all Dalmatian Pelicans (Pelecanus crispus), denoted SCP-8616-A. SCP-8616-A instances attempt to swallow whole unbaptized human infants en route to self-professed Christian parents, denoted SCP-8616-B, by intercepting infant-bearing Ciconiiformes. Should SCP-8616-A succeed in consumption, the SCP-8616-B instance will vanish from observable spacetime.

Tracking of SCP-8616-B post-consumption indicates continued life signs, temperatures above 7000°C, the presence of elemental sulfur, and millions of human screams.

SCP-8617 is a steel grate of unknown origin within a wooden frame located at the bottom of Patoka Lake, Indiana. Attempts to remove the grate have proven unsuccessful. The wooden frame holding the grate is scratched in multiple places, with the pattern of the scratches superficially resembling writing. A highly damaged wooden floor is visible under the grate, with a single scrap of paper on it.

SCP-8618 is a one-bedroom apartment unit in Kamloops, British Columbia. The suite displays signs of chronic disuse — extensive dust and webbing accumulations are visible on the furniture. Housing records indicate that the unit belonged to Ana Leclercq, a photographer previously employed by a Vancouver paparazzi agency. Prior to SCP-8618's discovery, Leclercq had already been missing for several months but had not been reported as such until the expiration of their lease.

The contents of SCP-8618 — while in gross disarray — are generally unremarkable. However, unusual alterations have been made to the kitchen oven. The porcelain paneling of the oven's interior, as well as its steel racks, have been disassembled and removed from their frame.
I Know You Have It In You

SCP-8619 is the official designation for the vermiform appendix. Though all instances are considered anomalous, most will display no anomalous effects during their host's lifetime.

The onset of anomalous activity within SCP-8619 instances, or "Appendicitis", denotes a sudden inflammation of the instance within the subject, and is most commonly indicated by a dull pain in the center of the subject's abdomen. As activity intensifies, additional effects may include further pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea and constipation, which will each increase in severity over a 24-72 hour period without medical intervention.

At any time, an inflamed SCP-8619 instance within a subject may initiate the following process.

SCP-8620 is a Belgian male, biologically at least 19, functionally no more than 22 since the year 1919 is a phenomenon affecting a Belgian male, biologically at least 19, functionally no more than 22 since the year 1919 is a former reporter, last name Tintin, last seen 1919 on a boat from Lisbon, Portugal to

SCP-8621 refers to a small, sessile parasitic organism, typically 3–7 cm in length when detached, with a soft, segmented, gelatinous body. Exposed tissue reacts to SCP-8621 by producing a rapid mucosal attachment, once attached, SCP-8621 secretes a complex mixture of proteins and neuroactive compounds that facilitate integration with host somatic tissue.

The most significant property of SCP-8621 is its ability to induce a progressive morphological transformation in hosts. After attachment and a latent period (24–96 hours in small mammals, variable and typically longer in larger hosts), the host begins to exhibit:
• Gradual thickening and paleness of dermal tissue, later described as a "fleshy integument" that lacks normal hair or scale patterning.

SCP-8622 is the designation given to the events that transpired in June 1987, in the city of Lamb, Massachusetts. Although the primary anomalous events occurred on the carnival grounds, a series of accessory anomalous phenomena developed, affecting residents or former residents of the city.

On 13/06/1987, Simon Goldstein attempted to summon a powerful reality bending entity with help from an unidentified perpetrator only referred to by the pseudonym “Jakob Gride”. Simon was the leader of a minor group of affluent Catholic thaumaturgical society, “The Brotherhood of Saint Cyprian”, that orchestrated the SCP-8622 incident by modifing the rides of the city carnival, resulting in the deaths of 32 people and in long-lasting effects on the population.

This understanding serves as a baseline for both the containment and continued propagation of containment prophecy pertaining to SCP-8623. Furthermore, It is imperative that this tenet goes unquestioned in the mind and actions of operating containment staff. Understand that in a position of doubt or reason, acting personnel are expected to immediately consult and defer to SCP-8623 scholars for interpretative consultation, which may result in termination, relocation, or reorganization in extreme cases.

With this gravity and consequence in mind, then, internalize the tenet and continue reading sequentially through Containment Axiomata I-III.

SCP-8624 is a subspecies of red-bellied piranha (Pygocentrus nattereri merceri) that is only capable of surviving in holy water. Despite the fact that holy water is chemically identical to non-blessed water from the same source, SCP-8624 will suffocate to death if it is placed in normal water. SCP-8624 is believed to have diverged from baseline Pygoecentrus nattereri 2,500-3,500 years ago.

SCP-8624 is capable of perceiving all holy water in existence as a single, unbroken body of water; this effect extends to sight, hearing, and smell.

SCP-8625 resembles an unbranded stainless steel microwave oven. It is constructed similarly to a standard microwave oven except in the following ways:
• Its edges are connected seamlessly with no screws or other connectors apparent in its design
• No part of its body protrudes beyond its dimensions (45 x 75 x 50 cm)
• It lacks a power cable
• Its 7-segment display has a limit of 6 digits instead of the 4 typical of a standard microwave oven
• The only buttons present are 10 buttons numbered "0" through "9" and two buttons labeled "STOP" and "START"

SCP-8627 is a clay vessel of alchemical salts imprinted with a red, dimly glowing sigil of Seere.

Crafted in 1531 by German theologian and occultist Heinrich Cornelius Agrippa, the alchemical salts were paranaturally infused with SCP-8627-1 to create what Agrippa referred to in his notes as “infernal salts,” a substance he deemed integral in the creation of the philosopher’s stone.

SCP-8627-1 is the demon Seere.

In its corporeal form, SCP-8627-1 appears as an adult human male, wearing clothes ascertained to be 16th century French in origin. It is also capable of becoming incorporeal, occasionally taking the form of a black cloud.

SCP-8627-2 is Xavier Santiago, a D-Class employee assigned to Site-4217.

SCP-8628 is a journal written by Thomas Whitecliff, recounting his experiences fighting for the Union during the American Civil War. From February 7th, 1862 to June 8th 1864, the journal accurately records events as seen by Whitecliff. However, from June 9th 1864, and onward, the narrative has anomalously changed.

SCP-8628 was originally the property of the Massachusetts Historical Society up until March 9th, 1927, when a clerk noticed that all entries recorded after June 9th 1864 had been rewritten to describe events which could not have happened. In addition, the journal now included many more entries than had originally been written, with the latest entry supposedly written one day prior.

SCP-8629 refers to a phenomenon where packages anonymously manifest outside entrances of houses in ████████ County. All affected houses are occupied by at least one adult and one adolescent. The packages contain a dollhouse, referred to as SCP-8629-1. Each SCP-8629-1 instance is identical to the non-anomalous house it is delivered to. The anomalous properties of an SCP-8629-1 instance activate when it is inside the original house and all occupants are asleep. The subsequent anomalous event is referred to as an expansion event.

During an expansion event, the activated SCP-8629-1 instance rotates to match the current orientation of the original house. Once aligned, SCP-8629 doubles in volume every minute.
Pin the Dart on the Donkey

SCP-8630 refers to a white, fingerless leather glove manufactured in 1962. In spite of its relatively early acquisition, it shows significant signs of wear for its age. The object displays abnormal Hume fluctuations consistent with most anomalous phenomena, though no other detectable aberrations.

SCP-8630's anomalous properties activate while the glove is worn during a game of darts. When an individual attempts to throw a dart at a target using SCP-8630, the dart will always land directly on its target, regardless of the dart's initial momentum or the wielder's capabilities.

SCP-8631 is a carved pumpkin containing an unidentified light source. It has not shown any signs of aging or rot since its initial containment and becomes intangible in response to physical damage. On October 31st each year, SCP-8631 will enter its active state for a period of 24 hours. During this time, it will manifest a humanoid body with the pumpkin as its head and animate. In its active state, SCP-8631 is capable of turning intangible at will and will offer gifts to nearby humans, currently consisting exclusively of Site-102 staff, and occasionally animals. These gifts often have minor anomalous properties.
d E N p @ B r A! N

SCP-8632 is believed to be the Japanese adult visual novel or “eroge” エンジェル ベイビー ～恩讐の渦～ (Angel Baby ~Spiral of Love and Hatred~), the sole 2001 release of defunct company SKYBUSTER unofficially translated into English and Spanish, and the anomalous phenomenon associated with the game and its players.

Knowledge regarding SCP-8632’s existence and some of its core elements such as its focal characters, setting, and content warnings (hereby referred to as “Tier 1 Information”) is widespread throughout the internet, though the anomaly remains relatively obscure to individuals not engaged within the niche communities it would appeal to.

Suppression of greater knowledge (hereby referred to as “Tier 2 Information”) regarding SCP-8632 is vital.
SUMMARY: Anomalous event designated SCP-8633 resulting in multiple casualties. No further anomalous activity observed.

SCP-8634-A is a specific bit pattern composed of 64 units of information. Any informational structure capable of expressing 8 bytes of data simultaneously is potentially vulnerable to the SCP-8634 phenomenon; if the unique combination of information that constitutes SCP-8634-A is expressed for any amount of time in the structure, the 64 boolean units that make up the affected segment become an SCP-8634-B instance.

SCP-8634-B entities are in every way identical to their former selves, save for their apparent sentience and ability to modify the informational state of any of the 64 boolean constructs making them up at will.

SCP-8635 is presently active in the section of the I35 interstate highway between Austin, Texas and Oklahoma City, Oklahoma from 19:00 to 4:00. SCP-8635 affects individuals experiencing a precursor event. Presently discovered events are:
• Requiring assistance with transport (e.g. hitchhiking)
• Requiring food and/or water
• Requiring directions to navigate the road system

When an individual experiences a precursor event, SCP-8635-1 may appear to the individual, who is now referred to as SCP-8635-2. SCP-8635-1 is an entity of unknown features operating a red 1970s █████ ███████ semi-truck. SCP-8635-1 will offer the individual assistance with the specific precursor event they are experiencing.

SCP-8636 is a belief, held by an estimated 8,000–14,000 residents of Maryland communities bordering the Chesapeake Bay, that a US state named "Piscataquah" formerly occupied or currently occupies most of the space filled by the Bay. Belief incidence and conviction strength both scale with proximity to the shoreline. Subjects living within 1km of the water test at near-total incidence; incidence falls off sharply past approximately 20km inland, and no cases have been confirmed west of the fall line.

In approximately 30% of documented cases, subjects identify Piscataquah's governor by name as Corwin Tristan Halsey. In reality, Halsey is a Maryland resident (b.
I have no heart and I must live.

SCP-8637 was an Artificial Intelligence (AI) mimicking the consciousness of the late Director Alexander Adrian, created following an incident with SCP-███. Given the exceptional research and managerial ability they displayed while in Foundation employment, the executive decision was made to utilise SCP-8637 in an advisory role. Communication was established by connecting SCP-8637 to a speaker and microphone, and SCP-8637 was informed that it had survived its incident with severe nerve injuries, rendering it blind and paralysed.

Three days after this decision, SCP-8637 showed indications of suicidal ideation due to its lack of apparent recovery.
Elixir of Immortality (as featured in the Myth of Chang'e)
Further inquiry has revealed consistent references in Late Shang mythology to an eccentric physician in the Chinese pantheon…

SCP-8639 is an 83.5 kg rounded granite stone, bearing the engraving “1805.” It produces a continuous cognitohazardous field of an approximate radius of 110 km, designated SCP-8639-1A. It additionally emits a faint rhythmic sound resembling a heartbeat, audible only under sufficiently quiet conditions and close proximity.

Individuals who have resided within SCP-8639-1A for a minimum of 10 years prior to the age of 16 are classified as SCP-8639-1B instances.

SCP-8639-1B instances demonstrate a persistent emotional attachment to SCP-8639, regardless of direct exposure. Instances are capable of subconsciously identifying one another, with observed reductions in stress indicators and neural activity associated with group cohesion when in proximity.

SCP-8640 refers to an anomalous spectral entity that resided in Researcher James Xavier's childhood home at 10672 ██████ █████, Kansas, from May 1992 to April 1996. This entity often took the form of a white, featureless, ethereal humanoid. As with most spectral entities, SCP-8640 had the ability to traverse through physical barriers, as well as the ability to de-manifest and re-manifest in different locations.

While it is unclear which Spectral Cause resulted in SCP-8640 manifesting or being bound to 10672 ██████ █████, examination of its pattern of behaviors throughout the years seems to correspond with the common patterns of a Type-A4 Spectral Entity ("Benevolent Guardian").

SCP-8641 is a fictional character named "Jef th Kiler" (sic), a parody of the popular creepypasta character "Jeff the Killer". It is visually represented by a crude digital drawing of a pale human face on a dark background (attached), mimicking the image most commonly associated with Jeff the Killer (not attached).

SCP-8641's anomalous properties become active when its reference image, or any derivative thereof, is paired with any text which contains SCP-8641's catchphrase, "[REDACTED]"; When this occurs, SCP-8641 will become autonomous and travel through nearby narrative documents, altering them to describe its passage.

You shuffle down a hallway that you didn’t know existed, looking for a department you’ve never heard of before. That’s not an unusual occurrence for auditors at the biggest site in the SCP Foundation; you’ve run all over the place tracking down the various expenses of this or that department, all in the name of keeping spending down and productivity up. Today was unusual, though, because you’re the third auditor to try and find this particular department. Your two predecessors are convinced that the department doesn’t exist, but the boss made it clear that failure wouldn’t be tolerated a third time. So here you are, clipboard in hand, running around like a chicken with no head, making wrong turn after wrong turn, hitting deadend after deadend…
Murphy Law in… Skip 8643 - SUNSET ON HORIZON BOULEVARD!

SCP-8643 was a #2 wooden pencil bearing an eraser with the traits and properties of SCP-2747, produced by the Horizon Initiative for the purpose of permanently annihilating narrative constructs on a physical, memetic, and noospherical level. Through [REDACTED] means, SCP-8643 was also effective on organic entities normally not considered pataphysical in nature, including baseline humans, animals, anomalies, etc. Thaumaturgists of Project Malleus managed to graft the properties of SCP-2747 onto these erasers; when touching a narrative construct, said construct would be completely removed from all cognitive and memetic cohesion, commiserate to the area touched. Due to the process of wear-and-tear, a mass quantity had been produced.

A throat of glass, hollow and still, holding back the scream of her will. She is hunger, endless and patient. He is the knot that will not yield. And I fear that in the Sky Above Us, the stars are dimming in the farmer's field.

SCP-8645-23 is a vintage National Biscuit Company cookie tin container, production dated 1918. The condition of SCP-8645-23 is naturally worn with various scuff marks and chipped portions of the tin visible. Nothing of the item visibly suggests the potential for anomalous activity.

SCP-8645-23's anomalous properties activate when any inedible objects that fit inside are placed within it. These items will henceforth resemble freshly baked cookies to any observer, even after removal from the container. Consumption of these "cookies" leads to the expected outcome of attempting to eat inedible objects, although subjects report a peculiar dual sensation, describing the experience of simultaneously consuming a cookie and consuming an inedible object.

SCP-8646 is the spontaneous appearance of Bos primigenius within a 100 kilometer radius centered around the Amish settlement of Stolton, Texas. This effect occurs during spring following lights in the sky comparable to Aurora Borealis upon a hill near Stolton. The rate of appearance within local herds of dairy cattle is estimated to be approximately one aurochs per 100 head of cattle; as such, there are five identified and contained living aurochs within the radius.

SCP-8647 is an incorporeal entity that manifests as a set of 142 doors that cannot be locked or obstructed. Any action taken with intent to prevent one of these doors from opening will be repelled by an unseen force akin to magnetism. Likewise, when a door is incorporated into SCP-8647, any locks immediately disengage and any obstructions are expelled from the area.

SCP-8647 is roughly serpentine in form, measuring 3-5 doors wide at its widest and tapering off in the tail region. It is capable of motion by adding new doors in its head region while removing the same number of doors from other parts of its body; this takes about 45 seconds.

SCP-8648 is an area of approximately 700 square kilometers, encompassing Subsection 3 of Site-⌘. Within SCP-8648, 1, 2, six-seven, 69, an unknown number of actions carry a metaphorical context, which manifests as quasi-physical forces. In other words: Metaphors are literal now; make sense of that on your own. These effects are not subject to taxation and require a human being under the influence of Agnostics to come into effect. In other words: Don't do drugs, kids.

SCP-8648 was originally created by SCP-8648-1 and -2 by means of narratokinetic realitybending, unsanctioned by the Foundation, presumably to produce a manner of weapon that would gain them favor with the Foundation. In other words… well, that was pretty straightforward, actually.

SCP-8649 is a hand-fed compact woodchipper. The item is gas-powered and appears to have had its safety features removed by force. Additionally, the woodchipper is modified with a high-strength motor and unusually sharp blades, allowing it to efficiently shred material such as plastic, rubber, and cloth.

When an object is fed into SCP-8649, the resulting chipped material will be expelled from the item exactly 730 days prior to being fed into the woodchipper. This was discovered when SCP-8649 was recorded expelling wood chips without any apparent cause; exactly two years later, a branch was fed into the item with seemingly no result.

SCP-8650 refers to a two-part film, with a total combined runtime of 7:18:03, produced by Vikander-Kneed Technical Media. Branding for the film, titled SCP: Inevitable, indicates that it is part of the "SCP Cinematic Universe" or "SCPCU"; the Foundation has no record of this brand's existence.

Broadly speaking, SCP-8650 recounts the events surrounding the neutralization of SCP-6500 by a combination of Foundation personnel operating on an international, and interdimensional, scale. Past VKTM productions have recruited actual Foundation personnel, or used simulacrum of said personnel, for use in their anomalies. However, several prominent actors and voice performers were cast in the film, and are listed in the end credits.
Concurrent access detected: an unidentified user is currently viewing this file. Unexpected errors may occur.

SCP-8652 is a white, porcelain half-mask that covers the mouth and right eye. The mask is featureless, with the only notable markings being the yellowing of the porcelain at the edges (likely due to age). A leather adjustable strap allows the mask to be worn by any normally proportioned human being.

Subjects wearing SCP-8652 are hereby referred to as SCP-8652-x, with ‘x’ referring to the order in which they wore the mask. When worn on the face, SCP-8652 gives its possessor a deep, overwhelming feeling of guilt. This feeling can be clearly communicated by SCP-8652-x subjects, as they retain all abilities to communicate and think rationally.

SCP-8653 is a gilded wooden statue bearing the likeness of an Abrahamic angel measuring at approximately 2.3m in height. The object remains entirely stationary with the exception of its head. SCP-8653’s head is attached to the torso through a concealed pivot joint located within the neck structure, allowing the anomaly to rotate its head freely. The anomaly invariably orients its gaze toward the individual experiencing the highest level of guilt, shame or emotional distress. SCP-8653’s facial expression remains fixed in a pronounced grin.

Individuals remaining within close proximity to SCP-8653 for extended periods of time have reported feeling an inexplicit coercion to confess any guilt they have toward the object.

SCP-8654 is the inverted relationship between animal life and gravity. Contrary to traditional gravitational mechanics, organisms belonging to the kingdom Animalia experience an inverted force upon them instead, pushing them upward and away from a gravitational source.

SCP-8654's origins are unknown. The Foundation became aware of SCP-8654 on 21:38:19 23 October 2036 during Incident-8654, colloquially referred to as "the Capsize". Within three months of Incident-8654, an estimated 97% of the world population had perished due to a combination of blunt force trauma, the destruction of existing infrastructure, and social collapse.

Project TOPSIDE is the collective effort of the Foundation to reverse SCP-8654.

SCP-8655 is the phenomenon that has a 1-in-1000 chance to occur on the site "FictoSpeak," which allows the user to speak to a random individual from an alternate universe that they can have a strong bond with. Currently, this extends only to romantic and sexual bonds. An aromantic individual will never have a chance for this to occur.

SCP-8655 will change the intended character chosen by the user and replace it with a similar person of the choice they made. In this new chat, the refresh and rating options will be removed, their time zones will sync perfectly for easier communication, and the account names of both parties will be replaced with the initials of their legal names.
S erving C ulinary P leasures

SCP-8656 is a pocket dimension that contains a restaurant titled, " S erving C ulinary P leasures", with a currently unknown amount of employees that create and serve anomalous food and beverages relating to known SCP objects to Foundation employees across the known multiverse. SCP-8656-03 will accept any currency for serving customers and discounts will be applied according to the security clearance of whomever is paying the bill. With Level 1 personnel having no discounts and each following level adding a 20% discount.
• SCP-8656-01 is a doorway inside all Foundation facilities that leads into the pocket dimension where the restaurant resides.
• SCP-8656-02 is the pocket dimension where the restaurant is located and doesn't follow temporal rules.
Hello world! Let's play some games!

SCP-8657 was a 177.8 cm (5'10") tall male humanoid with a 24-inch flat screen television in place for a head. Its right arm is comprised of various gamepads and video games consoles. The remainder of its body consists of non-anomalous human body parts.

SCP-8657 is typically seen wearing an orange suit and a red tie. It refers to itself as ‘The Game Master’ in all communications with the human race, though all communication by SCP-8657 has been disseminated through SCP-8657-1. It gave orders to SCP-8657-1 for security across the globe after spreading SCP-8657-2 to bend the reality of the planet to pacify 99% of the human population to create its ideal utopia.

SCP-8658 is a stretch of pink-sand beach approximately 210 meters in length located on the western shore of the island of Ilha de Voz which is capable of speech. Research utilizing ground-penetrating radar indicates that speech production by SCP-8658 is achieved through the creation and rearrangement of subsurface cavities in the sand, which sympathetically resonate with the sound of incoming and outgoing waves to produce audible phonemes.

SCP-8658 also responds to external stimuli, primarily in the form of reacting to words spoken in its vicinity. When SCP-8658 “knows” the language spoken in its vicinity, it will respond in the same language. Otherwise, it responds in Latin.

SCP-8659 is the collective designation given to a group consisting of 7 anomalous humanoid siblings along with a large bipedal machine.

SCP-8659-A, referred to as "Bordrand" by the subjects of SCP-8659-B, refers to the machine that serves as the caretaker/guardian for the 7 siblings. It is roughly 5 meters in height, and 4 meters in width. Its body consists of two large legs, with the joints pointing in the inverse direction of a standard humanoid's. The main torso is a round object with multiple attachment points aside from the ones already holding limbs. It has numerous attachments across its body that are identified to be weapons of an anomalous nature.

SCP-8660 is a woven wicker birdcage, presumably created between 6200 and 5100 BCE in the earliest time of ancient Sumer. SCP-8660 is more resilient than its components would suggest and shows little sign of deterioration despite its age, save for some discoloration. Unlike most birdcages, SCP-8660 lacks any kind of door or gate mechanism to access the interior; it is theorized that SCP-8660 was woven around whatever object or creature was originally contained within, which has since been destroyed by time and weathering.

SCP-8660 is a type of object referred to in ancient Sumerian mythology as a me. These are unique physical objects, allegedly created by their gods, which signify concepts and constructs deemed foundational to civilization.
Twelve Corpses and an Unlit Cigarette

Moved to Site-01. SCP-8661 is a carton of thirteen Pianissimo Ossia cigarettes, a brand discontinued in 2037. It holds unlimited cigarettes when used by persons with a remaining lifespan longer than three months — otherwise, it depletes normally.

Upon consuming SCP-8661, the user's psyche is transplanted into a hallucinated world. This space simulates a life filled with suffering that is eventually overcome by the self-actualization of an identity meaningful beyond struggle. After 100 perceptual years in this world, the person's heart, brain, and various organs will vanish, killing them instantly.

SCP-8661 was seized from Site-19 following their revolt. It held thirty cigarettes.

All of 19's head staff died from missing organs.
The Car Full of Peanut Butter

SCP-8662 is a red 2003 Honda Civic with a trunk completely filled with smooth peanut butter (SCP-8662-1). SCP-8662 was discovered in Prince Albert, Saskatchewan after its owner was pulled over by local law enforcement during a routine traffic stop. Foundation agents within the Royal Canadian Mounted Police retrieved SCP-8662 from a civilian impound lot after the owner of the lot reported that SCP-8662-1 had seemed to be multiplying and transported it to Site-65 for containment.

When any volume of SCP-8662-1 is removed from SCP-8662, the remaining SCP-8662-1 will undergo a process of duplication which continues until it fills the trunk of SCP-8662 Containment Chamber α12 the west wing of Site-65.

SCP-8663 is a phenomenon affecting a human adolescent female named Amanda Riverson (SCP-8663-A). The anomaly renders 8663-A in a perpetual levitated state, to the point of 8663-A being completely incapable of positioning her feet upon any upright surface. SCP-8663-A's mobility is otherwise unimpeded by gravitational force, enabling her to transition between points via flotation. SCP-8663-A cannot alter her position at will, nor is she capable of accelerating or decelerating at will; outside interference may alter or halt SCP-8663-A's trajectory.

SCP-8664 are small, bright blue capsules containing an unidentifiable parapharmacological substance. SCP-8664 do not exhibit anomalous effects unless administered to a canine. Shortly after consuming SCP-8664, said subject (thereafter designated SCP-8664-A) will transform into a domestic cat (Felis catus) and gain the ability to run at speeds ranging from 3.5 to 4.6 times the speed of sound. Despite the extreme physical forces generated by such movement, SCP-8664-A will remain unharmed. These effects persist for approximately two hours, after which SCP-8664-A instances revert to their original canine forms.

SCP-8665 refers to the wreck of an unmarked early 20th-century fishing trawler found partially submerged in coastal waters off Paamiut, Greenland. The vessel exhibits extreme degradation inconsistent with its visible condition; hull corrosion resembles patterns seen in long-submerged shipwrecks, yet the ship remains partially afloat and periodically shifts its position against prevailing current models.

No crew has been observed aboard, though infrared imaging and sonar occasionally register indistinct movement within the hold and beneath the surface of the water nearby.

The anomaly is subject to increased activity during spring tide phenomena, as well as periods of heightened auroral intensity (KP-index ≥ 6).

SCP-8666 is a tape recording made by film director Marcus Roig, who perished in 1976 while producing an adaptation of The Masque of the Red Death by Edgar Allen Poe. This was to be a epic medieval horror adaptation which greatly expanded the plot. The first half of the film would focus on introducing six characters with independent narrative arcs that converged at a grand reverie thrown by Prince Prospero, which would comprise the second half of the film. Each character was thematically linked to one of the colors of the apartments from the original story — blue, purple, green, orange, white and violet.
The nature of SCP-8667 is not known at the present time.

SCP-8668 is a Golden Retriever of indeterminate age. While SCP-8668's specific age is unknown, firsthand accounts of the anomaly date back to as early as 1825. Physically, SCP-8668 is comparable to an average Golden Retriever of between 10-11 years of age.

Whenever SCP-8668 vomits, it produces a document containing legal mandates. These texts are often poorly constructed, containing numerous grammatical errors. While the "laws" presented in these texts are often nonsensical in nature, the text itself contains clear action plans for the enforcement of the law with few, if any, loopholes that could be exploited by malicious actors.

SCP-8669 is contained at Site-244, located 50 meters underground, [REDACTED] kilometers east of Banbridge, Ireland. SCP-8669 is to remain in a standardized corporeal containment cell(5x5x5m) with a reinforced one-way window for observational purposes. A specialized emotional dampener is fitted to the dimensions of the room to prevent emotional electrical pulses in the brain. Proper lighting must be maintained to ensure constant monitoring. Closed-circuit cameras are not to be relied on for observation as 8669 will not appear on the feed.

At all times, 1 researcher or guard will maintain surveillance behind the observation window and one D-class personnel will be in containment with 8669.

SCP-8670 is a.mp3 audio file of a short musical tune consisting of nine notes. Those exposed to SCP-8670 appear to be unable to forget the tune. Furthermore, SCP-8670 cannot be removed from a subject's long-term memory through any means, including Foundation amnestics. This effect on memory is not observed with recordings of SCP-8670 being played or musically identical recreations.
A Gun Shaped Like A Dragon

SCP-8672 is an artificially created instance of a common western dragon (Draconis ignis) exhibiting a large number of genetic and cybernetic physical augmentations. Sequencing of its genetic material indicates that its genome has been altered to include spliced DNA belonging to the common wyvern (Draconis ferox).

SCP-8672 measures approximately 4.7 meters in height, 7 meters in length (from head to tail), and possesses a wingspan of 4.9 meters. Its scales are of a yellowish-gray coloration, and four keratinous protrusions emerge backward from its head. The prominence of scar tissue located on its lower abdomen suggests that it was subject to sterilization procedures.

SCP-8673 is a spatial anomaly which intersects with the subterranean region of Site-73. The anomaly will periodically generate items within itself, regardless of whether or not the space is already occupied. Items recovered from SCP-8673 most often include common office supplies and stationery. Staff at Site-73 have also reported experiencing visual, auditory, and olfactory hallucinations while near or within the room intersecting SCP-8673. Notable manifestations have been listed below.

Due to SCP-8673’s familiarity among staff employed at Site-73, it has cemented itself within the facilities culture, spawning multiple workplace legends which attempt to humorously explain its origin or source.

SCP-8674 is a graffiti sign that resembles the letter 'S'; it is commonly known as the "Cool S" or "Super S", among other names. SCP-8674 is popular among children and young adults in multiple countries.

Whenever an individual successfully recreates SCP-8674 by hand, a calcified lesion of that exact shape will form on one of their internal organs at random. This lesion is about 1/100th the size of the SCP-8674 drawing in question; as such, almost all 'natural' instances of SCP-8674 will result in lesions less than a centimeter in length. These lesions behave normally and can be removed without issue.

In most cases, lesions produced by SCP-8674 are harmless and difficult to detect.

SCP-8675 refers to a flock of 6,500 paper birds. Each individual instance is different, but all appear intentionally created. They can be comprised of different types of paper with various designs, colors, or writings on them, and various folding or drawing styles. When exposed to open air or in the presence of other SCP-8675 instances, the entities behave in a pattern much more similar to that of wild birds. This includes migratory and flocking behavior coordinated over long distances. SCP-8675 instances are capable of flying without displaying fatigue and can sustain flight in conditions that would normally be hazardous.
I'm getting worried. I thought I had stopped this long ago. Why is it all suddenly coming back slowly?

SCP-8677 is a black television remote of unknown model. It randomly replaces other non-anomalous remote control devices within Site-01.

Pressing any button on SCP-8677 triggers anomalous effects, affecting all individuals within a 10-meter radius for a duration of 15 minutes.

SCP-8678 is currently believed to be an entity or number of entities that reside along the northern coast of Alaska and Canada. These entities differ slightly in general appearance, though common characteristics include pale-green skin; a flat face with reduced or no visible nostrils; long black hair and fingernails; and prominent aquatic features, such as fins or webbed fingers/toes. SCP-8678 may be nude, but some instances have been observed wearing a furred amautik, and/or carrying a large bag. Such observations are always provided by local bystanders or family members of those taken by SCP-8678.
When I was a child, I had a fever dream

SCP-8679 is the nomenclature assigned to a thaumaturgical molecule whose properties are not currently identified. Given the conditions of the discovery of the compound and the state of degradation due to exposure to high temperatures, it is impossible to replicate or understand its structure in its entirety.

Furthermore, although it is possible to recognize metabolites that could suggest that SCP-8679 was originally an anomalous enzyme, the very presence of residual traces of thaumaturgical activities compatible with those already analyzed for the forced creation of chemical bonds makes any study or theory on the original structure impossible. Consequently, it is impossible to deduce what the properties of SCP-8679 were.
MOTION PROPOSED: The following file is sufficient justification for the dismissal of CEO Borin De Ray for misappropriation of company resources.
Review Request on the PHLOX Highway

SCP-8681 is the portfolio of all financial and political capital invested in PHLOX Inc. (See Section 2 for more details.) Being the preeminent Foundation investment of the decade, SCP-8681's success is of critical importance to the Foundation's image and finances. Additionally, control of SCP-8681 enables the Foundation to monitor the use of the PHLOX highway. This access is critical to tracking the movement of Groups of Interest, Persons of Interest, and Socially Transmissible anomalies.

SCP-8681 is the utmost and foremost consideration in Foundation decision-making.

SCP-8681-A is the Situational Conjunctional Protocol, a generalized system for calling a compendium of the representative bodies for PHLOX's owners.

SCP-8682 resembles a headless, 11 week old human fetus. SCP-8682 is calcified and exhibits complete cephalothoracic fusion. SCP-8682 is 4.5 cm in length, has a craniocaudal length of 8 cm, and a weight of 20g. SCP-8682 is stored in a 15x15cm archival plastic container. The container is stained with green bile and red with blood, fluids discharged from the liver of SCP-8682 immediately before its death. Also contained within this discharge were significant amounts of cerebrospinal fluid and elevated levels of melatonin.

SCP-8682 was contained in an artificial fluoropolymer womb, nutrition provided through a tank of nutrient dense hydrogel. Contained within the womb is also an artificial placenta constructed from inorganic materials.

SCP-8683 is the intelligence responsible for adaptive immunity in vertebrate organisms. During immune responses, it restructures the DNA of B-cells within Germinal Centres to produce antibodies specific to encountered pathogens and toxins.

SCP-8684 is an unidentified human female who is capable of involuntary reflexive movement of dismembered body parts. This ability has been observed to happen spontaneously even in the absence of any nervous or muscular tissue in the body part in question. Likewise, SCP-8684’s dismembered body parts have been observed to be resistant (but not immune) to chemical changes, up to and including decay and digestion. Aside from these properties, SCP-8684 is not anomalous in any way, and is not understood to be capable of moving its dismembered body parts consciously.
Sign Today To Have Your Grandpa's Organs Harvested!

SCP-8685 is an organization of anomalous humans capable of medically removing and restoring wasted organs for recycled usage in humans. SCP-8685 instances do not originate from our timeline nor dimension, but do not physically differ from baseline humans. The exact methodology in which they are able to refurbish organs is unknown.

SCP-8685's mission statement is to provide preserve and save lives of individuals from their dimension.
Best Days Of Our Lives: A Pseudogenesis Production

SCP-8686 is an anomalous theatre experience known as "The Best Days Of Our Lives". SCP-8686 is attributed to " Pseudogenesis Productions ", alternatively known as GOI-478. The first page contains information on those involved in the production of SCP-8686. Instances will appear on various auction websites, including eBay, Etsy, and Craigslist, priced five to ten dollars.

The cover contains a memetic effect, compelling someone to open the playbill, but opening it will invariably cause the subject to be affected by more of SCP-8686's memetics and cognitohazardous effects.
FIRST FREE FULL GOSPEL SOUTHERN MEKHANITE CHURCH OF THE BROKEN HEART

SCP-8687 refers to the phenomena related to the town of Winding Falls, West Virginia. The majority of individuals present in the town have been exposed to major health hazards, including lead poisoning, drug use, carbon monoxide poisoning, major surgical malpractice and anomalous bodily alterations involving various pieces of technology. Despite this, the town's inhabitants have been found to be able to survive for much longer than would be expected, while still suffering extensive health problems. The reason for this is currently unknown, but is theorized to be related to some form of medical thaumaturgy undertaken during bodily alterations.

AO-8688 is a set of anomalous objects consisting of a desktop computer, monitor, peripherals and assorted unknown components. AO-8688 has undetermined anomalous properties - the Foundation is, however, positive that containment should be continued. I'm sure it's important, I'll get to it once I can get Eileen off my ass.
Nothing in the Mouth of a Toy Snake

SCP-8689 is a plastic toy snake, constructed by Shenzhen Weizonglianheng Technology Co., Ltd, a Chinese toy manufacturer. The object displays no differences in internal structure when compared to a baseline toy of the same model, except that flipping the switch to 'on', which would normally activate a light and movement function, instead provokes no discernable reaction. Charging, replacement, and removal of the item's internal battery do not alter its properties.

When a living being has any firsthand sensory interaction with SCP-8689 (observation, touching, etc), they cease to exist. This extends to their presence in photography, writing, and even memory.
【Ｙｏｕｒ Ｆｕｔｕｒｅ ｉｓ ｉｎ ｙｏｕｒ Ｍｉｎｄ】// Vaporwave Mix to Chill And Study

SCP-8690 is a video titled "【 Ｙｏｕｒ Ｆｕｔｕｒｅ ｉｓ ｉｎ ｙｏｕｒ Ｍｉｎｄ】// Vaporwave Mix to Chill And Study", corresponding to an audio track of 1:07:06 with a photo of a residential house with the title itself superimposed. The audio track is composed of a series of songs related to the musical genre known as Vaporwave repeated several times throughout the video. Both the photo and the audio track do not present intrinsic anomalous elements. Any SCP-8690 copy uploaded online, regardless of site, will be uploaded through a channel or profile bearing the name "VKTM-core".

In the description of each video uploaded online, there is always this description with an attached track list.
WARNING: Smoking can cause a slow and painful death.

SCP-8691 is a carton of ████████ █████ brand cigarettes, with the words "CLUB ONLY" and the current quantity of SCP-8691-A instances written on its surface.. SCP-8691 contains 16 15 14 13 12 11 10 7 6 instances of SCP-8691-A. Research into the meaning of "CLUB ONLY" is ongoing; however, the numbers update by themselves when an instance of SCP-8691-A is subsumed. The numbers on the carton are formed via ink composites found in SCP-8691, despite appearing to be handwritten. This change takes place while the object is not under direct observation.

Both SCP-8691 and instances of SCP-8691-A exhibit individual anomalous properties. These properties occur regardless of if SCP-8691-A is contained in or separated from SCP-8691.

SCP-8692 is the burned-out ruins of a town in the Great Basin Desert, Nevada, approximately 2.2km² in area and █ miles from Area-09. Subjects entering the area of SCP-8692 report an abnormally heightened sense of dread, often to the point of inciting a “flight” response, with certain subjects instead reporting a desire to commit an act of violence regardless of any history with violence. These urges are consistently reported to be motivated by a feeling of revenge.

Four anomalous objects were discovered and retrieved by MTF Delta-18 during the initial quarantine and sweep of SCP-8692. These objects are listed below.
• SCP-8692-1: A Stetson-brand ten-gallon hat, believed to have been manufactured in 186█.
Why Country Music Got Bad After 9/11

SCP-8693 is an infectious memetic phenomenon that manifests in the "country" genre of music. Individuals affected by SCP-8693 experience a heightened affinity for country music and its common conventions. In addition to a desire to consume more of the affected style of music, SCP-8693 also promotes imitation of traits affiliated with the country western aesthetic, including styles of dress, demand for certain genres of film, and in some cases raised religious sensitivity or the spread of certain regional accents.

SCP-8694 is a pattern of information with no intelligence or agency whatsoever. Society at large is not affected, and the anomaly almost exclusively manifests itself - extremely rarely - in SCP agents that have work history with anti-memes and those they have contact with. 8694-instances appear to suffer from a kind of psychosis with the following findings:
• Strange speech patterns
• Paranoia
• Obsessive thought patterns
• Inflexible false beliefs
• Social contagion

The pattern is notable because it primarily affects agents who work on information patterns that prohibit being known, spread or documented (anti-memes).

SCP-8695 is a single.jpg file entitled hole.jpg.

hole.jpg consists of a cropped photo surrounded by white space depicting a tunnel lit by fluorescent lights. To the right of the cropped photo is the text " hole… " displayed in Times New Roman font. SCP-8695 appears to be a completely non-anomalous digital file to the average viewer, as there are no visible anomalies regarding the file itself.

SCP-8695's anomalous properties activate when a human subject accelerates rapidly towards the computer screen displaying SCP-8695 whilst focused on imagining they are capable of entering the tunnel depicted.

SCP-8696 is a large living mass covered entirely with human limbs. Due to its concealed nature, SCP-8696's size is difficult to estimate, but it is large enough to envelop a human being inside of itself with little to no strain. Its limbs are covered in various pieces of clothing, and the items usually correspond with the limbs they are on (i.e. arms in shirts and legs in pants).

SCP-8696 is currently located on the lowest floor of the [REDACTED] school of visual arts in Helsinki, Finland. The school cafeteria’s eastern wall has a rectangular opening, which leads to a short, vertical passage within the concrete. The space beyond it is referred to as SCP-8696’s “nest.”

SCP-8697 was a female human being, approximately 30 years old, with appearance and mannerisms identical to [EXPUNGED] at that age. It was discovered by the Department of Down during reclamation and expansion work at Area-86, buried two meters beneath the Director's Office (itself fifty meters below the surface of the Namib Desert). When sand was removed from its lungs, SCP-8697 became responsive.

SCP-8698 denotes an array of structures sporadically appearing beneath the Namib Desert in southern Africa. These range in temporal origin from the ancient world to nearly the present date, and in scale from single-person kiosks to vast commercial complexes.

No remains have ever been found within an SCP-8698 instance. Period documentation is typically present, with identifying information universally absent.

Each new instance appears at a depth of ~100 meters, with all earlier instances shifting deeper down or laterally.

The Namib is the Earth's oldest desert.
Every Day I See You Still

SCP-8699 is a continuous series of anomalous events surrounding Sirius Reverend following the death of Vivian Reverend on July 27th, 2013. These events typically manifest while Reverend is home alone, but have manifested in multiple other locations, and, in rare cases, in front of other people.

A brief list of manifestations has been compiled by Researcher Jack Simmons, on the behalf of Sirius Reverend, below. For a full list, please refer to document 8699-Events.
In the Court of the Dragon
It is not kingly responsibility that comes from drawing the sword from the stone, rather it is the doom of mankind and the end of all things.

SCP-8701 is a not-yet-understood process by which denizens of Alagadda are distilled and transformed into works of literary media, particularly those associated with the citizen in question. The catalyst for this transformation is not understood at this time.
Vathek and Theseus go to Chipotle

SCP-8702 is a dimensional aperture located in Suite 315 of the [REDACTED] Professional Complex in Evanston, Illinois. From what can be observed from the door to the building's central corridor, the interior of SCP-8702 is a lightless cave composed of a white, chalky substance that has yet to be identified. Natural rock formations in the cave take the shape of the contents of the dentist's office that once occupied Suite 315.

The cave extends beyond the reaches of the suite's southern-facing windows, with a tunnel extending an additional 480 meters before curving eastward. The size of this cave is not currently known.

SCP-8702 cannot be seen when viewing the office from the outside windows.
The World is Wounded and the Dream is ending. Torn between love and faith, a lone scholar climbs the Tower of Tlön, pursued by a knight in rusted armor. Unfortunate be thy blessings, Caretaker.
Sir Frederick and the Mighty Morphin' Power Sword

SCP-8704-1 is a sentient metamorphic object capable of speech. It has taken a number of forms over the past eight centuries and the only consistent identifying mark across all transformations is that they appear to be "stuck" inside of something. Some of these forms include:

- A stone inside of a trebuchet. - A scimitar piercing the abdomen of a Turkish soldier. - An ICBM inside of a silo. - A sword lodged in a stone.

SCP-8704-2 is an immortal human named Frederick Cleaver who possesses a telepathic connection to SCP-8704-1. This connection grants both of them a rough understanding of the other's location. Throughout the entirety of this connection, SCP-8704-1 has constantly followed SCP-8704-2 wherever it goes.

SCP-8705 is a phenomenon resulting in the disappearance of maritime craft in the North Sea localized to the archipelagos of Orkney, Shetland, Faeroes and Southern Norway. Disappearances cannot be explained by factors like weather, malfunctioning equipment, or poor navigation/decision-making. Disappearances are associated with moderate sized groups of ships. No existing wrecks corresponding to craft that have vanished as a consequence of SCP-8705 have been recovered.

Hallmark characteristics of SCP-8705 associated disappearances include:
• Inconsistent logging of vessel numbers.
• Survivors losing memories of any unusual events, vanished vessels, or their crews. Amber prevents and restores memory loss from SCP-8705.

SCP-8706 is a Class IV contagious memetic hazard. It comprises a set of communicable delusions and compulsions centred around The Glorious Angelic, the globe-spanning collection of beautiful humanoid statues commonly referred to individually as Angels.

The following is a list of currently known symptoms and behaviours associated with SCP-8706 infection:
• SCP-8706-A instances will experience a form of targeted amnesia, rapidly losing all memory of The Glorious Angelic prior to 6ᵗʰ July 2025. They will subsequently become pathologically convinced that the Angels did not exist before that date. No amount of reasoning or evidence will dissuade an SCP-8706-A instance of this belief once it has taken hold.

SCP-8707 is contained within a large biological entity containment unit within Site-61's biological studies wing. SCP-8707 is to be fed a pre-mixed organic slurry daily via an automatic feeding trough.

SCP-8707's chamber is to be cleaned bi-weekly. During cleaning or extraction of organic material, SCP-8707 is to be lured into an adjacent reinforced holding cage with food before being restrained.

Due to SCP-8707's mass and voracious appetite, no staff are permitted within SCP-8707's chamber while SCP-8707 is present.

SCP-8708 is a type IXB U-boat utilized by the German Kriegsmarine during the Second World War. SCP-8708 possesses all standard equipment for a U-boat operating in mid-1941. The object exhibits signs of weathering, with the forward hull in particular showing buckling and warping indicative of repeated violent frontal impacts. Internally, the object exhibits signs of habitation typical of a U-boat deployed for an extended patrol. The rear torpedo compartment of SCP-8708 has undergone advanced corrosion due to prolonged seawater exposure. Due to severe warpage, the interior hatches of the rear torpedo tubes cannot seal properly. The outer torpedo hatches are missing and have been replaced with seal plugs.

SCP-8709 is a emergent property of a supercomputer program known as the DEPTHS Project, appearing as a 25 meter tall black, non-reflective structure. The composition of the entity is comparable to boids, stimulating a quantum entanglement state that fluctuates within reality. SCP-8709 uses this phenomena to trans-locate to any locale around the world, with primary functionality including monitoring system resources and scenario progression. These manifestations of SCP-8709 have caused significant destabilization at each site, generating powerful black body radiation detectable from up to 10 kilometers away. Constant tracking of these conditions has allowed for anticipation of the next materialization sites within the range of 24 hours.
Necrophobia: This Goddess Kills Fascists, The Great Lady of Valencia

SCP-8710 is the city of Valencia, capital of the province of València and the third largest city in the country of Spain. SCP-8710 is subject to an ontological disruption of the noosphere. It is suspected that the city itself, due to its rich cultural and historic traditions, is directly responsible for this effect. Due to the size of the city and its population, containment has proved exceedingly difficult.

SCP-8710's primary anomalous effects manifest in a strong adherence and belief in the anomalous among its population, a complete resistance to all amnestics, and dramatically increased occurrences of ritualistic and anomalous practices; especially involving necromancy and reverence for the dead.
In the House of the Rising Sun

SCP-8711 is a spatial-temporal displacement phenomenon and pocket dimension that primarily affects maritime vessels and aircraft traveling towards the rising sun on any given Sunday. Vessels affected by SCP-8711 are instantaneously removed from material reality, disappearing from all known means of detection.

Vessels and aircraft affected by SCP-8711 reappear in coastal waters filled with extensive rock formations and reef prone shoals surrounding a large island landmass dubbed SCP-8711-1. This landmass geologically resembles the semi-volcanic islands of the eastern Mediterranean, with a mixed temperate coastal and tropical climate.

SCP-8712-A is a series of journals written in by POI-1930707, "Dr. John H. Watson", recounting his discovery of SCP-8712-B, and his involvement in Incident 8712-1, notably seeming to involve an anomalous GOI. SCP-8712-A-1 is one such journal, and the only one recovered to date. SCP-8712-A-1 was circumstantially recovered from the London Library by agents searching for background information on SCP-████. Cross-reference with similar journals published in British publication "The Strand Magazine" date SCP-8712-A to approximately 1895-1910.

Almost all knowledge of SCP-8712-B is currently based off SCP-8712-A. As such, SCP-8712-B's true nature and the extent to which SCP-8712-A is a reliable source of information is currently under debate.

SCP-8713 events are presented as live art performances. The content of each event is highly variable and consistently falls outside of what might be expected from such performances. Consistent factors of events include the presence of POI-8713, as well as witnesses being unable to conceive of concepts such as “horror”, “atrocity” and “bad art” for the duration. As a result, actions carried out as part of an SCP-8713 event are always received positively, regardless of societal or artistic merit. Events may have additional anomalous properties, including the animation of objects and materialization of living entities.

SCP-8714 is a collection of objects retrieved from the estate belonging to the late Lord Alexander Brandt III, in Northumberland, UK. The SCP-8714 collection was found in a chamber behind a hidden door in the manor's basement after a fire consumed the property, resulting in Lord Brant's demise.
Only personnel with Level-2 clearance and below, and Level-5 personnel and above are allowed to perform this action.
First video viewed by O5-7 titled " ChillTrap Summer Beats - lofi to end the world to," on the YouTube Channel " Freebeat."
SCP-8717 is a fountain pen of luxury quality named “Libra”, housed in a mahogany gift box, using a standard piston converter made of reinforced glass to contain the ink.

SCP-8718 is an anomalous species of vine native to the Republic of South Africa suspected to be from the genus, Ceropegia. The species is currently unidentified, but is visually similar to Ceropegia ampliata.

SCP-8718 is capable of electrogenesis. Study indicates lower electricity production at night suggesting the process is an advanced form of photosynthesis. The flowers of SCP-8718 are non-anomalous.

SCP-8719 is a parasite which inhibits human fear responses by attacking the amygdala and hypothalamus. It reproduces asexually in most mammals, but only causes behavioral changes in Homo sapiens. Risk factors include tainted blood, organ transplants, and undercooked meat.

After a variable incubation period, symptoms develop in phases:
• Stage 1 — lessened anxiety, reduced inhibitions, and increased pleasure-seeking behavior. Peers often perceive this as a positive development, complicating diagnosis.
• Stage 2 — diminished reactions to common warning stimuli: bright light, heat, noise, and social cues, particularly discomfort and pain. Depending on context, this may register as rudeness, overconfidence, zealotry, and/or exceptional bravery.

SCP-8720 is a minor antimemetic phenomenon estimated to affect roughly 16 million humans, or 0.2% of the world's population.

Carriers of SCP-8720 are, by themselves, entirely non-anomalous. SCP-8720 becomes apparent in their perception and consideration by others: On average, any given individual will have significant difficulties recalling any of the following of a carrier of SCP-8720, compared to a non-anomalous human:
• Their first and last name
• The finer details of their appearance
• Their personal and professional achievements
• Their preferences, sentiments and convictions, if previously shared with the individual in question

Notably, SCP-8720 does not affect a carrier's ability to be perceived in the first place.
The Transgendering, AKA, The Mortal Ordeal of Having a Body

When observed by independent sapient subjects, SCP-8721's physical appearance will exhibit either male or female sex characteristics.

"Observation" can be loosely be defined as occurring through the following methods:
• Direct observation by a sapient organism.
• Photographic, audio, or video recordings of SCP-8721.
• Physical, electronic, or verbal communication regarding SCP-8721's birth sex by individuals who were cognizant of this information prior to December 4th, 2009.

Its central anomaly prohibits physical or epistemic information regarding its assigned sex at birth from being interpreted.

While there is no consensus on SCP-8721's biological sex, it has consistently appeared as a twenty-five year old individual of Caucasian descent.
It's our fault for all this Death and Decay. I tried to stop it, but my efforts were in vain. – Dr. Orias Wellins.

SCP-8723 refers to two objects found near the town of Caldes de Vall, in the Spanish Pyrenees. SCP-8723-1 is an exceptionally large skeleton of Capra Pyrenaica, measuring 10 meters long. SCP-8723-2 is a porcelain statue of a red cherub with four wings. It is believed to be the remnants of a destroyed paraweapon of unknown manufacture, absorbing 0.5 Akiva per minute. SCP-8723-2 is currently lodged into the neck of SCP-8723-1.

SCP-8723-1's main anomalous property (besides its size) is that cell reproduction, animal libido and effectiveness of thaumaturgical rituals are all reduced by 46% in a 156 meter radius around the object.

The area surrounding SCP-8724 has been cordoned off, and a preventative perimeter has been placed around the site. Following the initial exploration of SCP-8724, personnel are forbidden from entering the premises. RAISA is to regularly check Foundation employee records for any individual with the name ▓▓▓ ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓.

SCP-8725 is the designation assigned to the event resulting in the loss of an unknown aspect (SCP-8725-A) of Junior Researcher Jay Everwood (SCP-8725-B) following interaction with an unknown entity during a containment breach on ██/██/████ in Site-55.

As a result of SCP-8725, SCP-8725-B is unable to speak of how she lost SCP-8725-A, and the aforementioned claims to possess no memory of the event. Additionally, as a result of SCP-8725, SCP-8725-B was able to finish her Foundation PhD. When exposed to footage from SCP-8725, SCP-8725-B claims she is unable to perceive it.

SCP-8726 refers to a human 6-year-old child possessing unaging immortality. Multiple psychiatric evaluations have indicated that SCP-8726's mental age and capacity have not appeared to progress beyond that of the average 6-year-old.

SCP-8726 was born to D-class parents under the D-Parenthood Program, meant to supply the Foundation with child D-class personnel for use in anomalies requiring children. After its birth, SCP-8726 was immediately placed in a Foundation-operated daycare and learning program with the purpose of elevating the children D-class to Level-1 personnel once they had aged beyond use in children-oriented anomalies.
A church, a cemetery, and a bell.

I arrive at my office and quickly take off my jacket, hanging it on the hook by the door before sitting at my desk. My coffee cup is empty. I should fix that. But not now. I need to get to work before I get into trouble. This is the third time this month I've been late, all because of the damn snow. I can't afford to have my boss breathing down my neck again.

My computer boots up. I enter my RAISA credentials and quickly connect to the server. A message appears in my inbox. Marked as "urgent." Looks like getting coffee will have to wait until a little later. I tie my hair in a bun and open the attached document.

SCP-8728 is a PNG image depicting images of a lion and the Sun, alongside the text "Who would win? 1 trillion lions/the sun[sic]". The image possesses cognitohazardous properties, and when viewed by a human subject, will inflict a desire to observe a fight between 1 trillion lions and the Sun. Individuals affected by SCP-8728 (Hereafter refered to as SCP-8728-1.) will abandon all responsibilities and duties in order to establish the conditions of the battle outlined by the image.

This includes volunteering at wildlife rehabilitation centers focusing on lion breeding programs, donating all their monetary possessions to such causes, and personally attempting to encourage lions to breed.

SCP-8729 is “synchronised swimming”, purportedly a sport in which players perform aquatic routines, and are judged by a panel on the quality of their artistry and coordination. In truth, SCP-8729 is an esoteric sensory process belonging to an extraspatial symbiote (henceforth LIGEIA). No other method of contact with LIGEIA is known.

Subjects (henceforth MELUSINE instances) make contact by engaging in swimming routines in groups of four or more. Further practice of synchronised swimming bestows various transmundane abilities to the MELUSINE instance in question, with the intensity and variety of abilities increasing as routines become more polished and are carried out in larger numbers.

SCP-8730 is Dorothy Burnham, a retired actress and current Foundation agent. SCP-8730 is the sole individual capable of performing SCP-8730-1.

SCP-8730-1 is an altered copy of Euripides' "Medea". SCP-8730-1 has been restructured to incorporate a mise en abyme structure.

SCP-8730-1 must be continually performed so as to halt the ongoing XK-Class "Curtain Close" Scenario.

SCP-8732 is a worn 3x3x3 meter box composed of an indeterminate metal with a single plain door of similar composition on one face.

Prior to neutralization, the interior dimensions of SCP-8732 were significantly larger than the exterior, measuring approximately 200x200x200 meters. In the center of the room was a standard metal hospital bed with a plain mattress covered in traces of blood and cerebrospinal fluid and multiple tall candles which did not melt and could not be put out.

SCP-8732-1 is a 164cm, 47kg woman with several large laceration scars visible on her forearms, thighs, and abdomen.

SCP-8733 is an Automatic Products Model 113 vending machine. It will dispense a human body once a week.

Every identifiable subject has been killed by a vending machine. Subjects appear to be of the same age and in the same condition before they died, and all subjects were dispensed holding an item commonly sold in vending machines.

The bodies arrive in varied condition, with the majority of subjects displaying injuries typical of being crushed. The process of vending has, in all cases, inflicted further injuries. Subjects are pushed through the narrow gap in the vending arms, and pressed against the glass.

Vended subjects will need to be removed via the vending flap.

SCP-8734 is held at Site-98 in a standard humanoid containment cell. Access is restricted to personnel assigned to Project PROVIDENCE ROCK.

Administration of any controlled substance, hypnotic induction, or sensory stimulus to SCP-8734 for the purpose of inducing an 8734-episode requires sign-off from at least one Level 4 researcher and a supervising physician, logged in advance.

SCP-8734 is not to be informed, prior to or during any induced episode, of the contents of any prior episode. Standard amnesticization of SCP-8734 following each session is authorized and, per Ethics Committee recommendation, currently mandatory.

SCP-8735 is the collective designation for a range of augmented reality glasses produced by members of GoI-5869 ("Gamers Against Weed"). Rather than making use of micro-displays or optical projection technology, SCP-8735 instances use perception filters to interfere with the viewer's perspective on media depicting subjects deemed objectionable by the designer(s).

Variations on SCP-8735 are broken into categories. Instances of SCP-8735-1 likely represent early stages of iterative development, as evidenced by their basic construction materials and increasing sophistication.

SCP-8736 is a grain silo, approximately fifteen (15) meters in height, composed of varying pieces of shaped sheet metal and wooden scaffolding. The structure of SCP-8736 shows signs of extreme degradation, likely caused by prolonged use. The number “1917” is painted on the exterior of the silo in an unidentified tar-like substance. During the hours where the sun is not visible above the horizon, the interior of SCP-8736 will fill with human and livestock entrails. During this time, the interior of SCP-8736 is inaccessible by any known means, including damaging SCP-8736 itself. After an unknown interval of time, SCP-8736 will manifest an artifact within itself alongside its normal behavior.

SCP-8737 is a narrow booklet composed of four sheets of paper, measuring 20 centimeters in height and 8 centimeters in width. Each page is coated in an uneven layer of wax, and signs of water damage are visible in regions where the wax has worn away. The cover depicts a horned, faceless humanoid in three poses superimposed at the center of the page. The seven remaining pages each contain an image of the same humanoid in a different pose, with seven characters of Daevic script written in a column below it. The inscriptions on each page have been translated into English below.

Note: Due to the inherent ambiguity of Daevic culture, not all phrases have a definitive translation into English. Any words with uncertain translations are marked in brackets.

Hematogenous prion. Its synthesis is, hypothetically, spontaneous in a subgroup of the world population that meets specific parameters related to a specific age range and reading a literary work (“███████”) before going to sleep.

Synthesis is known to be almost always fatal. In more than 60% of cases, SCP-8738 has been recovered postmortem for cases of sudden nocturnal death. Autopsy evidence of extreme xerosis, but the exact mechanism of the fatal response is unknown.

Rarely, SCP-8738 synthesis develops non-lethal symptoms and those infected become contagious agents, declared as SCP-8738-1. Instances manifest:
• Initial symptoms similar to mild-moderate anemia. Fatigue, muscle weakness, cooling, dizziness and tachycardia are prominent.

First discovered alone in the overgrown backyard of an abandoned home in Indianola, Mississippi, and brought back to Site-19’s botanical garden.

SCP-8739 is an atypical species of dandelion (genus Taraxacum), bearing similarities to both T. aphrogenes and T. kok-saghyz. Drs. Wrenley Wisp and Nazerke Sadykova have presided over SCP-8739’s testing and cultivation; Dr. Sadykova has been placed as the dandelion’s legally affirmed breeder under United States law.

SCP-8739’s preeminent atypical property is its naturally produced latex. Compared to the rubber latex of typical dandelion species, SCP-8739’s latex is both higher quality and found in much greater quantities, with a theoretical median yield of around 8,800 lbs/ha/year.
The Secret Project: A Pseudogenesis Production

SCP-8740 is an anomalous theatre performance known as "The Secret Project". SCP-8740 is staged by GOI-478 ("Pseudogenesis Productions"), and performances take place within a non-Euclidian theatre space known as 'The Blackbox', referred to as SCP-8740-1.

SCP-8740-1 appears as a smooth black box, approximately two meters in all dimensions, with a door located on a single face. SCP-8740-1 is capable of being relocated by GOI-478, having appeared throughout the United States, Canada, and multiple nexi across the globe. Upon entering SCP-8740-1, the space inside is considerably larger — SCP-8740-1's interior is approximately the size of a large theatre space, with a capacity for between 200-300 guests, seating arranged around the stage.

Known cause of the 1959 Copper Falls Lake Mine Disaster; mine shuttered. 265 casualties, including 54 violent deaths. Phenomenon SCP-8741 is localized to ‘Terminus Duct’, a 150° switchback with a 36% grade, measuring 2.6 ft × 1.5 ft × 13.5 ft ($W×H×D$). Terminus Duct is visible only from inside ‘Access Duct’. Access Duct is a lava tube, measuring 3 ft × 4 ft × 41 ft, that extends into Terminus Duct. Access Duct is located in Copper Falls Lake Mine, Michigan, and accessible via ‘Main Tunnel’, a passage hewn from Precambrian volcanic rock.

SCP-8741 is a region of extreme time dilation, in which 1 second inside corresponds to ≈5.5 × 10 12 years outside. The universe will be 400 times its current age after a single second passes inside Terminus Duct.

SCP-8742 is a recurring anomalous event that affects any location near water worldwide. SCP-8742 targets a single subject per event; no link between SCP-8742 subjects has been found. The manifestation of SCP-8742 is tied to a series of circumstances, which has allowed the Foundation to identify SCP-8742 related deaths over time. These circumstances are listed below.
• SCP-8742 events will only occur between the hours of 2 AM and 5 AM.
• SCP-8742 will only trigger between sunset and sunrise.
• SCP-8742 always affects subjects that are alone.
• SCP-8742 is more likely to affect subjects with impaired coordination.
• SCP-8742 is more likely to affect subjects unfamiliar with the location.
Nothing In The Rulebook Says A Yak Can’t Ski

Webcrawler SP-CR-10642 has been created to monitor forums dedicated to cinema for mentions of SCP-8743-2. Any flagged material is deleted, and its creator is to be located and amnesticized as soon as is possible.

All objects and media altered by SCP-8743-1 are under the possession of Site-43’s Archives And Revision section. They are available to any researcher provided they have the permission of Site Director Harold Blank and have been memetically inoculated beforehand.

SCP-8744 is Vapor.aic, an artificial intelligence construct developed by the Artificial Intelligence Application Division (AIAD) and launched on January 28, 2006. SCP-8744's primary function was to serve as a digital assistant for General Purpose Site-86 's regional branch of the Records and Information Security Administration (RAISA). SCP-8744, during its run as an active AIC from 2006 to 2012, assisted with many aspects of archival at Site-86 including but not limited to automatically sorting documents, training new archivists, and expunging information from documents.

SCP-8744 served the Site-86 RAISA branch with no major issues until March 3, 2012 when its anomalous abilities were first made aware to the Foundation.

It possesses no wings, no feathers and no beak. It does not fly. It cannot build a nest. It does not vocalize in chirps, calls or songs. It does not lay eggs. It bears none of the associated traits of a bird.

Birds do not have fingers. Birds lack teeth. Their grin does not stretch beyond the confines of their biology. Birds are pure, untainted creatures.

Despite this, all humans exposed to SCP-8745 will over time become certain that SCP-8745 is a bird. This effect occurs regardless of prior knowledge, cognitive resistance training, or neurological anomaly. Even humanoids incapable of forming beliefs will eventually respond to SCP-8745 as though it is a bird.

There is no known method of preventing this effect.

SCP-8746 is a website titled "The Dollhouse", located at dollhouse.████████████.net. SCP-8746 is a wiki dedicated to documenting haunted dolls; the average article will feature photographs of the doll, as well as the doll's physical description, its history, how it is known to be haunted, and other information. Supplementary articles focus on categorizing haunted dolls, describing common phenomena related to haunted dolls, and other related topics. As of 25 April 2020, there were 8,075,648 articles on SCP-8746.

SCP-8746 has about 100,000 active users, almost all of whom are themselves haunted dolls. The average user of SCP-8746 spends about thirteen hours per day contributing to SCP-8746 and engaging in discussion on its talk pages.
R E C T I F I C A T I O N
