However, comprehensive molecular analysis has confirmed that SCP-9168 belongs to order Coleoptera.

Formerly containment chamber #9169. Standard Euclid-class anomaly holding cell; reinforced concrete walls and lead-lined heavy-duty steel door. Recently recovered files seem to imply some kind of structural modification was made to the chamber prior to its current state.

Chamber is hypothesised to emit a strong antimemetic effect. All information regarding the contents of the chamber's interior can not be retained in any way, either through memory or writing. Individuals that look into the chamber will not be able to recall it as anything other than a blank void, and those who hear descriptions of it will immediately have the information purged from their memories.

SCP-9170 is a two story, Craftsman-style house built in the 1920s, located in the South West of England. Local maps and signage are consistent in the address being recorded as No. 17 Gorse Avenue. The other 34 houses on Gorse Avenue are similar in style and further details have been omitted from this report due to their non-anomalous nature. They are currently used to house staff, and to store equipment and supplies.

SCP-9170 appears to have no anomalous preservation properties and requires standard external upkeep as would be required for a building of this era and location.

Entry into SCP-9170 by cleared persons, through both personal info checks and the use of amnestics, should only be permitted on days cleared by the site director.

SCP-9171 is a 2km wide geyser located on continental Europe that erupted outside Paris, France, on 1 March 2026. SCP-9171 is connected to the Atlantic Ocean via an unknown number of underground tributary channels that act similarly in principle to a root system, which feed a reservoir chamber within the earth's crust wherein pressure builds until eventual eruption. The column of water projected from SCP-9171 is capable of reaching the highest section of the troposphere, where the water is instantly aerosolised, which drove initial concerns for public health and anomalous infection. MTFs supported by research staff were deployed, and the O5 Council declared a state of emergency across all Foundation sites.

SCP-9172 is an anomaly affecting children attending Westwood Grove Playschool in Westwood Grove, South Dakota. Adults over the age of 18 have not been found to be affected by SCP-9172. The anomaly affects children who enter Westwood Grove Playschool permanently, and no effective cure has been found as of writing.

SCP-9172 causes sporadic and inappropriate behavior in affected children. Common traits of affectation are abnormal mental faculties, depressive and hostile attitudes, and general disobedience. Hostile behavior towards care personnel is very common among the affected, notably becoming more severe during nap time and diaper changing.

All children currently affected by SCP-9172 are aged 4-8.

SCP-9173 is a solid granite statue carved in the likeness of former O5-█, [REDACTED]. It is located in ███████████, Galveston City, Texas, USA, and was first unveiled on 4 July 1857, in commemoration of [REDACTED]'s role in the American Revolution. SCP-9173 measures 3.5 meters tall, with a pedestal measuring 0.6 meters on each side. To date, all attempts to damage SCP-9173 for the purpose of collecting samples have failed, presumably due to the influence of SCP-9173-A.

SCP-9173's primary anomalous property is the constant projection of an intense reality-manipulation effect (SCP-9173-A) in a roughly 30–130 meter radius around itself.
I feel that sun is slowly coming,Little darlin'

SCP-9174 was created in 1970 by the Beatles and Jerry Lee Lewis, and was released by Memphis Sun Studios as a 5,000-piece remix record of "Here Comes The Sun" and "Great Balls of Fire". Subsequent interviews with relevant individuals revealed that none of them had any memory of creating or releasing this record.

When subject is played, regardless of where the pointer or the record is located, it will always start playing from the 0:00:00 mark of the music, and during the playback process, there is no possibility of rewinding or fast-forwarding. Any movement of the pointer or the record is considered impossible until the end of the play (0:03:05).

SCP-9175 is an optical phenomenon of unknown nature that was visible exclusively from within the township of Lakeridge, Montana between 12:00 and 1:00 am on June 23rd of 2015. Unmagnified photographs and witness accounts of the phenomenon describe an exceptionally bright, abnormally slow meteor, which originated over Andromeda and proceeded south, crossing the entire night sky until it passed the horizon. No magnified photographs of the phenomenon are believed to exist. It is not believed that SCP-9175 will ever be visible again.

Thirteen individuals are believed to have observed SCP-9175 through binoculars. All of these individuals have refused to describe or discuss the phenomenon with anyone, under any circumstances.

SCP-9176 was a 2,834-acre ranch outside the town of Hondo, TX, owned and inhabited by Eric Bauer (aged 86), who exhibited no paranormal properties. SCP-9176 was discovered by Agent R. Kowalska during a survey expedition for an unrelated investigation. His handwritten notes and drawings of the property were found to be unaffected by its paranormal effect. Bauer claimed the land had been inherited from his parents, who had likewise inherited it from previous generations.

Beginning in 1986, portions of SCP-9176 periodically ceased to exist. These disappearances followed no observable schedule or pattern. Following the disappearance of a given section:
• The affected land would no longer be considered part of SCP-9176.

SCP-9177 refers to a collection of 7 deceased European honey bees (Apis mellifera). Despite the deceased nature of SCP-9177 instances, no decomposition has occurred in any of the specimens for the entire span of its containment.

SCP-9177-1 are a group of seven male-identifying human adults claiming to be part of a medieval monastic order, originating from ███████, Germany. Subjects display fluency in Middle Low German, Modern German and Latin.

When any SCP-9177-1 instance experiences clinical death, a corresponding SCP-9177 instance will reanimate through currently unknown means. The reanimated instance will then initiate an SCP-9177-A event.

SCP-9178 is the Arlington International Racetrack, currently visually indistinguishable from its original appearance prior to July 31st, 1985. SCP-9178 exists entirely within a pocket of space that overlaps with its historical counterpart, but is largely inaccessible for most of the year. Foundation spatial penetration technology is able to override this if required. SCP-9178 access is restored during time periods in which the location would have been open to the public and hosting a derby — primarily May, June, July, August, September, and November.

SCP-9178 is technically operational and sustainable year round.

The following documentation grants access to all iterations of the SCP-9179 file, as requested by the Ethics Committee for their ongoing investigation into SCP-9179 and its head researcher Dr. James Gornell.

Please note that due to SCP-9179's nature and the nature in which these files were written, they contain extremely irregular formatting and vernacular, below any RAISA standard. They have been left in their original forms for the aid of your investigation.

RAISA has also taken the liberty to include further notices throughout this documentation to provide additional context where appropriate.

— Dolores Fawkes, EC Liaison, RAISA

SCP-9180 is a female, juvenile, domestic dog (Canis lupus familiaris) of a Golden Retriever, Labrador mixed breed. Anomalous properties observed to date include the ability to stay the same age, the production of varied animal noises, and the ability to de-age humans into toddlers. De-aged individuals retain the intelligence and personalities that were present before the transformation. De-aged individuals also shrink with the current clothing and accessories they are wearing.

Aggressive or "mean-spirited" behavior within the proximity of SCP-9180 will result in triggering of its de-aging ability. Its ability will prioritize present aggressors; however, it can recognize and target groups, regardless of members' locations.

SCP-9181 is the uninhabited area of Lowri Island off of the coast of Scotland. Lowri Island itself has remained uninhabited since discovery due to the anomalous effects it demonstrates as well as the newly anomalous local wildlife.

SCP-9181 itself is an island with anomalous properties and various anomalous wildlife. Non-anomalous wildlife is also present on SCP-9181, but as of 12/06/2024, anomalous wildlife have been recorded, labeled as SCP-9181-1 through SCP-9181-9.

The ground of SCP-9181 is near impenetrable, and digging into the ground of SCP-9181 becomes impossible after passing the topsoil. Beneath the topsoil is a hardened, chitinous-like layer, and has proven resilient to all forms of damage.

SCP-9182 is a combat-active Mobile Task Force, designated Sigma-16 ("Honed Edges"), currently in service with the Foundation. Prior to its exposure to an unknown anomalous object, and subsequent SCP classification, SCP-9182 held the designation of Platoon Charlie, MTF Epsilon-6 ("Village Idiots").

Individual members of SCP-9182 are designated SCP-9182-1 through SCP-9182-12. Should any instance of SCP-9182-X expire, their physical location and condition is reverted to that of precisely 34 minutes and 11 seconds prior to death. Any physical matter obstructing the return point at the time of reappearance is violently displaced. Any living creature displaced in such a manner suffers extreme physical trauma.

SCP-9183 is an anomalous increase in unsafe and unhealthy social behaviour and the health conditions which follow from them. These increases are extremely localized and are attributed to SCP-9183-1 visiting nightlife locations in the day(s) prior to their onset. Behaviours affected by SCP-9183 have included, but are not thought to be limited to:
• Smoking of tobacco and electronic nicotine products, followed by pneumonia, blood clots, and possibly various types of cardiovascular disease and cancer.
• Consumption of alcohol, often to a dangerous degree, followed by reckless behaviour leading to accidents, alcohol-induced coma (including terminal cases), and possibly liver disease.

SCP-9184 designates a trans-temporal entity inhabiting the human noosphere referred to colloquially as "The God of Empathy". Encounters with SCP-9184 both in and outside of the human Dreamscape have shown it to be both sustained by as well as capable of amplifying collective human compassion, mourning, and aspiration. Unlike most deities, SCP-9184 is unable to manifest willingly, although it can be summoned by acts or gestures from humans falling within its domain. These invocations do not seem to need to be directed at SCP-9184.

Historically, most SCP-9184 manifestations have occurred in conflict zones.

SCP-9185 is an entity composed entirely of sound waves. It is capable of travelling through all forms of matter and moves through air at Mach 1 velocity. It perceive its surroundings through some form of echolocation. The entity has the ability to reproduce any sound known to it with perfect accuracy, including human speech. The range of frequencies it has been observed to produce is from 10mHz to 300MHz, but its actual range could be beyond that.

SCP-9185 is fully sentient and has shown remarkable performance in logical reasoning and memory tests. It is able to communicate in almost every spoken language. An analysis of its known languages and vocabulary suggests it came into existence some time in the 15th century.
If You Say Yes To One

SCP-9186 was a 95-carat diamond, originally mined in Andhra Pradesh, India, sometime in the early 1400s. Records indicate that if the local light level was sufficiently dark, SCP-9186 emitted a 15-lumen glow, similar to a children's nightlight. It was used by a series of monarchs within South Asia as a reading aid or for vision at night.

SCP-9186 was acquired through initial exploits in the region, which concluded with the suspension of British activities in South Asia. Popular rumors during this time claimed it was "cursed," as male rulers who owned SCP-9186 passed away through unlikely means. As such, acquisition was straightforward.

However, after an unknown period following procurement, SCP-9186 was split into at least 54 pieces.

SCP-9187 is a Soviet pedestal-style desk lamp, visually similar to production units manufactured by ZiK in 1981. The object features a base made of glazed ceramic supporting a metal lamp assembly with a decoratively perforated cylindrical housing. It is topped with a wide, ribbed glass diffuser, which does not appear to be part of the original set.

The lamp shows moderate wear including mild surface abrasion, discoloration, and heat-related patina on metallic components, suggesting that the lamp has been subject to a significantly prolonged use. The power cable is permanently affixed to the lower part of the base and exhibits typical PVC insulation aging.

SCP-9188 is a cybernetically augmented great white shark (Carcharodon carcharias), which is approximately 6.5 meters in length.

The entity possesses several internal and external augmentations, which include four mechanized appendages directly integrated into the entity's skeletal structure.

These appendages can provide both bipedal and quadrupedal locomotion. During the bipedal mode, the entity can assume a vaguely humanoid posture while using the other two limbs as arms.

SCP-9188 remains completely inactive unless it visually detects a human hand forming a clenched fist.

SCP-9189 is a cinnamon bear (Ursus americanus cinnamomum) whose body extends horizontally at a consistent rate. SCP-9189 is wider than its containment cell at all times. Despite this, SCP-9189 is fully contained within the cell. The mechanism by which this occurs is not currently understood. Investigation is ongoing.

SCP-9189's anomalous width and expansion do not affect its typical biological functions. All of its internal biological processes operate within standard parameters for a specimen of its type. SCP-9189 exhibits no anomalous behavior and does not display awareness of its anomalous properties. SCP-9189 does not present a threat to personnel.

Since its acquisition in 2011, SCP-9189 has expanded to an estimated width of ██,███ kilometers.
Advantages of Making Regular Use of Cleaning Products

SCP-9190 is a form of surgery capable of transferring a human subject into the future. Personnel sent into the future by SCP-9190 are unable to call back or return to the past; this process is typically used to enforce the presence of the Foundation within periods of time that would otherwise lead to the Foundation ceasing to exist.

The exact process behind SCP-9190 is not scientifically understood.

SCP-9193 is held in a temperature controlled containment drydock in ██████, New Jersey, under the management of Site-83.

Visitors to SCP-9193 may board the vessel with written approval from Researcher A. Bykov, under supervision from containment drydock security staff. Anyone wishing to enter the main cabin compartment of SCP-9193 must wear a disposable coverall, gloves, and full face respirator, which are available on-site for use.

Any materials, samples, written descriptions, videos, photos, or items taken from within SCP-9193 must be first inspected in-person by Researcher A. Bykov, with the understanding that all research relating to SCP-9193 will be kept at Site-83 for further study.

SCP-9194 is the randomly appearing clause "And Patterson too" in existing English-based print, visual, and audio-based media. Its presence itself is unremarkable and non-anomalous; no characters will comment on SCP-9194, and no viewers or listeners report adverse effects. Consumers, however, do notice SCP-9194.

When in written form, the punctuation and grammar of SCP-9194 will be linguistically sound. However, the specific punctuation itself may change between manifestations. SCP-9194 appearances prioritize print media, especially well-known classical literature and other influential works. However, SCP-9194 has increasingly affected audiovisual content as well. SCP-9194 instances cannot be removed if present in digital media.

SCP-9195 is a phenomenon causing the disappearance of lost items and people. Current testing shows it to occur to objects in which an individual has an emotional attachment, with the nature of the emotional attachment having no effect on the chances of an SCP-9195 manifestation. Additionally, SCP-9195 impairs the memory of individuals who have formed an attachment to affected items, preventing them from clearly recalling the objects.

SCP-9196-A is the unconscious body of a male human of eastern Asian ethnicity, roughly 1.8 meters tall and weighing 82 kilograms. Subject's age is estimated to be between 27 and 30 years. Neural analysis shows fully functional cognitive abilities.

No observable decomposition or aging has taken place on SCP-9196-A since the subject's discovery in ████. Subject does not respirate or require material sustenance to survive, yet cardiovascular activity functions normally despite the lack of oxygen being delivered. SCP-9196-A constantly emits the scent of petrichor via an unknown source.

SCP-9196-B is a collection of four handwritten documents formerly tucked in SCP-9196-A's left arm. The author of the subject is currently believed to be SCP-9196-A.
What The Eye Doesn't See, The Heart Doesn't Feel

SCP-9197 is an illness with a memetic effect that inflicts strong urges of suicide on any of its patients(dubbed SCP-9197-A), as well as the urge to be seen doing so. SCP-9197 spreads if someone sees the death of an SCP-9197-A instance, both self-inflicted or by another individual. The illness can be first detected mere minutes after infection, however, it only takes full effect around 24 hours following initial exposure. SCP-9197 starts by inflicting depression on its host, eventually escalating to the point where they will try to either kill themselves or force someone to do so. As such, SCP-9197 is much harder to perceive in its initial stages, and affected individuals might go into society before the disease is detected.

SCP-9198 refers to a hostile, hivemind-like organism that visually mimics the appearance of snow. Its diet primarily consists of siphoning any nearby sources of thermal energy and organic matter, which it utilizes to replicate on a massive scale. Despite its potential to trigger an NK-Class (“Grey Goo”) Scenario, SCP-9198 is currently contained within the confines of Montreal Island in Canada, effectively preventing a global catastrophe.

A direct consequence of SCP-9198’s sustained presence on the island has been a severe deterioration of local weather conditions. For the three years since containment began, the island has remained in a continuous snowstorm, with ambient temperatures routinely falling below −50 °C (−58 °F).
And to Think That I Saw It on Mulberry Street

URA-7DL is a bipedal chimerical entity, origin unknown, estimated to be two meters in height. It is composed of bodily features from a ram, tortoise, baboon, crab, scorpion, ox, and snakes. URA-7DL is capable of emitting sarin gas, and has been reported to flay and devour children, using their skin as clothing. Prior to Foundation discovery, it had been sighted seven kilometers southwest of ████████, but its current whereabouts are unknown.

SCP-9200 is a crashed spacefaring vessel located in Makronisos, Greece. SCP-9200's operating artificial intelligence (known hereafter as SCP-9200-A) is functioning and has been since the ship first crashed into the island over 3000 years ago. The vessel has suffered catastrophic damage to its hull and major systems. The vessel is still capable of movement, and has burrowed into the central island's ridge. The SCP Foundation maintains limited control of the affected area through agreements with the Greek government.

Exact dating of SCP-9200's first discovery is difficult to determine, but the anomaly was known to the Mycenean Greeks as the earthly home of Hephaestus. The Hittite Empire likewise associated the island with Ḫašamili.

SCP-9201 is the Foundation Reality Transaction Manager (FRTM), a piece of paratechnology which enables ACID transaction processing on a piece of local reality. Due to its immense power requirements and the difficulty of properly determining conceptual parameters, effective use for Foundation operations is challenging.

The primary use of the FRTM is in SCP-9201-A, the Foundation Field Anomaly Analyzer (FFAA). This 47 kilogram device interfaces with an internally-installed limited-use SCP-9201 instance. The FFAA has been programmed to accept nearby spatial coordinates and generic conceptual information, or alternatively, an SCP database number.

This document has been modified into an order best suited for full comprehension. Interviews with head researcher Dr. Natasha Atacama have been interspersed for clarification. Due to the nature of SCP-9202, addendums 2 and 3 have been redacted to Level 4, as well as the entirety of PROJECT INDIVIDUAL.

Discovered in Whistlebay, Wyoming in 1992 following a number of sightings and reports of kidnappings by the entity. Moved to Site-19 following negotiations.

SCP-9203 is an anomalous morbidly obese female humanoid with a height of 6 feet 3 inches. SCP-9203 has mottled green skin, 6 arms, 3 eyes, and a large fleshy conical protuberance on its head. SCP-9203 has been taught crude English by Special Collections Program staff, although its native language is believed to be a form of corrupted Old Church Slavonic.

SCP-9203 has featured in a number of urban legends in Whistlebay and was referred to by the locals as “The Whistlebay Witch”.

SCP-9204 is a male Golden Retriever dog colloquially referred to as Milo. When given a verbal command to "fetch," SCP-9204 will always retrieve an object. This retrieval is uninhibited by distance, size, and other factors that would normally limit feasibility. A minority of requests result in retrieval of an object other than the one requested. The significance of non-target objects retrieved is unknown.

SCP-9205 is a cylindrical jar made of polished black marble, 14 cm in height and 10 cm in diameter, undecorated except for the Latin words carved into the lid: Male parta male dilabuntur. The jar is capable of self-repair, having survived multiple gunshots during attempts to acquire it, and it is not known if it can be permanently damaged or destroyed.

The contents of the jar consist of an opaque grey gel, which cannot be completely extracted or exhausted, as SCP-9205 automatically generates more to replace it. This substance is chemically identical to cold cream and exhibits no anomalous traits until exposed to the skin of a human being of at least forty years of age.

SCP-9206 is a spontaneous phenomenon biannually affecting 67% of England's adult Avifauna.

Avians affected by SCP-9206 will show the following anomalous effects for the next 10 months after being affected:
• An abnormally high cognitive function.
• Increased dexterity and bone density
• A desire to converge in specific locations along with their respective species.
• Innate knowledge of POI-9206's location.

Approximately 90 minutes after being affected by SCP-9206, said avians will attempt to migrate towards POI-9206. If contact is successful, all SCP-9206-1 instances will collect the closest spherical object and attempt to replicate a season of Association Football.

SCP-9207 refers to a genetically and thaumaturgically modified subspecies of the common pill-bug (Armadillidium vulgare promethei). SCP-9207 are fully sapient and communicate telepathically.

SCP-9207 instances are capable of self-detonating, with the resulting explosion having a force of approximately 150kg of TNT. Despite total disintegration, the instance will re-materialize 5-10 seconds after the detonation and suffer no lasting damage. SCP-9207 instances are capable of detonating on their own, but have shown a strong social preference for doing it in groups of three, citing the experience as "more satisfying."

SCP-9207 was created by GoI-014 ("Prometheus Labs, Inc.") shortly before their dissolution in 1998.

SCP-9208-A is a sentient manifestation of the concept of Autophobia. SCP-9208-A's exact appearance is difficult to document; however it has been consistently described as a feminine humanoid. SCP-9208-A most commonly manifests in crowded areas, especially areas designated as battlefields. SCP-9208-A was first discovered during the beginning of what is now known the ΔK-Class ("Stop Making Sense") scenario.

While in the presence of any being with sapience, SCP-9208-A will begin to excrete a cognitohazardous substance.

SCP-9209 is a caucasian male of approximately 14 years of age, standing 1.45 meters in height, with pale skin and shoulder-length dirty blonde hair. It is fully verbal, with fluency in French, Latin, and English. It has demonstrated basic levels of education as well as an acute awareness of historical events across multiple centuries. Two (2) large white feathered wings extend from its upper back, though it has not been observed utilizing them for flight. SCP-9209 was recovered wearing clothing consistent with late 19th-century clerical dress, and currently wears cotton garments provided by the Foundation.

SCP-9209 is typically non-aggressive during periods of containment.

SCP-9210 are anomalous zones in the continental United States mapping to enrollment boundaries of public elementary schools that enroll over 10 times the number of students as the next most populated.

After unknown criteria are fulfilled, homes that have at least one student enrolled in a school within SCP-9210 will spontaneously have an exact copy of the school building containing their child's class manifest 1 kilometer above their home. This results in total destruction of the home. The drop occurs in a way such that any inhabitants are left unharmed, though resulting debris may still cause injury. Copies created by SCP-9210 appear to be perfect replicas with all classroom supplies intact, and display little to no anomalous characteristics.

SCP-9211 are small insectoids similar in size and shape to the Musca domestica (housefly); their entire physiology comprises parts of timepieces which move and operate similarly to the timepiece they represent. Each unique SCP-9211 instance is composed of random parts that operational instances use to construct new ones.
Arthur's Cruel, And I Forget Why.

SCP-9212-D was an anomalous humanoid resembling a middle aged Native American male. It was a thaumaturgist capable of teleportation, transfiguration, and spontaneous energy manifestation.

SCP-9212-D's origins are currently unknown. No record of the anomaly existed until March of 2015 — it is unknown if it has manifested previously.
Ursus Arctos Major, or A Really Big Bear

SCP-9213 refers to an abnormally large female specimen of Ursus Arctos, commonly known as a grizzly bear. While most specimens measure out to be two meters long and one meter tall, SCP-9213 measures approximately one-hundred lightyears long and thirty-five lightyears tall, although exact measurements are beyond current capabilities. While several factors should have led to the subject’s demise, such as difficulty to take in oxygen at its current size and a lack of oxygen, SCP-9213 appears to be in good health.

SCP-9213 is capable of motion through space by walking, despite a lack of sufficient gravity or ground.

SCP-9214 is the designation for a collection of mind affecting, sapient hexapodal entities. Adult instances are approximately 3 meters in length, while the size of juveniles is dependent on the human host used for incubation.

SCP-9214 exerts a mind affecting anomalous influence after successful copulation, compelling nearby humans to provide a host. Once present, SCP-9214 injects it with a paralytic agent and a singular egg, before weaving it into a cocoon with a silk-like adhesive substance. Following an incubation period of approximately 4 months, a juvenile instance of SCP-9214 emerges, bearing the host's facial and bodily features.

SCP-9215 is the Applewood Public Library, located in Applewood, New Mexico, United States. It consists of six stories and covers an area of 200,000 square feet. A number of anomalous phenomena have been incorporated into the library's operations; these phenomena are under the complete control of the library's chief librarian, and can be modified or suspended at their command. See Addendum 9215-2 for more information.

SCP-9215 is inhabited by 15 14 anomalous entities, designated SCP-9215-A-1 through -15. They resemble species of non-anomalous fauna, but possess exaggerated features and abnormal coloration, as well as other anomalous properties that vary between instances.

SCP-9216 is a sapient organic biomass. The individual tissues and cells that make up SCP-9216 resemble those of a human, and it often maintains a nearly human figure. Its actual anatomy is highly fluid, such that its organs, their number, and their relative placement around its body are highly variable; it is not uncommon for fully-formed facial features to emerge from the dermal layers of SCP-9216 over the course of several minutes, move across the surface of its skin, and then disappear in a similar manner. SCP-9216 is able to influence these "fluctuations" to some degree, and it is usually able to maintain at least one matching pair of eyes, one nose, and one mouth on its face.

No individuals are permitted to remain unconscious on SCP-9217 outside of experimentation under any circumstances. All Foundation operations on SCP-9217 are restricted to daylight hours. The use of sedatives or sleep aids on SCP-9217 is strictly prohibited.

All active instances of SCP-9217-Myr are to be considered Foundation personnel, and treated as such. The creation of SCP-9217-Myr instances is strictly prohibited. Any discovered SCP-9217-Myr are to be terminated.
You are the light of the world. A city on a hill can be hidden.

SCP-9218 is the nexus known as FP-32, better known as "Adjacent-Oslo," a Free Port designated nexus that is currently under the covert administration of The SCP Foundation, and consists of a network of subway stations and tunnels connected to each other, located in an extradimensional space anchored to Oslo, Norway.

SCP-9219 refers to the events that occurred on [REDACTED] 2025 in an attic in [REDACTED], Hamburg, Germany (see Addendum 1).

SCP-9219-1 describes the suspected perpetrator of these events, one Martin Feldt. It is believed that Feldt was a reality bender, but whether he was aware of this remains unclear. Investigations into his background have yielded no information. Feldt was 27 years old at the time of his demise and a carpenter by trade. He had never previously come to the attention of the Foundation or public authorities.

Update: Persistent odors of smoke within the attic in question are to be explained as harmless residues from the fire.

SCP-9220 is a condition affecting approximately 0.00001% of humans bearing maternal organs. SCP-9220 manifests as spontaneous pregnancy, in many cases without any prior evidence of conception.

All babies produced from SCP-9220 are born dead. These corpses, hereafter referred to as instances of SCP-9220-A, display advanced stages of dehydration and desiccation. SCP-9220-A appear to have been dead from well before the time of birth, and show no signs of heartbeat, brain waves, or other metabolic functions. In spite of this, instances will continue to grow and age at a rate equivalent to a living human.

Upon reaching a point hereby referred to as the Terminal Age (approx. 21 years), the instance will open their eyes and [DATA EXPUNGED].

SCP-9221 designates 187 traffic cones, varying in size, color, and design. When arranged the instances connect to form an invisible barrier. With the exception of motor vehicles, the barrier remains permeable to all forms of matter.

SCP-9222 is Alice Starr, a non-anomalous human being related through unknown means to SCP-9222-1, an anomalous event/killing that occurred on June 4th, 1929. The victim, an as yet unidentified woman, was found brutalized in the Bayou Sauvage National Wildlife Refuge in New Orleans. Her eyes were noted to be heavily damaged, though other traumas were additionally present. The primary suspect is a Mr. Adam Altair, director of the local 'Rising Sun' opera house. Altair reported the body within 2 hours of death, despite its remote location, and refused to explain why he was in the refuge. Notably, Altair died in 1955. SCP-9222 possessed some known relation to Altair, though it is unknown if she was involved in the murder.

SCP-9223 is a ritual that was carried out on the date of the Wesak festival at seven locations in 595 CE, during the reign of Emperor Wen of Sui (隋文帝). The instructions for the ritual were diligently recorded by at least 18 monastic communities with continuity to the current day, and can thus be reconstructed confidently.

Recovered following a civilian incident in West Hollywood, California. The entity was reported as "emerging from the ground" and targeted four Canadian tourists. There were 26 casualties and 49 instances of gross rectal damage during transportation to Site Victorville. (See File SCP-9224-194B.)

SCP-9225 is an island located in the Mediterranean sea, between Greece and Libya, measuring 80km in radius with an area of 20,000km 2. The island is cloaked by an antimemetic effect, and as such, is entirely imperceptible and inaccessible to individuals not under the effects of mnestic drugs. The island itself has its topography partially warped in various locations, but most notably in the shoreline and its center. This can manifest via the bending of rocks to form sharp and uneven edges, as well as forcing the ground to bend at angles as steep as 90°. The environment, however, maintains the characteristics of a typical Mediterranean location, including non-anomalous biodiversity.

SCP-9226 is a species of flowering plant belonging to a monotypical genus in the family Asteraceae. It grows as a herbaceous vine-like shrub measuring approximately 50 cm (20 in) in height at full maturity. It produces inflorescent amber-fuchsia flowers which it uses to attract its primary pollinator, Eurycotis floridana.

The seeds of SCP-9226 are normally inedible and toxic due to high concentrations of non-anomalous toxins which may be neutralized through boiling, drying, and fermenting.

SCP-9226 has a poorly understood but highly potent psychoactive effect.
The United Federation Republic of New Pacifical States

SCP-9227 is a piece of copy paper with a drawing of a fictional country labeled "The United Federation Republic of New Pacifical States" on top of the paper. According to the drawing, the country is supposedly located in the Pacific Ocean, between North America and Asia. On the bottom right is a compass with a human eye in the center. The country contains 26 states, consisting of:
• Alford
• Temsfork
• Columbia Fields
• Heights of Dale
• Wilshore
• Crution
• Denton
• Pacificana
• Omveron
• Lexford Fields
• Mellburg
• Bridgecott
• New Havenshire Fields
• Georida
• Willowberg
• New Springsfield
• Nineburg
• Redwood Heights
• Madison
• Pensworth
• Zenterville
• Nova Riverside
• Rosewood
• Vickerson
• New Birchmere
• Bay Ocean Island

Human Foundation personnel are prohibited from entering a 3.5-kilometre radius of SCP-9228's cell without prior authorisation. All authorised personnel must undergo a complete medical examination at least 3 days prior to entering SCP-9228's containment radius and possess an Injury Severity Score (ISS) under 15.

Exceptions require authorisation from Site-11's Senior Medical Officer, Dr. Mitchell Wilson, or one Level 4 or higher authority.

All rations, medical supplies, and standard amenities are to be delivered to SCP-9228 via autonomous drone delivery.

SCP-9228 is to undergo a complete medical examination at least once every week.
Computer plot of gravitationally anomalous regions, p<0.02. Note the layer-cake arrangement.

SCP-9230 refers to a lake in western Bulgaria. Temporal displacement in the location around the anomaly causes the immediate area to maintain a consistent state of what would constitute midnight anywhere else.

SCP-9230-1 is a humanoid entity inhabiting SCP-9230. SCP-9230-1 appears as a human female, with height of approximately 10 meters, blue skin and red eyes. Unidentified luminescent white matter serves as both hair (approximately 8 meters long) and dress of SCP-9230-1. DNA samples are yet to be acquired. The entity possesses a high level of ontokinetic abilities, potential telepathic capabilities, and above average intellect. Individuals who come into contact with SCP-9230-1 have developed an immunity to amnestics.

SCP-9231 was the designation given to now defunct phenomena wherein memetically-augmented sestinas were anomalously imbued with the essence of a particular concept. The imbued concept, designated as SCP-9231-A, would always appear as one of the repeating words within the sestina. When was interpreted in either written or spoken form, the essence of the instance's SCP-9231-A would reflect upon the interpreter, causing them to manifest properties associated with the concept for a period of time. The resulting anomalous impact depended heavily on the interpreter's personal understanding of the concept, with particularly complex concepts generally resulting in significantly different results from interpreter to interpreter.

SCP-9232 is a humanoid male standing roughly 1.85 meters in height. The subject exhibits extensive thermal damage across the majority of its body surface, with an absence of body hair except for the scalp. The entity's clothing remains intact but charred and appears to be heat resistant. Facial tissue has undergone significant thermal deformation, resulting in a fixed expression resembling a smile due to fusion and contraction of surrounding musculature and dermal layers. SCP-9232 has three known mental states:
• Dormant; indicated by a faint orange glow
• Active; indicated by a bright orange glow
• Fugue; indicated by a bright white glow

Discovery unclear — item has been held at Site-19 since records began. It is a biological entity, extraterrestrial in composition and origin. Reports describe its epidermis as grey and translucent. SCP-9233 is only capable of being viewed once. After initial line of sight is broken, the item will become unviewable and intangible. This applies to visual and audio recordings.

Entities similar to known descriptions of the item have been viewed across rural America since the 1950s. Witnesses report the rapid on-set of physical and neurological symptoms similar to minor brain trauma when in close proximity. These symptoms are often paired with a slick, rough sensation in the throat.

SCP-9234 is the designation given to an anomalous effect that, until recently, affected all food consumed within the boundaries of ████‎█‎‎█, Virginia. Any edible item ingested inside the town retained its normal physical properties, including but not limited to:
• appearance
• taste
• texture
• nutritional content
• chemical composition

However, the item would be somehow be extraphysically transubstantiated into human flesh. Standard scientific analysis could detect no difference from ordinary food.

Description: SCP-9235 is coin locker #4, kept in situ at the Kisaragi Station. SCP-9235 possesses a selective spatial anomaly which allows it to be significantly larger than is physically possible, but only when it is used to store newborns. Non-newborn materials — such as swaddling cloth, good luck charms, or letters — cannot be placed within the deepest part of SCP-9235 and thus can be extracted without physically interacting with attached newborns. The exact mechanics of SCP-9235's spatial anomaly are unknown. Regardless, SCP-9235 culminates in a storage solution that can efficiently handle newborns, as long as regular maintenance is provided to remove non-newborn material from SCP-9235.

SCP-9236 is the city which will be built between the Tigris and Euphrates in June of 2043, and the process of its habitation.

The city will be arranged in a square whose corners touch the two rivers, and be raised from stones of many colours. Each building will rise one hundred and eight metres into the sky, and the towers will tessellate over the desert, so that the space between them gives rise to a series of parallel streets. The wind will whistle through them. Where the towers end there will be a wall of glass, composed of a single perfect piece, cast in place by enormous furnaces. Contemporary materials science suggests such a thing is impossible, but the fires have been seen.

It will be built over twenty-two days.

SCP-9237 is a standard 35 lb tape measure. It has no branding nor serial number leaving SCP-9237's manufacturer unknown.

SCP-9237 is capable of self-propulsion by extending its tape and hook to crawl. It has demonstrated the ability to scale vertical planes so long as its hook or magnetic tip can find an anchor point.

During feeding, SCP-9237 will coil its tape section around the paper, folding it under its hook. Upon reaching extension limit, SCP-9237 will then disengage its locking mechanism ingesting the paper quickly into its frame. After a period of presumed rest, SCP-9237 will extend its tape section revealing its lines of measure now match the scale of the ingested table.

SCP-9238 is a human embryo at approximately 8 weeks' gestational equivalent, measuring roughly 1.6 cm in length. It has shown no measurable developmental progression beyond this stage since initial containment. Aside from its developmental arrest, the subject exhibits no physiological abnormalities and remains biologically stable within its current containment environment.

Genetic analysis has failed to identify SCP-9238's biological parents, and its genome does not correspond to any known individual or human lineage in Foundation databases. No genetic markers have been identified that would indicate a non-human origin.

SCP-9238 constantly emits a localized telepathic field extending approximately 3 m from its body.

SCP-9239 is an extradimensional space created through ontokinetic manipulation. It takes the form of a realm consisting of creatures and objects similar to those depicted in common fairy tales. The entrance to this realm is currently located in the area formerly designated as Containment Unit 428-B, which has replaced the steel doors with a door of a design typically seen in medieval fortresses. Entering through this door will lead to a dense forest with trees as tall as 60 meters, and mythical creatures such as unicorns and ogres. These creatures are usually docile, and will not attack personnel unless provoked.

SCP-9239-A refers to itself as Sir Reynold the Great, who is the only human being present in SCP-9239.
Word Count: This article has an approximate word count of 22-24K words. Fair warning as so many offsets can hide the length quite well.

SCP-9241 is a 1952 Australian penny of moderate wear with a diameter of 30.8 mm. The coin has basic predatory intelligence and is keenly aware of its surroundings despite an observed lack of sensory organs.

The sole targets of SCP-9241 are human males no older than 15 years of age who are engaged in the act of metal detecting. SCP-9241 tunnels to a point 5–15 cm below the ground in front the path of its target and enters an idle state, seeming to prefer subjects metal detecting at beaches, riverbanks, and sanded playgrounds. Once acquired and taken to the residence of its target, SCP-9241 waits for approximately 3.5 hours after the commencement of the subject’s first rem sleep cycle before beginning digestion.

SCP-9242 is a spatiotemporal anomaly that manifests as a hiking trail extending approximately 7,769 kilometers, beginning within the Priazovsky State Nature Preserve in Russia, and presumed to end at a point in north-central Mongolia, approximately 3 kilometers south-southwest of Erdenet. While SCP-9242 exists outside consensus reality, its geography corresponds to that of the baseline regions it traverses, allowing SCP-9242 to be mapped using data collected during testing. Furthermore, GPS trackers prove functional within the anomaly. All forms of modern communication and audiovisual technology, including drones and personal cameras, are rendered inoperable after crossing the threshold to SCP-9242.
The Birth and Death of the Day

SCP-9243 cannot be contained by conventional means. Foundation containment efforts must focus on active monitoring and the minimization of collateral damage associated with both the primary effects of the anomaly and those incurred as a side effect of ongoing public dissemination. False information has been inserted into various records of note, including but not limited to historical accounts, census results, government databases, and consumer analytics systems.

The Foundation has established a worldwide perinatal monitoring network, in cooperation with select representatives from international agencies with particularly high SCP-9243-related stresses.

SCP-9244 is Lake Harrison, an artificial retention pond located near Harrow, Nevada, United States. Despite being artificially created and lacking any record or evidence of wildlife, fishing equipment utilized in SCP-9244 will often successfully result in catches at a rate similar to natural lakes of its size. Fish caught in SCP-9244, designated SCP-9244-A, are universally freshwater fish native to Nevada, though often are members of species not native to the specific region in which SCP-9244 is located. SCP-9244-A instances, while non-anomalous, possess significant physical deformities and are of an abnormally large size. SCP-9244-A instances released back into SCP-9244 quickly asphyxiate due to the lack of dissolved oxygen in the water.

SCP-9245 is a residential building in a gated community in upstate New York, built in 1995. Every room has three or more access ports that open to a network of small freight elevators spanning the building. While these are similar in design to modern dumbwaiters, a robust system of pulleys allows them to move in three dimensions along provided rails.

SCP-9245's dumbwaiter network connects to a 0.5 m x 0.5 m shaft in the basement, designated SCP-9245-A. SCP-9245-A is filled primarily with the mechanical components needed to move up to fourteen dumbwaiters through it at a time. Remote examination has shown that SCP-9245-A is at least 7.1 km deep; its total depth is unknown.

SCP-9246 is an annual phenomenon that occurs on January 10 every year, centralized to a remote location of the Shirakami Mountains in Japan’s Akita Prefecture. During this time, local reality in the area will become unstable, with rapidly and wildly fluctuating Hume levels recorded by Foundation sensors. The phenomenon will last approximately 24 hours, with an initial spike in fluctuations occurring around 7:30am local time and a final spike happening 24 hours later, after which all effects will cease entirely. Following the conclusion of this event, no further fluctuations in Hume levels will occur until the following January 10.

SCP-9247 is a class-4 ontokineticist named Juniper Castel, the daughter of Timothy Castel and Janine Springer. She is currently 14 years old. SCP-9247 entered Foundation custody after a rampancy event which occurred several months after the emergence of her anomalous capabilities. Her passive influence on the hume field measures in the top 10th percentile among class-4 ontokineticists, making her the third most ontokinetically potent humanoid currently contained by the Foundation.

The products of SCP-9247's ontokinesis characteristically involve hand puppets, shades of orange, pink, purple and blue — but not red or green — and fantastical elements.

SCP-9248 is a male human cadaver, 31 years of age at the time of death. Objects brought within the vicinity of SCP-9248 are occasionally replaced with other objects.

SCP-9248 is identified as Foundation researcher Matthew Martins. Further information on SCP-9248 should not be provided to personnel not associated with Mobile Task Force Delta-4.

Brought to Foundation's attention and successfully contained in 1958; however, historical documents indicate its existence long before. SCP-9249 is a series of motile stone monoliths bound to a meadow near Ypres, Belgium. Each instance is engraved with a face, typified by elongated, warped features—sometimes pitched at odd angles or with multiple lineaments layered atop one another. Each stone stands at around 2 meters tall. The number of SCP-9249 instances is dynamic and changes on a regular basis; however, the figure typically stands anywhere from 3 to 30 individual monoliths.

SCP-9249 instances are capable of locomotion, though at an imperceptibly gradual rate. No trace or path is left behind.
Symphony of Grief No. 1 in G# Minor

SCP-9250 is a musical composition, arranged and created by Dr. X. Flip, current Director of Site-109. The piece itself is orchestral in nature, and has been performed several separate times to great emotional effect in each of its subjects.

The music itself incudes grief-like symptoms in those who are exposed to it, taking the subject through each of the five known stages as the song journeys through its movements. Subjects are known to undergo erratic and swift mood swings, as well as experience an emotional connection to the music that causes them to vehemently protect the orchestra from anyone who threatens them as they continue to play the piece.

Effects are only witnessed in those who hear the song directly, in person, with a full orchestra.

SCP-9251 is a flooded emergency stairwell connecting Sublevel B12 of Area-79 to the upper levels of the facility. The stairwell extends approximately 52 meters, with water currently covering the lower portion to a depth of approximately 70 to 90 cm above the surface of the stairs. Despite the continued presence of water, its level remains consistent.

Attempts to drain SCP-9251 have had no lasting effect, with the water returning to its previous level shortly after removal. Outside of this unusual property, the water itself is believed to be benign and non-anomalous. The source of the flooding and the mechanism responsible for maintaining its level remain unknown.

DESCRIPTION: SCP-9252 was a localised, ontokinetic incident occurring at the Former National Stadium of Singapore, during the National School Championships on 11/07/2006. Despite the significant ontokinetic shifts observed, no casualties were identified, and there were no discernible lasting changes in reality after the incident.

SCP-9252-1 refers to Soh Ryan, an eighteen-years-old Chinese-Caucasian male with a height of 1.79m and an weight of 63kg at the time of SCP-9252. At the time, SCP-9252-1 was a participant in the A-Division 100m Sprint, seeded fourth. SCP-9252-1 is a latent reality bender operating at a typical Hume reading of 90/120.
I'm sorry I can't remember who we were… My love

SCP-9253 is a state of psychosis and amnesia that is incurable. There is no apparent natural cause to this state. It is characterised by heightened pressure, which is believed to be causing the psychosis. At the time of writing, one individual is known to be affected by SCP-9253, designated SCP-9253-1. SCP-9253-1 believes it is a knight in medieval times, with no familiarity with modern inventions. The personality appears to be based on modern interpretations of the time period. SCP-9253-1's previous memories are recontextualised to fit the delusions, based on the book "The King's Knight", a lost work of fiction dating back to the 13th century written by an unknown author. The end of the story is unknown.

Thank you to all my critters and vibe checkers, as always: Mr Panik vilsolad ThanTheDemoness QQuickSilver2 Madadad SierraBlade220 ViciousSpirit OnlineOpossum Dr F Otter P4TR1CK07 Fermentating Miss Lovecraft LeraviTheXatu Epirus

SCP-9255 is a space within Site-17 that does not exist, accessible via an antimemetic unlocked door on level 9, corridor 3-F. It admits only one individual at a time, becoming sealed from the outside while it is occupied. SCP-9255's interior dimensions and structure are variable, changing for each occupant. In the event that an individual enters SCP-9255, the previous occupant will forget what they experienced while inside the anomaly.

SCP-9256 is an anomalous computer virus which spreads through electronic mail and advertisements on Internet message boards. These messages will typically use the phrases "Cumputer Playmate" or "More than just a dial up <3!" in reference to SCP-9256. These messages appear to be generated by the virus.

SCP-9257 was a plate of nachos ordered from ████████ Bar and Grill on 2024-09-30. Investigations of ████████ and its employees have failed to provide any insight.

SCP-9257, along with two non-anomalous plates of nachos, were ordered as appetizers for the Site-99 Site Reliability Engineering team's end-of-quarter celebration. About 20 minutes after SCP-9257 was consumed, three of the four personnel who shared it realized that they had abruptly become homosexual. The subjects who ate SCP-9257 are as follows:
• J. Stedje — Male, 45, formerly heterosexual. Following the incident, Stedje separated from his wife of 13 years; at time of writing, they are in the process of divorcing. Counseling services have been provided.

SCP-9259 is a phenomenon regarding every known Scientologist-affiliated building. If an individual enters the building without express permission from members of the Church, the building's layout will shift in an attempt to keep them from entering the central room. These attempts are largely nonviolent on the first activation of SCP-9259. MTF Xunu-1 has noted increased levels of aggression as activations of SCP-9259 continue.

Entering the central room of the building will always lead to the discovery of Scientology advice manuals and handbooks, recruitment materials targeting celebrities, and occasionally, exposes regarding actions of the church.

SCP-9260 is the spontaneous imprinting on toilet paper rolls with the image of patent US390084A (fig. 1). The image is present in every sheet of each roll affected (collectively designated SCP-9260-1).

On 25/09/2025 janitorial staff at Site-55 reported instances of SCP-9260-1 in █ bathrooms. Personnel who utilized SCP-9260-1 for bodily hygiene reported having experienced "the feeling of doing something wrong". Object analysis has not shown any other anomalous behavior.

Junior Researchers accompanying janitorial staff in their duties inside the affected facilities reported that hanging toilet paper rolls contrary to US390084A (fig. 1) causes SCP-9260-1 to manifest, while acting in accordance does not.
SCP-9262 refers to a computer system, textual input device, storage media, and files on the storage media, referred to with the designations 9262-A through 9262-D for the remainder of this file.

There was a small planet; It had been in isolation for millions of years, and yet its civilization bloomed. Despite their isolation, they fundamentally differed from earth; they’d achieved a degree of world peace.

SCP-9264 designates an anomalous phenomenon affecting Earth’s rotational cycle, whose activity is judged based on the diurnal cycle observed around Mount Chimborazo’s equatorial region.While the Chimborazo area experiences daylight, the planet’s overall rotational velocity decreases at a consistent, regular rate. Conversely, rotational speed rises uniformly during nighttime hours within the same region.

SCP-9264-1 is a single Syrian hamster (Mesocricetus auratus) residing within the Earth’s core. The entity sustains its existence underground via anomalous properties: extreme somatic regeneration, complete immunity to senescence, and a total absence of metabolic processes.

SCP-9265 is a children’s book titled “What’s a poem?”, the cover of which is included above. The effects of this anomaly are not what dreams are made of. The object possesses a cognitohazard that forces subjects who have read the book to speak in rhyme. Testing is ongoing to determine for how much time. This effect also occurs with those trying to write or talk about the book. This happens regardless of whether the subject has opened the object and taken a look. Subjects unable to find a rhyming couplet will be rendered mute. This effect also occurs with writing, it’s absolute. The effect does not demand a perfect rhyme to complete a pair. This gives some leeway if an individual is struggling there.
Heart to Heart with a Wilting Flower

SCP-9266 is Julia Quartz, an anomalous human female, age 30 at the time of containment. SCP-9266 has leafless, dark-green, vine-like growths on its body, from here on out referred to as SCP-9266-1. SCP-9266-1 and its flowers do not correspond to any known plant, anomalous or otherwise. How these came to grown on SCP-9266 is currently unknown.

SCP-9266 does not eat more than a baseline human but does consume more water. SCP-9266-1 instances undergo photosynthesis and produce small amounts of oxygen that are supplied directly to SCP-9266's bloodstream, suggesting a symbiotic relationship.
SCP-9267 is a fatal neurodegenerative memetic disease that is transmitted through social media platforms. Instances of those affected by SCP-9267 are designated SCP-9267-1.
SCP-9268 is consistently described by individuals affected by SCP-9268 as the skull of an Odocoileus virginianus.

Dietary maintenance requires the automated delivery of one live, unanesthetized feral feline every forty-eight hours via a remote drop-chute. To prevent violent behavioral triggers, all medical sedatives, tranquilizers, and hypodermic needles are strictly prohibited within the containment area. In the event of a required transfer or physical restraint, personnel must utilize non-medical methods such as flashbangs, high-frequency sound waves, or specialized net traps.

During its biological estrus cycles, all non-automated interactions are strictly forbidden. Researchers and containment staff must avoid all types of observations into the cell, and refrain from using the intercom system due to SCP-9269’s heightened hyper-aggression.

SCP-9270 is an eigenweapon developed by the Foundation, measuring approximately 2.4m x 1.8m x 1.6m, composed of interlocking metallic components, analog input interfaces, and organic material interlaced throughout its internal chassis. SCP-9270 is continuously operational, despite the lack of a power source.

SCP-9270 is capable of erasing individuals from consensus reality. Targets are removed from physical reality, with memories and records manipulated to omit them. This process is not instantaneous nor complete in its erasure, with activation ending after 72 hours.

SCP-9270 operates by locking onto an individual's Noospheric signature.
The Same Place in a Worse World

SCP-9271 is Alicia Rivers, a completely nonanomalous individual whose release is urgently scheduled. 06:07 18/07/23.. These abilities allow it access to absolutely nothing out of the ordinary. 06:12 18/07/23.. This includes the minds of individuals who learn information about it. Furthermore, she is totally mundane in every aspect and needs to be let out of her cell. 06:14 18/07/23., which presents a serious threat to containment efforts. Both of these abilities are narrowly limited to direct references, and second-order effects do not occur. Though duplication and crosschecking of files provides some security, it must be noted that these alterations cannot be corrected except with SCP-9271’s cooperation.

Found in Colorado Springs post office in 1995, later requisitioned as ALBION DEFILADE. Entryway does not maintain stable configuration; initial discovery noted cordite residues and two spent.45 ACP shells in the area, alongside a carelessly folded postal worker's uniform. The threshold has taken forms including (but not limited to) a trapdoor, a chimney, a garden path, an airport terminal, and a dentist’s chair.

SCP-9272 is the space compressed beyond the aforementioned passageway. Its contents are inadvisable to describe, but it is known to have a volume of no less than eight cubic parsecs. The nature of the space is generally benign, so long as the entering personnel do not panic.

SCP-9273 is the collective designation for a series of anomalous phenomena associated with Little Mittens, New Hampshire, and its surrounding area. Although the town was incorporated in 1911 and appears on historical maps and surviving physical records, references to Little Mittens began disappearing from modern cartographic databases during the late 1980s. Contemporary GPS and navigation systems generally fail to recognize the town, returning responses equivalent to “LOCATION NOT FOUND” or immediately rerouting users away from the area. Satellite imagery and commercial mapping services similarly fail to consistently depict the settlement.

SCP-9274 is not to be used outside of testing; other use will result in extreme punitive measures, potentially extending to complete demotion and amnesticisation. Testing with SCP-9274 must occur exclusively in remote outdoor locations, so as to avoid obstruction of other projects. Additionally, testing with SCP-9274 requires the approval of the Site Director, plus a minimum of 2 Senior Researchers, through which the approval form may be submitted to the Director. In the case that non-Euclidean formations obstruct site proceedings and/or there are no longer feasible, valid locations for testing, a Zenith-class SRA may be requested.

SCP-9275 is a set of anomalous events occurring within the Philippines. Such phenomena occur at varying times and locations, but the following information has been consistent with each occurrence:

- The event occurs in an open area frequently passed by a high density of people. - The event occurs when 10 or more stationary individuals are within the same area. - The event occurs between 9:00 and 17:00.

SCP-9275 causes the sudden manifestation of an SCP-9275-1 instance in the area. The source of these objects is unknown, and witness testimonies show no knowledge of where they originated from.

SCP-9275-1 appear to be human corpses.
Mr. Fish, From Little Misters ® by Dr. Wondertainment

Item 9276 is a male humanoid, with 1.76 m of height and 64 kg of weight. Item 9276 presents no biological anomalies, with the exception of its head, which is that of a bluestreak cleaner wrasse (Labroides dimidiatus). The words "Mr. Fish, from Little Misters ® by Dr. Wondertainment" are tattooed on the sole of the Item's right foot. When recovered, Item 9276 was wearing a orange dress shirt and trousers, a blue fishing vest and a marine fedora, with 'Doctor's Orders' sewn into all garment tags.

SCP-9277 is a 74-year old human female named Esther Gallagher, capable of passive reality bending.

SCP-9277's reality bending is dependent on others' perception of the anomaly. If consensus among others regarding SCP-9277 is that a certain fact regarding it is true, SCP-9277's characteristics will shift to match this consensus, even if it was originally inaccurate. This affects elements of SCP-9277's physical and psychological states, such as personality, memory, and health. In rare circumstances, its ontological state is affected.

SCP-9277 was initially recovered on July 12th, 2025, from Conifer Valley Homes, a nursing home in Rochester, New York.

SCP-9278 is the current entity responsible for transportation of souls between the physical world and the afterlife. It manifests as a human female of European descent, appearing to be 8-10 years of age. It is always seen wearing a caped black cloak and carrying a scythe. Despite said items being significantly oversized for SCP-9278's height, they do not seem to cause the anomaly any physical discomfort.

Upon a given organism's expiration, SCP-9278 will manifest and separate the specimen’s soul from its biological remains, demanifesting shortly after. The anomaly exhibits a degree of counterchronological properties, allowing it to stay present for a period of up to 10 minutes, while simultaneously manifesting in other locations worldwide.

SCP-9280 is an underground gladiatorial arena located near Krasnoyarsk, Siberia, three miles north of Site-191. Foundation archeologists have concluded that the arena was built in approximately 320 BCE while the territory was controlled by the Daevite Empire.

SCP-9280 is believed to have been in active use from the time of its completion up until the conquest of the area by the Adytite Empire around 20 BCE. When and how SCP-9280 acquired its anomalous properties is unknown.

SCP-9280’s main arena is a small, circular stone floor with a diameter of ten meters. This pit is surrounded by tiered seating whose capacity is estimated to be around 1250 people.

Since before SCP-9280’s discovery, the entirety of this seating has been occupied by SCP-9280-1.

SCP-9281 is a humanoid entity with a limited shapeshifting ability. The entity has the ability to mimic others, including both mental and physical attributes. SCP-9281 does not produce a perfect copy of the original subject and differences will occur in both physical appearance and behaviour.

Minor differences displayed by SCP-9281 will be focused around areas of the body the copied subject felt insecure about, countering the reason for the insecurity. SCP-9281’s copy of knowledge and memory surpasses that of the original, causing it to display higher levels of ability in various areas when compared to the original individual.

Indications of minor memetic effects have been observed in those who encounter SCP-9281.

SCP-9282 refers to a large box of adhesive fabric bandages. Upon discovery, the box contained 72 out of 110 listed items. Due to testing, only 66 currently remain. If placed upon an open wound, SCP-9282 instances will act as a non-anomalous standard bandage. SCP-9282’s anomalous properties manifest upon placing an instance on a disfigured or amputated limb, or an approximate location of a removed or altered organ.

Testing has revealed that SCP-9282 is capable of fully regenerating limbs or organs that have been amputated or disfigured. While SCP-9282 does not appear capable of fixing neurological damage, it can completely eradicate an illness or disease if it is the root cause of an amputation or disfigurement.

SCP-9284 is a windows laptop that only has file explorer installed. Upon opening file explorer, the user will find just one folder labeled "defective file storage" that automatically adds files seemingly without anyone accessing it. There is no way to predict when a new file will be added as there are no observed patterns in how long it takes to make a new one. Inside the folder is a collection of Microsoft Word documents containing only one sentence, the collective designation for these files is SCP-9284-1 with each individual file being classified as SCP-9284-1-1a, SCP-9284-1-1b etc. Each sentence details special "conditions" that anyone writing the file must follow if they wish to mention the file in spoken or written terms.

SCP-9285 is a pair of objects, designated SCP-9285-1 and SCP-9285-2 respectively. SCP-9285-1 is an old Steinway & Sons grand piano, presumed to have been built in the mid 1930s. Despite how old the piano is, no visible wear is found on the piano, internally or externally. SCP-9285-1, when played, will sound perfect to those listening, and has never needed retuned. People who have heard SCP-9285-1 played have described it as "the most beautiful, soulful piano you'll ever hear." SCP-9285-2 is a generic sheet music manuscript. Within the sheets of SCP-9285-2 are different piano melodies, varying in difficulty. These melodies contain different objects, entities, and people that have been annexed into the manuscript.

Large, sapient organism of indeterminate origin, discovered in March 1986 on a family-owned pastoral farm near Dodge City, Kansas, United States.

SCP-9286 bears significant morphological resemblance to organisms of the class Reptilia. Its integument possesses a gelatinous consistency and is composed primarily of jaundiced scales interspersed with patches of dark brown and black scales that are visually reminiscent of necrotic tissue. SCP-9286 possesses four rounded eyes protected by a layer of hardened translucent keratin. One eye is located on the anterior portion of the face, one on each lateral side of the head, and one on the posterior region of the neck.

Treatment: Inform patient that their hallucinations and abnormal sense of tranquility are nothing to be worried about, and are in fact, part of the healing process due to an anomaly used to treat them.

SCP-9288 refers to the second door from the right on the first floor corridor of the Holloway Estate at 51██ █████████ Drive in Houston Texas, as well as the space behind it and the connected subrealities (SCP-9288-1 and -2 respectively).

SCP-9288-1 is a 1.9x1.08 meter door composed of pine wood that serves as the entrance to SCP-9288-2 but remains impervious to all attempts to damage it. Any attempt to access SCP-9288-2 without passing through SCP-9288-1 will instead result in accessing the first floor office. Its temperature consistently remains at 24,5°C. The door cannot be seen in the original house schematics. Behind the door is a series of tunnels that branch off and to SCP-9288-2 instances.

SCP-9289 instances are stuffed toys that represent members of the Pusa caspica (Caspian seals) species. Instances measure 16 cm in length, 32 cm in height, and 16 cm in width. Each instance is mainly made of quilting cotton, with higher quality materials used for small details.

Each instance was manufactured by a company known as Squib in the early 90s. They were advertised to teach children how to properly care for others and understand discipline in parenting. Like other stuffed toys at the time, each would include a small tag and accessory. The tag would include the name of each instance, and the accessories would range from pins to small headwear.
remove from internet tool by dado

SCP-9290 is a 93.72 KB executable file titled "dadotool.exe". When opened, SCP-9290 will create a 900x450 window titled "remove from internet tool by dado", featuring a background of colourful stars and text reading "remove form internet tool by dado 1.03" The window contains text boxes for an IP address and Port and a button reading "remove from internet".

When a valid IP address and Port are entered into the text boxes and the button is pressed, the target device will be destroyed in a direct meteorite collision in the following 15 seconds. Meteorites affected by SCP-9290 will take the path of least resistance to the target device, and typically only damage objects obstructing said path and in the immediate area of collision.
Your Very Own Badge of Bravery

SCP-9291 describes a small, cardboard box of bandages. Although there is no notable branding on the exterior, the phrase "Bravery Badges" can be seen on the front of the box. When applied directly to the skin, SCP-9291 has been noted to induce a calming and positive mindset on the wearer.

SCP-9291-1 is Elliot Weaver, an eight-year-old boy currently receiving treatment for Metastatic Extraosseous Ewing's Sarcoma. It is currently theorized that SCP-9291-1's state of mind affects the properties of SCP-9291.

SCP-9291 was discovered shortly after SCP-9291-1's admittance to Massachusetts General's pediatric floor for complications pertaining to his diagnosis.

SCP-9292 is the small agricultural village of Innset, Norway. SCP-9292 lies on the south bank of the Faxälven river in Finnmark, consists of 36 significant man-made structures, and as of 2022 it had a population of 17 individuals. SCP-9292 includes 8 domiciles, a small grocery store, a chapel, a graveyard, and a civic center.

Every single human-made object thus far examined in SCP-9292 is anomalous in nature, as are most naturally occurring objects (wildlife, plantlife, rocks, etc). Objects in SCP-9292 have shown a wide variety of anomalous properties, both hazardous and benign.

SCP-9293 is a 100-meter reinforced concrete cube partially embedded in the ground in Homewood, Birmingham, Alabama. SCP-9293 manifested suddenly on September 2, 2025, at 06:00. Prior to this, the location of SCP-9293 was occupied by 9 full and 3 partial single-family households on Maple Street and Roseland Drive.

While SCP-9293 is stable, its concrete is of low, flaky quality, and its rebar is in a severe state of rust. As such, it can easily be penetrated, but care must be taken not to disturb its structural integrity. A collapse of SCP-9293 would cause unpredictable damage to neighboring buildings.

SCP-9294 is an anomalous species with potent cognitohazardous properties. SCP-9294 instances resemble large, bipedal insects. They typically stand 2.0-2.5 meters upright and weigh 60-80 kilograms. Instances are fairly sensitive to light and usually nocturnal. They are omnivorous, with a dietary profile very similar to humans, albeit with lower tolerance for certain compounds. A scientific consensus has not been reached on the intelligence of SCP-9294: some argue instances are sapient and approximately equivalent to humans in cognitive abilities, while others claim their apparent intelligence is simply a product of their cognitohazardous effects.

SCP-9295 is a poorly-defined K-Class scenario involving the forced collision of all physical matter on the planet, including the planet itself. All atoms will travel at the speed of light towards the next nearest atom, creating untold destruction due to the resulting nearly-infinite collisions.

SCP-9295 was discovered by Field Agent Daman Kalsi via hereditary foresight, following the death of PoI-1973. It was suggested by Kalsi that his physical proximity to the demise of PoI-1973 "supercharged" his future-telling capabilities. As such, this information could not be verified by other members of PoI-1973's family, nor by independently-contacted seers.

SCP-9296 is an anomaly composed of two portions.

SCP-9296-A are various comments that have appeared within the SCP Foundation database. These pertain to various standards, language changes, and similar 'fixes' that attempt to 'professionalise' the existing SCP document.

SCP-9296-B is a contact named gro.tenpics|dnf.pcs.crg#gro.tenpics|dnf.pcs.crg, who claims to be from the department called the Department of Governisation, Regularisation, and Commensualisation. This department has never existed within the history of the Foundation in this timeline and/or kalpa. Due to their knowledge of Foundation structure, their minimum Object Class is Keter.
SCP-9298 refers to a carnivorous and extremely hostile lifeform with reptilian, mammalian, and insectoid characteristics.

SCP-9299 is the Black Covenant's annual Salem Witch Time Trial, a Halloween-night aerial race in Salem, Massachusetts, involving 25 self-identified witches. Participants employ permitted personal flight methods, including Transfiguration (Chiropteran/Felid forms), Mana-assisted locomotion, short-range displacement ("Transporelarus") and standard broom use.

SCP-9299 attains broad public attention each October, with global audiences viewing the event and associated promotional materials. Direct viewing is ticketed in-person within Salem; broadcast coverage is distributed by the Black Covenant to mainstream outlets throughout the month. SCP-9299 is then returned to the veil of secrecy for the rest of the calendar year.

From the first FTL probes, Humanity has unknowingly imitated and stumbled forward in another’s shadow. Where an advanced alien civilization has traversed before, Humanity’s first steps are never truly the first. Each step outward — from ships that pierced the void to colonies beyond Earth’s cradle — was following in the footsteps of a species we barely understood.

This is where the danger lies. Not in the discovery itself, but in the blindness that follows it. We see the works of others, we marvel at their achievements, and we are compelled to follow — never asking, "Was their end inevitable?"

And if it was… is ours?

— Dr. Hanson, Head of the Department of Exoarchaeology

SCP-9301 is an annelid organism with an appearance reminiscent of polychaetes. Its body has a diameter of approximately 8 cm and a length of 28 m. SCP-9301 possesses an iridescent exoskeleton that shines when exposed to light.

Similar to certain non-anomalous species of polychaete, SCP-9301 possesses two large mandibles at the front of its head that it uses to hunt for prey. It is capable of rapidly snapping these mandibles shut at a speed that vastly dwarfs those of non-anomalous species. The force generated by SCP-9301’s mandibles is strong enough to generate a shockwave through the water that allows it to cleave through prey from a distance.
You Won't Get Away With This

SCP-9302 refers to the active vampire population of Eschar, Tennessee.

There is no evidence of any Eschar resident, human or otherwise, regarding SCP-9302 as unusual prior to Foundation involvement within the town. It is not known when Eschar developed a substantial vampire population, as town residents have been reluctant to share information.

SCP-9303 is a 1.83 m tall, thin humanoid with a large aluminium ventilation cover replacing the face. This cover filters the air that SCP-9303 breathes for dust and debris, which it relies on as its primary food source. While unhidden, SCP-9303 has a grey skin tone.

SCP-9303 hides itself inside ventilation shafts by removing and replacing ventilation covers with its own head, using an adhesive layer on its skin to scale walls and being able to blend its skin colour with the environment. Once SCP-9303 finishes feeding, it places the previous cover back and it maneuvers to a more secluded area to emit red bioluminescence from spots on its skin. This allows methane buildup to escape, which is a form of waste disposal.

SCP-9305 is an unknown parasitic entity that affects South-African taxi drivers. Drivers (hereby referred to as SCP-9305-1), once affected by SCP-9305, will experience a growing state of euphoria, which culminates in the failure to adhere to most traffic laws. SCP-9305-1 instances lose the capability to form memories while affected by SCP-9305, resulting in drivers not remembering what occurred between the beginning and end of their shift.

The moment the cab has been deemed inoperable or once their shift is over, SCP-9305-1 instances will return to their original state. Instances will lose all effects of SCP-9305 once they have not driven a taxi for a month. The effects of SCP-9305 will reoccur when they operate any taxi.

SCP-9306 is Public Site-28, a large-scale Foundation facility occupying a significant portion of Manhattan Island within New York City. Both the site and the Foundation's existence are well-known, and are integral to the history of the area, as it is the largest employer in the city with 1.1 million personnel.
