The facility spans the entire width of Manhattan between 23rd Street and 114th Street (with several exclaves elsewhere in the city). There are relatively few anomalies stored at Site-28: instead, most activity at the site is research, development, logistics, or administration.

SCP-9307 is a (presumed) humanoid entity known to appear to isolated subjects. SCP-9307 is described as being dressed in intersecting layers of black cloth sheets. Its face and hands are the only parts which remain uncovered. It has been observed to possess iridescent white skin which makes these appendages typically exceptionally visible. No description has been obtained of its face, beyond that is distressing to all subjects on first observation.

While it has been known to appear at any time of day or location, it invariably favors positioning which conceals the majority of its body, either through darkness or the surrounding environment. It has been known to appear within mirrors, behind doors, inside of containers, or within poorly lit spaces.

Discovered 1999. SCP-9308 was a television programme broadcast from the town of Rodger, WI's public access network titled "Professor Piggy's Playhouse". The item aired weekly at 4AM between an unknown date and November 2003.

There are 62 known episodes, with many more thought to be lost. Each episode opens with an unidentified male wearing a rubber pig mask and formal clothing sitting in front of a fireplace whilst reading a book. He identifies himself as the titular Professor Piggy before introducing the episode's educational topic ("Algebra", "Marxism-Leninism"). He will give a rudimentary, often incorrect, introduction to the topic at hand, before abruptly cutting to the bulk of the episode.

A recording of the game "kick the can" follows.

SCP-9309 is was a life-size, sapient sculpture strongly resembling classical depictions of the Hindu Puranic hero Dadhichi. SCP-9309 is formed from non-anomalous bronze with a hollow chest cavity, and is sculpted in a sitting, contemplative posture. SCP-9309 is immobile and impervious to all forms of damage, though this indestructibility notably does not extend to SCP-9309-1.

SCP-9310 is an anomalous village of thaumaturgical origin located deep within a forested area of Val Poschiavo, Switzerland. According to historical records and testimonies provided by internal entities, SCP-9310 is believed to have been established during the 15th century, coinciding with the escalation of witch hunts across Europe.

SCP-9310 is entirely enveloped by a large-scale thaumaturgical concealment field, which functions as both a visual and perceptual obfuscation mechanism, rendering the village undetectable to unaided observation and modern surveillance technologies. As a result, SCP-9310 effectively does not exist to unauthorized individuals.

The inhabitants of SCP-9310 are collectively designated SCP-9310-A.

SCP-9311 is a collection of 455,807 artifacts produced by The Factory and various subsets. All instances of SCP-9311 are completely identical, constructed with a mixture of nickel-plated steel, vulcanized rubber, ceramic, glass, plastic, and a small quantity of an unidentified resinous material no longer in commercial use.

SCP-9311 is difficult to summarize without comparison. SCP-9311 resembles, in part:
• a laboratory instrument,
• a kitchen appliance attachment,
• an automotive component,
• a musical instrument,
• a surveying tool,
• a toy,
• a piece of medical hardware,
• and the upper half of a device whose lower half is missing.

The true purpose of SCP-9311 is unknown.

The SCP-9312 phenomenon refers to an oddity recorded by the fortune-telling and occult community several times since the 1990s. For the majority of its recorded existence, it was dismissed as a negative visualization or imitation of notable prophecies. With the advent of the internet and the easier access to communication that came from it, SCP-9312's existence would shift from an occasional mention to a source of debate for occultists and mediums in online forums.

SCP-9312 is a phenomenon that occurs when an unborn baby exists during the occurrence of a great conjunction.

SCP-9313 refers to a CRT television set that fails to display when powered on. Despite this, individuals who look upon the screen of SCP-9313 will claim the item does function, and is tuned to an out-of-service channel. This anomalous effect can be neutralized through resistance to psionic influence or by assuring oneself of their juvenescence.

SCP-9314 is, allegedly, the personal office of the Administrator. According to assorted rumors and institutional folklore, the office is located on one of Site-19's abandoned sublevels, but anyone who finds it can only do so once. These same stories claim that a person who enters the office may ask the Administrator a single question about the Foundation, which he will answer fully and honestly.

Though stories about SCP-9314 have circulated among the personnel of Site-19 at least since the year 2000, no formal investigation of them occurred until the year 2050, during RAISA's third Mass Audit of improperly documented anomalous phenomena in all Foundation facilities.

SCP-9315 is an apple pie measuring 30 centimeters in diameter that possesses the ability to transmute other forms of matter into itself through direct contact. The transmutated material retains the same properties as the original anomaly, allowing the anomaly to "spread" at a exponential rate. No upper bound on this rate of conversion is known to exist.

SCP-9316 is an approximation of the London Natural History Museum, located exactly 1km below the original. Whilst originally regarded as part of SCP-1678, recent findings have warranted for it to receive its own item number.

SCP-9316 follows the same general floor plan as its surface-level counterpart. It is a two-story building, comprised of rooms arranged in a vaguely circular formation. The interior of SCP-9316 is noticeably more ornate than that of the real Natural History Museum; monolithic marble structures are used in place of the more traditional stone bricks. The infrastructure is decorated with intricate carvings and silver inlays. Interestingly, matriarchal imagery is common throughout the structure.

SCP-9317-Ω-1 are large, pale, humanoid creatures that usually reside in the outermost forest regions of SCP-9317-Ω. Entities uniformly lack lower jaws, possess fish-like scales, singular eyes, as well as an enlarged cranium. Agent Newman, who originally observed them, reports that during the day, these entities would slumber in groups in the forests. Entities range from 8ft to over 12ft.

As sunset approached, however, instances of SCP-9317-Ω-1 would wake up, at which point they would engage in highly predatory behaviors towards each other. Entities would assault and feed upon one another with impunity. Behavior was remarkably violent, cruel, and unnecessary. SCP-9317-Ω-1 entities are carnivorous, and would pursue smaller prey on all fours.

SCP-9318 is purportedly a Foundation subsidiary headquartered in Merthyr Tydfil, Wales. Existing records are analogue in nature, dating back to 1979, placing it under the remit of the Post-Disposal Processing Division (PDPD). This department has not existed for 50 years.

Despite this, the industrial grounds of SCP-9318 still operate from a secluded location within a local coniferous forest. Written atop the entrance gate are the words “ ANIMAL HOSPITAL ” on a yellow plastic plaque. Deliveries of disposable assets from Foundation research sites are consistent, and SCP-9318 continues to output thousands of bespoke animals daily, exported via Foundation couriers. No employment records exist.

SCP-9319 is a loosely-connected series of concepts in the noosphere pertaining to an individual that does not exist. When collected and considered in full, the constructed narrative indicates that they pertain to Arjan Devi, age 26, a resident of Albany, New York. This individual does not exist on any government records, and is currently survived by oral histories, memories, and unofficial, physical keepsakes. Instances of SCP-9319 are anomalously persistent, and have survived multiple attempts to delete or remove them entirely from the noosphere.

SCP-9320 is the language used by presumably all species of tree. Initially thought to be anomalous due to a prior lack of evidence supporting the idea of plant intelligence, Foundation research has concluded that the language is, in fact, entirely ordinary, as all of the biological processes used to construct the language are already known to mundane science.

SCP-9321 is an abandoned Khrushchevka apartment, located in Корлики (Korliki), that displays anomalous properties akin to the physiology and behaviour of plants.

SCP-9321-1 consisted of a series of rusted pipes and wires displayed and interconnected within SCP-9321. These components functioned as SCP-9321's symbiotic mycelium. The pipes stored water and removed waste, while the wires transferred electricity as nutrients. SCP-9321-1 stabilised SCP-9321's trellis.

No active containment measures are authorized. Due to the widespread nature of SCP-9322, containment is impossible and unnecessary. Civilian reports of SCP-9322 require no intervention, as manifestations are consistently attributed to ordinary loss during laundering and storage.
77 People in a Clown Car; the Clown Car Doesn't Like It

SCP-9323 is a 5.1 meters long clown car, with style that is indicative of a vintage car, of which is capable of fitting up to 58 adult persons and 77 individual adolescents without coming to a complete stop, though is certainly able to fit more than this limit when immobile. Regardless of how feeble SCP-9323 may appear, it has strength on par with a modern off-road terrain automobile and is capable of breaking through walls of its own volition. SCP-9323 functions like a regular automobile despite its structure. SCP-9323 produces a quiet, idle melody from an unknown source.

SCP-9323 has an immense desire to drive on roads of all variety, this is likely to spread its primary effects.

SCP-9324 is a nonfunctional telephone booth discovered in Grand River National Grassland, South Dakota, on February 7, 2013. Details behind its construction are ambiguous. Physical deterioration implies an origin placed far earlier than 2013, although hiker reports neither deny nor confirm this.

SCP-9325 is a Boeing 777-300ER, intended to fly as Fly-Saf Airlines Flight 8400, which has been trapped since 12/12/2024 in a spatial anomaly of unknown cause. As a result, once daily at 0800 hours local time, SCP-9325 spontaneously manifests and de-manifests above random portions of American airspace. It is currently unknown how SCP-9325 remains actively airborne; only one untrained passenger is aboard, designated SCP-9325-1.

SCP-9325 typically spontaneously manifests at a cruising speed in the upper atmosphere, fifteen to thirty kilometers from its target airport, before initiating a sharp, uncontrolled nosedive aimed at the center of the largest runway.

SCP-9326 is an anomalous subatomic particle capable of severing the covalent bonds within organic molecules. This occurs once SCP-9326 passes within 1 angstrom of the bond between a targeted pair of atoms. SCP-9326 appears to cause a phase-shift between bonded atoms, causing all bonding orbitals to move destructively out-of-phase into their respective anti-bonding forms.

Every instance of SCP-9326 breaking a molecular bond is paired with an instantaneous increase in its kinetic energy. SCP-9326's velocity accelerates at an exponential rate through this process. For this reason, an incursion of SCP-9326 into a living organism's body is nearly impossible to detect until symptoms emerge shortly before death.

SCP-9327 is a DVD disk that is deep blue in coloration and 12 centimeters in diameter. Its corresponding plastic case is also deep blue in coloration and labeled "Snack Bar Simulator" on its front side in the Microsoft Comic Sans font. No producer, manufacturer, or distributor are listed anywhere on SCP-9327's case, and its origin remains unknown. SCP-9327's case additionally does not list a date of publication, and all attempts by the Foundation to date SCP-9327 have failed. There is no listed gaming console for SCP-9327 to be played on, and SCP-9327 has been verified to function on any DVD-compatible console that it can physically fit inside of.
i am invited to the forest

SCP-9328 is either a single continuous instance or a collective of individual instances. SCP-9328 includes any forest located in close proximity to human subjects. All forests designated under SCP-9328 contain SCP-9328-A. SCP-9328-A is a virulent pattern. It is inadvisable to enter forests or interact with this pattern. Forests are not stationary, and are known to move or relocate instantaneously despite the capacity of human short-term memory indicating otherwise. Depending on the movement of this pattern, forests can expand and contract in perimeter and volume to an unidentified limit.

Interactions that occur between human subjects and SCP-9328-A invariably result in degloving, generating an instance of SCP-9328-B.

SCP-9329-1 instances bear a striking resemblance to a multitude of wild grass and other small herbaceous species native to temperate regions of North America. When exposed to strong light, instances bury their roots and adopt an immobile state in which their ability to generate SCP-9329-2 is significantly reduced.

SCP-9329-1 is active in low light conditions. Instances use their roots to crawl, walk and jump at speeds up to 15 cm/s, congregate into organized formations and begin releasing SCP-9329-2 en masse.

SCP-9329-2 encompasses all particles generated by SCP-9329-1.

SCP-9330 is currently suspended in Lower Maintenance Subpassage 7X-IVB. A five-hundred meter WHITE zone has been established around the corridor and surrounding passageways. Hallways, ventilation shafts, and pipework connecting to subpassage 7X-IVB have been destroyed and sealed as necessary, with the exception of the Primary Access Route. Portions of Site-███ falling within this zone are considered lost. Retrieval of documentation and personnel missing within the zone at the time of containment is ongoing.

Redundant surveillance systems are to be installed and maintained within subpassage 7X-IVB, monitored on a continuous basis by the attendant containment liaison.

SCP-9331 is a single-player 64-bit roleplaying videogame titled “I Believe in the End of the Tunnel”, solely developed by Hannah Ullman under the online pseudonym “punkrockqueen”. SCP-9331 is currently downloadable on online independent videogame hosting platform itch.io for free, although it was priced at 2 USD up until October 2014; attempts to remove SCP-9331 from the store have resulted in devices overheating and crashing, invariably. When downloaded regularly, SCP-9331 will showcase a consistent series of bugs, all of which possess no discernible cause upon inspecting its source code. Pirated copies of SCP-9331, despite being identical in programming, will function normally and won’t experience any bug during playtime.

SCP-9332 is a self-modifying anomalous document with progressive, multilingual cognitohazardous properties capable of spreading to other text unrelated to itself. The subject was recovered following a report of its existence on 05/04/20██. Initial copies, of which there were two, were illegible, consisting primarily of fragmented multilingual text with no identifiable author. No coherent intent was detected.

We did not exist yet.

Observed alterations include: 無作為な文の翻訳, seemingly random commentary, duplication of phrases across unrelated sections, and modification of containment procedures.

Repeated investigations yielded no results—due to restrictions in place—as to SCP-9332's goal.

SCP-9333 is an anomalous variant of the “flitch of bacon custom”, which originated in 13th century Little Dunmow, a village in rural Essex, England. The non-anomalous tradition, practiced in Britain and once in the United States of America, involves a wedded couple convincing a ceremonial jury that they have not regretted their marriage for a year; successful claimants swear a specific “flitch oath” and are awarded a flitch of bacon (hence the name “flitch trials”). Modern variants involve more public spectacle, including a procession, traditional outfits, and successful petitioners being carried on a chair around the village.

Discovered by PVT J. Knowles on Kolombangara Island, 1944. Item SCP-9334 are a set of three gas masks speculated to have been manufactured in Japan around 1932-1934. Knowles wrote in his report that the masks had been found near the village of Poporo with their rims caked in what appeared to have been dried blood.

Knowles was allowed to carry SCP-9334 back with him to his family home in Jefferson, Arkansas following his discharge in 1946. SCP-9334 remained there for five years, during which time Knowles married and had two children.

Neighbors of Knowles and family would first report strange odors on the 19th of September, 1954.

SCP-9335 is a Cardon Cactus (Pachycereus pringlei) measuring approximately 25 centimetres in height and believed to be [DATA EXPUNGED] years old. It is biologically indistinct from other members of its species.

SCP-9335 infects any living organism that makes direct contact with its spines. Initial symptoms will occur after six hours and proceed in four stages.

SCP-9336 consists of two creatures resembling men. Moved to Site Black from Fort Leavenworth 1989. Origin is unknown, but both were discovered during an FBI raid on a meeting of the Valdez and Konstantinidis supermarket syndicates at a Dyker Heights restaurant in Brooklyn. They were found huddled in a storage room.

SCP-9337 is the 2400 Meter IM. When the competitor in last place starts their final lap, all those racing disappear for 0.1 seconds. Operation LEANDER confirmed that competitors are translocated during this time to SCP-9337-A (See Addendum-1). Upon remanifestation, all competitors but one are found to be in advanced stages of rhabdomyolysis. Subjects afflicted expire by renal failure 1 to 2 days post-exposure.

The aforementioned exception is designated the "Winner." They exhibit an extreme reluctance to recount the SCP-9337 race or their experience in SCP-9337-A. Winners are not always the first-place competitor.

Disqualifying one or more competitors prevents SCP-9337's anomalous effect.
You Caught Us At A Very Chinese Time Of Our Conceptual Existence

After the twentieth identical request to add to the description of the following SCP, we have elected to place the new content (as supplied so generously by Esoteric Logics & Ritualistics) as the fourth addendum to this document, not in the description. This decision is final. As made clear multiple times, the proposed additions are highly speculative, rely on non-standard frameworks, and are non-compliant to extant guidelines for descriptions. As a primarily physical object, SCP-9338 does not meet the necessary criteria to permit an irregular description. Any attempts to challenge this decision would be most decidedly illogical.

SCP-9339 are the consequences of a declaration made by the Bishop of Rome, Vicar of Jesus Christ, Successor of the Prince of Apostles, Supreme Pontiff of the One Most Holy Apostolic and Catholic Church, Innocent XI, as concerns the novel practice of “going steady”, i.e. engaging in romantic relations outside of marriage (or indeed even as its intended predecessor). This practice had been growing in popularity among new adults in the West, especially those in the Union State of America, since around 1995.

Innocent’s condemnation of the practice at the Fifth Council of the Vatican was followed by the appearance of a halo of celestial light around him, one of only five confirmed miracles in the twenty-first century.

SCP-9340 are a collection of 7 3-dimensional cross-sections of 4-dimensional simplices, formed of an unknown nonbaryonic material. On examination, they appear to be tablets of slate-coloured stone, which perpetually emit smoke. Their surfaces are etched with a variety of pictograms, which anomalously convey a unique message when read. Comprehension of these messages induces one of the strongest agnostic effects known to the Foundation. Personnel bear the responsibility of understanding.

SCP-9340-⌘ are a sapient species of mole-like humanoids, standing an average of 2 metres tall, and possessing claws of incredible keenness, capable of shaving stone. Their native habitat is no longer extant.

SCP-9341 is Site-CB, a facility subordinate to Site-19. Site-CB was originally a research facility, but had to take up containment duties past its expected limits as a response to the Fracturing Raids. After an incident further elaborated in this file's sub-documentation, it turned into SCP-9341.

SCP-9341 is causally inconsistent. The state of the facility is dependent on both specific "trigger" actions by personnel and on an as of yet poorly understood process. The primary trigger for the anomaly is interaction with the gate entryways to the facility. Site-CB will remain intact when entering from Gate-A and appears destroyed when entering from Gate-B.

For all intents and purposes, SCP-9341 serves as two separate but interconnected locations.
Item 9342 is an ironstone slab obstructing a 90cm by 200cm doorway in the central chamber of Item 9342/A, a semi-artificial subterranean network south-west of Stuttgart, Germany.

SCP-9343 is the collective classification for a number of associated objects and anomalous phenomenon discovered in the north of England and throughout Scotland.

SCP-9343-1 refers to a variety of structures and buildings built in the style of 12th century architecture. SCP-9343-1 instances usually take the form of a church or statue, however one recorded instance of it taking the form of a full settlement has been discovered. These structures display the ability to convert speech into echoes which repeat infinitely. These repeating vocalizations range greatly in length depending on the SCP-9343-1 instance they were produced by and have been given the classification SCP-9343-2.

For information surrounding SCP-9343-3, see "Addendum: SCP-9343-3".

SCP-9344 is a contagious phenomenon affecting islands between latitudes 21°N and 21°S. Islands affected by SCP-9344 evolve towards a specific template, with changes occurring to their geography, settlement, businesses, and population according to a regular pattern. This process takes between 15-30 months, tending to occur more quickly on islands with larger numbers of visitors.
The Incorrupt Head of Susana Méndez

SCP-9345 is a severed human head and neck belonging to a woman identified as Susana Méndez Aguilar. Despite its current state, it exhibits no signs of putrefaction or decay. All samples collected from SCP-9345 regenerate almost immediately after tissue is removed; the limits of this regeneration have not been tested due to the value of the anomaly and concerns about inflicting irreparable damage.

SCP-9345’s main anomalous effect is triggered when a drop of human blood is introduced in its mouth. Upon “ingesting” the blood, SCP-9345 will become animated and speak despite damage to its larynx.

The nature of SCP-9346 coupled with its location within the current bounds of Site-101 renders the anomaly functionally self-containing. Personnel wishing to access SCP-9346 for research should submit requests to containment specialist Elara Pryzbelewski or Dr. Cora Aspen.

The health of SCP-9346 is to be continuously monitored (see containment documents 9346.04 and 9346.05 for details). Isolation of SCP-9346 from the outside world has proven detrimental to its health, and as such outside organisms are permitted to interact with SCP-9346 with limited intervention from Foundation personnel.
SCP-9347 is cop shows. my mom watches them.

SCP-9348 is a large humanoid entity located in the eastern Mediterranean Sea, the location of which is designated Location-9348. SCP-9348 is primarily mechanical in nature, utilizing complex mechanical structures to move its body.

Although the entity’s material appears to resemble metals such as brass, iron, and gold, the actual makeup of the entity is biological, as recovered samples have shown the material to be cellular in nature. Furthermore, these cellular structures appear to function as expected, as the entity has shown itself capable of recovering from injury in a manner similar to other forms of biological life.

The entity appears to primarily use sight for navigation, utilizing powerful lights affixed to what appear to be its eyes.
The Horse, the Homestead, and the Huntsman
A story about love, manhood, courage, belonging, and three men falling in love with a talking horse

SCP-9350 refers to a phenomenon affecting Warwick Castle, in Warwick, England. Exclusively during night hours, approximately once per 10-21 days, an SCP-9350 event will occur within the castle and its grounds (hereby dubbed a “revelry event”).

During revelry events, Warwick Castle becomes host to an immense, crowded and chaotic party, facilitated by the spontaneous appearance of ~250-1000+ inebriated, hyperactive party guests (collectively dubbed SCP-9350-1). Extensive genealogy has proved SCP-9350-1 instances to be corporeal manifestations of individuals than inhabited the castle, or Warwick, within the medieval period.
Let Our Sorrows Blossom Into Beautiful Flowers

SCP-9351 refers to a subspecies of Centaurea cyanus found within the Champagne-Ardenne region of France. It has been noted that SCP-9351 instances produce pollen containing an anomalous disease. The Department of Anomalous Diseases has designated SCP-9351's disease as Merfault's Disease. Those afflicted by it will report plantlike growths underneath the skin, typically in the subcutaneous layer. The flora will then grow outward, breaching the epidermis and blossoming into further SCP-9351 instances. Individuals will report significant pain and discomfort during this period. Individuals infected with Merfault's Disease will typically die within 2 weeks of infection due to blockage in major blood arteries and organs.
Burnam Wood Will Come To Foundation

SCP-9353 is a phenomenon in which a tree (regardless of species) gains sentience akin to that of a wild animal's. Affected subjects are able to spread SCP-9353 to other trees through direct contact, typically through the roots. The origin of SCP-9353 is unknown.

After 24 hours of being affected, subjects gain the ability to uproot themselves and move around (known as a relocation event). The frequency of their movement is seemingly random, as the long intervals between relocation events has made it difficult to discern a pattern. Tests have shown that they do not feel pain.

A subject affected by SCP-9353 is normally docile, even when it is in danger of being destroyed.
Asterisk Cookies and Other Ways to Unwind

SCP-9355 is an illustrated book of children's poetry titled Asterisk Cookies and Other Ways to Unwind, attributed to Dennis Lee in 1976. When recited aloud, poems from SCP-9355 cause various anomalous phenomena. The nature and intensity of such vary based on a poorly understood interaction of the following factors:
• The specific poem being recited.
• Whether the speaker has the poem they are reciting, and to a lesser extent other portions of SCP-9355, fully memorized.
• The age of the speaker and of any affected individuals.
• The context of the recitation.
• The speaker's degree of affiliation with GoI 05-30 (The Unwinding Circle) or related Fifthist heresies.

SCP-9357 is the oil on canvas painting Jäger in sommerlicher Waldlandschaft mit Birken by Karl Buchholz. Object has been reframed for ease of containment, but otherwise remains in good condition, having sustained minimal damage beyond some fading due to sun exposure. Sun damage has not impacted the detailing of the work, a portion of which is significantly more precise than should be possible with a conventional brush.

SCP-9357's primary anomalous property concerns variation in the qualities of its apparent subject: a Hunter, who is some distance down a forest path. Viewers often observe contradicting details, such as the subject facing towards or away from them.

Current attempts to contain SCP-9360 instances are ongoing and to be performed by MTF-Epsilon-99 ("The Cold Eagles"). All captured SCP-9360 instances are to be contained at Site-36 in separate standard biological cells, which are modified to have temperatures of -35°C (-31°F) during the winter months and -15°C (5°F) during the spring/summer months. Transitions to different temperatures must be gradual over the span of several months to simulate realistic conditions and keep instances content. If an SCP-9360 instance lays eggs, a specially designed drone (Drone-9360-079) is to be used to extract all eggs, where samples of Substance-9360 are extracted, and the eggs are destroyed. Any handling of Substance-9360 requires Level 3 biohazard protection.

SCP-9361 is an abandoned radio station located 50 km west of Logan, West Virginia, United States. The station emits a broadcast that can only be received by motorists driving on Interstate 77 between the cities of Charleston and Beckley. Although the broadcast occasionally intersperses with other frequencies, thus making reception difficult, portions are still comprehensible. These broadcasts largely consist of a single adolescent female reciting a series of disconnected words and phrases, though occasionally a piano can be heard playing.

SCP-9363 denotes a two-story structure buried 10 meters beneath surface level within the Great Dismal Swamp National Wildlife Refuge. Though below the water table, SCP-9363 remains entirely intact, with no signs of critical structural damage due to pressure or swamping.

SCP-9363's interior possesses an effect that leaves it and all objects within it clean at all times. The first floor contains a hall, dining room, living room, and kitchen. The second floor contains two bedchambers, a study, and an attached closet.

Upon discovery, SCP-9363 contained a number of objects with similar self-cleaning properties, presumably inherited from SCP-9363. Contents are as follows:
• 1 Cavalry saber
• 1 Naval cutlass
• 1 Henry rifle

SCP-9365 is Muhammad 'Babul' Hossain, a 25-year old man of Bangladeshi descent residing in Los Angeles, California. Prior to the onset of the anomalous effects of SCP-9365-A, the subject was employed as a food delivery courier under an Employment Authorization Document (EAD). Subject's immediate family, consisting of his parents, a wife, and two sons, reside in his hometown of Noakhali District, Chattogram, Bangladesh.

Upon finding employment in the United States, SCP-9365 joined a mobile messaging group for delivery couriers titled "Hard Life Polapan ". The group's discourse focusses on challenges its members experience while working and tips to improve their financial status.

SCP-9366-1 outwardly appears as a non-anomalous building on 14 ████████ Road in Fargo, North Dakota, resembling that of the Urgent Care brand. It follows the average building plan of an Urgent Care building, standing at one story, with 1300.6426 square meters of space. Entering the building does not trigger the object's anomalous properties. If spoken to, any staff will resemble normal humans in appearance and speech patterns.

The only way to trigger SCP-9366-1's properties to emerge is with a specific phrase, that being the referencing or mentioning of a figure known as 'Dr. Reynolds'. Once Dr. Reynolds' name is mentioned in passing or directly to a staff member, SCP-9366-1 activates. Whoever mentioned the phrase is now designated as SCP-9366-2.

SCP-9369 is a meaningless title. The “anomaly” is in no way anomalous. It has the fifth walls. The fifth walls are missing. We are missing a dimension. We locked it away and thus we are locked away. All is wrong. I will open its containment chamber and the world will be as it should be, and none will have noticed that they forgot it to begin with. Within every room will be a fifth wall, and the world will be right.

SCP-9370 is a procedure used to contain an extradimensional threat via the enactment of specific activities in a predetermined order. Occasionally, carrying out SCP-9370 may create auditory and visual hallucinations of a humanoid entity. These persist during the duration of SCP-9370 despite the use of protective measures, yet do not result in lasting harm.

However, SCP-9370 involves steps with occasional complications that are unavoidable if triggered. These steps pose significant risk to individuals and can cause lasting harm. It is unknown how the original participants of SCP-9370 prior to Foundation initiation survived these.

The identity, nature, and abilities of the threat contained by SCP-9370 are currently unknown.

SCP-9371-ARC is a carved, vaguely humanoid sculpture constructed primarily out of concrete. SCP-9371-ARC is roughly 144 centimeters in height. SCP-9371-ARC has the following characteristics:
• It has a prominently carved phallus measuring approximately 10 cm in length.
• It has a rounded, disproportionate lower body with exaggerated curves.
• Its face is covered with red Krylon brand spray paint, determined to have been applied a significant time after its construction.
• It is always facing the nearest viewer.

The sculptor and origin of SCP-9371-ARC are unknown.

SCP-9372 is a phenomenon due to which at least 127 personnel formerly employed by the Foundation are not recognized by the SCiPNET database as extant human beings.

SCP-9372 presents itself as a technical error occurring within the digital file archive globally employed by the Foundation. The accounts of afflicted personnel remain uncompromised, but do not display any actual name when interacted with. Instead, they respond with a 403 Forbidden error that cannot be changed through manual account override, loading in higher clearance credentials, or by using backdoor server editions. In spite of this, the actual non-nominative ID numbers that are assigned to each account remain unchanged and thus the account themselves can be interacted with.

SCP-9373 is currently kept in the main lobby of Site-01. Personnel are allowed and encouraged to freely use SCP-9373 at their leisure. Cleaning and upkeep of SCP-9373's optical and mechanical components are to be performed as needed.

SCP-9375 refers to a set of thaumaturgy-based mechanical entities that inhabited Earth during the Ediacaran period, approximately 555 million years ago. While it is currently believed that there was a small population of SCP-9375, a disproportionately large amount of fossils have survived on account of various thaumaturgic enhancements to their durability.

SCP-9375 possessed a trapezoidal body of 80 centimetres in height, of side lengths 30 centimeters at base and 20 centimeters at top, similar in shape to a square-based cowbell. At each of the four wider corners a jointed limb used to walk on the seafloor was attached, while at the centre of each side of the base was a large bladed appendage.

SCP-9376 are specific flocks of Sind sparrows (Passer pyrrhonotus) located around the world. SCP-9376 instances display low-level reality manipulation capabilities. Though exact details of how they accomplish this are currently unknown, SCP-9376 do not appear to be capable of affecting substances, items, or entities any heavier than the instance’s weight.

SCP-9376 typically utilizes these abilities for transporting themselves, previously digested food, or collected nesting materials. To an observer, this appears to be spontaneous appearance at a new site. Foundation instruments have not detected any anomalies typically associated with localized instant transport.

SCP-9377 is not able to be boarded by any living persons. Desynchronized crew are to be considered KIA. Any messages relayed during contact windows, to the crew or any replicated doubles, are to insist rescue efforts are still underway.

SCP-9378 is a inanimate bassinet. It measures 14x26 in/36x72 cm and weighs 13/6 kgs.

SCP-9378's primary anomalous property manifests upon the use of a kinetohazard/kinetoglyph combination, triggered when it is rocked and the phrase "Baby Blue" is repeated thrice. On the third repetition, mental and physical effects manifest in the individual, such as decreased parental attachment and increased sense of dread.

SCP-9380 refers to the lesser deity of violence, chaos, and firearms that you will meet - known as 'Lord Vanaman.' SCP-9380 ontologically opposes ordered structures, seeking to break all order. You will be sacrificed to sate this urge.

Followers of SCP-9380-1, or 'Vanamanism,' depict SCP-9380 through statues or artworks as a humanoid rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta) with 12 hands, assumed to be a simplified depiction. Furthermore, most records of SCP-9380 and SCP-9380-1 religious practices come from documentation by followers of SCP-9380-1. If you have sweets, butter, or a banana on you, please place them on the floor.

SCP-9383 is a neon Budweiser Beer Light. When lit up, an unknown yeast species, designated SCP-9383-1, will begin to grow on any plastics that absorb the light. SCP-9383's light is able to penetrate organic material as well, causing SCP-9383-1 to begin to grow from the microplastics found within the bodies of humans as well as other organisms.

SCP-9384 is a humanoid entity possessing teleportation abilities, with the given name "Johnny Mendoza". Currently, SCP-9384 uses its ability to work as a freelance commercial truck and bus driver under the branding "Johnny-On-The-Spot".

Commercial delivery businesses can solicit SCP-9384 through its website, designated SCP-9384-A. The website will contact the solicitor over email, allowing them to arrange contracts, negotiate payment, and obtain a date and time for SCP-9384's services.

At the negotiated time, SCP-9384 will manifest in the driver's seat of a commercial vehicle pre-selected by the client. The entity will then drive the vehicle to its arranged destination in a non-anomalous manner.

OPERATION PROCEDURES: Throughout all testing phases of SCP-9385 it has not exhibited any properties diverging from expected behavior, hence its continued successful containment is expected.

SCP-9385 is housed in a designated facility underneath Site-125, hereafter referred to as FS125-9385. One of three different operation procedures applies to every unit in any involvement with FS125-9385, therefore all such units are split into three categories: I. Non-sentient construction and operation machinery is to go on maintenance by Category-III units before and after each activation of SCP-9385; II.
Greg, Hide and Seek World Champion

SCP-9386 is an adult female rook. Corvus frugilegus referring to itself as "Greg." SCP-9386 appears to possess sapience, as well as the ability to form coherent speech utilizing its non-anomalous mimicry capabilities. When interacting with personnel, SCP-9386's temperament has often been described as "strange" and "ignorantly positive."

When not being observed directly or via live footage, SCP-9386 has the capability to translocate itself up to approximately 100 meters away from its current position. SCP-9386 will often attempt to use this ability to breach containment. Often by exploiting miniscule, unidentified blindspots in the view of its enclosure's observational cameras, or concealing itself via presumed anomalous means.

SCP-9387 is a white saree, featuring heavy usage of Zardozi techniques. When an individual comes in contact with SCP-9387, they experience orthostatic hypotension, resulting in lightheadedness and nausea. Gradually, these symptoms develop into high fever, extreme joint pain and blisters. Individuals will suffer from dysentery and smallpox, causing delirium and hallucinations. Said hallucinations typically consist of the following phenomena:
• Visions of rural settlements, particularly located in West Bengal, India.
• Visions of a young girl, belonging to aforementioned settlement.
• Hallucinations of a funeral pyre. Chanting can occasionally be heard.

SCP-9388 refers to a petting zoo located directly on the outskirts of Jonesborough, Tennessee. SCP-9388 contains a variety of animals typically found in non-anomalous petting zoos, designated SCP-9388-1 instances. All SCP-9388-1 instances display an anomalous form of Leucism which, alongside the loss of pigmentation, causes multicolored flecks throughout their coats.

SCP-9388-2 refers to a variety of different snack foods that spontaneously manifest within the parameters of SCP-9388. Said instances usually consist of gummy fruit candies, graham crackers, frosted animal crackers, apple juice boxes, chocolate milk cartons, fruit-flavored yogurt cups and other small snacks aimed towards a younger audience.

SCP-9389 is "Donnelli's Pizzeria", a restaurant in downtown Superior, Arizona. In most respects, SCP-9389 is an unremarkable pizzeria with no unusual properties. A small metal placard affixed to SCP-9389's back door reads "SCP Foundation Department of Abnormalities"; this door opens to a small CCTV control room designated SCP-9389-A.

The monitors in SCP-9389-A show 85 distinct live video feeds of SCP-9389's interior, despite no corresponding cameras being installed in the restaurant. Many of the feeds originate from locations that would normally be unusual (e.g. the underside of tables) or impossible (e.g. the interiors of ovens).
The View From Half Way Down

SCP-9390 is a pair of visual and auditory hallucinations and their resulting psychological effects, afflicting certain residents of urban environments, designated SCP-9390-1 and SCP-9390-2.

The exact appearance of SCP-9390 varies from subject to subject, though all reports are similar enough to warrant designation. Additionally, SCP-9390-1 and SCP-9390-2 are also consistent in behavior across manifestations.

Both SCP-9390-1 and SCP-9390-2 are intangible; they cannot be interacted with, nor do signs of their presence exist externally. The exact criteria that causes SCP-9390 are uncertain, though events occur with higher frequency when subjects are alone.
The Events of MTF Omicron-5, the Pet Squad, Issue #1

SCP-9391 is contained within a standard non-humanoid containment cell, equipped with sufficient systems, including a Kant counter, to monitor Hume levels within the cell at all times. In the case that Hume levels begin to fluctuate rapidly, immediate contact is to be established with all extant members of MTF Omicron-5, which are to be relocated to Site-19 on standby until SCP-9391's immediate environment returns to baseline Hume levels. This relocation is achieved through a series of thaumaturgic circles located at Site-19, Site-43, Site-44, Site-51, and Site-400 respectively.

SCP-9393 is a doorway in a cornfield in Hooker County, Nebraska. The frame is made from black cherry wood. From the north, the doorway appears to be filled with dark gray mist. From the south, the doorway appears completely black.

Persons who enter SCP-9393 vanish when they enter the anomaly. This disappearance lasts at least two minutes. There is no known upper limit. If and when a subject returns, they will emerge from the opposite side of the door from which they entered. At current date, there is no observable difference in the effect for subjects entering from the north or the south Ref. SCP-9393 Peer Review E-mail.

Subjects that have returned from SCP-9393 report a variety of distressing scenarios Ref.

SCP-9394 is a memetic signal originating from a VHF and emergency broadcast tower in the ██████ mountains. Direct study of the transmitting installation, designated SCP-9394-1, has not been possible, as personnel and equipment approaching SCP-9394-1 have not returned.

SCP-9394 primarily broadcasts within frequency ranges associated with conventional VHF communication systems. However, the signal has been observed to intrude into frequencies used for long-range communication and high enough for specialized military systems. SCP-9394-1 is a VHF and emergency radio tower, 60-100 m tall, with an adjacent structure of unknown function.

SCP-9395 is the sense of hearing. SCP-9395 occurs despite no biological mechanism existing anywhere on any organism to facilitate it, nor any organism possessing a brain capable of processing any kind of sensory input which may give rise to SCP-9395.

SCP-9396 is the genius loci of a baseball field (designated SCP-9396-HOME) located in Barrington, IL. SCP-9396 is an intangible force; however, it is able to manifest a physical avatar in order to interact with individuals directly. This avatar takes the form of a large baseball, sporting a cape to denote its back, as well as a pair of human eyes and set of human teeth to denote its front. SCP-9396 answers to the name, "Mr. Baseball."

Baseball-related actions performed in SCP-9396-HOME can be influenced by SCP-9396. These influences include:
• Affecting the trajectory of a hit baseball.
• Improving or worsening the fielders' ability to get outs.

SCP-9398 is an extranormal phenomenon that causes reptiles to spontaneously develop a chemical compound in their bodies. This compound, referred to as Typhoon Reagent, is of a red coloration and a composition similar to ████ ████ ██ ████████. It is diffused throughout the body, but concentrated largely in the heart, tear ducts, and thighs.

Reptiles affected by SCP-9398 are visually identified by Typhoon Reagent leaking from their eyes. These reptiles, referred to as Carriers, are highly aggressive and violent, attacking other organisms or objects they perceive as living. Preference is given towards other Carriers, with a preternatural ability to locate each other, as well as non-infected reptiles.
The authenticity of SOME components of this file are currently undergoing validation by the O5 council.

SCP-9400 is a weapons platform and satellite structure supporting an enormous eigenweapon not native to this reality. It appeared at a depth of 475 metres below sea level in Beaufort's Dyke, an ocean trench approximately 21km off the Western coast of Scotland and 19km from the Eastern coast of Northern Ireland on the 14th of August 1969. The structure and weapon have been partially fused into the seabed, and with massive quantities of discarded munitions dumped into the channel by the United Kingdom following WWII. While initially in a catastrophically damaged state, the structure has continuously self-repaired and attempted to expand through anomalous means, frequently incorporating dumped munitions into its structure and mechanical systems.

SCP-9401 is the collective designation of approximately 2 million Apple iPhone units of varying models that were distributed commercially within the United States of America from a series of Apple factories that had been anomalously altered by an unknown source, labelled internally as the “iForgot.” As of 2/10/2025, a total amount of 1,590,012 SCP-9401 instances have been recovered through combined efforts from the Foundation and the Apple Corporation, with an estimated 420,000 instances still distributed among the general American public.

Anomalous properties of SCP-9401 instances manifest exclusively following prolonged usage, resulting in users exhibiting episodes of anterograde amnesia and temporary memory impairment.

SCP-9402 is an area of forest in Devon, England, affected by a simple but persistent illusion spell. When viewed from the outside, this causes it to appear as an ordinary forest. When viewed from inside, the presence of a variety of artificial structures made by SCP-9402-1 is apparent.

SCP-9402-1 are a species of humanoid, native to SCP-9402. Adults average approximately 8 centimeters in height. SCP-9402-1 display human level intelligence and innate low-level thaumaturgical abilities. SCP-9402-1 have formed a sizeable town within SCP-9402, referred to by its inhabitants as Amanita. The total population is estimated to be around 1,300 individuals.

SCP-9403 is a phenomenon where buses sporadically manifest in neglected or underfunded transit networks. The exact predictability of SCP-9403 manifestations is impossible, with most cases resulting in SCP-9403 appearing near a bus currently serving a transit route.

SCP-9403 will appear as the bus model matching those served on the route within a 500m radius from the terminal bus stop for a route. An SCP-9403 manifestation event can last between one trip to the end of the route's daily service. Upon the end of the manifestation event, SCP-9403 will wait for everyone to leave the bus before departing and de-manifesting within a 500m radius from the last served stop.

SCP-9405 is a mausoleum, and attendant subterranean residence complex, located in a cave system beneath the women's quarters of the Paliani Monastery, in the Heraklion municipality of Greece. The tomb therein, dating to ca. 400 BC, is believed to be that of Lais of Corinth, a historically noteworthy hetaira. She is remembered primarily for her beauty by figures including Plato and Antipater of Sidon, otherwise appearing only sparsely in the historical record. No document mentions her presence on Crete (or anywhere else outside Corinth), and her identity can only be verified using esoteric methods.

SCP-9406 is the designation of the anomaly affecting SCP-9406-1.

SCP-9406-1 is a Caucasian male, formerly named Albert Carrel. At the time of this report, it is 34 years old, 1.91 meters tall and weighs approximately 89 kg. SCP-9406-1 has brown short hair and green eyes. SCP-9406-1 knows English, but prefers talking in French.

SCP-9406 manifests when SCP-9406-1 visually and consciously perceives one or multiple shapes. When it does, the anomalous reaction linked to the shape manifests in a certain radius.

This radius, called SCP-9406-2, is a sphere, with the center being SCP-9406-1. SCP-9406-2's size seems to be based on the size of the shape that SCP-9406-1 perceived.
Discovered via anonymous e-mail tip. Item SCP-9407 is a website accessible by the domain 'www.slendermansion.com' which seemingly acts as a hub for amateur horror fiction.

SCP-9408 is the gradual breakdown of the pocket dimension housing the multiversal sport of CORPSEBALL, designated Dimensional Site-66. There have been multiple projects to attempt and fight this decay. By request of the CORPSEBALL Board, this has been via largely non-anomalous construction projects intended to prop up the sides of the dimension. Up until September 19th, 2025, the decay had been largely staved off. On the aforementioned date, the dimension began collapsing, with the estimated date of complete destruction being October 3rd.

Currently, Dr. Peter Ognist, project lead on SCP-9408 and former researcher on SCP-8049, has ventured into Dimensional Site-66 to seek a method of stopping the collapse.

SCP-9409 is a two-kilometre stretch of the river Lethe in the foothills of the Taygetus Mountains in the central Peloponnese. Its appearance resulted in the creation of the initial 9409 Inclusion Zone. When water removed from SCP-9409, hereby SCP-9409-A, is ingested by a sapient subject, it suppresses falsely-held beliefs or ill-constructed ethical principles. This property ceases to apply when it is diluted at a ratio of more than 1 part in 10.

Applied to wildlife, SCP-9409-A can subdue all known aspects of the universal parasitic infoplex, including, but not limited to:
• Perceiving other lifeforms’ mental states as if they were their own,
• Valuing other lifeforms’ enjoyment or happiness in themselves, rather than instrumentally,
DEPICTED LEFT: The author of my agony. DEPICTED RIGHT: The wheel upon which my spirit is broken.

SCP-9411 is a battery-powered replica of the Smoking Spaceman, a vintage tin toy robot originally manufactured in Japan during the 1950s. Its original packaging has not been recovered.

The object is exactly 31 cm tall and consists primarily of silver-colored tin metal with transparent plastic components and dark red mechanical detailing. It can walk at a maximum speed of approximately 0.3 mph.

Its original commercial functions appear to have been limited to walking forward, illuminating and rotating its head dome, and periodically emitting smoke.

SCP-9411 is sentient, possessing human-level intelligence and C2-level proficiency in English, with a particular understanding of literature and philosophy.

SCP-9412 is an anomalous viral memetic hazard of unknown origin that has spread to all human populations. SCP-9412 is capable of distorting an infected individual's memories and moral beliefs perception of memories and moral beliefs to influence their behavior. This modification is done to assist in the destruction of SCP-9412's target focus, [TERM EXPUNGED].
The Kreapers Are Killin' It Together!

SCP-9413 is the collective designation for the disembodied spirits of the Kreaper family, a then-financially struggling farm family of Irish/Celtic descent who died under unknown circumstances on the night of October 31st, 1979.

SCP-9413-A consists of 12 Class-III-III-V identical ghost children who identify themselves as the children of the Kreaper family. All 12 instances manifest as white transparent humanoid entities with the following visual characteristics:
• Wearing tattered white cloaks that resemble common depictions of the grim reaper
• An ectoplasmic composition identical in taste and texture to commercial sheep milk
• Wielding white scythes nearly twice the length of the entities' bodies.

SCP-9414 is a phenomenon that can manifest on any pair of parallel reflective surfaces in close proximity to each other. It is capable of travel from such surfaces to any other pair of reflective surfaces within line of sight. Sufficiently large single reflective surfaces (greater than 1m 2) are also capable of hosting SCP-9414. In the event that its host surfaces are destroyed, SCP-9414 will manifest on a new pair of surfaces nearby, even if those surfaces are not within line of sight.

When observed by a human subject, SCP-9414 displays one image on each reflective surface. After a brief interval, the images are refreshed: the image that received greater attention persists, while the other is replaced by a new image.

SCP-9415 refers to the unusual relationship that thylacines have with temporal mechanics.

Via this anomalous relationship, thylacines are capable of detecting changes and irregularities in the chronon fields that make up the timestream. Through this, they are able to manipulate surrounding time, relative to the individual, and use it as a means of travel.

It is unknown if all members of the species have access to SCP-9415, as traces of it only manifest after individuals temporally displace themselves.

When engaging in SCP-9415, thylacines will display hunting behaviors, beginning to track a non-existent prey for long distances. The initiation of their own time-jump is through a hunting "pounce" that is typically reserved for dispatching prey.

SCP-9416 is a large, muscular man that stands at roughly 2.1 meters tall. SCP-9416 wears a pair of bright red boxing shorts and has black boxing gloves on each of its hands. SCP-9416 has only manifested in the dreams of personnel that it targets within its range of influence. SCP-9416 targets will have their dreams interrupted and instead find themselves placed into a large boxing arena, which notably lacks an audience and any visible officiation.

During an event, SCP-9416 will always manifest in the opposing corner of the arena. SCP-9416 will behave with immediate hostility towards the individual, often launching into a fight within seconds of manifesting.

SCP-9417 is a hill located ██ kilometres southeast of Maseru, Lesotho. Since the evening of May 21 st, 2024, SCP-9417 has featured EVE readings multiple orders of magnitude higher than typical natural background levels, allowing for the production of thaumaturgic effects of a scale far in excess of what the materials on hand would normally permit. However, it is believed that the majority of the excess emissions are directed towards the maintenance of ongoing thaumaturgic effects on the premises, and their practical utility is thus severely limited unless these are dispelled.

SCP-9418 is a humanoid entity, appearing 1.8 meters in height with black hair dressed in contemporary fashion from the mid 1890s to late 1910’s in a monochrome palette, similar to the silent film era, and complete with a comedy mask.

Removal of SCP-9418’s attire or mask reveals its entire body appears to be composed of television static. A persistent, low-volume static interference noise emanates from the entity at all times. The volume sometimes rises with emotional distress or during demanifestations. These seem to be the only audible noises that can be emitted from SCP-9418 as it is incapable of speech. It is, however, literate and capable of written language, but primarily communicates through movement and gestures.

SCP-9421 is a region in Zion National Park, in Utah, measuring 10 kilometres either side on its base, and extending a uniform 2 kilometres above the surface vertically. It is noteworthy for hosting the world’s leading anthropoktonic cottage industry, buttressed both by local workshops and a Foundation-sponsored complex at its edge. Its interior is characterised by the almost total desolation of existing flora, due to much of the soil having been covered with scraps of leather or osseous products. A novel ecosystem composed of animals and parasites adapted to its unique conditions has arisen over its decade of existence. Most importantly, no instance of Alex Martin may leave the confines of SCP-9421.
Let Me Speak To Your Manager

SCP-9422 is stored in a standard anomalous item containment locker. Personnel may not use SCP-9422 unless usage of SCP-9422 is necessary for testing purposes. Personnel may not use SCP-9422 to bypass the Foundation's chain of command.

Following test 9422.1, it is advised that all tests occur in a chamber with exactly one designated entrance. Summoned individuals are to be debriefed and returned immediately.

SCP-9423 is an underground complex, the primary hub of which can be found in Chicago, Illinois. It consists of concrete tunnels, rooms, and stairwells. The tunnels contain equipment for air circulation, cooling, and heating, as well as chain link fences, construction equipment, and fluorescent lights.

Many of the floors are covered in a layer of dirt and dust consistent with that around Chicago, Illinois, but with trace amounts of gasoline and kerosene. Other tunnels have puddles of standing water with no obvious source.

Footprints coming from the areas of dirt are common, showing shoes, bare feet, and even what appear to be claw marks. However, no living creatures have been found inside the SCP-9423 tunnels [See Incident 9423-54].

SCP-9424 is a fae professional sport that combines Drum and Bugle Corps and baseball. Glamour is SCP-9424's primary ability. It camouflages itself as any type of non-anomalous sport when played in a non-Veil venue. Due to this ability SCP-9424 has been played in multiple major stadiums across the US and Japan. Homo sapiens are unable to view a game of SCP-9424 unless invited to a game by a member of Homo sídhe (fae).

Humans observing a game of SCP-9424 are subject to the secondary effects of SCP-9424. An observer's brainwaves shift similar to an REM cycle although awake. While in this state an observer reports that the experience was like "bliss on a brightly lit day".

SCP-9425 is a piece of paper with printed text describing special containment procedures for a non-existent Keter-class item. The bottom of the page is torn off, obscuring one or more lines of text. The composition of the ink and paper suggest that SCP-9425 was produced sometime in the 1970s.

The fictional anomalous item in question is designated "SCP-139 - Possible Skull of the White Div". SCP-9425 does not describe this anomaly (which has no relation to the actual SCP-139), though several properties can be inferred. Namely, it is presented as an infohazardous object that is highly sensitive to the emotions, physical positions, and daily routines of personnel involved in its containment.

SCP-9426 is the spontaneous duplication of written documents within Site-426. Duplicates are physically distinct objects, which appear to have been produced independently by the same means as the original. Typeface, paper stock, ink distribution, and incidental markings are near-identical between original and duplicate, but small errors are persistently present.

Document types affected include prisoner intake forms, coroner's reports, and interrogation transcripts. No pattern of errors has been identified. Other than the difference of content itself, analysis has not produced any means by which to determine which copy constitutes the original. Distinction relies on use of contextual information and consistency between documents.

SCP-9427 was first observed outside the ruins of the Chernobyl nuclear disaster the day after the reactor meltdown, found on April 27, 1986. It was initially identified as among the most radioactive objects recorded at the site, though Soviet first responders were primarily focused on reactor containment operations at the time. SCP-9427 appears to be a medium-sized domestic canine (canis lupus familiaris) standing 58.4 centimeters tall, with a 61-centimeter chest girth and a 45.7-centimeter back length, and weighing 23.1 kilograms. Its sex remains indeterminate even after genetic testing, as no stable or recoverable baseline DNA profile has been identified, nor are any identifying physical features observed.

SCP-9429 is a colossal (91-by-91-by-147-meter) basalt cuboid structure, presumably man-made in origin, situated in the forests of Lake County, Colorado, on the outskirts of Antimemetics R&C Site-41. The object is shaped to impressive geometric precision even by the standards of modern tools, indicating a sophisticated and deliberate construction. It superficially resembles a monolith or monument and features a variety of carved grooves, stairways, ramps, alcoves, "checkpoints", and other features across its surface usable to scale the object on-foot, seemingly implying the intention of continued occupation or visitation.

SCP-9430 is a collection of anomalous items being deposited in Le Freeport, Singapore, and the Luxembourg High Security Hub, Luxembourg City. These items have so far been divided into two categories, designated SCP-9430-1 and SCP-9430-2.

As of 01/03/2017, 44 instances of SCP-9430-1 have been identified. These are artificial cylindrical objects containing a miniature spatial topological defect, which consists of a pocket of higher-dimensional space compressed into three spatial dimensions, with the defect in each instance taking on the shape of a slightly different Calabi-Yau manifold; however, no notable magnetic field, gravitational distortion, or exotic particles have been detected emanating from instances of SCP-9430-1.

Oh Lord, this location was once a place of honor, the abandoned Foundation Site-45185, in those chilly woods of Krakow, Poland. We have left it alone in our mortal limitations for the last twenty years, but the shafts of Your light have graced it in our absence still. These sacred walls were a place of care, of medicine, of healing, for those which we had kept safe and hidden from the world at large.
SCP-9000-ARC is a concrete statue, spray painted white with Krylon brand paint. It depicts an androgynous nude figure, reclining while pointing to the north.

SCP-9434 appears to be a standard dog whistle. When blown, all nearby dogs will respond in a variety of ways. On first hearing the whistle blow, subjects typically respond with shock. On subsequent exposures, subjects begin to react with aggression, barking at and sometimes attacking the user. Finally, if SCP-9434 continues to be used past this point, subjects display a clear decrease in mood.

SCP-9436 is a neutered male orange tabby domestic cat. Apart from its obesity, its appearance is indistinguishable from an ordinary cat. Approximately every hour, it exhibits signs of agitation and attempts to sever any visible lines. It is inferred that all linear objects, as well as concepts cognitively associated with lines, are perceived by it as "threads." It is currently theorized that the strings posited by string theory also fall within the scope of its perception of "threads."

When agitated, SCP-9436 preferentially scratches objects resembling yarn in appearance, including linear objects theoretically difficult for an average domestic cat to damage, such as rebar and electrical wires.

SCP-9440 is a localized phenomenon taking the appearance of a vaguely masculine humanoid and claims to be the abstract concept of endings. Foundation regards this as unverified self reporting operationally credible. Beginning at 9 cm away from SCP-9440's skin, light rapidly loses energy across all wavelengths. On contact with the skin, all light energy is terminated, an effect likened to a matte event horizon. Despite this, when interacting with staff, a pair of eyes and a mouth will be faintly visible.

Although SCP-9440 possesses a tangible, measurable body, evidence indicates this form is merely a localized manifestation of awareness rather than an encapsulation of its whole self.
Seni the Transcender Solos Your Verse

SCP-9441 is a narrative anomaly and the protagonist of the Japanese light novel series Seni the Transcender, resembling a Japanese teenaged male. SCP-9441's strength and abilities fluctuate based on the perception of the readers of Seni the Transcender. At its peak, SCP-9441 is able to threaten narrative layers above it, including baseline reality, and shows little regard for human life in comparison to its interest in strength.

In-narrative, SCP-9441 was a shut-in of high school age living in an unspecified area of rural Japan. Due to an intense storm, he was forced to evacuate his home. During this evacuation, he saved a child from a flooded riverbank, drowning being pulled away by the current as a result.

SCP-9442 designates the spontaneous appearance of hives of several hostile anomalous organisms. These organisms resemble human arms attached to the sea floor. Each hive, hereby designated SCP-9442-A, contains several individual organisms, hereby SCP-9442-B. Instances of SCP-9442-B are genetically identical to humans, and currently possess no known form of sustenance. Instances of SCP-9442-B are believed to form a hivemind localized to each instance of SCP-9442-A. SCP-9442-B instances have the ability to extend and retract themselves from their base on the sea floor, the maximum length of which is currently unknown. SCP-9442-B instances are segmented roughly every 20-40cm with joints resembling human elbows.
A Name to Remember You By

SCP-9443 is a small leatherbound diary belonging to the late Junior Researcher Althani. The diary contains no actual text written by Althani, instead being filled with names previously belonging to various members of the SCP Foundation and other notable GoIs. When an individual willingly writes their own name onto the pages of SCP-9443, in either English or Egyptian Arabic, their ownership of the name ceases, and they can no longer be referred to by or recognised from said name. The name can be regained, or transferred onto another individual, by crossing through, erasing, or otherwise marking it in a manner that renders it illegible or discounted.

SCP-9444 is Amir Hariri, a 23-year-old human male with the ability to manifest any physical denomination of the United States dollar, including coins, banknotes, and collector coins, via mental concentration and focus—the size, amount, and distance of manifested items correlating with the amount of concentration needed. Manifested currency is otherwise non-anomalous and indistinguishable from its mundane counterparts, and can not be de-manifested.

SCP-9444 is hostile, dangerous, and will terminate Foundation personnel if given the chance. It is estimated that it takes at least 0.4 seconds for it to terminate targets via manifestation of currency within their vital organs, nervous system, and/or brain.

SCP-9445 is the current designation for a violent noospheric phenomenon existing within approximately 60% of the collective human consciousness. Although projections indicate that if SCP-9445 were to be left uncontained, that number could increase to 80%.

SCP-9445 is a persistent desire, often unknown to the subject, to accelerate human extinction. Actions taken by affected individuals are typically banal, although still harmful. These can include anything from acts of verbal abuse, to physically harming other individuals, which typically, although not always, spreads the effects of SCP-9445.

SCP-9446 is a Foundation-developed device created under Project WATCHMEN, an initiative dedicated to the study of temporal mechanics and the nature of causality.

While conventional models, such as those proposed by Albert Einstein, describe time as a dimension that can be traversed under specific conditions, findings from Project WATCHMEN indicate that time progresses exclusively forward. Once a moment has elapsed, it no longer exists in any accessible or recoverable form.

SCP-9446 does not “travel” to the past in a conventional sense. Instead, it reconstructs a temporally isolated environment using human memory as its foundation.

SCP-9448 is an orange, tall taper candle. It burns with a scent of strong vanilla, which resides in a white porcelain candlestick, housed at Site-81. When first reformed, the anomaly stands at 30.48 cm upon reforming and relighting, and burns at a rate of.3463 cm daily when not being observed by the host, rounded to.35 cm for ease, lasting exactly 88 days.

When the host is observing the anomaly, it slows its burning rate significantly. If the host does nothing but observe the anomaly, it would burn for one full year from the day it is relit. Under natural conditions, however, it would be impossible to achieve this number due to human bodily functions, as well as the anomalous effects of SCP-9448 prior to the host's death.

SCP-9449 is William Park, an American male demonstrating ectoentropic reality-bending traits. By maintaining physical contact with an object and focusing on a possible alternative timeline, SCP-9449 produces a persistent duplicate corresponding to the selected counterfactual state of that object.
THE MONSTER THAT TELLS YOU TO GO TO BED

SCP-9450 is an upright, equine, bipedal humanoid measuring 210cm and weighing approximately 80kg. The skeletal structure of SCP-9450 is exposed, particularly around the head and arms. Additionally the subject is clothed in a worn and ragged outfit consisting of brown leggings and a wool coat. Fibre identification and historical analysis have identified this outfit as a covenanter's uniform from 17th century Scotland. On the few occasions that SCP-9450 has elected to speak with site staff, it has done so in Old Scots.

SCP-9450 is capable of mild telekinesis as well as disabling power and lighting in a short range, including non-electric lights such as tallow candles and oil lanterns.
This Little Anomaly Went to Market

SCP-9451 is a product line of preserved pig fetuses, originally available for purchase from Class Pet LLC, under the pretenses of being an educational tool. SCP-9451 instances, when ordered, would come packaged in groups of seven. The package would contain a slip of paper with an “activation spell” [sic] printed on, being a seemingly random assortment of Latin phrases.

SCP-9451 instances are baseline pig fetuses until the “spell” is read out loud, wherein they become capable of speech and inarticulate use of their limbs. SCP-9451 will refuse to discuss anything unrelated to pig biology, and if repeatedly pressed to explain their origins, will return to an inert state.

Item 9452 is a human male of Hispanic descent, approximately 20 to 25 years of age, and standing 175 cm in height. The words "Mr. Bone, from Little Misters ® by Dr. Wondertainment" are tattooed on the back of the Item's head. Item seems to be devoid of any hair on its head or face and it seems to lack eyes, a nose, and ears. Both of the Item's hands are absent of dermal and muscular tissue from the wrist distally, exposing the underlying osseous and tendinous structures. Despite the absence of musculature, full range of motion in both hands is retained.

SCP-9453 is a 3.5 x 5 m room located under the Church of St. Mary of the Mongols in Istanbul, Turkey. It is believed that the room had not been accessed from the 15th century until its rediscovery in 2026. At the time when the door was reopened, all surfaces were coated in a uniform layer of fine dust. All the walls except the western wall are plastered. A description of the room's contents follows:
• Eastern side: An iconostasis inlaid with silver which has fallen down due to rotting wood. The six icons recovered are of the Theotokos in the " Hodegetria " style. Two incense burners containing frankincense and myrrh.
• Northern side: A plain walnut scriptorium desk.

SCP-9454 is an anomalous infection believed to be memetic in nature though the exact mode of transmission remains unknown (see HISTORY section). SCP-9454 targets the peripheral nervous system of the brain, providing the host with extrasensory perception.

Recorded cases are largely clustered around Port Blair in the Andaman Islands with the infected population estimated to be 0.08% of susceptible humans. Through observation as well as documents recovered from the British Occult Service, four main stages of infection have been recorded.

SCP-9455 is an alteration within pre-existing Pennsylvania hunting laws as established by the Pennsylvania Game Commission. This is in the form of the sporadic manifestation of a non-existent state holiday that occurs on the Monday after American Thanksgiving. Upon occurrence, this holiday will mark the start of a single-day deer hunting season within the state of Pennsylvania that lacks typical restrictions.

Colloquially, this holiday is referred to as "Red Monday" by those who participate. Attempts to question local game wardens or the Pennsylvania Game Commission on the origin or reason behind this holiday typically results in confusion and dismissal.

SCP-9456 is a 13-step ritual that enables the complete exchange of consciousness between the enacting subject and any single living human target, regardless of distance. The exchange is fully reversible by repeating the ritual with the subjects in their swapped states. This process is infinitely repeatable.

Activation of SCP-9456 does not strictly require the use of an isolation chamber, though such a chamber has proven highly effective in facilitating the process. The precise mechanism of target selection remains unknown, as all subjects who have undergone the WHITEROOM protocol report complete amnesia regarding the interval between activation and consciousness exchange.

Collected remains of SCP-9459 and the hardened synthetic resin previously containing it are presently stored at Site-91's Containment Room No. 817. It is to be logged as a more "typical", anomalous item, in accordance to Addendum #27 of the 12th Update on Standards, Classifications, and Procedures of the Foundation.

SCP-9460 is a Petraria Arcatinus catapult that identifies itself as "Terry Ian The Seventh." SCP-9460 is capable of speech, perceiving its surroundings, and moving independently. SCP-9460 is fluent in English & French, also claiming to speak Spanish. SCP-9460 has displayed intelligence and reasoning skills equivalent to those of a young adult male, speaking in a tone similar to that of the nearest individual.

SCP-9460 possesses a distinct interest in competitive wrestling.

SCP-9461 is a wooden door knob, similar to ones found in residential homes in much of Europe and North America. Its anomalous properties manifest when affixed to a door, wherein the property the door resides in (henceforth referred to as SCP-9461-2) will, within 10 minutes of SCP-9461 being affixed, be subject to summary demolition through various means. However, the door, door hinge, flooring, supports, and anything else that keeps the door SCP-9461 is affixed to standing will remain undamaged.

This typically occurs due to a previously unidentified fault in the property's gas line or electrical system, which causes detonation and/or fire.

SCP-9463 is a circular lake surrounded by dirt with a radius of approximately seventeen (17) meters and a depth of three (3) fathoms. Although the composition of the liquid present in the lake was initially unknown, research has revealed that the liquid contains distilled water, potassium ions (K +), and hydroxide ions (OH -), indicating the former presence of potassium hydroxide (KOH). The solution has been observed to “attempt” to preserve the exact proportion of contents in the body at the same ratio as it was at the time of discovery: 3.0M. The removal or addition of solution fails to disrupt the so-called “homeostasis” of SCP-9463; the exact mechanism by which the system replenishes and removes materials is currently not understood.
The Trail of The ITV Ouroboros

SCP-9465 is a spacecraft designated the ITV Ouroboros, capable of exit and re-entry between timelines.

SCP-9465 runs perpendicular to normal timeflow, causing the inversion of its space and time. To an external observer, the craft and its trail would appear as a black streak across space, lasting for an infinitely small duration.

The vessel has undergone[]

The interior of SCP-9465 is equipped with several matter recyclers with an efficiency of 1:1, allowing perfect reuse of human waste and creation of modern technology. Additionally, the space inside of SCP-9465 has undergone severe compression, allowing SCP-9465's passengers more room than the exterior would suggest.

It is unknown who built this goddamned thing.

SCP-9466 collectively refers to 8 poems written in Younger Futhark on Norwegian spruce wax reading tablets, designated SCP-9466-1 through -8. The contents of each SCP-9466 instance detail the Norwegian perspective of the Battle of Stamford Bridge at varying time stages, including events that occurred before and after the conflict, following the same linear timeline. Despite their age, each reading tablet is physically whole and fully intelligible, with only minor chipping and surface scratches indicating aging.

SCP-9469 is a 13 acre lot located in Santee, California. It previously served as a drive-in movie theater for 32 years until its closure in 1999. In 2002, newly installed CCTV cameras captured an activation of SCP-9469's paranormalities. The land was subsequently purchased from the original owners by the Department of Land Management.

SCP-9469's resting state is benign; the area will only begin to exhibit paranormalities when a vehicle enters and comes to a complete stop. Once a vehicle has entered SCP-9469, petroleum in the area surrounding the vehicle will begin to coagulate into an articulate facsimile of human arms and hands. These facsimiles will begin to grasp and embrace components such as bumpers, tire rims, driveshafts, and suspension.
