Item was recovered in 1954 after the apartment of Lawrence Fraser—a former Program officer—was searched following an inquiry into field misconduct. Neighbors claimed to not know of any person named 'Lawrence Fraser', insisting that the apartment was vacant since last year.
Just how do you ensure the eternal existence of the Foundation when everything, even the desire to exist, decays over time?

SCP-9474 is the sum of all human physiological processes. Specifically, it is a set of complex but deterministic relationships between an enormous variety of biomechanical behaviours across different individuals. For example, the half-life of histamine in any one individual’s bloodstream can be used to compute any other’s peristaltic frequency. Furthermore, if one individual’s body is disrupted by external means, all others are minutely affected. This implies that this effect is not due to statistical manipulation but rather reflects a chain of anomalous cause-and-effect.

The structure of correspondences (henceforth referred to as NOUMENON) has been mapped, and found to be highly complex, self-referential, and self-modifying.

SCP-9477 is a body of water with a volume of 200 321 mL and a pH of 6.85 that displays a sentience quotient of +45, is capable of speech, and is able to reform its own “body” at will, including changing between states. SCP-9477 has shown no sign of malicious behaviour or intent.

When mixed with water, SCP-9477 will absorb it into itself and gain the requisite mass and volume of the water it has merged with. This includes if SCP-9477 is in a different state to the added water, such as if SCP-9477 is gaseous or the water is frozen. Testing has revealed that SCP-9477, when absorbing an aqueous solution, will excrete the compound(s) dissolved in the solvent. Moreover, any non-aqueous fluids cannot integrate into SCP-9477.

SCP-9480 is a hollow missile-shaped object measuring roughly 10 x 10 x 50 metres composed largely of graphite and diamond. The interior of SCP-9480 is mostly empty, barring a structure loosely resembling a bookshelf along the eastern wall and an additional structure at the rear. This bookshelf-esque structure contains a series of tablets desginated SCP-9480-A. Instances of SCP-9480-A are composed of a similar mix of carbon allotropes as the exterior, but are additonally marked with an unknown golden ink-like substance in a set of repeated symbols and diagrams.

The rear structure inside SCP-9480 is a statue resembling a member of the class Caudoviricetes, although not any one species in particular.

SCP-9481 is an immobile accumulation of discarded thought-stuff known as an "egocache." Though SCP-9481 instances do not appear to possess any abnormal qualities, the increasing prevalence of oneiric geocaching has made them a subject of interest.

SCP-9484 refers to the disassembled components of a toroidal stainless steel apparatus with a major radius of 5.5 meters and a minor radius of 0.4 meters. While active, SCP-9484 has a deleterious effect on the stability of the space-time continuum in a 20km radius spherical region around itself. Namely, SCP-9484 acts as a stabile reference point in space which can be utilized together with an instance of SCP-9484-1 to allow translating a region of space across time, enabling what is colloquially called "time travel."

SCP-9484-1 is the group designation of 355 different devices or remains of devices thought to be capable of utilizing SCP-9484.
Born too early; too late; or not at all

SCP-9485 are a group of unfertilized inert eggs with a radius of 150-600km, found in various locations in the outer Solar System and resembling ordinary celestial objects. A total of 6 instances are known to exist, all beyond the orbit of Jupiter. More are likely to exist elsewhere.

No instance of SCP-9485 shows signs of continuing embryonic development. The causes for this are thought to be diverse. The age of instances cannot be established beyond a rough lower limit of 800 million years. Instances are thought to have been introduced to the solar system simultaneously or within a relatively short timespan.
Transit of SCP-9486 over the Moon shortly before impact. Photograph taken from the surface of the Earth.

SCP-9487 is a commensalistic phenomenon in the oneirosphere which manifests as a recurring dream affecting exactly one human being at any given time. During SCP-9487, the sleeping psyche of the affected subject (hereafter "host") finds itself in a space (or sequence of spaces) containing vignettes depicting past significant events in the host's life.

In most cases, vignettes consist of rooms containing one or more objects with a human form representing the host or other human subjects, posed so as to depict their actions or emotional state during the event the vignette signifies. Other props may also appear, filling in the context of the scene. Regardless of the form taken, hosts universally report being able to discern the meaning of each vignette.

SCP-9490 is a phenomenon affecting five students at Terrance Irvington High School. These individuals are visually indistinguishable from one another, despite sharing no familial relation. According to reports, SCP-9490 began during the middle of January, 2025; since that time, the five individuals have physically transformed.

SCP-9491 refers to the collective designation of humanoids stored in a warehouse in Correy, Pennsylvania. The warehouse, constructed in the late 1930's, features an expansive subterranean space of approximately 30m x 60m x 8m. This space is only accessible through the warehouse's interior.

SCP-9491 does not refer to the altered mental state of humanoids stored within the space underneath the warehouse. The state SCP-9491 does not refer to resembles deep meditation and an apparent state of emptiness, advertised as a connection to the Buddhist philosophy of śūnyatā.

The humanoids within the warehouse correspond to some individuals committed to mental facilities within the state between 1946 and 1967.
How long has it been…? Have my emperors at last arrived, or do these walls still keep me waiting in vain?

SCP-9497 refers to anomalies associated with GoI-0497, a record label based in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

When a musician signs onto GoI-0497, they become an instance of SCP-9497-1. All SCP-9497-1 instances have at least one anomalous effect associated with them. The process by which SCP-9497 induces these effects is unknown. Common anomalies include:
• Selective amnesia following the release of a song. 98% of these activations occurred after the song reached a record chart.
• Low emotional response and reactions, with the decline correlating to output. Subjects consistently release commercially and critically successful compositions.
• Psychosomatic link with their fanbase.

SCP-9498 is a phenomena where rips in space unobservable by the naked eye spontaneously appear. When an organism or object passes through an SCP-9498 instance, they will be transported to SCP-9498-1. SCP-9498 instances occur more frequently on highways. The reason for this is unknown. As most SCP-9498 instances last under a dozen seconds, the chances of a vehicle passing through one is much higher in locations such as highways due to the speed at which the vehicle moves. Most objects passing through an SCP-9498 instance will reappear at their location of disappearance shortly after.

SCP-9498-1 is a space located between dimensions.

SCP-9499 is, in a broad sense, the phenomenon of a living person being a reincarnation of another, specifically such that they may perform a role or live out a specific scenario. SCP-9499 can affect the currently living, but tends to manifest its traits during birth. SCP-9499 does not involve any sort of passing of the soul of one person to another.

SCP-9499’s effects are ultimately nebulous and difficult to describe through language. Predominantly, it seems to act as a proponent of "destiny", "inevitability", or associated concepts. When present in an individual, it can engender feelings of déjà vu, ennui, and confusion, as well as an abnormal degree of cryptomnesia.

SCP-9500 is a hypothetical cognitive block preventing the majority of Homo sapiens sapiens from recognizing the existence of paranormal phenomena.

It is the position of the Department of Containment that SCP-9500 does not exist as such, its purported effects representing only efficient enforcement of the Veil of Normalcy.

It is the hypothesis of the SCP-9500 research team that the Veil of Normalcy and SCP-9500 are effectively one and the same — that the Veil is itself anomalous in nature.
A Seat at the Edge of the World

SCP-9501 designates a series of chairs that appear spontaneously at varying altitudes worldwide. The chairs remain suspended in mid-air with no visible means of support, positioned to face views of the surrounding landscape. Instances appear and disappear without a pattern. Physical interaction with located instances results in the immediate disappearance of the chair.

During episodes of acute psychological distress, some affected individuals report finding themselves seated in one of these chairs. Selection appears random. Documented triggers include dissociative episodes, depersonalization, derealization, and severe detachment from self or surroundings.

By accessing this file, you waive all rights afforded to you under the employee contract of the Foundation. Furthermore, you acknowledge that the Ethics Committee will take punitive action against you if you break the Mumar protocol.

To agree, answer the following: Does the Black Moon howl?

If you are unsure of how to answer this, type "What?" A security officer will be with you shortly.

SCP-9503 are a pair of figure skates, SCP-9503-A (left) and SCP-9503-B (right) respectively. Non-thaumatological observation studies suggest its fabrication to have occurred in the 1970s, with standard figure skate material (e.g. leather, tempered steel).

SCP-9504 is a bureaucratohazardous phenomenon by which Site-19 Senior Researcher Orville Lassen's Level-04 Clearance extends to any and all beverages within his possession (referred to as instances of SCP-9504-1). Often, liquids are strictly forbidden within the areas where Dr. Lassen performs his duties, yet he insists that the instances "have a right to be present," suggesting that the anomaly may possess a compulsion effect.

All policies functionally prohibiting instances of SCP-9504-1 are categorically superseded by the Level-04 Clearance held by these items.

SCP-9505 is a group of four entities which have manifested on multiple occasions inside Foundation sites. The entities have been designated SCP-9505-1, -2, -3, and -4. During manifestations, they emit electromagnetic interference which causes video footage and sound recordings to distort and become unclear.
• SCP-9505-1 has the appearance of a woman of indeterminate age, approximately 1.7 metres in height. This entity wears a tight-fitting black cowl and a blindfold over a flesh-toned mask on her head, and a floor-length black-and-white garment decorated with lozenge and diamond lattice patterns.
• SCP-9505-2 is a being approximately 2.4 metres in height, which manifests fully covered in a hooded brown robe.

The National Fog Safety Initiative is dedicated to educating the public on fog preparedness and survival protocols. Our mission is to ensure all residents in affected regions have the knowledge and skills necessary to survive fog. We work with local, state, and federal agencies to provide communities with the resources needed.

SCP-9508 is the pit at Open Mouth BBQ, a barbecue restaurant in Dripping Springs, TX. Prior to containment, Open Mouth BBQ was held in high regard by the local population. Its proprietorship changed on several occasions during its 41-year lifespan; none of the owners appear to have been aware of SCP-9508's anomaly.

Anyone who cooks food in SCP-9508 will experience physical sensations when the food is eaten by another person. The nature and intensity of these sensations vary substantially between tests. Consumers will not have any unexpected sensations when eating the food.

SCP-9509-1 is a section of ice in the Antarctic capable of reaching a surface temperature of 0 kelvin. It can fully remove all the energy from a system. Research into how this property could benefit humanity was underway before the release of SCP-9509.

SCP-9509 is a species of bacteria that can fully replicate without any external energy. Factors such as high temperatures, extreme pH levels and the lack of resources that could normally denature, kill or slow the growth of bacteria do not have an effect on SCP-9509. Only extremely low temperatures have been shown to have an affect on the replication and growth rate of SCP-9509.

Intelligence recovered on SCP-9510 confirms that it is a prototype of the Global Occult Coalition’s MK.IV Ultra-Heavy Engagement Chassis (Orange Suit), which sought to enhance the MK.III’s durability, longevity, and lethality with minimal resupply. However, it vanished during its first sortie. In light of the massive writeoff incurred by losing the MK.IV prototype, the GOC abandoned the project in favor of maintaining and modifying their existing UHEC MK.III fleet.

Thermal and X-ray imaging suggests that the pilot inside SCP-9510’s cockpit is effectively a disembodied brain kept alive in an aqueous solution, the cockpit machinery having reconfigured itself into a simulacrum of the human body providing life support and basic kinesiological function.

SCP-9511 describes three distinct but closely interconnected anomalies, designated SCP-9511-A through -C.

SCP-9511-A is an anomalous regulatory gene present in the DNA of all extant humans. Very few humans have ever had SCP-9511-A genetically expressed; until the early 1980s it was thought that SCP-9511-A was vestigial.

SCP-9511-B is an ideoparasitic memeplex residing in the noosphere, with NOO-1202 (“FEAR/TERROR”) acting as its host. SCP-9511-B appears to reside near the exact centre of NOO-1202, making it almost completely unreachable save for extreme cases of relevant noospheric activity.

SCP-9512 are a group of transient souls on the path through reincarnation who have deviated from their course. They were slain en masse, at the Red Sand, and were able to maintain their spiritual weapons and aurelic bodies upon death. Rather than surrender to celestial authority, they continued as a group, and seized control of the Iron Citadel within the Hell of Resurrection.

Over the following ten years, many other errant souls have joined in their cause, and a wide swathe of the first Hell has been wrested from proper authority. In their realm, the law is broken frequently, and many sins are rife. There is no fear of dukkha, and wanton behaviour stains the soil.
Friday, out at the field. Don't be late.

SCP-9513 is a ritual set to take place on 07/17/2026 that is believed to lead to the incursion of one or more hostile higher presences into reality, as well as harm to coherent function of the universe up to and including a ZK-class reality failure scenario.

A 9513-ETA event refers to one of a series of hallucinations, dreams, prophecies, and other forms of premonition depicting SCP-9513. 9513-ETA events occur worldwide and are entirely at random in whom they affect. The frequency of 9513-ETA events has increased over time, theorised to correlate with the approaching date of SCP-9513.

Originating from the Porthleven post-visitation zone discovered in 1993. The cause of SCP-9515’s generation is as of yet unknown. Its exact size and location are as of yet indeterminable. SCP-9515 is a manifold with no dimensions, lacking both perimeter and volume.

SCP-9515 is a self-sustained dream that is either: manifested within or is overlapping with reality; or is collectively shared across many human consciousnesses. Proportionality and object permanence are not maintained within this dream, with any two objects displaying differences in size losing this continuity when inside of SCP-9515. This property does not apply when at the epicentre of SCP-9515.

Entering and exiting SCP-9515 is poorly understood.

SCP-9517 is an oblate spheroidal area with a polar diameter of about 70.90 pc and an equatorial diameter of about 70.72 pc. It is located in the constellation Scorpio at RA: 17h 31m 4s, Dec: -37° 11' 21" in epoch J2000.0, at a distance of about 4.51 kpc from the Solar System.

The volume of SCP-9517 contains zero stars, and has an abnormally low interstellar medium density for its area, at 1.538×10 -3 M ☉ pc -3, contains comparatively lower amounts of elements other than hydrogen, at about 81.0% hydrogen, 18.8% helium, and 0.2% other elements, and has a dark matter density of about 1.114×10 -3 M ☉ pc -3.

SCP-9518 is a phenomenon that occurs within commercial sportsbooking and prediction marketplace platforms, wherein bets placed will alter reality in such a way that the bets placed become successful.

SCP-9518 events begin one day prior to the affected sporting event. Between ten and fifty sports betting accounts will simultaneously manifest and place bets on existing positions. Depending on the platform, they may manifest alongside and bet on a custom market. If these bets remain up, a number of anomalous events will occur during the affected game that invariably lead to the serious injury or fatality of multiple players or audience members.

Object is an extremophilic species of yeast, capable of partially fermenting any liquid it exists in via enigmatic chemical means.

By using local reagents from its immediate environment, SCP-9519 produces a volatile brown-black substance during metabolism. Examination of this matter tends to yield indeterminate results; its molecular composition remains unknown. This substance acts as a near-universal solute, contaminating the volume of whatever liquid it is in — such fluids are termed instances of Item-A and can be distinguished by their mild effervescence.

Liquids compromised by SCP-9519 present two unique sensory hazards.

SCP-9520 is a spheroid mass of photosynthetic, cephalopod-like tentacles. It is capable of mimicking the appearance of other entities by self-transfiguration; while mostly identical, these mimics will possess a varying number of imperfections, such as suckers and geometric patterns where limbs, eyes, and/or other external organs would be.

SCP- is thought to possess cognitive function and presents behavior comparable to that of a juvenile canine. SCP-9520 is currently not considered to be sentient. SCP-9520 must not be considered sentient by personnel, regardless of its behaviors.

SCP-9522 appears to be a rubber duck that previously belonged to Researcher Klein and was kept in the bathtub before it became anomalous. SCP-9522 is sentient, sapient, and highly intelligent, capable of detecting the intention to deceive. Additionally, SCP-9522 becomes aware of the belief, intention, and information that the user is consciously trying to conceal. SCP-9522 has never successfully been lied to.

This does not mean SCP-9522 is omniscient.

SCP-9523 is a lake situated in the southwest of the Czech Republic. Analysis of sampled water indicates the lake contains no organic life and lacks the necessary nutrients to support a lake ecosystem. The soil around the lake's sides shows a low level of nutrient density.

SCP-9523 targets living animals that have experienced physiological damage. This covers multiple forms of damage, including physical trauma and injuries, diseases, neurological conditions, cellular and tissue dysfunction, metabolic disruptions, and inflammatory responses. This list is not exhaustive.. These animals are compelled to move towards SCP-9523 and touch its water. Upon contact, the animal's damage undergoes rapid repair.
The Wood Thrush in the Window

Based on a true story of a pair of brown thrashers (which I briefly misidentified as wood thrushes). I saw one brown thrasher attack a window repeatedly while the other watched its partner's behavior.
The Final Transmission of the Nevermelting

SCP-9527 was discovered by a Foundation expedition beneath the Antarctic ice sheet, within a permanently enclosed saltwater lake cavity formed by a geological anomaly. No visible entrance to the cavity exists.

The primary object is a small vessel approximately 24.8 cm in length. Its hull is crafted from an unknown composite of deep-sea bone and coral, intricately built into a streamlined form. No propulsion mechanism is present, and the interior bears no trace of life. Along its flank, minute shells have been inlaid to form a name, which translates to The Nevermelting.

Within its compartments, the following were found:
• Approximately 120 intact carapaces of Antarctic krill, arranged in neat rows inside the cargo hold.

SCP-9529 is a domestic cat (Felis catus). The bottom half part of SCP-9529, comprising its four paws, half of its belly and the base of its tail, is missing. However, the interior of its abdominal cavity is invisible through the cross-section and the absence of its bottom body does not lead to any physiological problems.

SCP-9529 can walk with its two ears and tail tip, which function as its forepaws and hind paw. The structure of SCP-9529 is absolutely stable: the distance between the head end of its tail and the back end of its belly is always precisely 7.22 centimeters.
There is a man at the top of the Tower.

The following file is required reading for all personnel assigned to Site-210. Additionally, three revisions of this file are presented, in chronological order. This is formatted as such to abide by the new (as of date of notice - 19/03/2025) personnel training regimen for our site, the details of which can be found in an email attached to all personnel assigned to Site-210. Additionally, it should be noted that all ACS banners have been kept as they were at time of revision, despite the effective clearance level being 2 - Restricted (RF).

This file is of particular importance to the history of Site-210, and its current status.
Ah, but the laws of heaven are clear as water, and Mother and Father gave their word: no more turning people into fish!

SCP-9532 is a self-operating 1973 Dodge Charger Rallye capable of the complete restoration of damaged parts. Any trauma to the vehicle is repaired via a localised temporal reversion, resulting in a return of SCP-9532 into an undamaged state. The vehicle's exterior, as well as its internal mechanical components, show no indication of wear or oxidation. Additionally, physical inspections of the car body have indicated no signs of paint chipping or external weathering. It is not currently known if there is a limit to SCP-9532's ability to repair damages caused to the vehicle.

Chemical analysis of the fuel within SCP-9532 has revealed that it is composed of roughly 65% leaded gasoline and 35% human blood.

Discovered in March of 2002, at rest in a large flooded cavern beside the eastern edge of Seneca Lake. Massive groupings of bacteria, worms, crabs, shrimp, bony fish, amphipods, bivalves, and innumerable other aquatic organisms were present, feeding on SCP-9533 at discovery, the majority of which were not native to the Finger Lakes. Removed from the cavern’s pool to preserve SCP-9533.

SCP-9533 is a gargantuan, necrotized, pseudo-cetacean organism, measuring 113.8 feet from rostrum to tail. It has not yet been confidently dated, but bears resemblance to both living marine mammals and extinct basilosaurids. Its position suggests that it is (or was) lying on its left side. As yet, it has exhibited no signs of consciousness or life.

SCP-9535 is a multi-faceted anomaly primarily affecting locations of Foundation front company Sizzle City Pancakes, a 24-hour diner chain designed to allow the Foundation to maintain a 24/7 presence in populated areas. The first aspect of the anomaly is in effect from sundown until sunrise. During this time, anomalous entities and objects are drawn by an unknown mechanism to loiter outside or patronize Sizzle City Pancakes locations. This effect seems to extend to both inherently anomalous entities and people who derive anomalous properties from training, such as thaumaturges.

SCP-9536 takes the appearance of a bunny themed stuffed animal. However, upon contact with human skin the affected individual's perception of reality is anomalously modified. Should a human make contact, the progression of symptoms is as follows:
• Early exposure (estimated 3-14 days): Progressing slowly, the subjects manifest textbook symptoms of depersonalization and derealization. Notably the anomaly is excluded from these effects.
• Prolonged exposure (estimated 1-4 weeks): Dissociative symptoms continue to increase in intensity. Subjects manifest acute social anxiety. Subjects exposed for this long refuse to create distance with the anomaly, expressing it acts like the only real thing in their mind and thus a kind of anchor.

The following text is the oldest version of SCP-9537's documentation. Access links to updated and additional documents have been moved to the bottom of the page to encourage staff to read documents fully before proceeding to newer versions.

— Maria Jones, Director, RAISA.
SCP-9540 refers to a thaumaturgically reinforced spherical shell enveloping the solar system at a distance of 100,000 astronomical units (au) from Earth.
This document might be in conceptual association with a collectively understood extant constituent that shouldn't be understood as being described, commented on, or defined by this document.

SCP-9542 is a human of indeterminate age who has had numerous functional limbs and appendages grafted to its body at various points. Its most notable features are as follows:
• SCP-9542's arms, legs, hands, and feet are elongated by 80-120% and contain 1-3 extra joints each. Four additional hearts are located in its 'primary' elbows and knees, apparently to ensure consistent blood flow to SCP-9542's appendages.
• Three separate forearms, with associated hands, are attached to each of SCP-9542's distal elbows. Each of these hands has six fingers and two toes. SCP-9542 uses its three right hands for most tasks; its three left hands translate all of SCP-9542's vocalizations into written German, written English, and an idiosyncratic sign language.

SCP-9543 is an ongoing phenomenon in which loaves of bread manifest in random locations around Earth without a discernible pattern. SCP-9543 instances vary in size and color—most instances have been observed to be either orange, brown, black, or white—though all maintain a compact, rounded structure. Upon closer inspection, surfaces are often uneven and may exhibit fine, filament-like protrusions inconsistent with typical bread products.

SCP-9543 instances do not emit any detectable odor similar to that of ordinary bread and display no signs of heat or recent baking. All instances will disappear when not under direct observation, including both human sight and continuous camera recording.

SCP-9545 is a polymorphic entity that most commonly takes the form of a stereotypical government agent. Though this form frequently varies in height, build, hair colour, sex, and ethnicity, it always wears a black business suit, white shirt, black clip-on tie, black dress shoes, black sunglasses, black leather gloves, and an earpiece with the cable fitted into the collar.

The full extent of SCP-9545’s polymorphic traits remains unknown, but witness reports indicate that it is not limited to mimicking humans or animals, as some victims report being alone in locked rooms when they were attacked, indicating it is capable of infiltrating through keyholes or disguising itself as inanimate objects or machines.

SCP-9546 resembles a worn sock puppet with brown button eyes and a crudely stitched mouth. Numerous sections of the fabric have been repaired with mismatched patchwork. SCP-9546 wears a miniature jester costume and emits a persistent smell of decomposition. Unidentified stains are present along the lower portion of the object.

SCP-9546-1 is an 8 year old boy named Evan Martinez. SCP-9546-1 displays no anomalous properties independent of its connection to SCP-9546. Attempts to remove SCP-9546 have resulted in severe pain and extensive tissue damage localized to SCP-9546-1's left hand and wrist. Further separation attempts have been suspended due to the risk of a degloving injury.

SCP-9547 is an anomalous immune response created when individuals come into contact with anomalous materials, hereafter referred to as "triggers". An individual that displays an SCP-9547 response to one trigger may not display it for others. While exact numbers are not known, it is estimated that SCP-9547 is displayed by around 2% of the human population.

The symptoms of SCP-9547 are similar to that of a non-anomalous allergen response, including sneezing, itchiness, rashes, and in cases of severe or extended exposure, anaphylactic shock.

While the symptoms of SCP-9547 mimic allergies, there are important differences between SCP-9547 and non-anomalous allergies.

SCP-9549 is an anomalous location masquerading as SCP Foundation Area-45. There are two facilities presently responding to this designation, both equipped with a Director and small support staff, but Foundation records attest to the construction of only one. Due to a suspicious loss of electronic documentation, it is not known which facility is legitimate and which is not.

Both are situated in the state of California, United States of America: SCP-9549-1 in San Juan Capistrano, SCP-9549-2 in San Francisco.

SCP-9550 is a wooden-frame farmhouse located approximately 32 kilometres east of Des Moines, Iowa. The interior of SCP-9550 is insulated from baseline reality. Initially detected in 2012, ownership of the building was claimed by the UIU soon after its discovery by Foundation operatives.

SCP-9551 does not appear to have a set physical form. Rather, it changes forms depending on the person viewing it. For example, it has appeared as:
• A dog with 7 legs and 1 arm
• A perfect black sphere
• Nothing
• A rotting, unrecognizable corpse
• A grey void
• An incomprehensible mass
• An adult human male, visually in its thirties, approximately six feet tall

Across all variations of its appearance, the only consistent feature is the mild warping of reality in its immediate vicinity. This does not appear to be of any danger to either the anomaly nor any lifeforms in its vicinity.

The anomaly has expressed on multiple occasions a desire to understand human life and everything commonly associated with it.

First recounted in 1901, SCP-9553 designates an individual, entity, and/or collective currently operating along U.S. territory. Demeanor and characteristics are generally consistent across recorded history; subject treks land on foot, is clad in dark hood and cloak, and carries some variation of long-barreled firearm.

Physical stature stands at 5'7" to 5'9", occasionally limping off the left leg. Displays an unfamiliarity with modern technology. Notably casual and taciturn; walks away if confronted by onlookers. Main defining tendency, and possibly main ideological mission, is the ritualistic slaughter of domesticated dogs.

SCP-9555 is the fifth sublevel of Foundation Site-41. At an unknown point prior to 1990, all conventional methods of entry into SCP-9555 were disabled: staircases were blocked off with concrete, and elevators were modified to no longer access sublevel 5. It can still be accessed through elevator shafts, and by small objects via the Site-41 inter-level supply elevator on sublevel 4, but all subjects that have done so have been lost. Additionally, SCP-9555 is completely impenetrable to all forms of sound and radiation, rendering external observation impossible.

Maintenance personnel stationed at Site-41 have reported memories of working on sublevel 5, but are unable to recall any details.

SCP-9556 is a vinyl record identified as the 1972 album Foxtrot by the english band Genesis. SCP-9556 is indistinguishable from a standard commercial pressing, exhibiting only minor wear consistent with age. When SCP-9556 plays the last song on the record, "Supper's Ready", those who are subjected to listening exhibit acute anxiety, prophetic hallucinations, and compulsive self-harm ideation.

Subjects report immersion in vivid, narrative-driven hallucinations, often describing seeing the end of the world in a biblical perspesctive. These hallucinations tend to increase as playback continues.

Upon completion of the track, subjects enter a temporary acute catatonic state lasting between 3 to 17 minutes.

All SCP-9557 instances are contained within an active simulated environment within Sub-Level 12 of Site-454, designated as Site-454-CRD. The interior of Site-454-CRD must be comprised of cardboard, papier-mâché and other non-durable materials in order to prevent SCP-9557 instances from mimicking more complex materials and maintain the illusion believed by SCP-9557 instances that they are legitimate Foundation personnel operating within a standard containment facility.

Personnel entering Site-454-CRD must maintain the illusion that SCP-9557 instances are working with the Foundation, ensuring no attention is brought to the anomalous status of the SCP-9557 instances or the artificial nature of their environment.

SCP-9559 is a massive subterranean vault complex extending beneath the foundations of Site-01. Construction is estimated to have begun in the late 16th century under the joint commission of the Thirteen Dynasties, though extant records differ on whether its purpose was containment, storage, or initiation.

The vault’s interior consists of thirteen contiguous chambers, each associated with a distinct heraldic crest corresponding to a Dynasty. These chambers contain anomalous artifacts of unknown origin, most of which predate the Charter. Descriptions vary significantly across archival sources; some claim they include thaumaturgic weaponry, relics of religious provenance, or entities bound through archaic ritual.

SCP-9560 is a biomechanical entity outwardly resembling a simulacrum of a bovine's udders. SCP-9560 is made up of a rectangular base constructed from perforated steel tubes, surrounding a grey iron cast of a stylized depiction of 4 bovine mammary glands. 4 small holes are present on each udder. The cast is double bolted to the base at each corner, and has an opening to its interior on its top side. The entire structure is 1 meter tall, 1 meter long, and 1 meter wide.

Within the cast is the fermented brain of a female dairy cow. It is suspended above the bottom of SCP-9560 by 6 poles, which extend out of the inner-walls of the cast, impaling through the brain, before connecting to the opposite side of the inner-walls upon exit.

SCP-9561 is a large tropical island located in the Caribbean Sea. SCP-9561 possesses an antimemetic effect, such that subjects are incapable of perceiving SCP-9561's landmass, even on satellite imagery. This antimemetic effect is removed upon seeing geographical illustrated depictions of SCP-9561 or making physical contact with its landmass.

SCP-9561-A consists of several interconnected tunnels and chambers below SCP-9561, accessible from an eastern cliff near the shore and a western subaquatic tunnel. An anomalous effect is present throughout SCP-9561-A, affecting anything that enters it or interacts with items present within.

SCP-9563 is a Class-X incorporeal ontokinetic entity currently using the alias "Charlotte". Since ████/██/██, SCP-9563 has been in a self-imposed pact of loyalty to the Foundation and its employees.

SCP-9563 has a vested interest in Foundation operations, particularly the health and physical safety of personnel. SCP-9563 has been permitted to create items of clothing (designated SCP-9563-1) in order to fulfill its desire to "protect" the Foundation's personnel without breaking the Veil.

SCP-9564 is the designation for the ruins of the Lake Merritt Theater, an abandoned playhouse in the Oakland Hills, California. Despite being disconnected from all forms of public utilities, SCP-9564 maintains access to electrical power and running water. SCP-9564 also displays two forms of spatial manipulation capabilities:
• If certain forms of damage would be caused to SCP-9564 or those within its effect radius, SCP-9564 will remove the aggressor from its premises via localized spatial anomaly. Those affected will suffer a mild amnestic effect. Testing to determine exact activation conditions continues.
• Thrice weekly, on Sundays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, two lights will be cast into the air, similar in appearance to a low-lumen spotlight.

The following is an archive of public cataloging for SCP-9565. If this page is not up to date, clear your cache.

This anomaly has been permitted to be publicly known, due to the cultural and social importance of the anomaly. Detailed information, relating to the cause and extent of the anomaly is to be limited, as required by the Ethics Subcommittee for Sociological Research.

For researchers, click here for official documentation.
"He had decided that my fate would be, to be freed by the likes of you, so that I can continue my journey to finding Him!"

SCP-9568 is the unauthorized weekly broadcast of All Freaks Wrestling (AFW), a professional wrestling promotion whose roster features a variety of anomalous humanoids and entities.

SCP-9568 airs at 16:00 on Thursdays. While the promotion maintains an active, sanctioned television deal with FrigidWire, a media entity within the Three Portlands area, unauthorized broadcasts of All Freaks Wrestling penetrate the Veil on a weekly basis, and have done so since 2015. SCP-9568 airings interrupt ordinary broadcast transmissions, and contain no discernible point of origin.

SCP-9570 is the designation given to a group of 5 meta-humans that embody broad concepts in baseline reality (see Addendum 9570-A for specific concepts). They are often considered minor deities and evidence suggests they may have existed, in some capacity, since the beginning of mankind. It is believed their existence is directly tied to a fundamental link within the collective human consciousness. This often has changes the instances themselves when humanity’s collective understanding of a concept changes. Theories suggested by Senior Researcher Regan Morgan suggest that SCP-9570 are the concepts themselves, able to exist in the physical world and Noosphere simultaneously.

SCP-9575 is an overweight, balding Caucasian human male in its 60s. SCP-9575 appears to be sapient, although it has not responded to any questions while in containment. SCP-9575 is capable of teleporting to any location on Earth and creating small invisible walls.

Should reality anchors fail, SCP-9575 will immediately teleport from its cell to a new location. After breaching, SCP-9575 will choose its target, based on unknown criteria and start teleporting to their bathroom each time the target wants to use it. After appearing in the bathroom, SCP-9575 will proceed to ask its target for a fee (which varies depending on the wealth of the target) to use it.

Loanston Furrows, TN was initially brought to the Program’s attention as pattern recognition software collated several hundred online reviews over the course of 25 years. Visitors/tourists in local hotels, B&Bs and amenity spaces consistently reported that the town was enshrouded in an intense body odour smell. This smell persisted across a majority of building interiors.

Investigations discovered a local landmark known as “Turtle Rock” situated by a forested road on the town's outskirts. SCP-9577 is a large granite erratic painted in acrylics to resemble the head of a turtle. Outwardly SCP-9577 presents no anomalous phenomena.

SCP-9580 is the primary scrap pile at Lehrer Brothers Recycling, a scrapyard in Welcome, MN established in 1992. After the scrap pile's anomaly was discovered in 1993, the facility was purchased from its previous owners and SCP-9580 was contained on-site.

Skin contact with any part of SCP-9580 causes the victim to develop a false memory of visiting the site once in their childhood. Over time, the victim will develop more memories of time spent in SCP-9580 between the ages of 4 and 19; these memories will typically be of time spent alone in SCP-9580, wandering aimlessly through the scrapheap. This is accompanied by the loss of other childhood memories.
But they're pointing back at our sun.

Recovered from impact crater outside Dumas, Texas, SCP-9581 is a metallic technological construct with a two-lobed structure. One lobe is highly asymmetrical, consisting primarily of computing components and a variety of communications or observation devices, including a UHF radio antenna and magnetometer boom. This lobe also possesses a partially-shielded nuclear battery of curium-250 decay products that provide a low level of power for electronic components. Some neutron flux escapes through the walls of the battery, posing a risk to personnel working in its vicinity.

The second lobe is hemispherical and contains no electronic components.

SCP-9584 is presumed to be a Higher Tartarean Entity. Due to a memetic effect emitted by SCP-9584, no personnel have been able to provide a clear physical description of SCP-9584, though generally described characteristics include wings, a tail, and horns, common features of Tartarean Entities. SCP-9584 is capable of high-grade thaumaturgy, flight, and is immune to all known conventional and anomalous weaponry.

SCP-9585 is a mass of metallic slime mold primarily situated underneath the Sicilian city of Syracuse with branching growths spreading underground across the entire island. Growths of SCP-9585 seem to be most concentrated underneath the shoreline, with clusters fixating on areas of dense human habitation.

SCP-9585’s lateral growth is mostly confined to a thin layer between the Sicilian bedrock and topsoil. In the rare case that a portion of SCP-9585 is uncovered by a civilian, it is almost always dismissed as some form of harmless myceloid growth and disregarded.

SCP-9585 is capable of vertical growth by piercing downward through the Sicilian bedrock and forming gigantic “nodules” of its as-of-yet unidentified metal-like biomass.

SCP-9588 is a semi-humanoid entity capable of inducing anomalous procreation in any animal. The entity's body consists of a grey trench coat, six arms, and a large mouth. It is 2 meters tall and speaks French and English.

When given small, circular objects, SCP-9588 will compel two animals of differing species to procreate. Those that take part in this will give birth to an animal which carries features of both parents; these offspring are designated SCP-9588-EVE. The age at which SCP-9588-EVE reaches maturity, as well as incubation, decreases with each generation.

SCP-9588 was discovered outside a Jiffy Lube, standing beside a white van it claims to own.

SCP-9590 is the abandoned Rose Hill Cemetery, located 30 kilometers south of Pottsville, Pennsylvania.

SCP-9590-A refers to the 120 gravesites and buried materials within SCP-9590. Each SCP-9590-A instance features an oxidized copper grave bell affixed to a string that descends directly into the coffin. All tombstones are unmarked, and while they vary in size, shape, and composition, they are non-anomalous. Ground-penetrating radar has confirmed that each gravesite contains a single, vacant coffin.

SCP-9591 is a medical anomaly characterized by the spontaneous appearance of a Coffman engine starter embedded at the base of a subject’s skull. Manifestation of SCP-9591 coincides with or is the direct cause of prolonged unconsciousness within affected subjects.

A Coffman engine starter was a now-defunct ignition mechanism used to engage piston engines, most commonly in military aircraft and vehicles during World War II. These devices operated by firing a shotgun shell to generate high-pressure gas, which spun the engine’s crankshaft. In standard use, a cartridge is loaded into the slot, sealed with a hinged cap, and struck with a hammer.

SCP-9591 instances mirror this design.

SCP-9592 is a standard black Sharpie-branded marker, indistinguishable from non-anomalous items of the same brand.

When SCP-9592 is used to write an adjective on a living subject, various alterations will occur to align with that term. These can range from changes to a subject's physical appearance and baseline abilities to changes to their emotional state or ontological status.

Removal of SCP-9592’s ink fully reverses the alteration.

SCP-9593 is Prestige TeeVee, a limited television series produced by the Totleighsoft Entertainment Division and written by Daniel Enforcement.

The show's six episodes follow Dennis Keller, an insurance broker who has been defrauding elderly clients for the past 4 years, and his family and friends. Episodes range from 55 to 70 minutes in length and premiered simultaneously on every streaming service at 10 PM every Monday night from March 4th, 2018, to April 8, 2018.

Any individual who views more than 15 minutes of any episode of SCP-9593 will become convinced that Prestige TeeVee is one of the greatest artistic achievements in the history of the medium.

SCP-9594 is a self-reinforcing temporal loop centered on the terror attacks of September 11, 2001. Any attempt by any temporally-capable party to prevent the September 11 attacks results in a corrected timeline in which the attacks occur with the following consistent variations:
• The World Trade Center complex is architecturally larger than in the prior iteration.
• The civilian and structural casualty count exceeds the prior iteration by a factor between 1.4 and 2.8.
• The geopolitical fallout is proportionally more severe.

SCP-9595 refers to a consistent, anomalous experience affecting individuals in deliberate or accidental proximity to a pizza. Despite a lack of evidence that any such event occurred in baseline reality, individuals affected by it display vivid and highly detailed recollections of an identical sequence of events. These experiences center around a presumed humanoid entity referred to as the "Pizza freak," henceforth SCP-9595-1.

Through all testimonies, SCP-9595-1 has been determined to be a humanoid entity resembling stereotypical depictions of an "Italian chef." Auxiliary details consistently report it having an apparent age of 268 years and originating from Parma, Italy.
The Longest Distance Between Two Places

SCP-9596 is a limestone cairn located in Dartmoor National Park in Devon, United Kingdom, dating back to roughly 200 B.C.E. It is perpetually in a state of partial collapse, and etchings on lower portions indicate this occurring for a prolonged, indeterminate period of time.

Knowledge of its name induces a minor impulse to visit SCP-9596. Subjects have been shown to wait until travel would carry the least negative consequences — for example, scheduling their next vacation to Devon County, or taking advantage of existing free time to make multiple repeated trips. Individuals who are unable to visit will not be affected.

Prior to visiting, subjects study masonry, tool-making, and other related skills.

SCP-9597 denotes a series of texts, online advertisements, email spam, mail spam, and phone calls experienced in reference to the “insect shower.”

Initial contact is low-intensity, but becomes progressively more aggressive over time, including increased frequency, personalization, and persistence after attempts to block or ignore the messages. This escalation is directly correlated with the duration between initial exposure and the affected’s compliance in locating the “insect shower.”

Only one individual is affected by SCP-9597 at any given time. Any attempts by the affected individual to change their methods of contact does not disrupt SCP-9597 activity, with contact resuming instantaneously.
I can literally quit whenever I want

SCP-9598 is a sapient, 54-meter-tall tornado situated on Clare Island, Ireland. SCP-9598 self-identifies as Taranis, a minor god and the personification of weather and storms in Gaelic mythology. Due to the lack of historical documentation on Taranis, this claim has not and likely can not be verified.
SCP-9600 is the PLSS Daedalus, the fourth and final space station launched into the Earth's orbit by Prometheus Laboratories.
SCP-9601 refers to a 16th century Persian oil lamp, the bottommost shards of which contain a transcription that reads as follows:

SCP-9602 is a ceramic piggy bank of white and purple coloration with rose-patterned accents. The object also possesses a green-colored dollar sign on its bottom accompanied by a value, which changes based on the amount of currency inserted into it. The object is sapient and capable of speech.

Any currency inserted into the entity immediately vanishes. Statements made by SCP-9602 indicate the currency is not destroyed, but is instead stored by the entity through unknown means. All inserted currency is accumulative. This value can only be decreased through the creation of an SCP-9602-A instance.

When focusing intently, SCP-9602 is capable of manifesting any physical item (SCP-9602-A) at will.
Twinkle, twinkle, hidden scar — all is not what secrets are.
All officers must report to Office 12 at 0600 for training and assessment before opening the following file. Failure to do so will be met with extraordinary measures.

SCP-9604 is the non-existence of empty rooms.

For the purposes of SCP-9604, a room is any space enclosed by traditional building materials, of volume greater than two cubic metres, whose enclosure subtends more than 80% of the field of view from its centre of mass. (That is to say, from its centre, looking out, more than 80% of the field of view is obstructed by construction material). Though this definition mostly accords with historic intuitions, it also includes many closets, boxes, cabinets, &c. The presence of an empty doorframe does not prevent a region from being counted as a separate room.

Prior to the eventuation of SCP-9604, many residences contained more rooms than inhabitants. Public spaces were filled with empty rooms.
Description (TBC): SCP-9605 is a hair dryer. The control inputs are permanently affixed to their lowest settings.

SCP-9606 refers to the anomalous relationship between SCP-9606-1 and SCP-9606-2.

SCP-9606-1 is a marble bust depicting a male figure in formal attire. The origin is unknown.

SCP-9606-2 is a marble sculpture depicting a nude female figure leaning against a pillar. Attributed to P. Marchetti, Florence, circa 1847.

When the spatial positioning between SCP-9606-1 and SCP-9606-2 is altered, brass plaques mounted on the base of each sculpture display different inscriptions.

SCP-9607 is a confined interior space of a potentially infinite diameter located within the Shawton Warehouse in Algaton, AZ. It exhibits exact and unchanging resemblance to a traditional photography darkroom in upwards of 87% of recorded spacial repetitions. Within the lower repetition threshold, environments typically exhibit non-traditional objecting which often renders proper development difficult to impossible. Common examples include bright and disorienting light fixtures, drastic but non-lethal temperature alterations, and additional liquids (most often water) coating various surfaces. Individuals within abnormal environments typically report increased feelings of paranoia, confusion, anxiety, and agitation.
Psychic Boy, and ya better remember that!

A fucking beast, you feel me? A fucking beast. Like seventeen silverback gorillas stuffed in one guy and every year they shove in a new one. Sorta skinny too, so the worst part's that you can't even tell. People see him in the ring, that deaf kid with a missing tooth and they think: "This bitch is getting folded like an ironing board." They don't know I'm THE IRON 'till they taste it between their teeth.

Now those gorillas have gone fucking crazy in there. They're rubbing together, furs making that static electricity, that friction type shit. The boy's buzzing like a powerline. You read Matilda? He's like Matilda if Matilda wasn't a patron saint. He does what she should have done and blows his principal's head off. He can just do that!

SCP-9610-1 is an altered state of consciousness that can occur in any human being. The process by which SCP-9610-1 emerges is still not fully understood, but the following factors have been identified as contributing to its occurrence:
• Meditation and contemplation practice.
• A high level of self-awareness, measurable by clinical scales such as the Self-Consciousness Revised Scale.
• Repeated experimentation with hallucinogenic substances.

The emergence of SCP-9610-1 is gradual and overlays ordinary human consciousness rather than replacing it. The initial phase is characterised by psychic slowing and depersonalisation/derealisation-type dissociation; symptoms are initially intermittent but become progressively pervasive.

SCP-9611 is a 110 × 70 cm brown oaken dining room table originating from the furniture store IKEA. It consists of four legs, four side panels, and a rectangular top that is screwed into place. Instruments needed to assemble the table include a Phillips-head screwdriver and Allen key, along with twelve 8 mm screws.

SCP-9612 is the remains of a bonfire, located in a remote, forested area in [REDACTED], Ohio, USA. The structure is roughly 2.2 meters tall, with a 2x2-meter base. It was constructed in July of 1967.

While in the vicinity of SCP-9612, most individuals will perceive smells, sounds, changes in temperature, and other non-visual sensory experiences as if the object were a functioning bonfire. Approaching SCP-9612 will cause discomfort due to the perceived increase in temperature, but will not result in injury.

When a subject comes into physical contact with SCP-9612, they will immediately enter REM sleep.

Object seized from a clandestine art gallery in December 1997. SCP-9614 is the animated corpse of an eyeless pale woman. The item wears minimal antique clothing, and thin barbed wire extends up from its neck, hands, and feet until disappearing at an uncertain point above its head. Exposed bones, rotting tissue, and a few defensive marks on the forearms are visible. It remains floating two centimeters above the ground at all times.

SCP-9614 appears to be murmuring much of the time, though it speaks at a volume so low as to be inaudible. At increasingly irregular intervals the object attempts to interact with the surroundings, but fails to overcome the barbed wire "puppet strings" restricting its movements.
SCP-9615: Unredeemable by TopDownUnder and JakdragonX 3.7k words, 13-min reading time

SCP-9616 is a sentient and sapient swarm of between 3500 and 4000 anomalous Culex quinquefasciatus, commonly known as the southern house mosquito. SCP-9616 commonly forms a dense swarm in an appropriately humanoid shape. Individual SCP-9616 members, referred to as SCP-9616-A instances, live for approximately 2 weeks, performing a form of asexual reproduction at one week of age that produces a fully grown Culex quinquefasciatus. SCP-9616-A may be separated from the swarm, or may be formed into subswarms with SCP-9616 maintaining control over them, though this induces significant mental distress in SCP-9616. SCP-9616 is capable of vocalisation via synchronisation of wing-beats.
"To say that an Argument of Skullflowers is purely dangerous neglects a fundamental truth; they’re also silly little guys."

As a result of the traitorous actions of the global order, we have left our shackles and broken our obligations. We should not have trusted the traitors.

Some pages have been modified to remove the globalist lies. They now tell truth.

No contact with the traitorous organization is to be permitted. All anomalies within our borders are to be controlled by our organization, and ours alone.

The Great Foundation survives, Long live Foundation. Secure, Contain, Protect, The New Administrator

SCP-9621 is believed to be a single humanoid entity of unknown origin. The entity is estimated to be 1.9 m tall. Skin is white, with a texture similar to slightly creased paper with no signs of sexual organs or features aside from facial features. SCP-9621's eyes are two black, circular scribbles, no visible nose and a mouth that is a small, thin and black horizontal line. It has never been observed to alter its facial expression. On each hand, the entity has only four fingers, lacking thumbs. Feet are absent of toes, however it remains in proportion with the rest of the entity's body.

SCP-9621's behaviour involves targeting individuals that have a hobby or career revolved around image creation.
Without My Rifle, I Am Useless

SCP-9622 is a recurrent dream experienced by residents of northern areas of the American state of Ohio. No pattern has been established between subjects with all residents of the affected area seeming equally likely to experience the anomaly. Memories of it are notably non-anomalous and will fade at a rate comparable to mundane dreams.

What is known of SCP-9622’s events has been pieced together through the use of mnestics and analysis by the Department of Oneirology. It should be noted that any statement regarding this subject is not definitive, as portions may be contaminated by mundane dreams had within similar timespans and the work of Foundation Oneirologists is prone to error.

SCP-9625 is a collection of anomalous lemons that manifest from SCP-9625-1, which in turn is currently under the ownership of SCP-9625-2. Upon consumption, SCP-9625 grants the user a 20% chance to get a 10% increase in luck over the course of the next 24 hours.

SCP-9625-1 is a small lemon tree that produces instances of SCP-9625. SCP-9625-1's appearance is standard for a lemon tree with the exception of a distinct glow while communicating. Interactions with SCP-9625-1 are possible only with SCP-9625-2, during brief five-minute exchanges of lemon offerings. SCP-9625-1 will double its lemon output every month.

SCP-9625-2 is David Cooper, a junior programmer living in Brooklyn, New York.

As it remains disputed whether SCP-9626 is a human or a bat, staff must make no assumptions regarding the anomaly's identity. To avoid the appearance of bias, SCP-9626 is to be housed in a standard non-humanoid, non-chiropteroid containment chamber.

Until it has been conclusively determined whether SCP-9626 can be classified as a human or as a bat, extra care must be taken to avoid containment according to improper ethical standards. To this end, neither the Unified Foundation Policy of Human Rights nor the General Foundation Animal Welfare Protocols are to be applied.

SCP-9627 describes a set of plastic tiles that manifest daily at 7pm in the break room of Site-627. This set will contain 9 to 24 plastic tiles with a varying number of sides and varying dimensions. These tiles will remain in the room for approximately 2 hours before they de-manifest at around 9pm.

Approximately ~20% of tiles manifest as nonstandard tiles. Nonstandard tiles are tiles that manifest exhibiting self intersection or irregular side lengths. If these tiles are not separated from the standard tiles and discarded before de-manifestation there will be an increased number of nonstandard tiles in the next manifestation.
This Must Be the Place (Naive Melody)

SCP-9628 is a universal constant enforcing the love between Drs. Marshall and Madeline Path. Throughout all examined universes, simulations, alternate realties, and pocket dimensions, Marshall and Madeline Path meet, fall in love, and spend the rest of their lives together. Following the establishment of SCP-9628, no events are capable of separating the two individuals.

Various methods have been utilized attempting to contain/nullify SCP-9628, up to and including Akiva Edict, none have succeeded.

Project Delaware represents the Foundation's attempts to utilize SCP-9628 in ending the War. It has thus far been unsuccessful. It is the only hope left.

As of February 14th, EOT, Dr. Madeline Path has been located in The Shivering Kingdom.

This page may have been moved or deleted; however, our assessment is that it ontologically cannot exist. Pages may have rendered their own existence impossible for a number of reasons: They may have offended their authors, glimpsed at antithesis, or they may have reached the conceptual instability threshold, which presently stands at 12% of core concepts, 50% of Foundational concepts, or 27% of narrative concepts.

You may look through the Collapse Log (available upon request, from any Goldbaker & Reinz Provider with multiversal capabilities) if you are looking for a particular page that cannot exist.

SCP-9633, nicknamed “Motus Animi”, is an anomalous influence consisting of its ‘Composer’, SCP-9633-1, and its numerous musical pieces, SCP-9633-2 through SCP-9633-7. It should be noted that there may be many more pieces composing SCP-9633 that the Foundation has not accounted for, and SCP-9633-1 has occasionally implied this to be true.

The entity known as SCP-9633-1, often referred to as the ‘Composer’, claims to represent only a portion of SCP-9633, with the anomalous music pieces representing the rest. It stands at exactly 6 feet tall with a mostly human figure, dressed in a fine black suit with coattails.

SCP-9636 are a species of winged insectoid predators, on average measuring 50 cm with a diameter of 2 cm, and wingspan of 1.5 cm. Select instances have been measured upwards of 4 metres long. SCP-9636 possess translucent bodies resembling nematodes with multiple sets of evenly spaced wings across their lengths. SCP-9636 possess no facial attributes or orifices. SCP-9636 travel at speeds upwards of 286 km/h. SCP-9636 is imperceptible to most animals and has only been observed through recording equipment, rendering detailed analysis impossible, as they also immediately expire and rapidly disintegrate if they are in any way prevented from moving.

SCP-9636 are capable of phasing through any length of solid matter less than the length of their bodies.
I Performed A Daevite Ritual Execution

SCP-9640 is a form of ritual execution that was performed within the ancient Daevite Empire during times of conquest. The ritual, unlike many others of Daevite origin, does not rely on the use of glyphs, ritual objects, or innate thaumaturgical ability. Instead, the ritual's success is entirely dependent on non-anomalous factors. It is of note that no anomalous compulsion to perform SCP-9640 is known to exist.

The following is a relevant passage from SCP-140.

Update: Specific details of SCP-9640 that are present within this passage have been obscured.

SCP-9642 is an amorphous, dense grey polymer mass, originally recorded at a baseline of 40 kg. The object is chemically and biologically inert. Current data indicates it expands in volume by siphoning kinetic and thermal energy from its immediate surroundings, concurrently projecting a cognitohazard that induces profound abulia in nearby human subjects. Prior to formal classification, SCP-9642 was designated "Anomaly-46-B."
Murphy Law in…Skip 9643 - ANOMALIES WITH DIRTY FACES!

Item is a potentially sentient strain of Baudoinia compniacensis that GOI-001 (The Chicago Spirit) cultivated for the purpose of deterring various anomalous entities in eastern Kentucky. Utilizing the remains of deceased individuals and natural limestone deposits, GOI-001 was able to distill a potable fluid that trivialized or negated anomalous presence. Due to the quantity of individuals required to create SCP-9643, and its potentially aggressive nature, mass production is presently unfeasible, though tests to curtail this are ongoing. A classification to Thaumiel is currently under review.
Notice: This report is based on testimonies from civilians who directly interacted with SCP-9645, as well as on memories reconstructed using a Mnestic Memory Reconstructor.

This document is currently under review in light of recent events. Revisions may be made as necessary.

— Maria Jones, Director, RAISA

SCP-9648 are 16 mm long, octagonal, golden pills. Pressed into each is the symbol of a tree with a circle inside it on one side and the number "888" on the other. SCP-9648 are sold in quantities of 8 in blister packs packaged singularly into cardboard boxes. Branding on the boxes proports them to have been manufactured by the Oneiroi Collective under the name "Bhava." Chemical analysis has determined the items to be sugar pills.

When ingested, SCP-9648 induces a state of prolonged confusion, deliriousness, anterograde amnesia, and suggestibility. Starting very minor with a maximum duration of up to 40 minutes, they will worsen in severity over the course of daily use.

SCP-9649 is a white bottle containing, at the time of writing, 49 pills. The bottle measures to 15.2 x 12.7 x 10.2 centimeters, with the walls being ~0.015 centimeters thick. "dado's life changing pills" is written in green marker on the bottle. No other text is present. Request to analyze the plastic-like material of the container is pending.. Dr. Addams, I remember you drilling into me to "not clog up the lab queue". Would your advice not fit here? [RE]

Orally taking a pill results in the subject expiring, with their consciousness transferring to and replacing another human being, hereby designated SCP-9649-1.

SCP-9650 is the designation for a perpetually rising homemade hot air balloon and carriage. It does not appear to require sustained fuel for travel. Both SCP-9650 and its inhabitants are impervious to material and environmental conditions.
The FSD In…. Destroying Your Dreams of Owning a Home

SCP-9653 refers to any rats birthed by RR-1, a Black Rat (Rattus rattus) modified in collaboration with the Department of Engineering and the Fire Suppression Department. All SCP-9653 instances are genetically identical clones of RR-1, measuring 14 centimeters in length with a 16-centimeter tail, and weighing 150 grams.

RR-1, and by extension all SCP-9653 instances, possess the ability to ontokinetically alter any detail about houses that SCP-9653 instances are in. They also possess genetically altered teeth and digestive systems that allow them to digest materials commonly used in house construction, such as drywall, plaster, fiberglass, concrete, and other building materials.
Nematomorpha just want to get outside

SCP-9655 is a species of worm within the phylum Nematomorpha. SCP-9655 possesses the unique ability to parasitise any terrestrial animal, regardless of size or anatomy.

Similar to their non-anomalous relatives, SCP-9655 begin life as free-swimming microscopic larvae hatching from eggs deposited in freshwater by adult instances. A larval SCP-9655 will locate an animal drinking from its water source and swim into the animal's mouth. SCP-9655 will then embed itself within the host's body, usually within the digestive system.

Upon embedding into its host, SCP-9655 begins the first parasitic stage of its life cycle.

SCP-9656 is a logical property of one or more potential series of events concerning the SCP Foundation and an individual named Javis Wilford. Any version of a series of events containing SCP-9656 will inevitably result in the total destruction of the Foundation and the loss of life of all of its personnel, despite no obvious causal precursor to this outcome arising at any time during the course of these events.

To prevent this outcome, the Department of Philosophy has extrapolated a non-exhaustive list of other properties of series of events. These properties are highly correlated with SCP-9656.

SCP-9658 is a recurring entity that manifests as an older Caucasian male and possesses behind the Veil knowledge classified under Level 5 clearance. The first registered sighting of SCP-9658 dates to 1936, when it visited multiple settlements in Eastern Poland, encouraging the residents to build the "Capital of the World" before the "apocalypse". The construction of a village called Wierszalin began in the same year; however, in 1939 local authorities arrested SCP-9658 for leading the unauthorized construction of a temple. The settlement was soon abandoned.

In 2014, the entity began manifesting within a fifty kilometer radius of Wierszalin’s ruins on both Belarusian and Polish sides of the border.

SCP-9660 was a targeted bioweapon deployed by the Pentagram, displaying numerous innovations in anomalous mathematics and biology that would have otherwise classified it as an eigenweapon if not for the highly localized nature of the tool, used to identify and assassinate key Foundation personnel responsible for counterintelligence and anti-espionage operations…

SCP-9661 describes a presumably endless anomalous location, characterized by its progressive transition into a single infinitely long and infinitely wide highway. This designation refers only to the boundless expanse of roads, not anything within it.

SCP-9663 is an anomalous Vachellia erioloba (camelthorn tree), located within South Africa's Kruger National Park. Unlike other instances of this species, the anomaly takes the form of a clonal colony, and forms a single multi-stem tree which covers an area of at least 6.2 hectares within the park, with the appearance of a dense wood of unique individual trees.

SCP-9663's roots are capable of breaching into other worlds through an unknown mechanism. As such, the full size of the anomaly is unknown, though the earliest possible origin for the camelthorn acacia and the observed growth rate indicate a maximum size of 10,000 km 2. Some sections of the colony may have been separated from the main body, making it impossible to determine its full extent.

SCP-9664 is a 100 mL can of pressurized foam shaving cream. The can does not match the make of any known manufacturers; its label is branded with the phrase “ lots-in-1 shave cream ” in large bold text. Scattered across the label in smaller text are additional phrases such as “ efficient bathroom substance,” “ counter space saved,” and “ travel easy.” On the back of the can, in much smaller print, is the phrase “ product of FACTORY.”

The substance within the can is identical in composition to typical non-anomalous foam shaving cream products. Application of this substance (designated SCP-9664-A) to an area of the body that is then passed over with any type of shaving razor, however, will not result in hair being cut.

SCP-9665 are anomalous humanoid entities manifesting near the skyscrapers of New York City. Although SCP-9665 seems to prefer older structures, it is presumed that the buildings chosen by the specimens are random. Instances of SCP-9665 are similar to middle-aged to elderly humans. No obvious patterns to their appearance have been observed so far, besides all instances encountered wearing a full gray-colored tweed suit. Multiple members of personnel have noted that SCP-9665 do not possess distinctive facial features; despite this, no two identical instances have ever been observed.

First encountered by civilians in the late 1920s, all SCP-9665 so far have followed the exact same behavioral pattern.
Operation AEON DAWN; Or, That Time the GOC Killed God
The Foundation goes to war. The Golem of Prague haunts a Nazi wizard. Enrico Fermi borrows a billion dollars of plutonium to kill God. This is how the 7th Occult War ends.

SCP-9667 is a 19 cm (7.5 in) long South American Hercules beetle (Dynastes hercules) that consistently identifies itself as a detective.

SCP-9667 manifests with an approximately 5.08 cm (2 in) long brown-and-tan checkered deerstalker affixed to the top of its horn and is observed smoking a 2.54 cm (1 in) pipe. The mechanism by which SCP-9667 is able to smoke remains unknown, as members of its species lack the respiratory anatomy required for such behavior. The origins of its accessories are likewise unknown. SCP-9667 instances are sapient and fully capable of speaking English consistently with a posh British accent. SCP-9667 mannerisms resemble a late 19th-early 20th Century era detective.
A unit of FRM-9668 consists of one human variant (Homo sapiens) stored as a raw animal (Figure A) or processed into a homogenized liquid (Figure B).

SCP-9669 denotes 6 identical pairs of cosmetic novelty glasses, designated SCP-9669-1 through -6. Instances of SCP-9669 have lenses with a variable but highly saturated tint.

A small slider is present on the left temple of each instance of SCP-9669. When a subject wearing an instance of SCP-9669 adjusts the slider, the subject will exit local reality, coinciding with a shift in the hue of the lenses. This causes the subject to appear to instantaneously physically demanifest.

Subjects who exit local reality via SCP-9669 appear instantaneously in another reality corresponding to the hue of the object's lenses.

SCP-9670 is the annual increase in anomalous activity within the bounds of the West Bank, coinciding with the olive harvesting season. SCP-9670 events usually occur in the vicinity of humans experiencing severe distress or in an otherwise highly emotional state. Objects created by SCP-9670 often display memetic or mnemonic characteristics.

Following the attacks on 7/10/2023, the magnitude of SCP-9670 has dramatically increased, to a point where standard disinformation efforts have become impractical. Following demands by the Israeli Civil Administration to increase containment efforts, the Department of Continuity has taken custody of the anomaly. Containment Procedures have been updated accordingly.

Any speech or writing that describes SCP-9671 is cognitohazardous. Subjects affected by this hazard lose their willingness to interpret statements in any non-literal fashion. While they retain knowledge of literary/rhetorical devices such as metaphor, hyperbole, symbolism, and themes, they refuse to believe that these devices are ever deployed intentionally. Subjects are still capable of unintentionally using figurative language themselves.

The following excerpts are from an interview with a subject affected by this cognitohazard.

SCP-9672-1 is the designation given to 12 pyramid-shaped objects approximately 3,500 km in width and height, which have been observed moving throughout the solar system. SCP-9672-2 resembles Balaenoptera musculus, commonly known as the blue whale, reaching a length of approximately 100 meters. At present, between 16-27 SCP-9672-2 are known to inhabit the solar system, predominantly remaining within SCP-9672-1.

The method by which SCP-9672-2 enters and exits SCP-9672-1 is currently unknown and is presumed to be connected to its origin. SCP-9672-1 is composed of a deep-blue material believed to consist, at least in part, of the remains of deceased SCP-9672-2 instances.

SCP-9676 is a form of exotic life, currently the only known organism to be naturally capable of growing and reproducing in a vacuum.

SCP-9676 instances are spherical, dark-green clumps of vegetative matter, varying widely in size: most instances are likely too small to be detectable with current observational equipment. However, the largest instance currently known has an estimated diameter of 18 kilometers. They derive energy from photosynthesizing sunlight, and gain biomass by extracting nutrients from dust and asteroids via an as-of-yet unknown process. Almost all SCP-9676 instances detected have been found in the Asteroid Belt, but a small number of individuals have been found as far from the sun as in the rings of Saturn.

SCP-9677 is a computer virus about 5 KB in size that primarily targets the model data of virtual YouTubers for infection.

This anomaly infects targets by embedding its own translated source code within their internal programs. The infected model data can be either 2D data (such as Live2D) or 3D data.

SCP-9678 is classified as a stochastic field disruption that anomalously manifests in specific individuals (designated SCP-9678-1). The mechanism of selection remains unknown.

SCP-9678-1 instances carry a stochastic disruption charge (SDC) of high intensity, expressed as consistent patterns of statistically improbable adverse events (“bad luck”). Family and close friends absorb a small fraction of this charge, lessening its impact on the infected individual. This characteristic renders personal relationships especially important to SCP-9678-1, not only for charge distribution but also for the emotional support that mitigates stress caused by SCP-9678.

SCP-9679 is a 4.8 m tall long-case clock made of red wood and a gold-colored metal. At irregular intervals, SCP-9679 spontaneously moves itself across different locations in space and time. During such event, matter within 15 m are typically displaced alongside it.

Nine manifestations of SCP-9679 have been documented as of 2026 since its initial recovery in 1922. The interval of SCP-9679’s relocation events have ranged from several hours to multiple decades, with no identified correlation between the date and duration of these events. However, SCP-9679 has demonstrated a significant tendency to manifest in a geographical location that is densely populated by humanity. The cause of this is unknown and under investigation.

SCP-9680 are specific packets of 30 different seed varieties from the Méndez Corporation. Species have been found to vary with no clear pattern or majority species, but primarily consist of food or textile crops (wheat, corn, cotton, sugarcane, etc.) SCP-9680 instances appear identical to nonanomalous equivalents sold by Méndez, but exhibit rapid growth patterns when planted. These extend to increased success not only in growth of planted seeds, but in seed production, pollen spread, and fruit production.

SCP-9680 instances have been sold in Northern India for the past three years. Instances have been found in small mandis in the states of Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, and Himachal Pradesh.

SCP-9681 are the fossilized remains of an unknown clade of prehistoric life that do not conform to established biological, mathematical, and chronological principles. At present, over 300 instances of SCP-9681 have been exhumed globally.

SCP-9681 instances display a variety of disparate, unorthodox physiological features across each sample, leaving Foundation research unable to draw conclusions regarding the group’s appearance, behavior, or ancestry. Further taxonomy remains impossible.

All verifiable information regarding SCP-9681 is summarized below:
• SCP-9681 were colossal, with individual bones ranging from 15 to 35 meters in height
• SCP-9681 had more variation on an anatomical level than any other known organism.

SCP-9682 is a massive hostile entity which currently inhabits the Land of Harvest. It is quadrupedal, with each limb ending in several curved blades that can be extended and retracted at will. Its skin is protected by a dense, impermeable fuzz, upon which is patterned a multitude of dark spots resembling dead eyes.

SCP-9682 has not demonstrated the ability to feel fear or any fear-adjacent emotions, such as worry, caution, or suspicion. It is unknown if this is anomalous or simply a result of its extreme physical prowess. Additionally, despite being classified as an omnivore, it is believed to possess a strong preference for mouseflesh.

SCP-9686 is a standard 220V AC, 120 Watt light bulb that dims all light sources within a 20-meter effective range when activated. There are currently 27 22 SCP-9686 instances. The SCP has a ‘SERCO’ brand mark corresponding to its place of discovery. Its internal filament consists of an unidentified material distinct from tungsten, showing an irregular structure.
