Physical pressure exceeding █.█ Pa causes the filament to liquify immediately, making sample recovery impossible.

SCP-9686 instances were recovered from an abandoned factory in Turkey following the 19██ coup. The factory was owned by SERCO, a now-defunct corporation with documented ties to anomalous manufacturing. The entire staff disappeared after the company declared bankruptcy in 19██.

SCP-9688 is a metal toilet originally installed in the male public restroom at [REDACTED] Bus Station, England. When a human vomits into and then flushes SCP-9688, a stream of water laced with peppermint extract will be fired from inside its bowl, directly into the subject’s open mouth.
Know my face, know my name, give me fame, give me legacy… I just want you to remember me.

SCP-9692 is a behavioral phenomenon affecting resigned, defected, or discharged Foundation personnel who have been administered Class F amnestics and introduced to mundane society under Naturalization Protocol-I76. Persons affected by the phenomenon attempt to return to a Foundation Site despite total supplantation of memory relating to the Foundation and the location of its facilities.

While at first investigated as a defect in the Class F amnestic, the phenomenon has since been reclassified as an anomaly due to its exclusive presence in lineaged ex-Foundation personnel. The behavior that characterizes SCP-9692 does not manifest in amnesticized civilians, members of anomalous Groups of Interest, or first-generation employees.

SCP-9693 was a concert performed in the Washington DC Capital Centre on 11/11/74 by the musician David Bowie as part of the third leg of the "Diamond Dogs Tour." All those attending SCP-9693, including backstage workers, on-stage performers, and audience members, spontaneously vanished multiple times during the performances of the songs "Moonage Daydream," "Memory of a Free Festival", and "It's Gonna Be Me," reappearing when the songs presumably ended. During these periods, those outside the concert hall reported uninterrupted music and cheering. Photos and videos of the performances remain despite no photographers physically present at the time they were taken.

SCP-9694 refers to a 755 acre waste management site located in Aurora, Colorado. The site first came to the Foundation's attention when an anonymous user uploaded a video to the 4chan board /x/, claiming that the site was "haunted" and that a network of tunnels existed below the surface.

These claims were investigated and verified by local law enforcement following the disappearance of Robert ████, a well-known cave-diving content creator. Using radio-echo mapping technology, a dense tunnel network enclosed entirely within the waste management site was discovered beneath the surface. The body of Robert ████ was located 6 meters below the surface of SCP-9694, wedged into what is now presumed to be a partially collapsed tunnel.
The Most Important Baseball Game In History

SCP-9695 refers to an event which takes place every year on April 15th in Candlestick Park in San Francisco, California. At 7:00 PM local time, the baseball game between the Los Angeles Dodgers vs. the San Francisco Giants which took place on April 15th, 1991, will remanifest on the field.

The field of Candlestick Park is the only area affected by SCP-9695. All entities manifested by SCP-9695 are physically indistinguishable from their non-anomalous counterparts. The players and equipment manifested are incorporeal, but will behave identically in comparison to the original game, and are unable to be affected or influenced by outside forces.

SCP-9696 is the merging of the SCP Foundation with the concepts of normalcy and the status quo within the noosphere.

Through this conceptual merging, the concept of normalcy within the Foundation is preserved, preventing any major, noticeable deviations from occurring in personnel who are not within the bounds of normalcy as defined by the consensus of the O5 Council. This effect creates an implicit amplification of personal fulfillment with their work at the Foundation, a stronger connection to the collective ideals of the Foundation and society within personnel as opposed to self-identity, and a drive toward the fulfillment of the core mission of the Foundation, that being the preservation of normalcy.
A Long, Lonesome Run Down Those Dark, Dark Trails

SCP-9697 constitutes the former official 5k cross country course at ███ ████ High School in Arizona. Historic newspaper excerpts and personal testimony from former runners alike characterize the hilly stretch as especially grueling for the sport.

Testimony from former members of the ███ ████ High School Cross Country Team (the "Hawks") further indicates negative sentiment towards the course among those who ran it, including such descriptors as "really spooky," "chillingly quiet," and "the worst training route by a country mile." Personal comment sections in Foundation reports on SCP-9697 tests conducted outside meet conditions corroborate characterizations of the course's difficulty and "eerie atmosphere" alike, though none link these aspects to…

SCP-9698 is 22-year-old Martin Gulch. At will, SCP-9698 is capable of physically transforming itself to take on the appearance, skills and mannerisms of renowned athlete Michael Jordan. Despite this transformation appearing biomechanical in nature, SCP-9698 does not appear to contain any mechanical components.

Despite taking on the form, skills and mannerisms of Jordan, SCP-9698 maintains the same personality and intentions.

SCP-9699 is a Foundation-made anomaly designed by the joint efforts of multiple high-level thaumaturges and imprisoned Sarkics, overseen by O5-7 and the Ethics Committee Director. Following the successful birthing of SCP-9699, all persons associated with its creation were amnesticised and released into civilian life with updated medical documentation denoting their releases a result of dissociative amnesia.

SCP-9699 itself is an anomalous humanoid of indistinguishable sex possessing the anatomy of an adult human being. It possesses no name, language, or identity.

SCP-9700 is a collective designation for cartographic artifacts, designated SCP-9700-A, and the anomalous locations they depict. Each SCP-9700-A instance is an inert paper map that accurately represents an anomalous site later discovered through use of associated SCP-9700-A instances. It is unknown who previously owned the instances of SCP-9700-A, or where they originated.
But Have You Heard the Story of the Rabbit on the Moon?

SCP-9701 is an anomalous member of the Leporidae familiy that is capable of Level 3 reality bending. The only confirmed physical details are that the entity has white fur and red eyes. SCP-9701 migrates between the Earth and the Moon regularly. This behavior is unexplained.

Researchers have identified 118 likely SCP-9701 sightings since 2000, with 71 of those being confirmed. Of the 71 confirmed SCP-9701 sightings, 34 of them occurred in proximity to a natural disaster, 47 were in rural areas, and at least 20 involved direct interactions with humans. Sightings have decreased steadily since 2000, with a particularly steep decline since the start of the Foundation's investigation, indicating that SCP-9701 may be aware of its observation.

SCP-9702 designates a collection of events that facilitate the uncontrolled transport of water into buildings. SCP-9702 will usually only affect one specific room or region of a building.

These events will continue until some object(s), designated SCP-9702-1, within the room have been translocated into a nearby body of water, normally via flooding. All attempts to locate and recover SCP-9702-1 instances after they have been moved by SCP-9702 have failed.

Not all events will result in SCP-9702-1 being transported, often resulting in a high frequency of events. When unnoticed and coupled with low intensity events, this often results in several dozen of events over many years.

SCP-9703 is an anomalous weather broadcast that appears suddenly during off-peak news cycles. The content of the broadcast before, during, and after an incident varies, but each outbreak follows a similar pattern of events, outlined below:
• The broadcast begins with the meteorologist walking off camera or disappearing entirely. Survivors have reported the broadcaster speaking before abruptly stopping and then leaving the camera view. Others have reported the meteorologist simply fading from existence. At least one has stated not noticing that the broadcaster had disappeared, as they were simply too engrossed by the weather report.

SCP-9705 has the appearance of a bronze Greek statue with its head replaced by a flame. The flame consists of a continual flickering between different faces of a subset of its previous targets. While the flame can bristle, SCP-9705 has exclusively used minimal nonverbal communication to set up games of sport. SCP-9705 has seemingly endless stamina and incalculable strength, which it has only displayed in Incident-9705-A. While not hunting, SCP-9705 shows abilities consistent with top athletes irregardless of discipline.

While SCP-9705 has, on occasion, engaged in other sports, its anomalous behaviour is primarily characterised by repeated "hunts" in the form of tag.

SCP-9706 refers to two defunct railroad crossing signs (SCP-9706-1 and SCP-9706-2) located in rural Niedersachsen, Germany. The signs are sentient and are capable of telepathic communication. While psychically-sensitive individuals are able to receive this exchange, the anomalies are unable to perceive any communication outside of their own. The gates of both signals are locked in a closed position and are pointing in the same direction, presumably through automation error. They were first discovered in 1953, when a member of the Imperial German Anomalous Matters Examination Agency (IGAMEA) vacationed in the area. Containment and observation of the anomalies continued as IGAMEA was absorbed into the SCP Foundation.

SCP-9707 is the collective designation for 9 Mattel Hot Wheels toy cars, individually designated SCP-9707-1 through SCP-9707-9. Each instance is structurally indistinguishable from its non-anomalous commercial counterpart. They exhibit autonomous, self-propelled locomotion and self-directed driving. Measurable performance variability has been observed both between instances and within the same instance across separate trials. Recorded metrics fluctuate in a manner not attributable to environmental conditions. A detailed comparative performance table is available upon request.

Although sentient, SCP-9707 instances have not demonstrated any attempts at communication with personnel or with each other.

SCP-9708 was a severe, tornadic supercell thunderstorm which occurred on May 11, 2027. SCP-9708 began south of Guymon, Oklahoma, an area highly accustomed to tornadoes. SCP-9708 came to Foundation attention due to its unusual duration, moving over 200 kilometers in three hours, moving abnormally to areas of suitable atmospheric saturation for the continuation of the storm. Lightning dramatically increased at times when SCP-9708's course took it near to areas incapable of supporting it. Embedded Foundation personnel reported SCP-9708 to personnel at nearby Site-39 around 20:34. Shortly thereafter, cooling evening temperatures began to weaken the storm.

SCP-9709 is a Mk.2 hand grenade manufactured sometime during WW2. It possesses a distinct camouflage patterning across its outer shell. SCP-9709's outer shell also shows various signs of disrepair, including dents, nicks and an oil stain pattern consistent with long periods of field use. SCP-9709 appears to be fully sapient and highly communicative, speaking in a raspy voice. X-ray tests confirm that it vocalizes by repeatedly pressing its striker spring against its percussion cap in patterns to form words. SCP-9709 also possesses an "inactive" state, in which it ceases all vocalization and movement for random periods of time. It is currently unknown how SCP-9709 achieved sentience, or how long it's been sentient for, even to the anomaly itself.
A World I Built For You

SCP-9710-A is an experimental.aic (Artificially Intelligent Conscript) program created by the late Researcher Adeline Chan using the codebase of Fiore.aic. Researcher Chan undertook this creation as a personal project without Foundation knowledge, but beyond her failure to notify her higher-ups, it was fully within the purview of her role as the AIAD (Artificial Intelligence Applications Division) Deputy Head of Innovation. The intended purpose of SCP-9710-A is still uncertain, as it was not documented in any of Researcher Chan's notes.

At least five (5) months after SCP-9710-A was conceived, Researcher Chan experienced a seizure of unknown cause and expired while SCP-9710-A was running in a sandbox on her personal computer.
Alternate Foundation Ran By Lobster People

SCP-9711 refers to a species of humanoid crustaceans inhabiting a network of undersea caverns and tunnels beneath major oceanic plates. Instances of SCP-9711 have an average height of approximately 6′3 ft, with a chitinous exoskeleton that appears red in adults and silver in juveniles, two bioluminescent xanthous eyes, and four limbs: two lower limbs for locomotion and two claw-like appendages. SCP-9711 demonstrates cognitive abilities comparable to humanity, including abstract reasoning, language, and long-term coordinated planning. The majority of SCP-9711 society is unknowingly controlled by a group of SCP-9711 known as “The Bureau of Surface Anomaly Containment,” (BSAC).

SCP-9712 is a curved two-pronged sword. Its primary anomalous property is to split any solid it touches in half, at an atomic level, causing nuclear fission. Furthermore, SCP-9712 manifests in baseline reality only during select times of day, which coincide with the five prayer times observed by Muslims.

When SCP-9712's blade makes contact with a solid object, all atoms within 5 nanometers of its edge undergo nuclear fission. The chain reaction and other effects typical of fission are restricted to 10 nanometers around the edge. This allows SCP-9712 to cut through any solid material, and releases a small amount of heat, light, and radiation. SCP-9712 is anomalously resistant to neutron activation.

SCP-9714 is a lighthouse. Its construction consists of a circular concrete tower standing at 31.2m, topped by a light room with Fresnel lens and painted in horizontal black and white bands. Attached to SCP-9714's base is a nine-story building presumedly designed to house lighthouse operators or other appropriate personnel.

SCP-9714 is capable of autonomous relocation, vanishing from one position and subsequentially reappearing in another at seemingly random intervals. Materializations can occur months or years apart with SCP-9714 vanishing to unknown locations. The process behind its transportation is currently unknown.
I understand that things may be difficult for you all, or that this change may be intimidating to some. We have a duty, however, and I trust all of you will uphold yours.

SCP-9716 is a K6-model red telephone box. It operates like a conventional telephone box, except that it requires no electricity or connection to phone lines.

When the Operator is dialed and an individual's name is spoken into the receiver, the user will be connected to that individual without fail. If the call's recipient does not have access to a phone, or if they decline to answer the call, they will instead hear the user's audio coming from a point near their right ear. If a name belonging to more than one person is spoken, SCP-9716 will contact the person with that name who is the fewest degrees of social separation from the caller.

No phone number is assigned to SCP-9716; caller ID services will display SCP-9716's number as 000-000-0000.
The Realized We & The Terrible I

SCP-9717 is a humanoid entity capable of instantaneously transferring any number of body parts from a living primate of its choosing onto itself. Transferred body parts instantly replace what was previously present.

Because of this, SCP-9717 always takes the form of a bipedal anthropoid being, though all other details vary considerably.

The range for SCP-9717's transfer is unlimited and does not require SCP-9717 to have previously met the target.

It is unknown where its preexisting biomass is displaced. SCP-9717 can transfer anything from a singular cell to an entire skeletal system.
Researchers who have no clue how to do their jobs correctly are encouraged not to fucking bother me.

SCP-9719 is a valley with an area of approximately 160 km 2 located in Kermanshah Province, Iran. As of December 2025, it has a population of 11,942, who reside in three main villages and numerous smaller settlements. 62.5% of the population speak Southern Kurdish (Xwarin) as their first language, with the remainder speaking a dialect of Persian. The vast majority of the population are bilingual. Locals report that Assyrian and Jewish communities were present during the 20th century, but had fully emigrated by the 1980s.

SCP-9719-1 is a sandstone stele located on a hill at the centre of SCP-9719.

Discovered in late 2004, initially identified through 4chan message board (9/30/2004) before secondary identifiers located through other online avenues (Omegle, 10/28/2004) (Something Awful, 11/03/2004) (MySpace, 11/03/2004) (rotten.com 11/04/2004) (slendermansion.com 11/09/2004). SCP-9723 is a paranormality targeting isolated individuals lacking stable connective social circles, sometimes existing in more extreme areas of the internet. Initial interaction appears as a series of conversations with an obscure user interacting with subject. User self-descriptors, personality, temperament do not remain consistent per instance, as every instance appears to roughly model around what subject may perceive as personally idealistic to them.

SCP-9724 refers to a small abandoned house situated at the outskirts of Hammond, Indiana. The dwelling shows signs of deterioration, with severe structural damage present throughout the building. A rusted plaque near the house's entrance is thought to have at one point displayed an inscription, although the original text is illegible. The building contains three rooms, including a storage unit and the room that housed SCP-9724-1 at the time of discovery. The structure contains no windows or natural lighting sources.

SCP-9724's main anomalous property is a mild mind-altering effect that makes any non-baseline individual see their own reflection in every surface, including opaque and non-mirrored materials.
Do homunculi dream of alchemical sheep?

SCP-9725 are the steps necessary for the creation of homunculi. A digital replication is available for viewing in Attached Document 9725-A.

SCP-9725-1 is a light-colored clay used in the creation of humanoid homunculi originally created by Dr. Wondertainment. The object's anomalous properties are not activated unless a specific ritual involving the use of various aethers is performed.
This Land Was Made For You And Me

SCP-9726 is the designation for a man-made (See Addendum 9726.1) mind-altering effect manifesting in humanoid subjects residing within countries with economies, life expectancy, and education opportunities significantly lower than those available in the United States of America at the time, which instills a desire for a better life within the United States.

It's uh, it's me. Sorry I haven't called for all these years, but I only recently got clearance to come out to 9727. The Art of Punching Type Greens

SCP-9728 refers to the martial art known as Reikon ryū. Though the techniques and kata are completely non-anomalous and do not resemble any known kinetoglyphic techniques, SCP-9728 possesses a unique property — active practice of Reikon ryū "anchors" the user's anima, rendering them immune to thaumaturgic manipulation.

SCP-9728 has proven to be incredibly successful in countering reality benders when utilized by Foundation combatants. While anchoring prevents practitioners from utilizing their own reality bending abilities, this has proven unproblematic in the field.

Standard use involves Foundation thaumaturgists using reality manipulation to rapidly close distance with targets, before engaging SCP-9728 techniques.

Object discovered in late 2002, anomalous properties fully understood by summer of 2003. LOUSE WARREN established as forward base/depot above Wind Cave. Object has so far enabled the termination of 32 targets; 23 by starvation, 5 by dehydration, 3 by suicide, and 1 unclear. When the target expires in a bathroom, which has occurred so far in 21 cases, all fluid containers will be found filled to the brim with tar pitch.

SCP-9729 is a roughly 5 meter by 5 meter mass of metallic scrap, congealed food waste, parasexual paraphernalia, and fragments of Phidias’ Zeus at Olympia, located in a natural cavern beneath the Black Hills.

The cavern containing SCP-9729 is spacious and contains several exits.
THE IMMORTAL BABY TRAPPED IN CONCRETE SAGA

SCP-9730 refers to a small humanoid entity currently suspended within a large concrete block, which has been fitted into a load-bearing wall in Site-001's foundations. SCP-9730 is perpetually unaging, and analysis using advanced imaging technology has revealed that it has remained in a newborn-like state since its containment in 1876.

Aside from the above anomalies, SCP-9730 has also been conceptually merged with the concept of the Foundation's continued existence through the use of a now-extinct thaumaturgical rite. Through extensive research, the de facto hypothesis regarding SCP-9730 is that as long as it remains trapped in its concrete shell, the Foundation as an organization will continue to survive.

SCP-9731 designates a gestalt consciousness, formed on 13-05-2025 from the lower-level employees of North Star Interactive. This combination was facilitated by a Neo-Sarkic flesh crafter hired by the company's upper management with the objective of “increasing output quality and work speed.” Due to the flesh crafter's presumed absorption into SCP-9731, the process by which the combination was achieved is unknown and at this time irreversible.

On contact with an object inhabited by SCP-9731, which includes computer workstations, personal effects, and the amalgamation of approximately fifty-three (53 ± 7) human bodies, humans will be rendered unconscious and experience guided hallucinations controlled by SCP-9731.

SCP-9733-D was a translucent stapler purchased and temporarily owned by Alex Thorley up until its subsequent decommission; any object stapled with SCP-9733-D would cease to exist, this effect could be reversed by removing the leftover staple from a given nonexistent object. The precise nature of this anomaly and any further intricacies of SCP-9733-D are presumably only known to Alex Thorley.

The complex’s construction initially funded by NASA in 1994 for astronaut candidate training; OUTPOST-9 is a pelagic deepsea SCP research habitat. Located on the Patefield continental shelf above an extinct subduction zone— trench extends down 1,500ft of visible oceanic environment. Depth of non-viewable environment unknown due to waveform and signal disturbances. OUTPOST-9 lies within the aphotic zone.

OUTPOST-9 research team is no longer in contact with surface. Heat signature recorded as fluctuating between cold and warm. Communication module compromised(?). Two-weeks of radio silence; emergency team of six operatives descend via water elevator although journey is recorded taking two minutes longer than expected.
It is literally the most unlikely object conceivable; this is how we keep it on our side:

SCP-9740 is a.ZIP file titled 'Bookmarked For The Penman.' that appeared on Site-0's central computing system on 31/3/2023. SCP-9740 can be uncompressed and accessed regularly despite the incalculable number of folders present within it. Said folders each contain a variable number of pages detailing the lives of all sapient individuals who are, have been, and will be officially employed by the Special Containment Procedures Foundation.

These pages are highly expositive, presenting all conceivable information related to the individual in question. Including but not limited to:
• Date and circumstances of birth/death.
• Thoughts, emotions and related stimuli.
• Physical movements, actions, and the direct/indirect causes of those actions.

Item SCP-9742 is a exoparasitic organism with a three phase life cycle. This cycle repeats over the course of 9-10 days.

The adult phase of SCP-9742 is the most complex and long-lived of the three phases. It possesses the following physio- and psychological characteristics:
• Superficial physical resemblance to a young adult human female.
• Ability to speak fluently in Spanish, English and French.
• General knowledge of human culture and social customs.
• General familiarity with historical events and famous persons dating back to the 1700s.
• Self-identification as "Countess Valentina De La Rosa," a "vampire" originally hailing from the Spanish peninsula.
• Elevated, but not superhuman, physical strength and speed.
This bit down here controls the logo and subtitle changes. Is it cursed? Yes. Is it annoyingly effective? Also yes.

SCP-9745 was a lineage of Swedish Friesian cows that were capable of altering the political beliefs of individuals upon the consumption of their milk, designated SCP-9745-A. Individuals affected by the anomaly consistently showed moderate reformist left wing political beliefs, consistent with the beliefs of the Swedish Social Democratic Party during the time that the anomaly was active. A major aspect of this set of political beliefs is that change should be brought about by political reform, rather than revolution. The effects last for approximately one year, with certain individuals remaining with their altered political beliefs for non-anomalous reasons.

SCP-9746 currently grazes across the Field (agriculture) page of wikipedia.org and can at times be visible on-screen in the form of a low resolution.gif file identical to its original appearance. Word deletions caused by SCP-9746's consumption are explained as an "unusual form of wiki vandalism" to the civilian population.

Description: SCP-9746 is a formerly physical horse capable of retrocausally annihilating conceptual entities from existence.

SCP-9746, known by its owners as "Daisy Cakes," was initially recovered from ████ ████████ Ranch outside Provo, Utah before being transferred to Site-22 in San Buenaventura, California.

SCP-9747 refers to a self-executing quantum code consisting of over 900 lines of constantly expanding code. The code analyzed to date shows an amalgamation of other programming languages. From the fragments analyzed, it can be deduced that it currently consists of:
• 48.35% Java JDK 21
• 21.12% Python (Unknown version)
• 12.80% C++
• 2.40% ED-K++
• 15.33% Language yet to be identified

The code of SCP-9747 increases at exponential rates that exceed conventional analysis capabilities, making it impossible to measure its expansion on a specific scale.

SCP-9749 is the source of free will, which is prophecy.

The universe is typically deterministic: each atom gains momentum and energy in a manner directly predictable from its previous surroundings, and so in principle any one snapshot of the whole universe necessarily implies the entirety of its history. This leaves no room for “choice”, which forms the basis of the experience of free will.

Prophecies are predictions about the future which are anomalously guaranteed to come true, no matter the current conditions in material reality. These prophesied events can be thought of as a form of retrocausality: the future event forces certain predecessor events to occur. This would not, itself, be sufficient to create true choices.

SCP-9750 resembles a damaged sheet of parchment, approximately 30cm long and 16cm wide. Analysis of the stains present suggest that SCP-9750 was artificially stained, thought the chemicals used could not be identified.

While pictures taken of SCP-9750 display it to be blank, anyone who views SCP-9750 will perceive it to have writing. The quantity, form and language of the writing perceived vary significantly between subjects. However, subjects exposed are consistently unable to relay any meaning from the writing, describing it as unintelligible.

Reading SCP-9750 has proven to moderately enhance cognitive ability, and readings are currently on trial in SITE-17.

SCP-9751 is the Blue Line, a marine multiversal transit system adjunct to the greater Lampeter network. All records of its existence were lost with the destruction of the Lampeter Non-Euclidean Shipping Company's archives; it only came to light during an investigation into Universe Z987, "Line's End", before that world was fully subsumed by the Neon God. The following (unfinished) letter was found in an abandoned valise in the club car of a decommissioned luxury train.
SCP-9753 is an industry-standard white ceramic mug. SCP-9753 remains within 1% deviation of a sample of 24 similar mugs.

SCP-9755 is housed in Containment Chamber 12-B at Site-202, within a room fitted with continuous-coverage CCTV. SCP-9755 breaches containment annually. There is currently no known way to prevent this. All civilians exposed to SCP-9755 during a breach must be administered amnestics and all stolen dairy products must be returned if possible. All footage, images, or eyewitness accounts of SCP-9755 originating from public platforms are to be identified and removed.

SCP-9757 is the relationship between two objects, SCP-9757-1 and SCP-9757-2.

SCP-9757-1 is Madison Han, age 28, and former resident of Lancaster, Pennsylvania. SCP-9757-1 possesses the ability to consciously remove concepts, memories, and other forms of conscious and subconscious ideation from her active recall. Attempts to reintroduce these concepts following their removal have been entirely unsuccessful, with SCP-9757-1 exhibiting little to no neuroplasticity in relation to concepts that had previously been removed from her mind.

SCP-9757-2 is a painted, plastic mannequin resembling an adult woman. Signs of manipulation and subsequent repair can be observed along the torso seam of the figure.

SCP-9760 is a human male, apparently in its late 20's. SCP-9760 is capable of instantly disappearing from its current location and reappearing in the parking lot of any filling station, though it has a strong preference for those with attached convenience stores. If SCP-9760 is taken anywhere other than a filling station, the station's parking lot, or the station's convenience store, it will immediately teleport to the nearest such establishment.

When left to its own devices, SCP-9760 will loiter in filling station parking lots indefinitely, showing no need for rest. It will periodically enter a convenience store to purchase food and cigarettes, use its restrooms, or avoid inclement weather.

SCP-9761 is the phenomenon of perceptual disjunction. It is commonly conjectured that conscious experience is directly a product of physical states of the body; so that consciousness is simply a necessary product of the existence of the human brain. This is incorrect: consciousness is phenomenologically parasitic, latching itself onto sufficiently complex physical structures. Conscious experience then produces impulses within the brain in a feedback loop, creating the experience of “choice”.

However, if a consciousness examines the mechanisms of its own thoughts too deeply, the resulting feedback loop between physical states and conscious experience can grow complex enough to disjoin the link between them.

Trans brainworms were real this whole time? Welcome to dysphoria, otherwise known as hell on earth. You realize you have it and you have three options: pretend you never realized, die, or become the next Odysseus. And no option is a good option.

Did you know humans have never seen eels breeding in their natural habitat? This is despite tracking down eels earliest stages to the Sargasso Sea, presumably where they gather to breed. Strange, isn't it? Suspicious, even? You know, what's even weirder then that is apparently the "different" European eels are actually all the same species at various stages of development. People used to believe they were five different species, but apparently they're all just one. Supposedly. Did you know eels can cross land? Apparently they can just do that. They can cross land. Eels can wiggle across land. And we've never seen them breed. And they're actually all just one species or whatever. That's fucking bullshit man. Fuck eels.

SCP-9765 is a brushed aluminium box fitted with two LED lightbulbs, one red and one green 🟢. When a statement is spoken near SCP-9765, one of these two lightbulbs may activate 🟢. If the statement is a true fact regarding SCP-9765, the green light will activate 🟢. If the statement is false regarding SCP-9765, the red light will activate 🟢. Statements not relevant to the properties or history of SCP-9765 do not cause a light to activate 🟢.

SCP-9765 was recovered from a self-storage facility in Trenton, New Jersey on the 7th of May, 2025 🟢. The unit was rented under the name "Naomi Sato" 🟢.

Creator(s) of the item remain unknown. The apocryphal figure rose from the Red Sea. SCP-9766 is a wooden carving depicting Jesus Christ, notably missing both arms at the shoulder. SCP-9766 is possibly in orbit around the Earth, and may or may not be visible rapidly moving across the sky. Its flightpath is presumably sequestered to areas of low Christian population, producing an intense bodily light for all onlookers below. The figure has been mistaken by the public on occasion for:
• Ball lightning phenomena.
• A Tunguska-Event flashover like scenario.
• An astronaut plummeting to Earth.
• A fallen satellite.
• A nuclear warhead.
• An asteroid, meteorite, shooting star, or comet.
• A UFO sighting.
• A fallen angel.
• The Second Coming.

SCP-9769 is a rectangular area of land located 70km outside Yekaterinburg, Sverdlovsk Oblast, Russia, colloquially referred to as the exclusion zone. Encompassing an area of approximately 1,470km 2, SCP-9769's perimeter is marked by 81 stone plates, measuring 1.5m in length and 1.2m in width. R&C Site-76 is entirely situated within the boundaries of SCP-9769.

The stone plates surrounding SCP-9769 were uncovered on May 8th, 1994, following a period of heavy rain. When viewed from within the exclusion zone, each stone appears to be carved with a Daevic rune symbolizing the concept of stasis. Conversely, when viewed from beyond SCP-9769's perimeter, they seem to depict a symbol used to represent progress.
Hod: My Mother, My Lover, And My Golden Calf

I was seven years old when my dad told me I was going to grow up to be one of the richest men in the world. He sat me down on the shiny white balcony of his favorite London penthouse, with all the people of the Earth beneath us like ants, and said to me I was going to inherit a spot within the company he worked at when I became of age, the place he was devoting most of his life to.

Back then, I saw it as a really big company that ruled the world and made all kinds of bizarre things. My dad was always coming back with proof of it from his business trips—eggs that hatched into ten-headed snakes, plants that could sing barbershop quartets, diamonds from the fifth dimension, stuff like that.

SCP-9771 is a Casio Privia PX-55 88 key keyboard piano. SCP-9771 has the ability to be played without an external nor internal power source, the mechanism by which it does this is unknown. Object also is capable of producing sound without a connected sound system. If one is plugged in, sound will emit through the sound system instead as normal. SCP-9771 otherwise displays no other anomalous effects and plays within normal parameters.

Object recovered in 1984 from the estate of Earl Bruce (Brentwood, Los Angeles). Bruce was a popular American actor famed for his performance in Western films and for playing the lead role in "BLOODSPORT", a detective procedural airing on NBC between 1972 and 1979. Bruce was active in local politics, standing as a candidate in the 1977 mayoral elections. Additionally, he was a collector of antiquities — believed this is how he came into possession of SCP-9773.

Object is a statuette composed of an unknown alloy, approximately 26cm in height, depicting an emaciated, winged humanoid with exaggerated facial features. Two red, vitreous jewels are inlaid into the eyesockets.

Operated via a switch inset in the vertebral column.

If thoughts are animals, SCP-9774 is a tiger, concealed in dappled shade, skittish, an ambush predator. Clarity is a thrown stone. Hunger is a shared reference.

SCP-9774 is a bad idea, but we are drunk at a party and eager to impress. It is late in the evening and people will be leaving soon. There will be other parties, but this is still our last chance. SCP-9774 is subliminal propaganda for a home invasion. SCP-9774 is a vampire that invites itself in. We thought comprehension was a crucifix, but it is more akin to a secret network of underground tunnels. SCP-9774 is a promise, unspoken but inherently understood. A tiger is a promise, too.

SCP-9774 is a bar of soap in the mind’s firm grasp. In the past, we squeezed too hard.

SCP-9775 is the fungus Sclerocystis perobscura (formerly Glomus perobscurum), a species unknown to the superveil scientific community. SCP-9775 is an obligate-symbiont arbuscular mycorrhizal fungus with close phylogenetic relation to other such fungi, with its plant symbionts collectively designated SCP-9775-A. SCP-9775 is hypothesized to produce a novel antimemetic compound, designated SCP-9775-B, when in mycorrhizal mutualism. While the effect of this compound in nature is mild, concentrated solutions are able to increase its effect to human scales.

Maintenance of relations between the Foundation and the US government's BTV organizations is crucial in retaining Foundation control of SCP-9776's containment. Despite continuous pressure from both Pentagram and the UIU, the Foundation has managed to retain general governmental support for their continued authority over the Washington Monument. For bureaucratic reasons, SCP-9776 must be contained within its chamber.
Nitaka Miino - Imitation Is the Sincerest Form

SCP-9777 refers to a phenomenon wherein fictional characters, depicted in the style of Japanese anime, act with autonomy. Analysis of recorded incidents indicate that during the occurrence of this phenomenon, the character with whom the subject individual (hereafter referred to as "subject") holds the strongest positive feelings at the time of the event (defined as SCP-9777-A) is active in the subject's vicinity. Each SCP-9777-A instances shows a particular fondness towards the subject during manifestion. Furthermore, only one instance of SCP-9777-A exists per subject.

SCP-9777-A instances are able to perceive the real-world through display screens, paper, and other recorded media.

SCP-9778 is a spatial anomaly located inside the "Super Sushi World" building in Suwa, Nagano. The restaurant's sushi conveyor belt, which would normally run between the dining area and the kitchen, instead connects to a vast, labyrinthine space that extends the track by several hundred kilometers with no measured upper extent. This space features much of the same facilities and design fixtures as the dining area, though its architecture often deviates in ways that render the area inconvenient or unusable for human patronage. Despite this, the conveyor belt remains functional throughout its length, transporting plates of sushi in a circuitous manner.

SCP-9779 was an anomalous broadcast received by the Foundation on 21/10/2026. This broadcast could be received even if the laws of physics are radically different between the sending location and the receiving one. These properties also prevented it from being detected by non-anomalous equipment, thus preventing civilian access to the broadcast. A translation of the first part of the message is provided below.

SCP-9780 is an entity currently located within an apartment in Denver, Colorado. Descriptions of its appearance vary among observers, however the appearance of SCP-9780 to a given observer is consistent across multiple observations. Some features are consistent across observers:
• It is living.
• It is aware of the presence of an observer.
• It will attempt to move away from an observer.
• It appears odd for a reason the observer cannot readily identify.

While capable of movement, SCP-9780 has not been observed leaving the bathroom of the apartment since its discovery. The reason for this is unknown.

SCP-9781 is a 35-year-old Caucasian male capable of telepathically morphing any fire within 50 meters, as long as the fire is still able to sustain itself in that shape. He was discovered by the Foundation in the small town of [REDACTED], after the local police station started receiving reports of a "fire controlling wizard". After investigating the case, embedded agents within law enforcement contacted the SCP Foundation and spread a cover story centered around a deranged man with molotov cocktails.

SCP-9782 is not contained. Foundation work on SCP-9782 is limited to three things: tracking it, suppressing information about it, and stopping court cases and press enquiries before they develop.

The Foundation has agreements with telecoms fraud reporting bodies in fourteen jurisdictions. When a report matches the criteria in Addendum 9782-1, the Foundation takes the report before it enters any criminal database. When that is not possible, the report is allowed to proceed and is retrieved later, during the investigation.

No document may be treated as genuine merely because it says the Foundation has reached an agreement with SCP-9782.

SCP-9785 is a 15 cm handheld containment chamber used to capture and store minor anomalous phenomena. The device operates in two configurations: a dormant standby state and an active operational mode triggered by verbal or physical command.

Upon activation, SCP-9785 autonomously identifies and targets a subject within range, initiating containment via compressional miniaturization and spatial transference. The device sustains operation until manually deactivated, releasing and enlarging the target to its prior state within 5 meters of SCP-9785.

SCP-9785 was developed for external use by Eng. Vilen Sang with the Department of Containment (refer to ADDENDUM 9785.1).

SCP-9786 is a 3x3x2.5 meter room currently embedded into a wall at Site-55. The interior walls are made of drywall and ceramic, while the exterior is composed of an unknown metallic material. The room contains a single wooden chair in the center and a tool cabinet on the left wall. The top drawer of the cabinet contains surgical tools, the middle drawer contains industrial tools, and the bottom drawer contains cleaning supplies. The drawers have much more internal space than their dimensions would suggest.

Inside SCP-9786 is what appears to be a male caucasian humanoid, referred to as SCP-9786-A, that stands on the right side of the room dressed in an American federal corrections officer uniform.

SCP-9787 is the collective term referring to 201,378 anomalous instances of Polistes aurifer nested inside of a gray 2014 Honda Civic Si. An instance of SCP-9787 possesses unusual intelligence and durability, extreme pettiness, and the ability to telekinetically exert 0.03N of force on an object within sight. SCP-9787 instances also project a slight memetic effect causing individuals to ignore them. This effect diminishes in strength with time and with closer inspection. SCP-9787 instances have demonstrated knowledge of traffic laws inside of the United States and possess valid licenses for Utah, New Mexico, Texas, and Nevada.

The SCP-9787 colony will remain neutral to humans unless insulted, disrespected, or inconvenienced.

SCP-9788 is an adult male collared bush robin (Tarsiger johnstoniae) referring to itself as "Mark Rosewater." SCP-9788 is capable of coherent human speech through unknown means. When interacting with personnel, SCP-9788's temperament has been described as "overly prideful" and "loud."

SCP-9788 appears to possess a greatly increased mental capacity compared to that of the average human, being capable of playing Chess at a high level. At random intervals, SCP-9788 will ask the nearest individual if they "wish to attempt a bout against a Grandmaster. " Should the individual accept the offer, a chess set will manifest between the two and an instance of SCP-9788-A will begin.

SCP-9788-A is any game of Chess played with SCP-9788.

SCP-9789 is a non-transmissible neurodegenerative disease comprising two phases, SCP-9789-A and SCP-9789-B, which together form an AB Cycle. Disease progression is associated with, and therefore tracked by, the number of AB Cycles.

SCP-9789-A manifests as a lucid dream and is the first presentation of SCP-9789. While the contents of the dream vary greatly, it can be generalised as an alternate reality, where the cause of one's anxiety or depression has been resolved.

Another distinguishing feature of SCP-9789-A is the presence of an entity referred to as SCP-9789-1. SCP-9789-1's appearance and behaviour remain consistent between patient interviews and scans from NeuroEYE.

SCP-9790 refers to an underground structure located on the outskirts of Minsk, Belarus. The structure first came into the attention of the SCP Foundation following a review of all catalogued Foundation properties on 24/03/2020. SCP-9790 was designated as "Site-0", with a date of acquisition listed as 30/10/1961, the records of its original owner having been redacted.

SCP-9790 can only be entered through a 5 meter long metal tunnel, descending from a hatch similar in appearance to that of a bomb shelter entrance. The main body of SCP-9790 is a concrete tunnel, 100 meters in length, containing 15 reinforced metal doors on either side. In addition, a single wooden door is present on the northern end of SCP-9790.

SCP-9791 is a circular spatial rift approximately 30 meters in diameter, suspended 120 meters above sea level at a fixed location in the South Pacific Ocean. SCP-9791 only appears to be permeable by instances of SCP-9791-B.

The interior of SCP-9791 is uniformly dark in color. However, at irregular intervals of around 15 days, SCP-9791 will temporarily begin to emit white light, during which time SCP-9791-B instances may emerge from the opening. The light will fade after approximately 1 hour, no longer allowing SCP-9791-B instances to cross.

SCP-9791-B is the collective designation for any aircraft that emerge from SCP-9791. SCP-9791-B instances are primarily non-anomalous in nature, but have been seen to utilize anomalous technologies.

SCP-9792 is a humanoid silhouette visible when reaching relativistic speed.

At present, the Foundation lacks further information about the anomaly, making it necessary to conduct tests to ascertain its nature. The primary objectives of the research are:
• Determine whether the anomaly is material or merely an optical illusion caused by relativistic speed; • Ascertain whether the anomaly can appear at non-relativistic speeds; • If the anomaly is confirmed to exist, determine whether it is sapient; • If the anomaly is sapient, attempt to communicate with it and determine its intentions.

SCP-9795 consists of specimens from various animal species infected with a currently unknown disease. Infection results in the progressive loss of several functions and behavioral traits typically associated with the affected species. Breathing-like movements continue to occur, although no biological function has been identified.

The appearance of SCP-9795 varies depending on the infected animal. Most animals retain their original form, although some become unrecognizable and may be mistaken for other species. All instances of SCP-9795 exhibit a distinctive green color over their entire bodies.

SCP-9797 is an anomalous, contagious disease affecting exclusively human subjects (referred to as SCP-9797-A) initially resembling common depressive mood disorders. Its vector of transmission is a thick black fluid generated (referred to as SCP-9797-B) by SCP-9797-A instances. SCP-9797-A subjects invariably share additive symptoms in five phases of infection (noted as SCP-9797-A-1 through -5):

Phase 1: Symptoms are mostly indistinguishable from major depressive disorder or similar mood disorders. SCP-9797-A-1 instances experience fatigue, hopelessness or despair, alexithymia, and high pain tolerance.

A LOCAL COLLAPSE OF REALITY EVENT IS IN PROGRESS. ACCESS TO THIS FILE HAS BEEN RESTRICTED TO THOSE GIVEN EXPRESS PERMISSION BY THE EMERGENCY THREAT TACTICAL RESPONSE AUTHORITY. ANY PERSONNEL NOT INVOLVED IN ONGOING CONTAINMENT PROCEDURES BY ETTRA SHOULD CEASE ALL ACTIVITIES RELATED TO THIS EVENT.

SCP-9799 is a spectral entity resembling Ronald Bradbury, a Foundation agent who disappeared in August 1986. SCP-9799 appeared on a single occasion within Helby House, a 19th-century country house in southern Lincolnshire, England, on 2007/11/06.

SCP-9799 retains some of the memories and personality of Ronald Bradbury, albeit in a degraded form. It can interact with its surrounding environment, but has only been observed doing so in a limited fashion.

The circumstances surrounding Bradbury's disappearance are unclear. He was last seen boarding a train from Kings Cross Station, London, to Grantham, also southern Lincolnshire, on 1986/08/23; his reasons for travelling are unknown.
Life and Death in Another World

SCP-9800 is the provisional designation for an anomalous event that led to the transformation of a large area of land, entirely encompassing Site-618, into a contiguous rice paddy field. Attempts to re-establish communication with the Site have been unsuccessful. With the exception of a Dr. Felix Bowie, all Site-618 personnel have been considered MIA.

A temporary outpost has been established within the vicinity of Site-618 to support investigation efforts, which are presently ongoing.
The following are a collection of facts. Not all of these facts are relevant to SCP-9801, as some have been added as obfuscation for the sake of security and personnel safety.

SCP-9802 is an outdoor air-conditioning unit which is sentient and proficient in American English. How SCP-9802 vocalizes is currently unknown, and it does not display fluency in any language except its current dialect. Otherwise, SCP-9802 is completely non-anomalous.

SCP-9803 is a phenomenon that manifests as an internet advertisement. Instances have appeared across a wide range of websites, with little correlation between site content or viewer demographic, aside from affected websites hosting low quality "chumbox"-style clickbait advertisements.

SCP-9803 consists of a picture of an individual reported missing, accompanied by crudely formatted text such as "see where they are now", or "see what they've been up to." Minor variation has been observed across manifestations, with every recorded instance inviting the reader to view the subject's current activities or location.

SCP-9804 is an 80 cm long cricket bat, likely intended for use by children. It is well-worn and lacks distinctive patterns. The handle is wrapped in blue tape and can be held without triggering any discernible effects. Individuals in possession of SCP-9804 are referred to as the Batter.

In order for SCP-9804 to display anomalous properties, the following must be true:
• SCP-9804 must be held by the handle.
• SCP-9804 must collide with an individual other than the Batter (hereby designated the Bowler).
• The Batter and the Bowler must not be physically touching except via SCP-9804.

Given these conditions are met, a “Run” will occur for a duration of 46 minutes.

SCP-9805 was an entity which briefly manifested during an unrelated scientific project. No other materializations of SCP-9805 have been recorded.

The photo reel containing evidence of the apparition was first located by the US Military following abnormal reporting emerging from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. A subsequent investigative raid revealed a constructed anechoic chamber, used to conduct the experiments which first discovered SCP-9805.

SCP-9806 is an anomalous manifestation of the noospheric erosion of First Nations languages of the Americas, tracked across each language's remaining population of native or fluent speakers. Its sole observable physical consequence is instances of members belonging to the taxonomical family Psittacidae (referred to as SCP-9806-A), discovered inside empty Foundation containment cells, storage spaces, drawers, cabinets, wardrobes or quarantine facilities, throughout both North and South American continents. Regardless of all Foundation efforts, all instances expire within 72 hours upon discovery.

SCP-9806-B is the designation for the noospheric vitality of an endemic language (catalogued both living and extinct) across the Americas.

SCP-9807 is a beige, push-button telephone. While unbranded, it is both visibly and mechanically similar to telephones used in offices during the 80's.

SCP-9807’s other anomalous effects manifest when a call is made in a sales context. Upon a caller performing a “sales pitch” for any product belonging to a brand, the receiver, now designated SCP-9807-1, becomes a regular consumer of the brand’s products. SCP-9807-1 instances have also presented elevated consumerist tendencies, as well as loyalty towards the aforementioned brand. This effect does not apply if the product does not exist as of the time of the call.

SCP-9808 pertains to an Anomalous Quercus alba (White Oak) hardwood tree situated on the crown of a sparse foothill in the Monongahela National Forest in eastern West Virginia, United States of America. SCP-9808 constitutes the only known Multiversal Constant documented by the Multi-Foundation Coalition.

Accordingly, SCP-9808 is phenomenologically equivalent across all known iterations and manifestations. Cross-analysis with representatives of the Foundation Multiversal Consortium has regularly corroborated this observation. The core, notable properties of SCP-9808 are as follows:
• SCP-9808 invariably inhabits a planetary body where humanity originated.

Seized from HMPD evidence locker after the "Hammond Spring Parade Massacre", in which Arthur Bresnan Jr. murdered 12 people with a hunting knife. Later investigations uncovered that Bresnan Jr. was responsible for another 7 unsolved murders within Indiana, all thought to have involved SCP-9809.

Captured instance was discovered to have originated from Glamoure Costuming Shop; a subsequent raid recovered numerous other paranatural objects.

SCP-9809 is a series of fleece and acrylic costumes designed to resemble a ram. They consist of five pieces: a mask, a torso, a lower body, and a pair of mittens. Two sets are currently in SCP custody, with possibly over a hundred unaccounted for. Manufacturer is unknown.
Love Grows Where My Rosemary Goes

Due to a common interest in fully containing SCP-9810 so as to preserve normalcy in the region, the Foundation and other signatories to the Southern United States Extranormal Organization Cooperation Treaty (SUSEOCT) have agreed to engage in a scheme of cooperation through the sharing of labor, information, and resources. Region 352 Director Kate McTiriss has been designated as the Foundation’s representative and point of contact with respect to this sub-agreement; all relevant communications from outside parties must be forwarded to her.

Under the terms of the sub-agreement, the Foundation’s primary responsibility is the examination of SCP-9810 incident sites.
If You Need Me, I'll Be In Montanna

SCP-9811 is the Foundation designation for the "Montanna [sic] Natural and Cultural History Museum." The building has three entrances: Visitors, Guests, and Staff. Only the Staff entrance appears to be inaccessible. Foundation personnel have yet to determine how to access this port; attempts to utilize other anomalies, including SCP-005, have been unsuccessful.

Inhabiting SCP-9811 are humanoids officially designated as SCP-9811-1. These humanoids act as employees within SCP-9811 and typically curate exhibits within the building. Blood, hair, and urine samples indicate that these anomalies appear to be standard members of the species Homo sapiens.

SCP-9812 is a human ear attached to a section of grey-painted drywall. Its skin is similar in coloration to tarnished brass with notable spotting on the lobes and near the base. The lobes are droopy and larger than average, implying advanced age. It continually produces a light which passively varies between 180-200 lumens in intensity. Medical examination has determined it is continuously circulating blood. As all biological structures terminate on the point of contact with the drywall it is unknown from where this blood is supplied or how.

SCP-9813 designates ██ organisms which resemble King James English translations of the Christian holy text known as the "Bible." The covers are composed primarily of chitin with microscopic analysis of the pages showing they are similar in structure and composition to silk as is produced by bombyx mori (Domestic Silk Moth). Mouth parts are present at the top of the spine which also allow the item to expel waste.

SCP-9814 is a wooden dining chair, measuring fifty-eight centimeters in height. It is carved ornately, with Chinese symbols and designs engraved on it, and is coated with dark brown lacquer. Testing of SCP-9814's wood has revealed it is carved from a Prunus serrulata, and the item is not assembled from different pieces of wood, but rather carved from a whole log.

When a person is within 10 meters of SCP-9814, and within view of SCP-9814, it will enter its active stage, in which it will violently detonate with the force of one kilogram of dynamite explosive. This explosion happens spontaneously from the entire item, rather than from a centralized detonation, and will launch wooden fragments up to twenty meters away.

SCP-9815 cannot be observed initially; it can only be secondarily confirmed. At the time of the incident, the collection terminal for the above recording was in a powered-off state; the file does not exist in the terminal, nor does it exist in any backup. The sole surviving copy is a paper transcription reproduced from memory by the on-duty personnel; the time of the transcription differs from the time claimed by the recording by eleven days. The name used by the answering party in the transcription is the same as that of a neighbor from the first-contact personnel's childhood; that neighbor moved out of their registered residence ██ years ago and has had no contact records since.
SCP-9816 is a washing machine that explodes upon use.

SCP-9817 is an anomalous file compression algorithm created with the goal of minimizing the amount of storage space a player’s mindfile takes up in SIMULACRUM data centers. This increases the maximum player capacity of SIMULACRUM without allocating additional resources to building data centers. SCP-9817-α is D-91811, who was used in Procedure‑TOMSDINER. D-91811 was chosen for her unique set of qualities.

SCP-9818 refers to a phenomenon that affects workers between the ages of 16 to 65. This phenomenon occurs across a one-month time span. Subjects who are affected by SCP-9818 initially exhibit an increased productive capacity, at the cost of neglecting their own physical and mental health. As the SCP-9818 event progresses, so does a subject's obsession with productivity, opting to spend their time off continuing to work. Subjects detach themselves from their personal life, cutting off friends and family entirely.

This event culminates on the final day with a subject compulsively beginning to mutilate themselves to use parts of their body during work. Notable examples include:
• Office workers cutting off their own skin to use as paper.

SCP-9820 is a viral phenomenon causing the organelles in the host's somatic cells to spontaneously exit the cell through anomalous means. This process is inevitably fatal. Upon infection, the speed of the effects will progress exponentially, with overall time taken varying from host to host. As of current research, four stages to the infection have been determined, each presenting with identifying symptoms:
• Stage 1 (approx. 1-2 days). The host begins experiencing slight weakness and fatigue. May complain of nausea or muscle spasms.
• Stage 2 (approx. 72 hours). The host's mobility and brain function is affected. Symptoms may mimic a stroke. Bodily functions may be erratic or nonexistent.
• Stage 3 (approx. 78 hours).
"I'm one of the thirteen most powerful people on this planet. I contain gods and demons. And yet, I'm utterly useless in this room. Completely powerless to help the one person I love." — O5-13

SCP-9824, titled "She Was Killed", is a memetic freeware survival horror and puzzle PC video game made in the “RPG Maker VX Ace” engine, published on GameJolt on 03/31/2014 by user “3S2F12W23Q1W". SCP-9824 is downloaded alongside a non-anomalous.txt file titled "README". SCP-9824, set in Egypt, is centered around a couple, Mara and Naomi, who must solve puzzles and avoid mythological beings in order to escape a pyramid while being stalked by an undead Pharaoh named Eiret.

SCP-9825 is the collective designation for SCP-9825-1 and SCP-9825-2, which manifest together in random events. These events are henceforth referred to as SCP-9825 events.

SCP-9825-1 is a humanoid entity. Following manifestation events, subjects will report fleeting awareness of a humanoid figure in a dark green suit and hat. Exact details are unknown and seem to vary between manifestation events. Research into SCP-9825 events suggests that this image is the result of the human brain attempting to rationalise a thaumaturgic ⓘ Thaumaturgy Thaumaturgy is the term for what is colloquially referred to as "magic". Thaumatology is the study of magical principles as a practical science. Click this link for more information.

SCP-9827 were 10 duplicates of a man named Garrett Matney. All drowned on the same day (December 31st, 2025) in different locations. SCP-9827 only came to Foundation attention after its neutralization, when its 10 sets of remains were all separately identified as the same individual. Further investigation of Garrett Matney's lives found no physical or documented evidence of his existence after the year 2017, with the exception of its remains and objects that were on their person(s) at time of death. Despite this, each instance's life was partially remembered by 1-5 individuals that claimed to have been its friends or acquaintances.

SCP-9828 refers to the Red Block at the former location of Site-42, a CI2M filtration camp for civilian and military prisoners.

SCP-9828 is a large cube-like structure two stories in height. The surface of the object is a dark shade of red and covered with sigils of an unknown origin. The sigils were originally black, but have since changed to a gold color with a texture resembling liquid mercury.

The interior of SCP-9828 is home to the Ingestion Process, a hemomantic ritual with unclear repercussions or purposes. Walls within the object are covered with hundreds of holes with a 30 cm radius and 10 cm in depth. A 13-meter-deep well has been excavated into the floor, with the concave surface consisting of an unidentified obsidian-like composite.
SYSTEM ERROR: This anomaly does not exist.
Addendum 9830-1: A series of actions taken in response to statements of SCP-9830’s existence, by order of the O5 Council.

SCP-9831 is a female humanoid, around 20 years old, standing 165cm in height and weighing 55kg. SCP-9831 is able to voluntarily transfer memories from itself to other individuals, animals, and inanimate objects, and take memories from others in the same way.

Memories transferred to living organisms are implanted directly into the hippocampus, making it difficult to distinguish memories given by SCP-9831 from genuine memories. Memories taken from living organisms are entirely removed. Exposed individuals have reported a sense of "tearing" and temporary feelings of pain and panic when this occurs, although no permanent injuries have occurred.

SCP-9832 is a neurochemical serum that inoculates the neocortex from cognitohazardous effects. Following a study of anomalous entities resistant to these effects, Foundation researchers extracted samples of cerebrospinal fluid from these entities and cross-tested them with a sample of one-hundred D-class, documenting their effects prior to, during, and following mild cognitohazardous exposure. The data remained inconclusive until samples from SCP-████ were tested, which resulted in complete immunization for 78% of test subjects. Further tests were conducted DATA CORRUPTED percent of subjects being immunized. The data was forwarded to the Ethics Committee and Overwatch Council for review, with a vote of 9-3-1 approving of limited usage.

Discovered following public exposure as 2005 Cedar Park mass incident, initial coverup impossible due to circumstance of incident inciting scrutiny and interference from general populace, secondary and tertiary investigative journalistic bodies obscuring site of episode. Site cleanup resulted in loss of significant assets prior to Program acquisition. Paranormal nature unclear if at all present.

Designation is the 2005 mass fatality event that occurred on fourth night of five-day ArFIX Biannual Technical Conference, Cedar Park, TX.

SCP-9835 was a building located in North Wales, which operated from 2001 to 2016 under the name "The Manticore Hotel.". While in operation, SCP-9835 was a multiversal hub for anomalous activity, kept in check by GoI-119 "The Manticore Corporation". SCP-9835 appeared to only be 30m tall when observed from the outside but its true height was estimated at 3048m.

SCP-9835 currently lays in ruin, with very little of the structure remaining. Following 2016/05/23, all anomalous activity has ceased.

First brought to the attention of the Special Collections Program following an expulsion event occurring at the Providence Children's Hospital in El Paso, Texas in 1990. SCP-9838 begins, conditionally, from the rooftop of the Houston General Hospital, located in Houston, Texas. Any human subject who intentionally leaps from the roof of the building with the intent to end their own life will pass through it. The interior of SCP-9838 presents as a significantly-warped version of the Houston skyline, with the subject falling besides an infinitely tall version of the hospital, and the ground appearing to remain a constant distance away.

SCP-9839 is a form of human blood that has unusual optical properties. It is an exceptionally bright shade of red — more so than any existing pigment or any electronic display can properly replicate. SCP-9839 will continue to appear red even in the absence of red light, or in concentrations where regular blood would appear black. Details of SCP-9839's appearance are abnormally easy to discern, even at a distance or under adverse conditions.

SCP-9839 is a visual cognitohazard. Direct observers report that SCP-9839 appears more "realistic" than its surroundings. They will generally describe this effect as akin to that achieved when a photographic image is placed in an illustrated or computer-generated environment.

SCP-9841 is an anti-memetic anomaly that causes increasing levels of apathy towards any given Foundation employee's career at the Foundation from their acquaintances, friends, and family members. SCP-9841 almost universally affects all acquaintances, family members, and relatives of all SCP Foundation personnel, and appears to intensify over a prolonged period of time, as long as the relevant Foundation personnel continues to be employed at the Foundation.

In a case of SCP-9841 affliction, the Foundation employee (henceforth referred to as SCP-9841-A) does not appear to be affected by SCP-9841. Only their acquaintances, family members, and relatives (henceforth referred to as SCP-9841-B) will be.
SCP-9842 was recovered from an overgrown tomb outside the Sicilian city of Syracuse.

SCP-9844 refers to a low-level, object-oriented, statically typed programming language known as ██████, originally written as a competitor to the Java programming language. SCP-9844 was created sometime between 1997 and 2003 at ████████████, a now defunct technology and software company based in Buffalo, New York. Preliminary analysis by Foundation field agents upon recovery of SCP-9844 materials from the ████████████ office in Buffalo suggests that ████████████ employees and executives were unaware of SCP-9844's anomalous properties, intending for it to be a viable industry-standard language.

Due to the lack of an available compiler, SCP-9844 will not compile or execute on any known computer architecture.

SCP-9848 is a pocket unwindable tape measure which kind of looks like a Stanley Powerlock 25-Foot Pocket Tape Measure. Pretty much all writing and numbering on SCP-9848 seems to be anomalously difficult to read. Attempts to capture the markings on SCP-9848 using different measurement equipment will yield differing results. SCP-9848 appears to gradually infect the environment around it with anomalous ontogeometric distortion unless information about it is actively obscured.

The spread of SCP-9848's distortion is accelerated by intentional observation, measurement, or description. Obfuscation is for your protection.

Seized from Glamoure Costuming Shop in Hammond, Indiana. SCP-9853 is a two-piece, fleece and wool costume designed to resemble a yellow-furred “Easter Bunny” character. The object’s hollow interior is occupied by a mass of plaster, allowing it to maintain form.

Once every 24 hours, SCP-9853 produces a firm, oval-shaped, white mass from a hole located within the object’s ‘mouth’. While the outermost layer of these objects is chemically comparable to rubber, testing has revealed a plaster interior, similar to SCP-9853’s internal composition. Despite this, these objects possess an intensely odorous, sulfidic smell.

Physical contact with an object produced by SCP-9853 will induce an alteration in a party’s active perception.

SCP-9856 is a two minute long song recorded on a cassette tape. The song is sung in an unknown language by a single female voice. In the background, songbirds, wind, and footsteps are audible. When SCP-9856 is played, strawberry plants rapidly grow from the source of the recording. As testing is still ongoing, the full capabilities of SCP-9856 are currently unknown.

SCP-9858 is an entity resembling a human male lacking a head. The entity has the typical build of a middle-distance runner, and wears non-branded sports wear. However an icon resembling wings is embroidered on the quarter of its sneakers

SCP-9858 manifests only to a human (SCP-9858-1) that runs over 3 km alone between 20:30-4:00 after daylight hours. Beyond these circumstances, there is no clear determination for why SCP-9858 appears within this sample. SCP-9858 begins its pursuit 40 metres behind SCP-9858-1 and runs at an equal pace to SCP-9858-1. During its pursuit, SCP-9858-1 will be unable to locate any other civilians regardless of where they search until SCP-9858 concludes its manifestation.

Discovered in the inventory of the Jesus Christ of Our Sorrows Clinic, Chattanooga, TN 1980. Latex male contraceptives of the Anti-Baby brand produced by Celestino Group Inc. Their peculiarity lies in an outer layer of seminal fluid derived from an unknown mammalian species, with a shelf life of two months under ambient conditions. It is capable of fertilizing humans, resulting in a corniform mole. SCP-9860 is manufactured at a facility in Chattanooga, a subsidiary of Celestino Group Inc.

SCP-9862-alpha first uploaded to file sharing website jeemsreview.██ and later to YouTube as far back as June 2 2010, commonly titled "Fish From Hell" or variations thereof.

File is a "shock video" or "screamer video" depicting the uploader's supposed uncle or father slaughtering fish. Windows Movie Maker title overlays tell the story of the uploader's fishing trip wherein deep holes, caves, or secret man-made passages are discovered under Seneca Lake. Photos of these structures are presented throughout, constituting a breach of security.

Screamer occurs at timestamp 2 minutes and 19 seconds; viewing personnel have made it up to 2 minutes 38 seconds before device compromise via water damage.

SCP-9863 is a condition affecting approximately 1% of people possessing severe food allergies. Individuals affected by SCP-9863 occasionally suffer anaphylactic shock reactions consistent with their consumption of an allergen when no such allergen is present in the consumed food. As of this writing, no means of determining when these reactions will occur has been discovered, though accumulated data has indicated the following:
• Individuals affected by SCP-9863 do not experience SCP-9863 events before they independently discover their non-anomalous allergy.
• Individuals affected by SCP-9863 typically have a period of several months to years between SCP-9863 events.

SCP-9864 is a phenomenon that occurs during the voting process of the United Nations Security Council (UNSC). After the President of the UNSC calls for the members to raise their hands, an index card printed with a vote on the resolution and a comment, which is invariably a single sentence written in English, will manifest on the person of the President or one of the voting members. These cards are designated SCP-9864-A.

SCP-9866 is a minor deity intrinsic to indigenous folklore of an isolated sub-alpine forest region within the Rila-Rhodope massif. While formerly integrated into the micro-culture of the region, public awareness of SCP-9866 has since faded into obscurity. It has accepted this status quo and expressed satisfaction with it.

Site-3J was established to leverage the isolated environment and permit long-term research into viral hazards and monitor SCP-9866 concurrently. On-site personnel are subject to extended deployment periods as a quarantine precaution.

SCP-9867 is an anomalous instance of Cetorhinus maximus, measuring 7.78 meters in length, and weighing approximately 4,425 kilograms. SCP-9867 exhibits sapient characteristics and is capable of verbal speech, in English, however, it is unknown how SCP-9867 is capable of producing sound, as no gas exchange occurs between the interior of the subject and the origin point of sound from articulation. During phono-articulation, sound emanates from the gills of the subject, and sound waves maintain amplitude and wavelength as they breach the surface of the water. The subject's speech can be heard by the human ear clearly, even while subject is fully submerged, as long as the subject is within ~5 meters of the surface of the water.

SCP-9868 is a series of small, red stickers created by Dr. Simon Webster and Researcher Elaine Parker between 2005 and 2008. When SCP-9868 is applied to an object, ownership of said object is transferred immediately to Dr. Simon Webster or Rsr. Elaine Parker, depending on who produced it. Upon removal of SCP-9868 from the object's surface, the object ceases to be owned.

The original batch of SCP-9868, numbered one through 100, was the accidental byproduct of an experiment performed by Dr. Webster, during which he attempted to create a nöospheric name tag. After realizing the mistake, Dr. Webster began to test SCP-9868 as an independent entity.

SCP-9869 is biology, a feature of the high-energy regime of the very early universe characterised by remarkable speed, adaptability, and the ability to allow complex structure and intelligence in the deeply hostile early expansion environment.

It has been long understood that in the period directly after the initial singularity, the universe was characterised by extreme concentrations of mass and energy. On the timescales relevant to this regime, creational flux did not occur, and mass-energy was bound into essentially static bundles (archive expeditions report this was known as “baryonic matter”). These were known to be able to form microscopic masses; the ancestors of the iron particles we know today.

SCP-9870 is an environmental anomaly superficially similar to extreme cold. While the precise conditions needed for manifestation are not yet known, it can manifest anywhere on the surface of the Earth once the temperature falls below freezing. After a variable period of time, SCP-9870 manifestations dissipate spontaneously. No consistent conditions causing these dissipations have yet been identified. Affected environments frequently experience snowstorms and/or dense fog.

SCP-9870 prevents the generation of new heat within its area of influence. Once an environment is enveloped by SCP-9870, its temperature can no longer rise and begins to progressively decline.

SCP-9872 is a stick of chewing gum, measuring approximately 7.0 cm in length, 1.4 width, and 0.15 cm in thickness. Recovered instances are individually enclosed in transparent polymer wrappers bearing a stylized yellow W. No manufacturer, ingredients, or other identifying information is present. Chemical analysis of recovered SCP-9872 material has identified conventional gum base, sweeteners, flavoring compounds, stabilizers, and food-grade additives. No component exhibiting independently anomalous properties has been identified.

When chewed by a human subject, SCP-9872 produces three sequential flavors:
• Tomato Soup
• Roast Beef and Baked Potato
• Blueberry Pie

SCP-9873 is an anomalous variant of Actinodium cunninghamii or Swamp Daisy. SCP-9873's presence in La Rue Macabre has been noted as a secondary anomalous characteristic, given that the Swamp Daisy is endemic to Australia. The primary anomalous characteristic is its ability to alter its surroundings predictably. When planted, SCP-9873 causes all surrounding material, biological and artificial, to undergo significant change and break down upon germination.

Okay, you know what? I’m not even going to continue with this document like this is a professional piece of work. I’m absolutely done trying to save face. I’m going to lay out the cold hard facts here, because I doubt this document will even be proofread prior to being posted as an official entry. This might be the worst anomaly in existence. I hate this thing.

It doesn’t even do anything interesting. It came with like 80 crappy cassettes and it plays all of them perfectly fine. The ONLY anomalous trait about this stupid thing is that it plays a cassette of “I am the Walrus” by The Beatles that came with it backwards inexplicably. It’s not an issue with the tape or the recorder. We checked. Sure, that IS anomalous.

SCP-9875 is an mnestic anomaly occurring within a standard hotel room at the Horizon View Resort in Orlando. Any individuals who have previously been administered amnestics will regain suppressed memories while inside SCP-9875. However, all memories restored during exposure are lost upon exiting the room.

SCP-9876 is the designation given to a man-made device comprised of various gears, levers and pulleys, which are composed out of fossilized osseous tissues of an as-yet unidentified creature.
