The device measures 2 × 2 × 2 meters and is cuboid in shape. Carbon dating has placed the object's age anywhere between 65 000 000 to 67 000 000 years old.

The main anomalous property of SCP-9876 is, through a series of input commands on the device, the generation of an Einstein-Rosen bridge to, what can only be theorized to be, a pocket dimension.

SCP-9877 is a repeating broadband radio transmission originating from a region of space corresponding to the star Shǎowèi. SCP-9877 was first detected in the 27th century. The signal is extremely degraded, due to severe signal attenuation and background cosmic noise. Despite this, listeners of SCP-9877 report intense feelings of safety, recognition, and "not being alone."

Analysis by the Department of Pre-Modernity has identified several snippets of pre-24th-century music, such as Johnny Be Goode by Edward Berry, Eine Zauberflöte by Wolfgang Mosark, and Puspåwarnå by Duke of Mangkunegaran. Several other snippets believed to be Terran music have been found, but are unable to be properly identified.
Here is the Giver of Gold

SCP-9878 are a series of thaumaturgically and necromantically active Anglo-Saxon archaeological sites. They are also distinguished by their exceptionally well-preserved condition. Their anomalous properties may only be utilised by certain individuals; it is not known what criteria are used in the selection, but it is known that Prime Minister █████ qualifies for the use of all SCP-9878 instances.

SCP-9878-1 is a church, dated to ca. 500 AD, whose graveyard has been emptied. Each grave has been unearthed, and the remains are scattered across the pews. When eligible individuals enter the main building, these remains answer questions regarding the presence, layout, and opinions of religious groups within four hundred and forty-four miles.

SCP-9879 is an antique jack-in-the-box dated to the 17th century, measuring 76 centimeters squared whilst docile. Stapled to the lid is a sketch depicting SCP-9879 in its "activated" state, originating from 20th century Spain. The artist's relationship with SCP-9879 is unknown.

SCP-9879 naturally rests in a docile state until a minimum of two humans begin conversing within the object's proximity, assumed to be the extent of the chamber. Approximately 5 to 15 seconds after the conversation began, a piston will push SCP-9879's lid open, subsequently causing a skeleton to emerge. SCP-9879's skeleton is restricted from rising beyond pelvis height, and at its maximum, SCP-9879 can reach 193 centimeters (6 foot 4 inches) tall.
Geburah: This Corner of the World

SCP-9880 is a blend of 13 major thaumargic rituals, 76 memetic manipulations, 189 various micro-rituals, and 10^7 liters of water, creating a spherical dome reaching both above and below ground. The size of the dome adjusts itself to the size of the contained settlement.

Once activated, it is impossible for every living being to physically or anomalously enter or leave the area affected by SCP-9880. Physical force does not affect the dome's durability, and use of any thaumaturgy will have no effect either, no matter the amount of EVE energy accumulated. Souls' ritual, or any ritual that may remove one's spirit from a body, is superfluous, as even sentient ectoplasmic matter will be contained by the dome.
On the Harmful Effects of Chekhov's Gun

Analytics & Intelligence shall consistently monitor reported events throughout Site-512 for unexpected directional trends that can be linked back to SCP-9881. Anomalous Energies shall notify the Containment Heads and Supervisor if the background narrative energy in 1-2-2 HQ rise 20% over baseline.

DESCRIPTION: SCP-9881 is a Carbine, Caliber 5.56 mm, M4 assault rifle anomalously imbued with an excess of narrative potential energy. While its energy levels are insufficient to completely warp narrative around itself, it acts as a "narrative collapser": when it is capable of doing so, it will swiftly insert itself into narratives that naturally overlap with its own, hastening their conclusion in a way that makes it a vital part of the relevant narrative.

Due to an incident involving Dr. Allen and an unknown second party, all testing on SCP-9882 must be performed with Foundation personnel level-2 or higher that have gone through a psychological evaluation. See Interview Log.9882.1 for more information.

SCP-9883 is a specimen of Pholcus phalangioides exhibiting basic cognitive functions sufficient to comprehend rudimentary literacy and formulate simple concepts. This capacity has been expressed through the formation of silk letters (approximately 10 cm in height) constructed from repeated thread layering. The entity has been marked by a blue dot on its abdomen, distinguishing it from non-anomalous specimens on site.

SCP-9883 was first identified in Office C-1013 by Dr. Daniel Koehl, when he found the word “HELLO” inscribed along the ceiling's edge. Subsequent observation confirmed it as the source.
AKASHA-CHOCOLATE:: Push the Ladder for $1,850 Bucks

Since 2002, our department has semi-annually been performing scans of Foundation databases across multiple universes using the Davids-Scranton UADA (Universal Anomaly Discrepancy Algorithm). These scans are performed by an AIC capable of treading through raw universal data and has been trained to predict for potential K-Class scenarios in our universe by cross-referencing various and random SCP documents from other universes to our own. Usually, there is no difference of note or very slight changes due to social variation.

SCP-9885 is the collective designation of all official and unofficial copies of the 653-page fantasy novel by the name of “The Swords of Kendaladron” by T.R. ██████, published by ██████, 06/04/20, in a single printing of 950 novels. T.R. ██████ has been located in an extreme state of infection, and has been detained according to protocol. The exact origins of SCP-9885 are therefore currently unknown.

The object contains a viral cognitohazard that progressively erodes and replaces the identity of its reader with a character from its narrative. During symptomatic progression, the reader is compelled to obsessively promote SCP-9885 to other potential readers.

SCP-9886 is an ersatz-class biological construct which superficially resembles Dr. Joseph Hadley, an employee of the Foundation stationed at Site-234. SCP-9886 is physically identical to Dr. Joseph Hadley, with the exception of several modifications:
• The epidermis of the subject is more elastic than that of a normal human, resulting in skin folds resembling the effects of cutis laxa. The skin also lacks many sensory neurons, including nocireceptors.
• Needle-like protrusions extend from the bones of the subject. These protrusions break through the skin of the subject in several locations around its body, including the hands, forearms, ribcage, and spine, and it has been observed using them as weaponry.

The material was impounded from a deep-sea mining operation targeting spiritual vortices in the North Atlantic Ocean. However, due to complications surrounding the project, a full yield of the material could not be obtained. As a result, an excess of 57 operatives were captured by the SCP object's effect by the year 1981. Recovery of the human assets buried in the seabed will not be attempted.

As we approach the anniversary of last year’s events, this is a friendly reminder that all proposals for experimentation or recovery attempts linked to the following SCP will be summarily rejected. All ongoing related projects remain indefinitely suspended.

I know. I miss them too.

SCP-9889 is an immense arthropod resembling a stretch of asphalt road. At its death, it measured 114 meters long and 8 meters wide, with a height of just over 4 centimeters. SCP-9889 would move along stretches of road under cover of darkness, using its natural camouflaging abilities to blend in with occupied streets.

SCP-9889 was discovered on 10/4/2025, when residents of Clarence Lane in Cleveland, North Carolina reported that a large section of the street had become discolored and dislodged from the rest of the road. Foundation agents confirmed the presence of a deceased anomaly and evacuated the surrounding area in order to remove SCP-9889 safely.

SCP-9890 refers to perfect biological copies of recently deceased individuals. Each SCP-9890 instance is identical in every aspect to the individual it is mimicking, including retaining the individual's memories. Upon manifestation, an SCP-9890 instance attempts to establish contact with the deceased individual’s close relatives, relying on them for basic care and support consistent with typical human relationships.

As of 10-28-2025, seven SCP-9890 instances have been reported globally, designated SCP-9890-1 through 7. Each case involves the reappearance of a deceased individual within 2–174 days of their confirmed death. Investigation into a potential common origin or trigger event is ongoing.

SCP-9891 is a humanoid entity with confirmed historical records dating prior to 1549, with documents showing that it lived among communities east of the Russian Tsardom. SCP-9891 is approximately 2.4 metres in height and possesses a thin physique. SCP-9891's respiration ranges from 5-9 breaths per minute. Initial examination upon recovery revealed that its sclerae exhibited signs consistent with conjunctival injection. The exterior of SCP-9891 is black and displays a texture consistent with silicone elastomer.

SCP-9891 is classified as an adversarial entity due to its involvement in two regicides and one suspected regicide between 1881 and 1918.

SCP-9892 is a red-painted slat shed with a black shingle roof located in rural Ontario, Norfolk County. SCP-9892 resides on the property belonging to Dylan Molson, who is currently being treated as a member of staff. SCP-9892's anomalous properties began manifesting on 21/05/2010, when the page listing all active Foundation sites and facilities listed Site-𝒾, which includes a list of anomalies it contains. SCP-9892-1 instances manifest digitally as Site-𝒾 on the relevant Foundation pages and forums.

The following is a partial list of the anomalies manifested by SCP-9892.

SCP-9893 is a human female of apparent Mediterranean descent in its late 20s. SCP-9893 has several morphological differences from baseline humans, most notably a pair of black geniculate antennae 0.73 meters in length extending from its forehead. These antennae are under SCP-9893's conscious control and serve as tactile, olfactory, and gustatory organs. SCP-9893's irises and sclera are replaced by a smooth black surface of unknown function.

When supplied with a high-sugar diet, SCP-9893 is capable of producing honey from any of its exocrine glands. The exact biological mechanisms which allow this are unclear.
If this is death, let me staunch it, let me hold it back

SCP-9894 is a Greek male youth estimated to be approximately 17 or 18 years of age. SCP-9894 has not aged since entering Foundation custody.

SCP-9894 possesses a serious skull fracture to the back of the head that has left it in an incapacitated state. All mundane and anomalous attempts to treat it have failed, and the injury has not been noted to improve (nor worsen) during containment. Otherwise, SCP-9894 appears to be impervious to all other ailments and injuries.

SCP-9895 is a cluster of three factories (designated SCP-9895-A, -B, and -C) around Chenhu Lake (沉湖) in Guangdong Province, China. SCP-9895 produces 99.7% (2025) of all stationery equipment purchased by the Foundation Logistics Department, including writing instruments and consumables, paper products, filing and organisation equipment, adhesives and tape, and miscellaneous desk supplies.

Prior to 2020, SCP-9895 consisted of non-anomalous manufacturers operating at net profit margins of 2-4%, attaining 94-95% of theoretical maximum capacity utilisation.

SCP-9896 is the definitive proof of the SCP Foundation's ethos and mission as discovered by the Department of Axiomatics, currently comprised of a 34 page paper. It consists of a demonstration through the fields of semantics, noospherics, metaphysics, and axiomatics.

Upon full acknowledgement of SCP-9896, there is an universal consensus regarding its verity and objectivity. It proves the mission of the Foundation is ontologically moral, justifiable, desirable, and unstoppable.

Following the dismantlement of the Ethics Committee, it is thought that the discovery and application of SCP-9896 has saved the Foundation 3.4 billion dollars in organic management.

SCP-9897 is a Motorola HT 220 portable radio manufactured circa 1983 and formerly issued to emergency responders throughout North America.

When powered on, it produces a faint static-like sound that cannot be attributed to any identifiable component of the device. The sound is best perceived in quiet environments. Subjects frequently report that the sound becomes "clearer" or "louder" over time, despite no corresponding change in measured volume.

Prolonged exposure causes the anomalous sound to become progressively more pleasurable, accompanied by corresponding changes in the subjective enjoyment of other sounds. This effect appears to be influenced by the circumstances under which other sounds are produced.

SCP-9898 is a line of scar tissue in the shape of the International Date Line, the cartographic convention defining the boundary between two calendar days, present on the body of Mark Copperfore, a 40-year-old geography teacher from Auckland, New Zealand.

SCP-9898 streches from Copperfore's breast down to the bottom of his abdomen, measuring roughly 60 centimeters in length, and is positioned on the left side of his body. Aside from occasional meteoropathic pains, SCP-9898 did not cause any considerable discomfort in Copperfore's daily life.

SCP-9898 appeared in September 1993, as a consequence of a break-in in Copperfore's home.
IT IS THE YEAR 3169. SPACE IS DEAD. ALL EXTANT LIFE FORMS RESIDE IN DIGITA. GOD-EMPEROR REAGAN RULES THE CYBERSPACE.

SCP-9900 is a single-file line that exists outside of baseline reality, currently containing an estimated.,...,... humanoid individuals. SCP-9900 has never been successfully measured in full due to regulations enforced by SCP-9900-1 instances.

SCP-9900 weaves through both anomalous dimensions and baseline reality in no identifiable pattern. The environments that surround SCP-9900 are both recognizable biomes and non-endemic environs. The majority of environments that SCP-9900 passes through are anomalous in origin. Whenever the end of SCP-9900 appears within baseline reality, new individuals are able to join SCP-9900.

An individual who joins the line is hereafter referred to as a 'candidate'.
SCP-9901, by P4TR1CK07. Massive thank you to BAD_DATA for making the battle photo, absolute legend for that!

SCP-9902 is a gelatinous substance believed to be extradimensional in origin. It is dark blue in coloration and carries an odor comparable to molten acrylic plastic with a hint of blackcurrant. Due to the fact that SCP-9902's odor is carcinogenic, further olfactory analysis is inadvisable.

The mass of SCP-9902 is indeterminate; identically-sized samples have weighed anywhere between 0.4 kg and 53.92 kg depending on factors such as ambient ultraviolet light, ambient temperature, and the phases of the Moon. (For a full list of mass-altering factors of SCP-9902, see Document-3829N.)

SCP-9903 is a spherical barrier surrounding the Sun at a radius of 1,940 AU. Though it has no effect on electromagnetic radiation entering our solar system, it absorbs all outwards emissions between the frequencies of 0.4-10.4 GHz, which constitute a large fraction of the Terrestrial Microwave Window. It has no effect on the movement of physical matter.

SCP-9904 was a vertical leap performed by Alex Thorley on ██/██/20██ 14:12 local time.

During this event:
• Alex Thorley's feet both left the ground.
• Alex Thorley rose approximately 25 cm.
• Alex Thorley remained airborne for approximately 2 seconds.
• Alex Thorley successfully landed on the surface without assistance.

These statistics imply a 95% reduction in gravitational acceleration during Alex Thorley's airborne phase. Alex Thorley expressed uncertainty on how SCP-9904 occured.

SCP-9905 is the Foundation designation for Thaumaturgical Ritual Catena-337, a type-B thaumaturgical working that is instrumental in the creation of Scranton Reality Anchors (SRAs). The ritual is performed at the end of the SRA construction process, used to catalyse and pacify the internal bio-chemical mechanisms of the device, responsible for stimulating electrochemical activity.

The process requires the following items to perform:
• One practitioner of thaumaturgy with a diploma in Applied Necromancy, or adjacent fields.
• A fully-built Scranton Reality Anchor with a healthy central neuro-substrate.
• 150 75 grams of Compound 9905-13.
• A felt-tip permanent marker.
"I found Doe; both deer and Jane, in the woods last night. They were next to each other, bleeding from a gunshot wound to the back of the head."

SCP-9907 is a unique thaumaturgical paradigm practiced by the Rujov lineage. Standard thaumaturgy (as defined by the Unified Theory) relies on the manipulation of local leylines to extract EVE and project onto a flowing matrix. SCP-9907, however, relies on drawing from an unidentified energy-well.

This form of EVE, termed Signature-907, possesses unusual crystalline properties when physically manifested, with a distinct red hue. Further analyses found it to display a zero-decay particulate lattice, inert to entropy even when detached from the practitioner; a major concern in traditional thaumic engineering known as the Hesse effect.

The Rujov Estate is situated at the edge of the Rose Valley, Bulgaria, near Kazanlak.

Recovered by local authorities in Soddy-Daisy, Tennessee upon receiving a report of several youths smoking in public. All but one managed to escape before apprehension; during questioning, the youth stated that the group was smoking a folding table, rather than tobacco or any illicit substance. He then demonstrated SCP-9908's properties to justify his claim. The object was subsequently confiscated.

SCP-9908 is a package of Marfil brand rolling papers. When emptied and left unobserved for two hours, it will refill with a fresh supply of rolling papers. Its primary property, however, is that any solid material can be used to fill a cigarette made with SCP-9908's papers, regardless of its material properties.

SCP-9909 instances are moments of projected human actions. Individual instances will congregate together to give the illusion of a human fitting into the current environment and situation. No instance has been observed more than 30 meters away from its corresponding SCP-9909-A instance.

An individual instance might be a human arm grabbing a can of coffee, while a congregation of instances might look like a human performing an office job, occasionally drinking coffee and engaging in idle conversation.

A single instance is only real for the purpose of its performed action. For example, inserting a knife into an instance performing a coffee-grabbing action will result in the knife passing through the instance.

SCP-9910 refers to five short sheepskin parchment scrolls, designated SCP-9910-1 through -5. The scrolls' condition varies, with SCP-9910-1 and SCP-9910-3 being the most well-preserved, and SCP-9910-5 the most degraded. Radiocarbon dating indicates all five scrolls were produced sometime between 120 BCE and 50 CE.

SCP-9910 has been recovered in 1955 from Cave 10 in Wadi Qumran, alongside an unremarkable ostracon and a stone slab marked with an unknown symbol which appears on the inverse side of all five SCP-9910 scrolls. Public knowledge of SCP-9910 has been successfully suppressed, and Cave 10 is deemed archaeologically sterile in all public literature on the subject.

SCP-9911 is a novel astrotheological phenomenon affecting all known planetary bodies in the Solar System. It is considered to be the conversion of these objects into Akiva sinks through poorly-understood processes.

Akiva sinks are typically found in items of religious significance, and are the primary medium for which Akiva flux may be channelled as both receptor and emission source. Objects and entities without this property do not exhibit any anomalous traits when exposed to Akiva radiation, though emission of Akiva radiation may occur in rare cases. Consequently, most known Akiva sinks are manmade with the express purpose of interfacing with divine entities and/or phenomena.

SCP-9912 is a spectral entity, resembling a hairless humanoid dressed in white robes with large feathered wings extending out of the back of its shoulders. An enlarged human eye takes up a majority of SCP-9912’s face; no other facial features are present. A thin, glowing ring floats perpetually above SCP-9912’s head.

SCP-9912 will remain within the direct presence of one specific human at all times. SCP-9912 moves without motion and can pass through solid surfaces. SCP-9912 cannot be physically touched; it, however, is able to interact with physical matter of its choosing.

SCP-9912 will treat its chosen subject in a manner comparable to a carer/nurturing figure.
Take Me Out of the Ball Game

SCP-9913 is a noosphere-permeating method of obfuscating the true inventor of baseball, Person of Interest-███, developed by the Administrator of the SCP Foundation, mining engineer Abner Graves, and lawyer William R. Wheaton following an undisclosed incident. The method is designed to introduce and perpetuate false information to the global population via all possible outlets (physical and digital records, media, oral tradition, historical societies, etc.), whether subliminally or overtly, in order to remove the entirety of POI-███ from all conception, for as long as feasibly possible.
scp9914.contain(containment_function = labyrinth, mazerunner = prisoner, mazemaker = architect)

SCP-9915 is the collective designation for the "Cuddle-Up Cutie!" line of dolls manufactured by the Maillard Corporation. There are 4 models within the line: "Sweetie Sally", "Lovely Lacey", "Snuggly Susie", and "Pretty Parsley".

Individual "Cuddle-Up Cutie!" dolls are designated instances of SCP-9915-1. SCP-9915-1 are 25 centimeters in height and composed primarily of polyester. They appear as simple representations of humans, lacking digits or defined joints. Details vary between models, but all have long hair and wear a dress.

SCP-9915-2 is a collective intelligence shared between all SCP-9915-1. It identifies itself as "Cutie".
I am Going to the Lordy

SCP-9916 is an indestructible, sentient, and emotionally unstable 1941 Woodstock typewriter.

In addition to typing on its own, the subject is capable of producing an infinite supply of paper and black ink from an unknown source. The only known way to stop SCP-9916's output is to incinerate the paper, i.e. during a Flail Event. This stalls output for two hours.

When typing, SCP-9916 addresses itself as either Charles Julius Guiteau, his lawyer, his PR agent, his wife, or the Abrahamic God. (Notably, all five identities type in the same style.)

Whether SCP-9916 is truly an incarnation of Charles Guiteau or an overzealous impersonator cannot be confirmed at this time.

SCP-9917 is a wooden stage located within a decommissioned theatre in southwestern Canada. When SCP-9917 is not adequately suppressed, 1-2 nearby humans become instances of SCP-9917-1 and attempt to reach the stage. Upon reaching the stage, instances of SCP-9917-1 perform involuntary choreiform movements. These movements do not correspond to the individual's known training or abilities. Instances of SCP-9917-1 remain lucid and aware during this time. Attempts to communicate with instances of SCP-9917-1 are acknowledged, but commonly result in apparent annoyance, including frustrated facial expressions and dismissive hand gestures incorporated into the ongoing movement sequence.

SCP-9918 is the collective designation for three deeply interconnected anomalies.

SCP-9918-A physically resembles I WOULD HAVE FORGIVEN YOU a wooden stake, with a stark white colouration when viewed from a distance. Weighing approximately 10 grams, SCP-9918-A's size, material, and colour changes depending on the angle the viewer observes it at and whatever emotion they are feeling. While the observer stands within a 10 metre radius of SCP-9918-A, they can only experience whatever emotion they were feeling prior to entering that set radius. If the observer sustains eye contact with SCP-9918-A for a prolonged period, ranging from 5-15 seconds, they will manifest inside SCP-9918-Æ. WHY MUST YOU PERSIST?

SCP-9919 is a noospheric crossover phenomenon between the conceptual domains of “orange” and “beetle.” Affected incidents result in the instantaneous transmutation of physical matter exhibiting an orange coloration into a mass of living beetles. These transformations are entirely at random, and occur on a global scale.

The origin of the conceptual crossover is currently unknown. Documented reports of SCP-9919 manifestations began in January 2016 and continue sporadically worldwide. An abridged selection of civilian-submitted BUG REPORTS is provided below

SCP-9920-1 is an unlabeled reel of 35mm black-and-white movie film. The film shows mild signs of degradation. When loaded into an appropriate film projector, most viewers report that the object produces no discernable images.

SCP-9920-1's anomalous properties manifest when viewed by a subject with strong thoughts on historical film. When an appropriate subject views a projection of SCP-9920-1 for the first time, they report that it shows a figure standing upright in a dimly-lit room, accompanied by low, droning audio. Descriptions of this figure are consistent with the reported appearance of SCP-9920-2. Viewers report that the film ends in a title card, reading “See you soon.” Repeated viewings of SCP-9920-1 produce no discernable images.
Mechanical Martin and the fall of Site-9

In the center of SCP-9921’s face are 2 advanced camera lenses which act as its source of vision. SCP-9921 has a speaker embedded in its mouth which it uses to communicate. SCP-9921 refers to itself as “Martin” and claims its reason for being constructed is to “comfort the depressed populace and inspire them to build a better world”. Conversations with SCP-9921 are often described as “pleasant” or “uplifting” as it actively encourages people to confide in it and offers advice or condolences to issues people are experiencing.

SCP-9921 was discovered on 01/11/1909 in the home of Edgar Roy, a deceased inventor previously living in Summerside, Prince Edward Island, Canada.

SCP-9922 refers to a set of antique opera glasses. SCP-9922's objective lenses have been rendered opaque, and focus wheel mechanism is permanently fixed in the maximally extended configuration. When pointed at an object, peering through SCP-9922 gives the effect of seeing the object from a short distance. This is not accomplished by the regular means of optical magnification via refracting incoming light; instead, SCP-9922 generates two circular spacetime anomalies precisely 41.5 centimeters away from the targeted point(s). Light which would normally pass through said anomalies is instantaneously transmitted to SCP-9922’s corresponding ocular lens.
Readers are advised to agnosticate before continuing.. AGNOSTICS: Bottled semantic disassociation. It'll teach your brain to swim and your feet to fly.

SCP-9924 is a two-meter-wide road made of packed dirt that exists on every continent on Earth. The dimensions and material of SCP-9924 are identical in each instance, regardless of the local soil composition. Changes made to one SCP-9924 instance are not reflected on the others, however any removal or manipulation of the material of SCP-9924 will be reversed if it goes unobserved for more than 30 seconds.

All instances of SCP-9924 enter an active state for 24 hours following an Omen Event. An Omen Event is defined as a major astronomical, social, or biological event at some place on Earth.

If an individual walks along SCP-9924 during an active period, they will be transported to SCP-9924-1.

SCP-9926 are a strain of pearls with anomalous psychoactive properties. Instances have been discovered in varying coloration, but among recently cultured specimens, lighter off-white colors are most common. SCP-9926 instances are typically trafficked under the pretense of transporting pearls. Due to the scale of the pearl trade, the Foundation has encountered significant difficulty in full containment.

The most common modern use of SCP-9926 is as a recreational substance that provides a sense of euphoria and functions as an aphrodisiac. However, jewelry made from SCP-9926 instances was popular prior to Foundation intervention and is still rarely produced and collected.

SCP-9927 refers to a soul presumed to belong to the 31st president of the United States, Herbert Clark Hoover. Based on the distances between ostensible sites of SCP-9927 activity in certain short spans of time, it is conceded that it inhabits an extradimensional space ("pocket dimension") designated SCP-9927-2 with some degree of physical access to baseline reality. While outside SCP-9927-2, SCP-9927 resembles Hoover as he appeared during his presidency.

On October 20th, 1964, former president Hoover fell into a coma in the Waldorf Astoria New York hotel where he had temporarily resided with his children. At this point, his consciousness split from his body, leaving him to expire within the next few hours.

SCP-9928 is an extradimensional space comprised of a singular, large cavern with an amphitheater at its center. This central structure appears to resemble Roman architecture, despite radiocarbon dating indicating SCP-9928 predates the style by several centuries.

The space was discovered on 13 June 1938 when CLIO-4 uncovered a document attesting the existence of a portal within Greig’s Caves that would “lead to the Lion’s Den”. The only known entryway to SCP-9928 would be found by Dr. Vivian Scout and MTF Alpha-43 (“Witch Hunters”) upon investigation. This entryway was comprised of the following pieces:
• A carved stone arch covered in complex, spiraling patterns;
• A large central hourglass filled with white sand.

SCP-9929 is an image derived through Project Kallinikos and a variant of SCP-2140. Individuals who view SCP-9929 become retroactively acausal. Such individuals become free from the bounds of linear time, acting as eternal concepts/motifs, and can often be found hundreds of years before they are born.

All individuals who have seen SCP-9929 are invariably inimical to the Foundation as well as all life on Earth. The reason for this is unknown, though several theories are suspected, further detail may be found in appendix 2.

Amnestic agents have been deployed worldwide. AIC filtering has reduced mentions of SCP-9930 by 96%. The enacting of worldwide censors on news and government organizations has prevented knowledge of the event from reaching wider public consciousness. SCP-9930 will be erased from humanity's collective record within the next year.

SCP-9931 is a series of pre-Anthropocene technofossils excavated from siltstone strata in the Scollard Formation at Alberta, Canada. Location of discovery extended a depth of 72.19 to 73.18 meters below surface, just under the Cretaceous–Paleogene boundary.

SCP-9931 violates the law of superposition. Reliable radiometric dating methods on SCP-9931 and layers of strata adjacent to discovery place both at an age of 66.46 million years BP; Despite this, the layers of strata are in order with the rest of the excavation site, showing no signs of a hole being excavated and filled back in.

SCP-∞ is a spatial-temporal anomaly affecting Foundation infrastructure, characterised by the progressive manifestation of sections of Site-∞ through a process of causal reversal.

Prior to an SCP-∞-𝑥 event, the affected area presents as though a large-scale explosive detonation has occurred. This includes widespread structural destruction and thermal damage consistent with a conventional blast event. Following the event, the environment begins a causal reversal in which the explosion and resulting physical damage are systematically undone, with debris reconstituting into a fully intact structure resembling areas of Site-∞.

SCP-9933 is an extradimensional spatial anomaly that morphs its physical geometry at a perfectly constant rate. Due to its design, it is immune to all known forms of time manipulation, including timeline resets or reality bending.

The anomaly is deterministic and follows an infinite series of unique shapes. Every second, the monitoring array measures the anomaly's current shape and cross-references with where it appears on the pre-calculated sequence. Using this and the constant rate of change, the computer can determine exactly how much time has elapsed.

Since this count cannot be altered by any reality benders, Foundation Standard Time (FST) is used by the anomalous community as the only objective method to measure time.

SCP-9934 refers to mayflies that emerge from the bodies of a portion of the human population after death.

No consistent pattern has been identified among persons that create SCP-9934 instances, however various trends have been identified. SCP-9934 is known to correlate with, though not be entirely dependant upon:
• Living or having been raised in conservative or religious environments, such as family or culture.
• Various negative psychological phenomena, such as depression, anxiety, and feelings of isolation throughout life.
• Not being a member of the LGBTQ+ community.

SCP-9935 is a baseball game between the Indianapolis Hoosiers and Washington Nationals that has been played continuously since it originally began on the 5th of October, 1889. As no rule exists that declares a baseball game concluded after a set period of time if the score is tied, and as neither team has broken the tie since the game began, it has run uninterrupted for over 135 years.

The unusual nature of the game in question has resulted in a region of altered temporal state surrounding the ball field that affects both the persons who inhabit the region, and persons from outside the region who cross into it.
Te h Me me Ma sh ine (c. 2016)

SCP-9937 is a wooden doorway, standing at 2m tall, 1m wide, and 13cm thick. It possesses a white coat of oil-based paint, as well as three knuckles of bronze hinges screwed into the inside of the frame.

When an individual walks through SCP-9937, they are transported to a room of variable size and appearance.The room possesses a puzzle or task for the individual to complete, as well as a large analog timer on the walls. The task changes with every separate instance of this room, as does the length of the timer, seemingly reflecting the difficulty of the task.

In addition, the room features a door, noted to be of similar size and shape to SCP-9937.

SCP-9938 was a concept that, prior to its excision from human consciousness on 18 May 2022 at 20:21:14 UTC, was common knowledge in almost all human societies and vital to the functioning of many. It is the first known major concept to disappear in this fashion, and has been tentatively designated as anomalous. While humans are still able to sense the literal content of SCP-9938, any attempts to interpret or apply the information will fail.

While any information that would clarify SCP-9938's contents is completely illegible, context clues have made certain inferences possible:
• SCP-9938 was applied to areas on Earth's surface, or else used in adjective form to describe things in/of those spaces.

SCP-9939 is a 5-meter-tall humanoid golem with iridescent eyes, made up of dirt, rock, and other minerals. Originally located at Site-228, it was moved to Site-19 because of the lack of space. SCP-9939 primarily consumes dirt, rock, and one live animal every two weeks.

SCP-9939 requires the iron in blood to keep itself alive. It is noted that SCP-9939 hunts by waiting and luring prey, a process that will result in SCP-9939 successfully consuming the blood of the prey in most cases. Additionally, SCP-9939 is capable of sensing heartbeats within 250 meters. SCP-9939 is also capable of reconstruction if destroyed.
Erotophobia: May the Emptiness Leave Me
You stare into oblivion until you can't help but look up. In the distance, you see the point where continuing to save yourself becomes worse than death.
SCP-9941 is a recurrent theological phenomena centered around Noseworking competitions. This event occurs in upwards of 0.17% of worldwide instances.
特殊收容措施： 9942已经以无法掩盖的形式对全球造成极其严重的冲击，各大国家以及异常组织皆遭重创。由于仍无有效措施解决项目本体，所以当前工作重心为根据末日预案采取一系列措施以维护外界稳定及应对灾难余波。基金会管理层的残部正在决议帷幕破碎后续事项。
I Would Have Made A Fool Of Myself

SCP-9943 is the collective designation given to a series of 35 craters, each designated SCP-9943-1. These take the form of a ring loosely distributed throughout the city center of Amritsar, Punjab, India. Each instance has the same 10-meter radius and a variable depth. Upon entering SCP-9943-1, the subject will be immediately propelled outward by an unknown force away from the center of the crater, reaching significant, non-lethal speeds. Thaumaturgic traces suggest an artificial origin of SCP-9943, though this remains uncertain.

SCP-9944 is a phenomenon in which global population numbers are consistently and egregiously reported as being higher than they actually are. As of writing, the global population is reported as approaching nine billion humans. In actuality, the Foundation estimates the true population as being no higher than four billion, and likely lower.

Despite this, global commerce continues as if it the population were true to SCP-9944.

The previously mentioned object is physically and biologically a non-anomalous ██-year-old female human (Homo sapiens) of ███████ descent. The retrieved object was first retrieved in 2009 from ███████████████, South Carolina, USA, following webcrawler reports of anomalous activity on "pariah███.███", a now inactive online forum advertised towards "misanthropes and social outcasts". The exact date and method of acquisition is currently unknown. As of yet, no non-Foundation documentation has been found to match such a person, likely due to the anomalous properties possessed by the object mentioned above. Continued search for such documentation is currently discouraged, due to the risk of discovering a name.

The Adventures of Xiaoyu and Xiaoyan

Only the 64 officially released episodes of SCP-9947 are permitted to remain publicly accessible. Television networks, children's programming channels, and major streaming services operating within the known affected region are to be monitored continuously for unauthorized SCP-9947 material. Any unauthorized episode detected is to be interrupted and removed from the relevant broadcast or streaming service as soon as possible.

Physical and digital media associated with the original 64 episodes may remain in public circulation. Any DVDs, promotional material, merchandise, or other media containing content from unreleased SCP-9947 episodes are to be confiscated and stored at Site-272.

SCP-9948 was a necrotic impingement on the local psychic field in and around the Republic of Ciskei, inducing mania, aggression, psychosis among the native populations, leading to the incitement of terrorism. It caused both auditory and visual hallucinations in the affected; subjects described a voice calling them to violence or revolt, and a female figure appearing at the edges of their vision. Though the majority of the afflicted were able to resist the anomalous effect, around 5% of those suffering were overcome by a compulsion to violence against local authorities, especially racialised violence targeting white individuals.

This resulted in a notable uptick in radical activity in and around the Republic.

SCP-9949 is a memory, present within an as-of-yet unknown proportion of the human population.

The exact content of SCP-9949 is hard to confirm, as subjects verified to 'hold' it show contradictions in certain sections of their testimony:
• 100% of subjects remember a space that is in nearly pitch darkness.
• 100% of subjects remember a human face in uncomfortably close proximity (Hereafter referred to as SCP-9949-1).
• 96% of subjects claim SCP-9949-1 is male.
• Consensus places the age of SCP-9949-1 between 50-80 years old.
• There is no consensus on the race of SCP-9949-1.
• 80% of subjects remember a strong smell of alcohol.
• 65% of subjects remember a strong smell of cigarettes.

Due to the sheer ideatic density of SCP-9950, full separation of its various related memeplexes from baseline reality, and thus proper containment, is infeasible. Current research is centered on the manufacturing of a hypothetical narritive space without the existence of SCP-9950, regardless of the logical impossibility of doing so within an SCP-9950-infected plane.

SCP-9951 is a difficulty setting found within Touhou Fuminkyou ~ Echoes of Insomnia (不眠響), a 2018 fan-made video game based on the larger Touhou Project series.

SCP-9951, presented as "Insomniac" difficulty, is entirely absent from the game’s code. The Touhou Fuminkyou development team similarly displayed nescience towards the game mode’s existence during Foundation interrogation.

SCP-9951 is not accessible through ordinary gameplay, and its activation requires the player to recite a spoken-word invocation while making visual contact with betobeto.jpg, an image file of a fan-created character downloaded alongside the game.
Researcher Tiffany Ortega presenting her winning catch during SCP-9952-06. September 5th, 2015.

SCP-9953 takes the form of a children's game, henceforth referred to as Ludus. It is a memetic construct expressed through children (age range: five to fourteen years). No person past the cutoff age has ever played, or been capable of learning the rules of, Ludus.

Ludus has no known origin. It appears to be attested on every inhabited continent and in every historical period for which usable records exist, with apparent fidelity across accounts.

Ludus sessions do not appear to be entirely random. When plotted chronologically, the confirmed locations of sessions show a continuous path across the Earth's surface, advancing at an average of 33 km per day (see Addendum 9953.5), including across open ocean.
Trace organic particulates detected. Uncontained biological anomaly detected in Module ██. Initiating atmospheric decompression cycle. Please stand by.

SCP-9955 was a previously unknown retrocausal Fifthist Sect known as the Fifth Congregational Church. The five cult leaders of SCP-9955 manipulated members of the inner circle in order to transfer Elan-Vital Energy (EVE) from one host of SCP-9955 to one healthy human subject knowledgeable in occultism and anomalous technology. When a non-cultist subject is within an estimated radius of 500 meters from SCP-9955, they will experience a psionic event within the next 24 hours. The subject will hallucinate being stalked by a cult leader and a hand with a relevant sin burned on its back.

SCP-9956-α is a fine anomalous powder released following the improper destruction or structural degradation of SCP-9956-1 specimens. The substance has also been documented following the complete biological collapse of individuals affected by advanced transformations.

Additional research shows that SCP-9956-α possesses weak luminescent properties, producing a subtle shimmer when suspended in the atmosphere or illuminated under dim lighting.

Short-term inhalation of SCP-9956-α has been associated with mild psychoactive effects, including emotional tranquility and temporary euphoria.

SCP-9957 is a 17" x 10" acrylic painting depicting a beach. The surface of the item is distinctly textured, indicating numerous (5,950,012,713) grains of sand. Viewing SCP-9957 triggers an episode of intense arithmomania in the observer.

SCP-9958 is an audio cassette, containing a 23 minute and 58 second long recording. The phrase "Oh, lost sheep blinded by false light, for you I shed my blood, for you I died" is written on the cassette with a white marker. SCP-9958 is a source of unique cognitohazards that are referred to as the "Words of Wisdom" by the entities related to the anomaly. Research into the specific nature of these cognitohazards is ongoing.
Restored image of SCP-9959 during Project Flying Saucer taken by Exterior Camera a2.

SCP-9960 is a parasitic cognitive entity capable of gradually inhabiting the consciousness of human subjects. SCP-9960 demonstrates a preference for individuals occupying positions of significant influence. Observed hosts include: Heads of State, Corporate Executives, Military Officials, Celebrities, Religious Leaders and Financial Authorities.

SCP-9960 appears capable of inhabiting only one individual at a time. Habitation periods range between 3 and 5 months before spontaneous departure occurs. The criteria governing host selection and departure, and its mechanisms, remain unknown. Early-stage infection is typically asymptomatic, as habitation progresses, subjects begin exhibiting substantial behavioral and neurological abnormalities.
SCP-9961 was a transformative event that affected Senior Researcher Charles Stafford (retroactively designated SCP-9961-1) during a New Year's Eve party at Site-76.

SCP-9962 is a phenomenon affecting secure instant messaging channels used by O5 Council members. The anomaly manifests itself as text messages from an individual claiming to be a member of a supposed "O6 Council". Despite numerous assessments from Foundation IT teams, the origin of SCP-9962 is still unknown.

this File describes an irregular SPRIG of VISCUM ALBUM; or EUROPEAN MISTLETOE. folk Tradition associates the PLANT with Fertility and Protection, which stands at odds with the fact that IT is a Parasite. VISCUM ALBUM thrives in the infestation of host Trees, draining their Sap and Nutrients while contributing little. it is no wonder that the FRUITS of such a malicious PLANT are poisonous, causing Cell death when ingested, among other Symptoms. there is also a popular Custom where any Man underneath the MISTLETOE should expect a Kiss from a Woman he meets under IT. in some Versions of this Custom, each Kiss coincides with plucking a BERRY off of the hanging PLANT, to cease once IT is barren.

SCP-9965 is the designation for a large, indeterminate species of terrestrial annelid. The morphology of SCP-9965 is largely identical to that of non-supernatural terrestrial annelids; Divergent aspects include an idiosyncratic radula specialized for its carnivorous diet. SCP-9965's mucus contains a strong paralyzing agent used to incapacitate prey. An additional anatomically correct human mouth is located between its eyestalks, possessing a full set of teeth, a functional tongue, uvula, and tonsils. The esophagus of this mouth leads directly into the cavity containing SCP-9965's brain, which is sometimes visible during speech and resembles a human child's.

SCP-9965 prefers to feed on adult humans.
Hermits we are, the shell suffocates our might. Alas, we allow the current to take us home.

SCP-9967 is a 30 x 26.7 cm painting, the back of which is signed "PoI-6770". The painting itself exhibits memetic properties, as viewing SCP-9967 triggers a severe form of dyscalculia in the observer, eliminating their ability to understand mathematics and practice number sense.

Brain scans of SCP-9967-1 before, during, and after exposure to SCP-9967 show the rapid development of acute abnormalities in the parietal cortex, particularly the intraparietal sulcus, which occur immediately upon viewing SCP-9967. Attempts to treat SCP-9967-1 with traditional forms of instruction and therapy have been unsuccessful.
SCP-9968 refers to species of animals consisting of anomalous edible plastic. Any shed fragments of SCP-9968 take twice as long as their non-anomalous counterparts to degrade in the environment.

SCP-9969 is a species of asexually-reproducing microscopic organisms resembling lizards living in human stomachs. SCP-9969 has a mutualistic relationship with humans, where humans provide a safe place for the species to live in, while SCP-9969 helps break down food brought into the stomach by passing it through their own bodies.

Instances of SCP-9969, known individually as SCP-9969-1, are unable to be detected by medical scans. After the death of a host, instances of SCP-9969 are briefly detectable as they enter their reproductive phase. There, they exit the host's body, implant within a food item, and divide into clones to await a new host.

SCP-9970 collectively refers to a string of murders that occurred at Camp Greenwood, in New Merilyn, New Hampshire, as well as the subsequent destruction of the camp itself.

As told in the story released to the public, five teenagers (SCP-9970-1 to SCP-9970-5) trespassed onto the campgrounds around midday on 4/12/1988. It is understood the group intended to stay at the camp, which had been closed to the public, for several days. However, that evening an unidentified individual (SCP-9970-6) ambushed the group, ritualistically hunting and executing each member. Following this, it is believed the individual set off some kind of reaction, triggering an explosion and burning down the camp. Emergency services arrived onto the scene not long after.
Bear the memories of them forgotten.

The object designated as SCP-9971-1 is a seemingly perfect replica of the Voyager II space probe launched by NASA in 1977. In August ██, 20██, SCP-9971-1 was discovered by the CNEOS Sentry program moving on a trajectory to intercept Earth. It was identified as Voyager II by NASA due to the radio transmissions originating from the object being identical to Voyager II's original transmission. Despite this, Voyager II was confirmed to still be in contact and on its original course. Agents embedded within NASA relayed this information to the Foundation, leading to an independent survey and retrieval of the probe before it entered Earth's atmosphere. After the object was brought into Foundation custody, it was taken to Site-██ to be examined.

SCP-9972 is a photograph of a sailboat at sea during a sunset. Prior to her disappearance, it was kept in the office of Researcher Jones.

Although no anomalous properties have yet been experimentally observed, it is hypothesized that SCP-9972 exerted an anomalous influence on Researcher Jones due to the number of delusions she held regarding it that could not be reconciled with the rest of her personality and belief system. These delusions included:
• That she had been to the location depicted in SCP-9972 as a child. Foundation records indicate that she was born in Nebraska and never left the state prior to her recruitment.
• That SCP-9972 depicts Heaven or a Heaven-like location beyond the material world. Researcher Jones was otherwise an atheist.

SCP-9973 is a Canon EOS 400D digital camera (manufactured 2006, serial number not present). When any photograph is taken of one or more living human beings, the resulting digital image depicts the subject(s) as a glossy plastic mannequin in the exact pose, lighting, and environment of the original scene. Background elements, non-living objects, and non-human lifeforms appear normally. Subjects are initially depicted wearing their original clothing.

When the same individual is photographed a significant number of times, progressive degradation begins to appear in subsequent images. The depicted mannequin gradually loses limbs, other body parts, and portions of its clothing. This degradation is cumulative and irreversible within the image record.

SCP-9974 is a stationary blender manufactured by Multi Pallet Appliances, a shell company formerly operated by the Multi-Coloured Coats.

When activated, SCP-9974 induces an immobilizing pain in all organic lifeforms within a radius of approximately 2kms. The sensation is equable to 'burning,' or a 'shredding.' Neurological scans indicates SCP-9974 remotely arouses the nociceptors without causing corresponding physical injury. Despite the absence of physical injury, exposure frequently results in significant psychological distress.

SCP-9975 was a PowerPoint (.pptm) choose-your-own-adventure styled game set inside Site-583. The game took up approximately 900 MB and had 937 slides. The PowerPoint had 6 characters the user could play as. Those include: D-class personnel, Researcher, MTF, Chaos Insurgency, SCP, and O5. However, to access additional characters, users were required to complete the main story in any way (since the entire PowerPoint contains 50 outcomes) as a D-class or MTF. Upon using SCP-9975, an individual corresponding to the role that was selected in SCP-9975 within the site was designated as SCP-9975-1 and entered a compelled state.

SCP-9976 is a collective intelligence controlling █% of the space debris currently orbiting the Earth, as well as an unknown number of artificial satellites. The overall composition of SCP-9976 is difficult to measure due to its widespread nature, many of its components being measured in nanometers, and SCP-9976's own attempts at obscuring itself.

SCP-9977 manifests itself through institutional language and belief systems that promote indefinite symptom management over resolution. It maintains itself through behavioral cycles and routines which result in propagation of a virulent, self-reinforcing ideological complex. Infected individuals externalize fault, defending their condition intransigently. Typically, affected subjects will seek out and join reinforcement communities, such as mutual support groups or internet forums, which promote self-identification with the supposed "chronic" illness.

SCP-9977 was formally identified in 1983, following a Foundation-wide audit of medical outcomes from various site infirmaries.

SCP-9978 is a collection of celestial objects distributed in the solar system, with a high concentration orbiting the planet Neptune. The exact number of fragments is unknown, with estimates ranging from ≈ 15 000 objects to ≈ 40 000 objects. When observed from earth-based telescopes, SCP-9978 fragments are indistinguishable from normal asteroids. Meteorites composed of SCP-9978 fragments constitute its primary vector of contamination, by infecting wildlife in the immediate vicinity of impact sites. Such infected local people and animals (designated SCP-9978-#) become secondary vectors that spread to other living beings through physical contact.

SCP-9981 is a radio broadcast in the ██-██ AM band, detectable on a five-kilometre stretch of beach between ██████ Point and █████ Point, on the southwestern coast of England. Each broadcast, which lasts between thirty seconds and five minutes, occurs at unpredictable intervals. Gaps between broadcasts vary, but are on average one week, with the shortest recorded interval being thirteen hours.

The transmission has a semantodissociative effect, causing the meaning of various forms of communication to become disjoined from their medium. This renders all storage devices ultimately unreliable, including the human brain.

Access to SCP-9982's containment chamber is restricted exclusively to authorized Foundation personnel. Interactive direct communication features associated with SCP-9982's internet access are to remain disabled at all times.
Do Not Look Inside The Box

SCP-9983 is an highly contagious cognitohazard and anti-meme, which extends its effects to any individual, instrument, or data which perceives or retains information regarding the anomaly. Any individual or piece of equipment which views or contains such information becomes an instance of SCP-9983-1.

The effects of SCP-9983-1 proceed in two stages. For the first 48 hours SCP-9983 infection is asymptomatic and undetectable, with the exception that human vectors will experience an intense urge to spread information regarding SCP-9983, an act which creates further SCP-9983-1 instances. After 48 hours, the person, object, or data will experience sudden and severe ontokinetic disruption and cease to exist.

SCP-9984 is a humanoid male of indeterminate age. SCP-9984 has suffered significant physical deterioration whilst in containment, becoming paralysed from the waist down.

SCP-9984 was captured in a raid of a Chaos Insurgency facility in 1973. It had previously been identified as a high-ranking member of a CI cell in Southern Mexico, and had taken part in a terrorist attack that terminated three Foundation personnel.

Since entering containment, SCP-9984 has shown a decrease in anti-Foundation sentiment. SCP-9984 no longer seems to hold any strong personal convictions at all.

SCP-9985 is a ██████ brand desktop computer, with a preloaded operating system named "StallOS" (designated SCP-9985-1), a Debian-based Operating system. The OS functions as a standard Linux machine; opening the "Staller.sh" file (designated SCP-9985-2) will result in an input menu appearing with the text "Please enter your delay:". Upon entering an upcoming event, the specified event will inevitably be delayed by various means; attempts to run events on schedule result in personnel being late, airplanes crashing, [DATA EXPUNGED]. SCP-9985-2 appears to only work on StallOS, and delays vary in time. Attempts to decompile SCP-9985-2 are ongoing; progress is limited by complex encryption.

SCP-9986 is a set of 32 standard aluminum soda cans with a capacity of 355ml (12oz). The cans are identified as “Liminal Limes,” originating from “Citric Liminality” in Nanaimo, BC. All 32 cans contain the same transparent lime colored carbonated liquid known as SCP-9986-1.

When ingested, SCP-9986-1 will cause the subject to revisit a specified memory that is consciously picked by the subject, with 100% accuracy in the exact events of the memory. Memories range between memorable events, life-changing moments, flashbacks to tragedies or specific days in history that the subject lived through.

The duration of these effects lasts a minimum of 30 seconds at a minimum dosage of 10ml, or up to 18 minutes at 350ml.
Keter: A White and Shining Fire

SCP-9987 is an entity of unknown origin resembling an adult human male in its mid-40s. SCP-9987 claims to be Francois Couperin "the Great", a French Baroque composer who lived from 1668 to 1733. SCP-9987 appeared aboard the FSS Hakim nine years into its mission, only months from reaching its destination at Location of Interest #223; it claims no knowledge of how it arrived on board.

SCP-9987 is approximately 180cm in height, weighing 76kg. It is pale-skinned, with blond hair that is in the process of balding, resembling surviving portraits of the historical Couperin. SCP-9987 has demonstrated an ability to speak fluent French, English and a wide variety of other languages, although it has trouble distinguishing between them.

When moved or otherwise disturbed by an outside force, Item/9988 is considered "irritated" and becomes at risk of leaving the dormant state. If the object is not immediately brought to rest and re-stabilized, it activates. "Activation" comprises the spontaneous appearance of an H/NS-class entity — hereafter Item/9988/β — from assorted tissue, bones, cartilage, and tendons, among other muscle materials, upright and vaguely resembling an extremely disfigured skin-less human being, with the original Item/9988 remaining as its left eye.

SCP-9989 is an anomalous chain of salps located approximately 19 km southeast of Point Nemo in the southern Pacific Ocean. While typical salps will generally float freely through open waters, SCP-9989 appears to be anchored at one end to a singular object further below, with the rest of the chain rising vertically from this point. SCP-9989’s upper end is located approximately 1,200 m below the ocean’s surface. Since its discovery, SCP-9989 has remained fixed in this location.

SCP-9991 is a mass-produced plush pendant, 15 cm in height, marketed as "Lapupu" from the "Creatures" series manufactured by Culture Shock. An estimated 50,000 instances were distributed prior to the halting of all production. Dissection shows a composition of vinyl, sherpa, and polyester fiberfill, with no mechanical or biological elements present.

The objects are capable of movement and can vocalize by repeating two syllables despite the absence of the required parts necessary for these functions. Instances have the ability to differentiate between the general public and Foundation staff. Multiple reports from child subjects claim witnessing instances rearranging household items and stealing food or small possessions.
When a Killer Falls Off the Face of the Earth…

SCP-9993 is a temporal disturbance traveling forwards in time at a rate 6 times faster than the normative temporal flow. SCP-9993 seems to be located spatially on northern Spain and will coincide with baseline temporality in 03/04/2014. Currently, SCP-9993 manifests as SCP-9993-1, a constant burst of tachyon, shtrums, and chronon particles manifesting in the future location of SCP-9993 that then disipates on the space all around it.

We Need To Talk About Parallel Universes

SCP-9995 is the 2008 video game Street King Racing. Developed by the Swedish video game developer Awe Arcade for Windows computers, SCP-9995 is a street racing game with 8 levels. Players compete against 7 AI-controlled opponents to complete 3 laps the fastest. Races do not end until the player's vehicle crosses the finish line.

SCP-9995's anomalous properties are currently poorly understood, but the virtual world of the video game appears to connect to an infinite number of parallel universes that can be accessed by means of various glitches or exploits.

SCP-9995-A are entities that inhabit the parallel universes within SCP-9995.

SCP-9997 is the former Shattered Land National Park and Preserve, covering approx. 245,000 acres of wilderness in southwestern Utah, U.S. At its peak, the park was considered one of the “Mighty Six” of the National Park System in Utah; it saw approx. 1.1 million visitors per year and housed three visitor centers, a park lodge, and 112 miles of hiking and backcountry trails.

SCP-9998 was a studio audience sitcom titled A Prince Among Men, broadcast on American television network NBC between 1994 and 1999 for five seasons. The series was created by David Harper, who served as the Executive Producer and Head Writer throughout its run, and was produced by NBC Productions in association with Warner Bros. Television Studios. The series revolved around Cornelius "Nell" Prince, a teenager from a wealthy, upper-class background who, as punishment for his comedic antics, is sent by his father to live with working class relatives in the Lower East Side, New York City. SCP-9998's anomalous attributes are detailed following an overview of its plot and production.
